scripts.say: It's the early hours of the morning, and Akashi has told me she has something important to discuss.
Good morning, nya. Good news, nya!
I have a new proposal for you – the Dorm Extension Project, nya!
I see. Is this the "important" thing you had to discuss?
Sure is, nya! The port has grown over the years, and we ought to build new homes to accommodate everyone, nya!
Conveniently, there was a disused factory that Ingraham demolished a while ago, nya. That has cleared up plenty of space, nya.
Wait, you're going to construct new buildings? I thought this was limited in scope to a renovation.
No, we're building from the ground up, nya. It's more profitable, nya.
(She's not even trying to hide her intentions.)
My vision is to create a place where shipgirls can be more comfortable than ever and enjoy the simple pleasures of everyday life, nya.
Combat and work both take a toll, nya. With a place to better rest and recover, they'll perform better than ever before, nya!
You have to agree it's a pretty good idea, nya.
Can't deny that. It'll help them work and fight with renewed vigor.
Exactly, nya. That's why each home should also be decorated to suit the occupant, nya.~
Each room is going to be tailor-made according to the inhabitant's tastes, nya!~
So basically, occupants can move in without packing their bags or anything.
That's precisely what I'm thinking, nya.
We CAN also build a private space exclusively for you if you want, nya.
For now, proceed with just this plan. Incidentally, when will the construction start?~
It can start right away, nya! Although, there's a catch, nya.
Given the port's resource stockpiles and technology, finishing the actual construction won't take very long...
But, relocating everyone at once isn't feasible, nya.
How come?
Designing and furnishing a home takes time, nya. Everyone could move in at the same time if we were making cookie-cutter homes, nya.
But we aren't, nya! I've already promised to provide every person with a unique residence, nya!
So, the girls will just have to wait for their turn and move in one at a time, nya.
Not ideal, but I suppose that's how it is.
Since we're doing it this way, it's important to decide who's moving in first. She'll provide valuable feedback on how it feels to live in this new dorm.
I've already picked someone, nya! One of the Royal Maids, nya.
(A Royal Maid? That's probably Belfast. She's the perfect candidate for a test run of the project.)
The office door opens, and a familiar face walks in.
Good afternoon, my honourable Master.
As your humble servant, I am truly honoured to be the first resident of the new dormitory.

options.content: Well, since you've already made up your mind...

scripts.say: There she is, nya. The blueprints for her personalized place are already done, so all you need to do is sign this, nya!
After mulling it over for just a moment, I put my signature on the documents.
I shall perform my duty with grace and live up to your expectations, my honourable Master!
One month later, in the office...
Commander, nya! The construction on the dorm extension is done and Sirius' room has been furnished, nya!
Naturally, the homes are all built with safe materials with no trace of formaldehyde or other harmful substances, nya. It's all up to standards, nya!
I... see... Hey, where's Sirius?
In her new home, waiting for you, nya! Go and speak to her, nya!
My honourable {dorm3d}, may I ask you a question?
Have you had any favourite foods lately? I was thinking I should... practice and get better at cooking.
Wait... By asking so directly, I've surrendered the opportunity to surprise you...
Umm... Please forget I asked anything.
Do you like the scent I've chosen today, my honourable {dorm3d}?
This aroma is meant to provide you with the most fulfilling sleep possible.
Won't you please stay here a little longer?
I wish to be by your side and serve you.
主人，您身为指挥官，因为工作方面的需要也游历过许多国家……
可以告诉Sirius，您眼中最美丽的风景在哪里吗？
Sirius会想办法让这里接近您记忆中的风景，这样您每次来也会觉得更惬意一些。
比起这个，我更好奇Sirius眼中最美的风景是什么？
是与您相处的每天，每个时刻。
只要您出现在Sirius的视线范围内，那对Sirius而言就是最美丽的风景。
Sirius……也有这么“肉麻”的时刻啊。
Sirius只是将心中的答案如实地传达给了您哦。
无论何时何地，只要您出现，您耀眼的光芒就会成为Sirius眼中最美丽也是最极致的风景。
请让我一直看着这样的风景和光芒……
也请让我永远永远，陪在您的身边——我骄傲的主人。

options.content: I might be interested in hearing about it.

scripts.say: Are you interested in sword maintenance?
Hmm... You probably won't get it if I explain everything with words. I'll show you how it's done next time.
The sharper the blade, the more care it needs.
If you treat your sword well, your sword will treat you well when it really matters.
It's kind of like... how you are to me...

options.content: Yeah. I got to see you.

scripts.say: You look quite happy today, my honourable {dorm3d}. Did something auspicious happen?
Oh gosh...
Nothing fills my day with joy more than getting to see you, too.
You mean this magazine?
It's the latest volume of Port Vogue, which is like a fashion mag...
I mean, we're not at the Academy anymore. Sometimes, I want to figure out my own personal style, y'know?
I bet you'll like it, too, honey.
Phew! I win so much more often when I game with you, honey.
Since you block their attacks so well, I can hit 'em with all I've got!
I never could've stood a chance without you!
Hm? Whatcha got there, honey?
You asked me for it recently, didn't you?
Oh! You mean the mixed fruit juice I loved back at the Academy?
Thank you so much!
You're so cool for remembering.
Let's drink the first glass together! Cheers to our memories!
Phew...
(Open the curtain.)
Urk... Too bright!
Enough pretending you're still asleep.
Hehe, caught me, huh? I've been waiting this whole time for you, honey!
*sigh*... I'm so tired. Honey, can we go to the cafeteria?
Sure. It's about time for lunch.
I wonder who's on duty today!
Do you ever end up on cooking duty?
Not normally... If you want me to, though, I could think about it.
Honey, there's something I want you to do for me.
Yeah?
What is it?
There's this scene in a movie I saw... Near the end, the girl runs up and hugs the boy by the window after school. I wanna try it.
Just imagine it...
Hehe, did it excite you as much as it does me?
What the...
Why'd you bring the drill plans over, honey?
Basically...
Aww, that's rough~ The indomitable Black Dragon will help you, though! Next time, bring something more fun!
Or else even I'll get mad at you...
{dorm3d}，{dorm3d}？
Hm...? You shouldn't be sleeping right now.
You came to hang out in my room, so no falling asleep alone!
Just looking at you is making me all... sleepy, too... *yaaawn*...
Oh, this coat? Hehe, pretty cool, right?
But it's no ordinary coat. Get this...
Back at the Academy, honor students would wear this baby up to the podium to give speeches.
I've always thought it was so cool since then.
Yeah, you're just as cool as back then... No, you're like 200% cooler now!
Wanna try my home cooking? Even when it comes to food, the Black Dragon is supreme!
I can even make Iris cuisine! It's just that cleaning up after kinda sucks...
Sounds like even the great Black Dragon has a weakness after all.
A weakness... Don't be silly! Either way, I know you'll take care of it for me!
Hey there, honey! You're just in time! Wanna watch a movie?
I just hit the climax of this thriller.
If you get scared, just snuggle up to my shoulder, and you'll be fine.
The indomitable Black Dragon will protect you!
Snacks? Heheh, you've asked just the girl!
I get it. It's nice to have a snack when you're watching TV or playing games, right?
If you can't spare a free hand, I'll feed you!
Open up. I just know you'll get addicted to my special buttered popcorn!
Honey, have you had enough water today?
Juice and coffee alone aren't enough!
Huh... You mean I have to drink as well? I'm kinda fine, though.
Ugh... Okay, if that's what it takes to get you to hydrate...
I'm honestly embarrassed that you're the one looking after me now.
Add a little cream here... Some raspberries to balance the flavor...
What are you making?
Perfect timing! Taste this for me, honey.
It's, uh... dizzyingly sweet...
I bet! This is my original recipe for... Honey? Honey?!
You're looking a little pale.
That's enough work for today. Let's grab some popcorn and watch a movie together!
Like they say, all work and no play makes me a dull girl!
It's okay. If there are any problems at work, we can think about them together!
Honey, help me cut this... Ack!
Show me your hand! Geez, you need to be more careful...
We gotta treat this, and fast! Actually, maybe we should go straight to the medical team?
It's just a scrape. Regular first aid will do just fine.
Are you sure? Ugh, I feel like I'm about to have a heart attack. Are you SURE you're okay?!
If you wanna hold hands, don't hesitate to try...
Here. My hand is available any time!
Is my palm hot?
Pssh... I think you're just imagining that... Haha.
Come to think of it, we don't talk about this much.
But for me, it's gotta be gangster flicks. Heheh, does that surprise you?
Bam! Right through your heart. Isn't that the coolest?
One, two... Jump!
Wow! Good thing you were here... I could've taken a bad tumble.
These new dance moves are a little hard, but I promise I'll master them for your sake!
*yaaawn*... I-I'm not sleeping!
I thought I'd get more time with you today if I got all the work done last night, so...
*sigh*... Let me just hold you for a while. I might doze off a little... Zzz...
Phew, I'm beat!
Honey, don't you think it's about time I get a reward?
Like, saaay... A date outside the port?
Hehe... I already know where I wanna go. You're gonna love it!
Where do I want to go?
There are lots of places, but... none of them are better than here.
This bustling port, the person I love...
That's the real Black Dragon's treasure!
Oh, you want to see that sapling we brought back a while back?
But if you beg, I guess I could think about it...
Haha, just kidding! I already moved it to the garden, and it's growing up great!
Let's go see it later!
Urgh... Too bitter. I just can't stand coffee...
You're working so hard, honey. There's no reason for me to stop before we finish.
But don't push yourself too much, okay? Take care of yourself.
You want to record stuff from our lives on video?
Ah! If you do, you'll see me thinking about you the whole time you're gone~
Honey, why not take a break? Right in your special seat!
I'm not that tired.
It'll already be too late when you start to feel it!
Okay, then.
Good. Here you go... Mwah! A soothing kiss for you. Do you like it?
New Jersey?
Huh? Honey, you're here...
...Was I drooling in my sleep?!
I was dreaming about eating this limited-edition ice cream, and then I heard a sound...
Why'd I wake up? Because you're more important than ice cream, duh!
Spending holidays on the sofa is a Union tradition. Come sit with me, honey!
Isn't it a little cramped?
Hehe, I think this is just the perfect level of closeness. After all...
Eep! Hey, don't do it so abruptly! But... if you like this, then...
If you and I fought...?
That's hardly worth answering! After all, we would never fight.
It's important to face problems head-on. We'll never give up on things and suffer alone.
So there's no need to worry about that!
Honey, you slept really soundly.
Hehe, I heard you sleep talking a lot!
Wanna know what you said?
Too bad, it's a secret! I remember all of it. Even if you didn't know you were saying it, I'll never forget!
Ugh, I can feel the low pressure...
Does it affect you, too?
A little. Seeing you so down makes me feel a little prickly.
I wish I could blow all this glum energy away with my cannons! Honey, don't you agree?
What am I proudest of?
Did you think I'd say "being the Black Dragon"?
Well, no. My proudest feat is... earning your love, honey!
That's what you like to hear, right? Hahaha, did your heart skip a beat?
Honey! Huggies!
New Jersey? What's gotten into you?
The internet says that people need a ton of hugs per week to maintain physical and mental health!
So I wanted to try that out... Heheh, you like it, don't you?
Where'd I put that DVD I borrowed...
Right here.
Thanks, honey! Mwah!
Hnnnh... The weather is great outside. How about we go jogging?
Of course, it's just an excuse to eat two more ice... I mean, umm, to maintain my health!
I can't be with you forever if I don't keep up my health, right?
Now, let's get going!
*sniffle*... Honey, it's been so long since I last cried...
I just know I'll regret it if I miss even a single moment with you...
...Hahaha! No, no! I'm just crying because of this onion!
There are lots of flowers outside my room this time of year. I picked a few on my way in.
Wanna make a flower arrangement together, honey?
Comman– I mean, honey...
It's so hot that I'm getting dizzy... Oh? *gulp, gulp*... Aah! Thanks for the fruit juice! I feel reborn!
Ah, d-don't come so close...
Stop sniffing meee!
Hmm... This is annoying.
I'm gonna have to ask for help.
New Jersey? What's with the yarn?
It's a present! More precisely, a present I'm in the middle of making.
It's not officially ready yet, but I swear, it'll warm you up better than the sun! Because it's a blessing from the Black Dragon herself!
Here you go, honey! Mulled wine with tangerine juice!
Hurry up and try it.
I'm curious how it tastes, too.
If it's good, then I might try it!
New Jersey?
Honey? Hmm... Wait a sec. Okay, now we're good!
What were you doing?
My makeup, of course! We may have made our oath, but I'm still not gonna let myself go!
I need to show you my prettiest and best self every day!
This movie's a little boring...
It's all cliché stuff. I'm amazed you can sit through the whole thing without complaining...
Honestly, I didn't like it, either. I only got through it because there was something else on my mind.
A-ahem... Then just watch me instead, since I'm the cutest girl ever!
The moon is pretty? No, no, no!
Ahem!
I'm way prettier than the moon, and I can actually look back at you, honey!
Hmm... My training results are improving lately! Very nice!
I think you're strong enough already.
Not at all! The Black Dragon has to be the strongest ever to protect you!
If I can get strong enough to kill any enemy in one blow, then that would give me so much more time with you.
Cats or dogs...
Cats are soothing to be around, but dogs are so fun and exciting.
Both of them fall just short, though, because I love bunnies!
In fact, I'm the bunny who's gonna hippity-hop into your heart! Is that what you like to hear?
My camera storage is getting full...
Have you gotten into photography, or something?
That's not it. I've just been keeping records of our time together!
Heheh, I can't have just Academy memories in there, after all.
Let's make many more good memories so we never have any regrets!
Another day, another mental conflict... Here goes!
Conflict? With who?
It's a war between the proactive New Jersey and the timid New Jersey, of course!
Okay. Who won?
Mwah! I dunno, who do you think?
Honey, do you know what day it is today?
Of course I do.
Good! I booked an awesome dinner for us! They have strawberry ice cream for dessert, too!
Let's have a wonderful night. Happy anniversary, honey!
Hmm... Hon– Actually, never mind.
What's up?
I saw this really cool thing for sale recently, but now that I think about it, I don't really need it.
Online shopping can be one slippery slope...
I'll beg you for something more meaningful instead!
I love you, honey! A thousand times! No, wait... Ten thousand? A hundred thousand? Actually, infinity!
What's going on?
I wanna confess to you! I want to make my love clear over and over again!
Our oath is eternal, and so is my love for you!
Honey, watch this! This spinny chair is so much fun!
Spinny spinny spinny spiiiiin!
...Whoa. When... did you get a clone...?
Two honeys' worth of love...
I'm getting giddy... Hehe, hehehe...
You look so mature and cool when you drink coffee!
Mm... If only I could stomach it.
You're plenty cute when you drink fruit juice.
Aww, honey. You're making me fall even deeper in love!
Hum hum hum♪ Such a good song. It's making me antsy...
Shall we dance and let out some of that nervous energy?
Hehe... You know just what I want, honey!
Don't look away from me, okay? I'm gonna knock your socks off!
Heheh! Check out this new cocktail-mixing trick I learned!
Shake shake! Rattle rattle!
Bam! Give it a try... Hmm? I can't get the top to open...
Whoa?! The shaker went flying!
This cake is delicious.
Right?! It's so fluffy and sweet!
But... Don't you want something even sweeter, honey? For example... Mwah!
How's that? Super sweet, right? Hehe!
My honourable {dorm3d}! Thanks to Belfast's assistance, I believe I have now cultivated some skill in cooking!
Having said that... whenever I practice by myself, I always end up feeling anxious.
I'm working on overcoming my anxiety! Furthermore, I'll try my hardest to one day make a meal worthy of your palate!
Oh, you went into your room and found it unusually clean? I actually deep-cleaned it for you.
I'll do anything to get into any place related to you, no matter what it takes...
{dorm3d} loves this... Doesn't love this...
I'm taking notes of everything you like.
All so I can serve you better♡
{dorm3d}... I happened to see you chatting with another girl for a long time.
You promised you'd come see ME today. Why are you seeing other girls?!
I'll need to punish you for that~
Punish me how?
By making you belong to me and me alone, of course♡
I thought I smelled something familiar. It was you, {dorm3d}!
*sniff*... Aah. That's the musk that drives me crazy...
I just wish it would get on me a little, so that I can always feel your presence...
I've been waiting all day for you, {dorm3d}. Is there anything you need from me? I do mean anything.
I have important work to do.
What work? I thought you'd already finished all of today's duties...
Or is there some other kind of "work" that needs to be done? Something only you and I can do alone, maybe?
Are you passing out rewards for our latest victory?
Let me guess... Is it a new outfit? Or new equipment?
I'll treasure any gift from you, of course.
But... I do want something a little more special. For example... A hug might do?
{dorm3d}, {dorm3d}, {dorm3d}... I miss you so, so much...
Huh? {dorm3d}, when did you get here?! Did my mantra work after all?
Wait... I smell another woman on you... Does this mean my dorm isn't your only option?!
I'd only choose you.
Phew... I almost thought I'd lost to another woman.
I'll work even harder to become your only option, my love♡
I occasionally find mysterious foods near you. When I do, I take it upon myself to dispose of them immediately.
You mustn't put such unhealthy things in your body!
If you do get hungry during work, try eating one of my delicious packed meals!
I'll make whatever food you desire. Just say the word!
I mended that shirt of yours that got torn during the last operation.
How did you get that?
I have many means of getting closer to you, and I do use them.
The shirt isn't all. I have lots of your things...
You found my diary, didn't you?
Are you worried I'll read it?
That's an odd thing to worry about. I only write about you in there, so frankly, I'd WANT you to read it.
Because now you'll know... just how much I think of you when you're gone♡
Are you having trouble finding your epaulette? Heehee, I know where it is.
But now that I've found it, I'm afraid it's part of my collection now.
If you want it back... Well, valuable collections are often kept in secret places.
I think you know where I mean. If you can find it, then it's all yours~
You've finally come to see me, {dorm3d}? I think I'm a bit sick... My body's all hot...
Let me feel your forehead.
Mm... That might not be enough.
I'll need a closer examination to have any hope of getting better. You can start anywhere♡
You look tired, dear. Lean on me and rest for a while.
Consider my body your pillow. My chest, my lap – use whatever you want~
I'll go for your lap.
I'm a little surprised... I hope it's soft enough for you to get ample rest.
Aww, you can't find your room key anywhere? No, you didn't lose it – I just borrowed it.
If you want it back, you might have to come search me.
Not there... Nope, not there, either... Aah! Are you just pretending you can't find it? What a little bully you are!
Perfect timing, {dorm3d}. I was just struggling over what to wear on our date.
Something preppy? Or a mature red dress? I have to choose carefully.
There are pests all over the place out there, and I don't want your eyes being stolen away from me.
Found you, {dorm3d}! Today, I won't let you leave my side for even a moment.
Last night, I had a dream where you forgot about me... We must not be spending enough time together!
I'd never forget you.
Yes, I understand~ You're too kind to me.
The last time you suffered from insomnia, I worried so much.
Knowing that you couldn't sleep, and I wasn't there for you... What a blunder on my part.
As such, I've recorded a piece of music to help lull you to sleep at night.
If you ever can't sleep, play it by your bedside. Or, of course, I wouldn't mind coming to see you!
Your lips look a little chapped. It must be this dry weather.
I'll moisturize them for you~
I don't use lip balm much.
Hehe, that's okay. I'll just apply it with my own lips... Kidding! I'll teach you.
I hear that, if you collect a loved one's belongings and put them in a special chest, you'll be inseparable.
So I prepared my own chest with lots of private things inside! Take good care of it, okay?
Don't worry about your things~ I already have plenty.
Just the person I was hoping to see! I'd like to show you a new dance I learned.
Also, what outfit would you like me to wear when I dance?
Everything you have is lovely.
Goodness, {dorm3d}... I'll do my best to live up to your expectations!
Did you come to my room just to stand around?
If you're not sure what to do, then why don't I give you a one-on-one lesson?
Make sure you stop by every night so we can really drill this lesson in...
The weather has been awfully dry lately... You seem a little uneasy, too.
I hear kissing has a calming effect. Why don't we give that a try?
What posture do you usually sleep in, dear?
On my stomach.
Then I'd better learn a new sleep position! Then I can be the perfect hug pillow for you.
I'm sorry... I didn't help much at all in today's battle!
You know what that means. Punishment time.
Huh? Is it what I'm imagining?
If it makes you happy, then I'm ready for anything!
Finally, you're awake... Your sleeping face is adorable, {dorm3d}.
Did we sleep together all night?
Are you playing dumb? You were so vigorous last night, though...
What do I mean? I mean your hugs were vigorous, of course! Though I would welcome you being vigorous in other ways...
I keep a record of every photograph of you and every word you've said to me.
That lets me feel your presence even on nights when you're not with me.
Putting a photo of you on my heart makes me feel like I'm really hugging you...
You can just hug me directly.
Huh... I-in that case, I'll hug you as hard as I can!
I heard recently that you can't truly own someone until you've done a certain something with them.
I'll wait patiently. Whenever you want it, I will be there.
I'm just dying to have complete ownership of you♥
You've worked so hard today, {dorm3d}. I've been waiting for you~
Your bath is ready, and I picked your favorite fragrance of body soap.
Should I bathe with you, or should I take care of you? Either way, I hope it's a wonderful time for you♥
Oops! I can't button the top of my blouse...
Want some help?
Y-you'll help me, {dorm3d}? Okay, give me your hand... Found it?
Hyah! {dorm3d}, I told you to button it, not unbutton it. But if it's me you want...
Then don't blame me for what happens~♥
I cooked a special dinner for you. Do you know why it's special?
Some new cooking method?
Wrong! What's special is the utensils I'll be using to serve the food.
I think you'll find my food even tastier... when you eat from a plate of my own making!
You look tired, {dorm3d}... Is anything wrong?
I'm exhausted from my daily duties...
If you're feeling stressed, then let me be your stress ball! Use me to blow off steam!
Caught you, {dorm3d}~
With this specially-sewn ribbon around you, you'll never be able to escape!
I do want to be fair, though, so you can tie me up any time you want.
About our next vacation... What if we went camping in the woods? Or would the beach be better?
Either way, I just want to be somewhere nobody can disturb us.
Then we can indulge in whatever fun we want without shame or worry of interruption♡
{dorm3d}! I have a special present for you today! Guess what it is.
Is it you?
Huh... You guessed so easily! Well, go ahead – open your gift!
I've read that exercising before bed is good for your health. We should do it together!
What exercise should we do? Whatever you'd like, of course.
At any rate, dear, my health is in your hands...
I made my own blend of moisturizing cream. It's great for keeping skin smooth and soft~
But there are some places I can't reach on my own...
May I help?
Aww, you're so sweet, {dorm3d}! I'd love that.
I've discovered a brilliant new way of using adhesive bandages! They're not just for covering wounds – they can be clothes, too!
See? With just three little bandages, you can put one here, one here, and then... one right here!
The thing is, I don't know how it'll look. Can you try being a model for me, {dorm3d}?
{dorm3d}, let's play red light, green light today!
Sounds like fun.
Red light! No moving, {dorm3d}!
Hehe, now, I think I'll just search you for a little while. Let's see if there's anything I can add to my collection...
I'm thinking of making a new dress, but alas, I've forgotten my three sizes.
And I lost my tape measure AGAIN... Can you measure me with your hands?
You'll need to get up close and personal to get the most accurate measurements.
I've been counting, {dorm3d}. You visited me one more time last month than you did this month.
You'll get three times the punishment for the one you missed... Make sure you do better next month, okay?
I changed out my bed sheets today and sewed a new pillowcase for you. Want to try it?
What if we break it in together?
Oh, did the same idea occur to you? That sounds wonderful!
Just the thought of lying down on a nice, soft pillow with you is enough to make me giddy!
As a thank-you for coming to visit so often, I put together an exclusive service for you.
Specifically, I'll do something for you every time you visit depending on your mood!
Of course, I'm happy to take any requests you have.
Whatever it might be... If you want it, I'll happily satisfy you.
I had a great idea. Let's roleplay for a little change of pace today!
It's exciting to think of how things might change if our relationship was different... Like if we were teacher and student for a day, or a nurse and her patient.
Do you really want that?
Let's try it! You never know what you might learn. Isn't the thought of it thrilling?
Phew... Today's battle has me a little tired...
Want a massage?
{dorm3d}... You would give ME a massage? I'd love that!
Right there... Push a little harder, please... Mm, ah... Aaahn... That feels good. I'm totally relaxed...
I learned the proper way to use a belt. First, we wrap it around me...
Then... We wrap the rest around you. Now we're tied together forever...
{dorm3d}, I found this really fun game. Can we play?
The rules are simple. We eat this chocolate stick from opposite ends, and whoever finishes it first wins...
That's right, take one end, and...
Mmmm... The chocolate on your lips is even tastier than the rest.
{dorm3d}, your breathing is a little ragged. Is something troubling you?
I'll measure your heart rate. Don't be nervous – I'll need to touch your skin directly...
Your body heat is rising so fast! Poor thing, you must be sick! You need to lie down and let me take care of you!
I feel a little bad for making you come over to visit all the time, but it isn't much easier to sneak into your room...
Wouldn't it save so much effort if we had our own house together?
Plus, it would give me much easier access to your personal belongings...
{dorm3d}, I'm going to leave a special mark on you♪
What kind of mark?
Come closer and find out... Mmmwah! Now you've been branded to show my ownership.
It's your turn now. Go on – anywhere is fine.
{dorm3d}~ {dorm3d}~ {dorm3d}~
Just calling you gets me trembling with excitement!
Every echo ripples through my body...
{dorm3d}, I so badly need you by my side forever and ever!
Your hands are a little cold... It's okay. I'll hold them for you.
My warmth, my heartbeat, my breath... I give them all to you, my dear~
If that isn't enough, then I'll warm you with my bosom.
Until you're forever imbued with my scent...
You're overworking yourself again, aren't you?
It's okay... Leave everything to me.
I'll wrap you up until all those annoying, needy voices fade away...
You like these little moments of peace, don't you? Heehee...
As long as I'm with you, my heart feels warm and fuzzy♡
I wouldn't even mind if everything but you and I disappeared.
A world just for the two of us, your eyes eternally on me...
This deep, passionate feeling... is my brand of love.
{dorm3d}~ You're unusually quiet today. Are you pondering how to express your bountiful love for me?
You don't need to say it. I'm always, always watching you, my dear...
Until you call my name...
Until your eyes see nothing but me...
You always open the door just before I knock. Your timing is impeccable.
Heehee. I'm simply very good at detecting your footsteps and your presence, {dorm3d}.
No, actually, perhaps we simply operate on the same wavelength.
My honourable {dorm3d}, if I may, I have a favour to ask of you. I wish to practice applying makeup. Would you mind helping me?

options.content: Really? I think you always look beautiful.

scripts.say: I've tried it myself over and over, but my skills aren't developing at all.
Thank you, but even so, I want to look MORE beautiful for you.
Let's start with applying lipstick, shall we?
Heheh! How do you like it? I decorated everything myself. Nice place to relax, don't you think?
Heehee... Surprised? I can tell from the look on your face.
I prepared it just for today. Come, I'll show you around.
...Ouch!
Urk... I stubbed my toe...
It's a trivial thing, but I really like this window.
Why? Well, see for yourself.
That's right. You can see the whole port. I can even get a view of the road leading there. Isn't it great?
...Huh? Do I get bored of seeing the same view every day?
You little... Never mind. Forget I said anything.
That potted plant in your office is lovely. It has pink leaves, doesn't it? Must be rare.
It's proof of their delicate nature. I think that's kind of endearing.
So I water it once in a while...
It just looked a little pitiful, that's all. Don't misunderstand me – I'm not THAT fond of it... Just a little.
"How to build your own aquarium," hm? So this is what the girls are into these days?
I think they admire the sea.
Admiration, hm?
Even if it's just a fleeting fantasy, that urge to keep the sea by your side...
...Heh. It's almost adorable.
Is there anything I'm particularly fond of? What an odd question.
I'm a greedy woman, you know. When I set my sights on something, it will be mine. Do you know what that means?
It means I never let go of what I like. Whether it be fine wine, or...
Hehe... Do you want to hear the rest?
On sunny days like today, I can feel the sea breeze from the port.
The breeze carries news, whispering all sorts of things to me.
Is this a god's privilege? Heh, not quite... I suppose it isn't truly news that the wind carries, but rather the echo of my own hopes and wishes.
For example, the hope that a certain someone will return to me...
I've noticed you hiding something behind your back... Is this some kind of childish surprise?
Show it to me. What could possibly be so... Hm? A plushie?
...Because it looks like me, with its soft body, short horns, and big head...? Is that how I look to you, Commander?
I'll be confiscating this. Best not let it sit in your office and undermine my authority.
You want it back? In that case... you'll have to trade me one that looks like you. It's only fair, isn't it?
You want me to tell you a story? This is sudden...
Ugh, don't look at me like that! Fine, fine, I'll tell you a story!
*sigh*... This is the story of the Witch of the Sea.
Legend has it that all who heard her singing would willingly sink into the abyss and stay by her side for all eternity.
Heehee, it's too late to cover your ears now, Commander.
You say you occasionally feel a strange pressure when we're together?
Isn't that natural? Who do you think I am, exactly? Wait... Why is it only occasionally?
It's only when I'm wearing shoes...? A-are you saying that I'm only intimidating because of my high heels?!
Hey! Get back here! Say it to my face, you!
Did you see that just now?
When you tried to pet that cat and scared it away?
Hmph. So you did.
This is only a minor setback...
Besides... If animals fear me, then it just proves that I have a powerful aura, no?
Don't look at me like that! I'm not sad at all... But you can't leave until I let your hand go, you hear me?!
These moments of peace are rare. It wouldn't be right to let them go to waste.
Excuse me? You want me to be your maid for the day? ...Because I did it last time?
What kind of nonsense... That was out of a sense of duty! Yes, duty! No other reason...
Don't look at me like that... Goodness...
Fine. N-next time you come over and spend the night... I'll think about it. That isn't a guarantee, though!
What's the matter? You've been staring at me for a while...
Huh? You want to feel my hair?
Maybe I'm spoiling you too much these days, letting you get carried away... H-hey, what do you think you're...
Ugh, you've made a mess of my hair... At least warn me next time.
"7 AM: sunrise at the beach. 8 AM: breakfast, sausages and beer a must..."
Hmm? Are these travel plans I spy? You know exactly what I like... Well done.
"6 PM: walk on the coast with the Commander, and if the vibes are right, do something romantic..."
...Huh?
Wait, how did you get a hold of that?! Give it back at once!
This movie again? You never get enough of it.
Well, it's more like...
...Why are you looking at me? You don't think I'm interested in this farce, do you?
But if it's what you want to do, then I suppose I'll just have to join you.
Haha... That part where she fell over was hilarious!
...Ahem! I mean, this plot is pure nonsense. How terrible this movie is!
Yeah... Sure, it's terrible.
A wound? On my hand? You must be seeing things. Nothing in the world can wound me.
Wait, don't touch that. It's not finished yet.
Is this...
It's just a scrap of cloth! Give it!
You never brought your doll to trade like I said, so... mine is all on its lonesome. I started to feel bad for her...
Ah... Never mind! I said nothing! Forget all of that!
Ngh... Ouch.
This morning, I was leaning out the window to pick up something that had fallen outside. In the end, I got stuck in the frame and couldn't get out.
My feet could barely touch the ground, and my hands were of no use... I'm amazed I managed to escape.
Th-thank you... It feels better now that you've massaged it. Hehe, very considerate. You have my praise.
What are you laughing at? You're not thinking of something rude right now, are you?
What if I said that you should just stay the night?
I'm understanding, though, and I know that you haven't finished work yet.
So, come back once you're done. For today... I'll allow you to stay with me as long as you please.
Heehee. Why not let me make a selfish demand or two once in a while?
Aren't you always like this?
Wha...?! H-have you always felt that way?!
If I knew you'd act like this, I never would've offered!
Those are some awful bags under your eyes.
Lately... *yawn*... I haven't been sleeping well. Even counting sheep doesn't work.
Counting sheep? Instead of pinning your hopes on that, you could've just asked me for help.
I can hardly bear the sight of you so haggard.
Come, lie down. Would you prefer the couch or my lap?
I have techniques that can soothe even the abyss... Today, you'll get to experience them.
Remember this favor.
Is that... a pocket watch? Are you thinking of doing something fishy again?
Hypnosis? Surely you don't think that's real. *sigh*... Hmph! Fine, I'll entertain your silly delusions!
I-I just have to stare at it, right? Such a thing could never work on...
...{dorm3d}...Everything's swaying...
Ägir? Can you hear me?
The pocket watch is glowing... Zzz...
Have you heard the stories about this dormitory?
It's one of the seven mysteries of the port: "footsteps in the night."
People hear them when the night is still.
Ah...! Did you hear that?!
Oh... Something just fell on the floor. I'm fine! I just... umm, I felt cold, so I needed your arm to block the breeze...
What's with this table full of snacks? You don't mean to eat all of this for lunch, do you?
...You want me to win the "secret item" for you? Well, you'd best understand that a few snacks won't be enough to win a favor from me.
Oh. You think I'm not confident that I can? You believe that I, Ägir, cannot defeat mere snacks?!
What's this one?
The legendary super-rare?!
Hah! Hahah! Just who do you think I am?! Luck is but another of my... Eep! Don't hug me out of nowhere!
As I was saying, the price of seeking my blessing is a heavy one.
But... we still have plenty of time, so you can take your time deciding what to offer me.
The stars? Why are you suddenly asking me about that?
I can navigate by the stars, yes... Surely you don't need me to teach you such basic skills.
Oh, astrology? That is popular around the port lately... If you really want to try it with me, I don't mind.
Umm, so I check this one and this one, close my eyes and pray, and then... look at the results... Hyah?!
I-it's nothing. There was no fortune for me... D-don't look at it!
Ägir, I have a question for you.
What is it? If you need something, then out with it.
Your smile looks awkward lately. Are you feeling unwell?
Awkward? Your rudeness knows no bounds! I-I practiced this in front of the mirror so many times...
Those fashion magazines said this was the prettiest curve... I should've known better than to believe them.
(I've been feeling her gaze on me a lot more lately... Am I just imagining it?)
Commander...
How have I never noticed how delectable you look?
Hahaha! Too cute! That little flinch just now stimulates my predatory instincts like nothing else ever has.
You should be honored to be chosen by the abyss. But be careful... or else you might just get devoured.
What is this? Hm? A paper airplane?
It... suits me? Y-you must be teasing me.
Oh, it flies so far... Ugh, this is infuriating. Mine are folded so much better. Why do they flip upside down as soon as I throw them?
Heheh, if you're so good at this, then...
Here. This stack of paper is all yours. Make paper airplanes out of it all! You fold, and I will inspect.
It's fitting, isn't it? If you can't finish them all, then your punishment is that you'll have to spend the whole night with me in this sea of paper.
You came at the perfect time. Shall we share a drink? My private collection isn't open to just anybody.
Isn't it amazing? This cold liquid holds such sweet, passionate flavors...
Drink up. All at once – don't go slower just to taste the flavor. Let it burn through your throat and into your heart, and then, you will never forget its taste.
Hahaha! Good, just like that! Don't worry, there's plenty more.
It'll be a while before you get used to this taste. We can just keep drinking, and drinking, and drinking.
What are you just standing there for? Sit.
You've come over plenty of times by now. How can you still be nervous?
Hm? That scent...
Something the matter?
Hehe... My scent is all over you now, isn't it?
*sniff*... So reassuring, just like always.
{dorm3d}, do you know the word "encroach"?
It's when you step flippantly into somebody else's space and act as you please, as YOU so often do.
Hehe, if you mean to encroach on my space...
Then it's only natural that I retaliate, no?
Don't struggle, now. Be calm... and accept my retaliation until I'm satisfied.
Great timing. I've just finished doing all of this paperwork for you.
You'd best be grateful. I used my own free time for your sake, after all.
Hm? You mean there's a letter mixed in? And the recipient is... you?
G-give it back! I don't know how that slipped in there... N-no, it's not mine...
...Give it back!
Ugh... My head is throbbing. I'm seeing double...
You got hungover that easily? Work on your drinking tolerance,{dorm3d}...
You just kept pouring me drinks...
Hmph. You're the one at fault for not knowing your limits and so easily falling under pressure.
But, magnanimous as I am, I will forgive this failure. Besides... you're clearly in no state to work today.
Come lean on me for a while. I'll take care of your day's work, so relax and fall asleep in my lap.
It bears repeating that your alarm clock is deafeningly loud. Even storms on the sea aren't this loud.
Sometimes, it's still hard for me to wake up.
Goodness... All you'd have to do is ask me to wake you up. Why go through the trouble of using an alarm clock?
I see how it is. From now on, I'll bear the task of being your personal alarm clock.
If I can be the first thing you see each morning... then I'll consider this cacophony my victory song.
A wish? How greedy. You already have the abyss's favor, yet you still demand more?
Very well. As long as you'll pay the price, I can grant any wish.
...Hm? That's not it? You want to fulfill MY wishes?
Hmph! You're bold, I'll give you that!
There's no taking that back now. This is a rare opportunity... Are you ready to witness my wish firsthand?
Your gaze has been wandering for a while now. Something on your mind?
Or... are you curious about that black fabric caught in my closet door?
You're not even hiding it, huh?
Heehee... What ever could you mean?
Do you want to know? If you do, then ask.
I could answer you, or I could just show you... Either way, I'd be happy to.
{dorm3d}, is work going well?
Oh... Still a little left, hm?
No particular reason. I was just thinking... When you leave, you won't be for my eyes only anymore.
Goodness, when did I become so stupidly childish? You have your work, and I have my duties... I know that.
But let me hold you for a while... It won't be long. Just for now...
I heard you put in for time off. Are you feeling ill?
I-I am not worried! I just worry that your work will be affected... Huh? You want to go out with me?
To a cat café...? Hey, you know animals don't like me! Why would you do something so mean?!
You want to go to a dog café... and a bird café, too?
F-fine! If you want to go SO badly, then I suppose I must! If anything goes wrong, you'd best rush to my aid!
Do you remember when you asked me if there's anything I particularly like?
It's fine if you don't. I wasn't certain then, but now, I am.
My answer is... Well, do you really want to know? Once you've heard it, there's no going back.
Heehee... Like I said, when I set my sights on something, it will be mine.
I'm never letting go of you again.
{dorm3d}——
Whoa, you really pounced on me. What's wrong? Wait... How much have you been drinking?
Does it matter? This is the fate of the hunted when they aren't constantly wary.
I warned you, didn't I? That you should be careful not to be devoured by me...
As suuuch... Heehee, it's all your fault. If you want to blame anyone, blame yourself for being vulnerable.
You're mine now. I'll taste you, from top to bottom.
What's that in your hand?
This? It's the port's newest fashion magazine!
What? Do you think it's unlike me to be fashionable?
Even I want to change my style sometimes. Staying the same forever is just boring, isn't it?
Hmm, this won't do... Nor will this.
What are you picking out?
Eep?! You scared me... Don't sneak up on me like that!
Umm, th-they're... s-swimsuits. There are a few that I like, but I wasn't sure which to choose...
Wouldn't it be better to try them on in-store?
Maybe so... Okay, then it's decided. Tomorrow, I'll go to pick one out in person! You will accompany me.
I won't take no for an answer, you understand?
The only things you can trust are fine wine and powerful foes.
Have a glass, {dorm3d}. This Federweißer is only available for a short time each year.
It's made from white grapes that haven't fully undergone fermentation...
It's lighter on the usual bitter taste of alcohol, with a rich, fruity aroma.
I'm sure you'd love it if you tried it.
Hmm? Is this a speech? Why are you looking at such things now?
I see... You want to learn what makes others' speeches so persuasive?
Hahaha! You are too cute, Commander... Believe me – the fact that you're standing here now is proof that you have charisma in spades.
The god of the sea never lies. My words are undeniable truth. You're "my" Commander, after all, so be a little more confident in yourself.
There are things that even I can't do.
What? You look so surprised... Did you think me omnipotent?
Huh? But aren't you?
Oh! Well, aren't you a sweet-talker...
I don't have a problem with admitting it. You wouldn't abandon me for my imperfections. That's why I feel so at ease with you.
However, you are going to witness every little thing I CAN do, okay? Heehee, I promise I won't disappoint.
*sigh*...
Why am I sighing? Hehe... It's your fault, actually.
Whenever you're not around, I feel this anxiety... Nothing I do makes it better.
Lately, even your presence doesn't do much to help it. You know why, don't you? Then I hope you'll take responsibility.
It's your fault... so it's up to you to fix it.
Skin care products are so compact these days. I run out in no time. I thought the set I bought would have everything I needed...
These are travel size. I'd be surprised if they lasted you more than a week.
Travel size? That's what they are?! O-of course I knew that!
Yeah... Yeah, I bought them on purpose! In case I needed to travel!
I'll pick some out for you next time.
O-oh... Very well. You do understand my preferences, I'm sure...
*yaaawn*...
Hm? Of course I yawn, too... What manner of being do you think I am?
I-it's cute? How dare you?! Do you always like to watch people letting their guard down?!
Never mind it... You already know I'd never let anybody else see me like this.
It's all your fault... that even I could relax my nerves...
Don't try to act like it isn't.
How do you plan to repay me for blessing you with my good fortune?
I know that look... Don't tell me you forgot!
Of course not!
Hmph! So you really remember? If you haven't decided yet, then I suppose I'll have to choose. It's better that I choose how you repay me anyway, isn't it?
Heheh, good fortune doesn't come cheap. We'll begin... tonight.
Do you see that column of cloud on the distant sea?
Yes... Those clouds bring storms. Have you ever seen one up close?
Hah! Changing course just for the sake of your companions? That does sound like you...
Still, always cautiously avoiding danger may leave you unprepared for when danger comes to you of its own accord. That would be terrible, now, wouldn't it?
I'll teach you. With hands that control the waves... I'll let you experience something even more intense and overwhelming than the strongest of storms.
A slice of whole-wheat bread...
Rich Limburger cheese spread amply on top...
With fried bacon and chopped vegetables piled high...
Behold! A nutritious Iron Blood breakfast!
Eat it, {dorm3d}. Let this god of the sea's ultimate creation conquer your tongue!
Are you going out now? Then take this with you.
Yes, your documents. But I put a little... lucky charm in with them.
I can't be with you all the time, but having the charm will give you enough good fortune to bring you back to me.
This little coin represents more than just good fortune, too...
Now, my {dorm3d}, I... I wish you... g-good luck.
Umm, Ägir? Don't move. Just listen.
You seem troubled. What's the matter? If there's something you need to say, then out with it.
There's a splinter in the chair behind you, and it's snagged on your...
What? Why are you whispering? I can't hear you.
...Your stockings. Which just tore.
Turn away! At once! And close your eyes, too!
If you tell anybody about this... I-I won't come and wake you up for three whole days!
I was starting to doze off while you were gone.
Now that you're here, I feel a surge of energy.
Should I feel honored?
Don't get carried away so easily...! Come closer...
Close enough that, even if I get sleepy, I can just lean on you.
Let's play a game. Whoever looks away first is the loser!
*sigh*... I lose again. Those eyes of yours are just unfair.
Fine – you win. Here. You may have the rest of the wine.
As punishment... you must drink all of it.
You look sleepy. Did I get you intoxicated in your dreams?
Do you need me to wake you up?
Very well. Now that I've seen this side of you... You may consider this sandwich a gift of mercy.
Now your stomach is mine, too.
Hm? Strange...
When I hear that slow rhythm, for some reason...
I can't help but want to dance with you... No, I'm not saying we should dance together.
I mean more... showing you the rhythm I feel...
Would you... like to see what I mean?
Say,{dorm3d}. Have you ever made a perfect swirl in your coffee cup?
Take a look at mine...
Do you like it? It's incredibly deep and fragrant...
Hmm... Maybe these are the sensations that you've given me.
I'd best savor them.
My honourable {dorm3d}, you seem to be rather listless. Your work must have taken a toll on you, I assume.
I know just the thing that could raise your spirits!
A bath! Bathing is the quickest way to relieve fatigue!
I shall prepare a bath for you right away! Let's start by undressing you!
I've noticed something – I've improved at a few things ever since I moved in here.
It's all because you've given me more opportunities to see you, my honourable {dorm3d}.
Really? How so?
For instance, I'm able to be with you for longer periods and I can respond to your requests immediately.
In that way, I believe that I'm on the path to improvement!

options.content: Is there something on your mind?

scripts.say: Is there something on your mind?s
Oh, um, I'm thinking about the clouds.

options.content: And what does your heart desire most?

scripts.say: I've been told that what a cloud looks like to you reflects what your heart desires above all else.
{dorm3d}... I think you already know the answer.

options.content: You being here for me is all I need.

scripts.say: {dorm3d}, you're always busy with something, so I'd like to make some vegetable juice to supplement your nutrient intake!
B-but... you must pay attention to your health.
Very well... Then I shall bolster your health with my own body!
Have I ever thought about restyling my hair, you ask?
I can't say I have. Short hair is simple to maintain and doesn't get in the way during combat.
Can't deny that.
Cutting down on time wasters in order to provide better service is compulsory for a maid.
I want to be at your side, ready to serve as long as possible, my honourable {dorm3d}.
My refrigerator has been quite cramped as of late – most of the space is occupied by ingredients.
Want me to get you a bigger one?
My honourable {dorm3d}... I would rather clear space by practicing cooking, and I'd like you to help with it.
{dorm3d}, could I ask for some of your time to help me practice my dancing skills?
Should you be left unsatisfied with just a dance, we can then jump right into–
Huh? Just a dance will be plenty? Oh... Well, alright!

options.content: I might be interested in hearing about it.

scripts.say: Are you interested in sword maintenance?
Hmm... You probably won't get it if I explain everything with words. I'll show you how it's done next time.
The sharper the blade, the more care it needs.
If you treat your sword well, your sword will treat you well when it really matters.
It's kind of like... how you are to me...
I borrowed a detective novel from the port's library. It's pretty interesting stuff.

options.content: I'm pretty sure the final murderer was...

scripts.say: Hm? Judging by that look... have you already read it? I see...
The detective's best friend – correct?
Your expression tells me my inference was right.
Heehee. I'm afraid your attempt to spoil me failed.
Akashi has been testing fireworks for a while now. Every night, the sky lights up with different patterns.
If you have some time, do you want to watch them with me later?
Tonight might be on too short notice...
Even if the fireworks are just for test purposes, watching them with you will be a lovely experience.
So, you have to build up the mood and all, you know?
Most importantly, I need to pick out a beautiful yukata first...
Huh? I'm been spending a lot more time in my quarters lately? Really?
Let's have a look at my schedule... Hmm... Yes, my time here has gone up by... 60%.
I want to spend time with you, so I adjusted my schedule accordingly.
On that note... haven't YOU been spending more time here, too?
I was walking through the street earlier, and the wind blew a strange flyer into my hands.

options.content: Who would make something like that?

scripts.say: It said things like, "Love potion" and, "Secure your lover in only three seconds."
I have no idea. We should look into it if needed.
I kept the flyer just in case. Should we order the potion and try it out?
Err, just as a follow-up investigation, I mean!
Sakawa suggested that I shoot a short video of a song and dance number.
I think she called it a "dance challenge."

options.content: Do you want to shoot the video?

scripts.say: She said she saw Guam sent it to you, so it might take off as a trend in the port in the future.
I'm not sure if my dance moves are that good...
But if you want me to, I'll give it my best shot.

options.content: Is it a special day or something?

scripts.say: I'll make a lavish full-course meal for you today. Hope you'll look forward to it.
No, not really. I just wanted to make it a little more memorable.
But... since you asked, we might as well make it official and dub this Surprise Day.
Every month on this day, I'll whip up some sort of surprise for you. How does that sound?
Commander, I picked out another movie. Don't worry, it's not a horror movie this time.
It's an acclaimed romance movie. It's, um... perfect for couples to watch. Or so they say.
Let's get comfy and give it a look later.
...Did you just call for me? Sorry, I was a bit distracted.
That's been happening a lot when I'm with you lately...
Just seeing you puts my heart at ease.
That makes me think about you, and my mind wanders...
What? You want to see me in idol mode on a regular day?
W-what a thing to ask... I was wondering what you were going to say...
But if that's what you want, then I see no reason not to.
Give me a minute to prepare, and I'll give you a special, private performance.
My schedule for this week?

options.content: I was hoping we could go out together, but I guess your schedule is packed?

scripts.say: Read a few books I borrowed, then follow up with some solo training...
G-go out together? In that case... I can postpone everything else for later.
You're my number one priority.
Maybe I should try a new hairpin...
I don't usually think about it much since I'm always focused on my training and work...

options.content: Go with the one you think looks nice.

scripts.say: Could you help me pick one, {dorm3d}?

options.content: What if I pick one you don't like?

scripts.say: But I want you to pick it for me...
Any hairpin you like, I'll almost definitely like as well.

options.content: I was just curious how you'd react to it.

scripts.say: {dorm3d}? Why are you calling my name out of nowhere?
I see... You wanted to see my expression, did you?
Well, you're free to call my name more often.
I'm always waiting for that moment – the moment when you call for me.
A dessert for me?
Umm... Sorry, I'm afraid I'll have to pass on it for now.
I've been eating too many sweets lately. Cutting down on sugar is one of the secrets to healthy skin, they say.
D-don't tell me it's "perfectly fine to eat"! You'll make my resolve waver with those words!
And please, no more tempting me with desserts from now on!
{dorm3d}, I just read my fortune, and it says my luck for today is great.
Logically speaking, I don't believe in fortunes, but I think it's fine to believe in their good message for the placebo effect.
It also says that spending time with your sweetheart will pass your luck on to them...
Please, {dorm3d}... always stay with me.
It's quiet. So quiet I can even hear the wind blowing.
I'm so lucky to get to enjoy this serenity together with you.
I hope all our days will be as peaceful and blissful as this one...
{dorm3d}，my recent training hasn't been yielding the results I hoped for.
I included extra training during my break time, but it hasn't had much effect.
Do you think you could help with my training?
All I need is for you to be nearby and watch... I feel like that would help me improve so much faster.
I'm working out breakfast, lunch, and dinner for tomorrow.
Is there anything in particular you want to eat?
I mean... you will be here tomorrow, won't you?
{dorm3d}，do you want me to clean your ears?
I picked up some tricks from my friends around the port, so I should have gotten better at it.
This time, I'd like you to lie on your back instead of your stomach.
But if you really want the other way... I suppose that's fine...
Isn't the Ferris wheel nice? You get a great view in a closed space with a person you like...

options.content: Do you wanna find out right now?

scripts.say: I wonder – what happens when you reach the peak together?
Umm... I'll take that to mean that you're also curious.
Let's ride one and find out. Later.
{dorm3d}，could you fill in this survey?
Don't worry, it's just for understanding your personal tastes.

options.content: Some of the questions seem a bit strange...
"What kind of women's swimsuits do you like"?

scripts.say: That way, I can do more things for you in our day-to-day life.
Ahem. Those are bonus questions.
What is happiness to you, {dorm3d}?
I see. Being with you in this moment is what happiness is to me, too.

options.content: I don't do it that often.

scripts.say: Do you exercise much, {dorm3d}?
Just as I imagined.
Doing regular, moderate exercise is very good for maintaining your health, you know.
If you find it hard to keep up on your own, why don't we exercise together?
{dorm3d}, do you want to watch another movie with me?
Alright. Let's pick out what to watch.
Ah, in fact, how about we have a weekly movie night?
We can forget about work, huddle up, and have a comfy, quiet time together.
Elegance is the flowers in this room, the breeze, and the birds out the window... All that's missing is the moon.

options.content: Good idea. Will the moon be out tonight?

scripts.say: Speaking of which, how about we go gaze at the moon tonight?
It should be, based on the weather. I'll, uh, prepare some drinks as well.
Who knows, maybe you'll look at the moon and tell me the magic words...
{dorm3d}, I can give you a massage if you're feeling tired.
Also, I've been reading up on massage techniques, and the book had a section on massages using your feet as well...
Y-you sure?! Would it be a bit too much... Also, I'm not as light as you may think.
But if that's what you want... I'll give it my best shot. So, uh, full-body?
There is a while to go until the next planned task. Get some rest, {dorm3d}.
I'll hammer out some long-term plans while you relax.
No, longer than that... They're plans for our future together. Just thinking about it makes me all giddy.

options.content: Didn't that just hit the market?

scripts.say: I saw that they installed a weightless sleep pod in the water park a while ago.
Yep. Apparently, it simulates a weightless environment that lets you sleep like a log.
That's what Lützow told me.
Well... What do you say we go and give it a try?
I checked the pod's dimensions, and it's big enough for both of us at the same time.
I've been reading a novel that came out recently.
It's mainly a story about romance, so it might not be up your alley...
Still, the author's prose is beautiful and brings something new to the tired and cliché romance genre.
I'm still in the middle of reading it, but if I finish it later tonight, I could read some of it to you before bed.
When night rolls around, I start getting weird thoughts that I usually wouldn't.
For instance, what would happen if I stopped being attractive?
What would happen? Would you get bored of me?
I knew you'd say that. I believe you...
Would you like some fruit? Or is there something else you want to eat?

options.content: What's this all of a sudden?

scripts.say: Anything you want, just let me know.
I did some self-reflection. Compared to others, I don't think I'm very proactive when it comes to you...
So I've decided I'm going to concentrate on you more from now on.
Ahem... And please don't mistake it for me being nosy!
I said I'd get you a surprise before, didn't I?
Well, this is what I have for you – an anything-you-want voucher.
This gives you the right to ask anything of me, but only once.
Yeah. This took a lot of courage on my part, so please think carefully about what you'll use it for!
Do you think I should tie this ribbon into a bow?
Variety is the spice of life, no?
Plus, I want to look fresh to you...
I found a recipe for a very good dessert, and I was hoping you could be my taste-tester.
The only problem is, it doesn't list exact amounts, it only says "a little."

options.content: Try putting it all in a bit at a time.

scripts.say: How much is "a little" supposed to be?
Yes, I suppose that's the only way. I'll give it a shot.
Hmm... You want to discuss love with me?
I've thought about it for ages. Love cannot be measured, it's uncertain, and it's filled with ups and downs...
Still, love is a wonderful thing. It turns even the most ordinary days into something special.
Don't you agree, {dorm3d}?

options.content: Is it a flu? You need to rest up!
I'll bring you some cough medicine!

scripts.say: My throat has been itchy for a couple of days now... *cough cough*... I feel worn out, too...
Mgh... Thank you.
You know, I feel better already just after hearing your voice.
You being by my side is the best cure I could ask for.
Have you given any thought to my idea of us exercising together?
It's for your own health, but I won't force you into anything. I know your work is already very exhausting.

options.content: Can we start with something simple?

scripts.say: How about we start with something simple? Then you won't have to worry that much.
How about... when you're processing paperwork, you lift a dumbbell with your free hand?
I'll sit by the side and make sure you don't hurt yourself.
I learned a little magic trick, {dorm3d}.
Close your eyes.
Heehee. You really fell for it.
I can't do magic, if you didn't already guess.
Something with the softness of a feather graces my lips, and I feel her breath on my cheek.
There are quite a lot of genuine maids around the port...
Still, some of us non-maids still dress up like maids on special occasions. Me included.
...Maybe I'm being too roundabout with this.
What I'm trying to say is, even though I'm not a real maid, I can still fulfill all your requests.
Nobody else will outdo me on that front.
I've actually been learning how to make tea for a while now.

options.content: It's good as long as you like it.

scripts.say: It might not be that trendy, but it's a lot of fun...
You think so? I'm glad to hear that.
I'd be happy to make tea for you once I've gotten a bit better.

options.content: Really? Let me give you a massage this time.

scripts.say: When I finally let my hair down, my built-up stress just hits me at once...
You will? Really?
Okay, um... Please do, in just a bit.
You want to know my secrets? I don't keep any secrets from you.
Who's my favorite person, you ask?
C-come on. Surely that isn't a secret to you?
If you want to hear the words, though, I'll say it as many times as you want.
It's you... You're my favorite person.
...You really liked the dango we had last time and want to know where I got them?
Actually... I made them myself. I've practiced the recipe a lot.
If you want that, would you like me to make some right now?
Maybe we could even... make them together?
It recently dawned on me how gorgeous the port looks at night.
Whenever we go for a late walk together, it feels like you and I are the only people left in the world.

options.content: I always enjoy our time alone together.

scripts.say: It's so quiet, so beautiful, so romantic... Oh, sorry, I'm being a little weird.
You do? Then how about we... go on another walk sometime soon?
{dorm3d}! If you've got a twittle bit of time, do you wanna tw-eat dinner with me?
...No, I can't pull it off. I sound like an oddball when I speak like this.

options.content: You don't sound like an oddball at all.

scripts.say: They say talking like this is "cute and trendy" – but it clearly isn't, right?
Huh? You really think so?
Well... Maybe I'll keep chirping like this a twittle longer.
{dorm3d}, I had a dream last night.
We were together, huddled up next to each other, and we stayed like that until the end of time.
I woke up feeling happy, and it didn't bother me that the dream ended.
After all, we're already moving toward that future, aren't we?
The waters are really clear here. What do you say we take a dip together?
Do you remember the warm-up exercises I taught you before?
Heehee. Well then, let's do some exercises together before we go in.
Just repeat after me, and please put in the effort.
{dorm3d}, there are tools for sand sculpting lying around.

options.content: Sure. Let's give it a shot.

scripts.say: While I'm definitely no sculpting artist, I do want to try it with you.
Great. I'll just get some things in order, then we'll start.
Let's hope the waves don't wash away our sculpture once it's done...
But even if that happens, the waves can't wash away our memories of making it together.
{dorm3d}, do you want to check out the shaved ice stall that just opened?

options.content: Any particular flavors you're keen on?

scripts.say: Nothing beats a cold treat on a hot day at the beach.
I want to try the strawberry-chocolate flavor. The sudachi flavor, too...
Why don't we decide when we get there? Let's go.
Don't you think this is the perfect mood for a walk?
It's quiet all around us, save for the sound of the waves... It's so relaxing.
Oh, uh... Let's hold hands as we go, then.
No risk of tripping now, right?
The coral reefs here are beautiful. It makes me want to put on some gear and go snorkeling.

options.content: Don't worry. I'll keep you safe from them.

scripts.say: Although, I might run into jellyfish... Those seem pretty dangerous.
How reliable! But really, if we WERE to run into jellyfish...
Then if anything, I should be the one to protect you. Heehee.
Don't you still have work to do, {dorm3d}?
Isn't chatting with me like this just a way to slack off?
It's so obvious from your reaction...
Let me handle your work. I'll help.
I've been thinking about tying up my hair.
With long hair like this, it's likely to hit you in the face if I turn around suddenly. Ahem...
Apropos nothing, what hairstyles do you like?
You don't need to answer now. We can see some hairstyle photos later.
(Something in this room smells different...)
{dorm3d}... Is there a smell in the air that's bothering you?
Ah. That's probably the smell of the new body soap I've started using.
You should use it, too.?
They say lovers should smell like each other, so...
...I-I didn't say anything!
{dorm3d}, do you want to watch a movie?
A movie about a terrifying monster that lives deep in the woods. How's that?
Ah, right... I forgot to ask if you even like horror movies.
How about you just choose the movie instead?
I'm happy to watch anything if it's with you.
I love the weather we're having today!
More specifically, I love the weather when I'm with you, {dorm3d}.
Rainy and sunny weather are both excellent in my eyes as long as you're by my side!
Do you ever feel disappointed when you miss the sunset?
Miss... the sunset? Is it a shame that you're missing out on the beauty of it? I'm not sure I understand.
Are you saying that you miss seeing the transition from dusk to night, so the line between days blurs?
In that case, I shall help you with your papers every day from now on so you may finish your work sooner!
Whatever you wish for, I strive to make come true!
{dorm3d}, do you know how adzuki beans are meant to be prepared? Whatever I do, they always turn out hard.
Why are you suddenly invested in cooking with those beans?
Well, I've heard that the Sakura Empire has a custom of eating "sekihan" – rice made with adzuki beans – on special occasions.
Therefore, I've been trying to learn how to cook them.
...It's too advanced for me, you say? Oh no... I'm being overambitious again, aren't I?
*stares maidly*

options.content: Is there something on my face?

scripts.say: I feel like Sirius is staring at me intently.
Oh, um... It's nothing.
It's just that I find myself gazing in awe at you, even though your looks should be burned into my memory...

options.content: That's actually the same thing I was thinking.

scripts.say: {dorm3d}, could I ask you to take a picture with me?
Thank you, my kind {dorm3d}!
This way, I can always look at myself snuggled up against you, reveling in happiness... Heehee.
Is there anything you'd like to talk about, {dorm3d}?
Of course. Let's talk love.
...Is what you're hoping I'm going to say, isn't it?
Y-you've seen right through me! Yes, you're entirely correct
Should you ever be in the mood to talk about love... I will be ready.
My favourite thing?
Of course, my favourite thing would have to be you, {dorm3d}.
Err, that didn't sound right! I didn't mean to make it sound like you're an object!
Let's just retroactively change the question to, "who's my favourite person," please...
You'd like to hear some ghost stories from the Royal Islands?
Hmm... There's tales of old ghosts appearing in theatres, and the bones of the dead being buried in the walls of hotels. I assume that's what you're asking for.
In my opinion, ghosts and other supernatural phenomena are all the same.
Should they, or anyone else try to attack you, I will dispatch them no differently!
You're wondering if I can sing?
Well... I can't say I'm very good at it, but I've also never really had time for it.
Then let's go sing karaoke when we have time, you and I.
Really?! But then... it would be just us two inside a small room...
My honourable {dorm3d}, I can think of no greater honour than receiving singing lessons from you.
{dorm3d}, do you like cream puffs? I think if nothing else, I've learned how not to screw those up!
Wait, aren't cream puffs pretty tricky to make? Have you already learned how to?
Pardon? I thought making cream puffs only entailed squeezing the cream out?
How do you like living here?
It's a fantastic place, made all the better by the fact I get to see you and be alone with you much more than before. I'm very happy here.
There is one drawback, however.
What would that be?
Well... That I can't serve you at night, like I can at your office.
With {dorm3d} in the dorm... Anchorage is so happy!
Are you happy, {dorm3d}...?
Yaaay! Anchorage and {dorm3d}... Two of us, three times as happy!
{dorm3d}, Anchorage made a wish... to see you!
My dream came true... Was it magic?
Anchorage also wants... to make a wish for you, too!
One and one make one... Two and two are four... Three and three are, um... {dorm3d}...
Anchorage doesn't understand... Teach me...
With you here, Anchorage can get smarter!
Anchorage... read a book!
It says... {dorm3d}s like good kids...!
Anchorage... is a good girl!！
{dorm3d}... Like me more!
That weird cloud in the sky... It looks like you, {dorm3d}!
How...?
Hmm... Umm...
I know! It's big... like you! Hehe...
Recess time...! {dorm3d}, let's take a break... in the dorm!
Anchorage will give you tasty desserts...!
Oh, Anchorage can't... make desserts... Sorry, {dorm3d}...
But they're good...! Try them...!
Anchorage... had a great idea!
Huh... What was it? I forgot...
{dorm3d}... Give me headpats! It might... help me remember...!
Headpats for Anchorage...! {dorm3d}!
Anchorage planted... little seeds!
What will grow...?
Sweet candy? Big veggies...?
Hmm... Maybe even a picture book!
When it grows... Anchorage will tell you first, {dorm3d}!
Anchorage is tired... I'll sleep against you, {dorm3d}!
{dorm3d} is warm... Feels nice... Perfect for sleep!
Together with {dorm3d}... Anchorage is energetic!
Anchorage and {dorm3d}... Together forever!
Today's wind... feels good!
Anchorage... wants to go on a picnic!
With {dorm3d}! Bring lots of snacks!
{dorm3d}, snacks, the wind... All of them make me happy!
Hop, hop! Anchorage is a bunny!
{dorm3d}, is bunny Anchorage cute...? Say it!
Hehe, I love you, {dorm3d}...!
So happy... Anchorage will be even more of a good girl than ever!
Anchorage doesn't understand much...
Except for what {dorm3d} says... I understand that!
{dorm3d} is nice... and helps me learn lots!
{dorm3d} and Anchorage... go really well together!
Anchorage drew... a picture! A picture of {dorm3d}!
Your hands... are warm and big! They give me hugs...
Your eyes... are serious! They look like they know everything...!

options.content: I don't know if I like the sound of this...

scripts.say: And your legs... help you run really fast!
Hmm... Anchorage isn't done drawing yet! Later... I'll show you!
Your work looks hard, {dorm3d}... Anchorage wants to help!
I'll work... instead of you! You rest!
But the hard stuff is too much... Easy ones are okay, though!
Umm, hmm... Mail? Where-house? Let's... empty it all!
No! Stop!
Weather forecast... Weird! How do they know... what will happen tomorrow?
…Can they... see the future?
I explain how weather forecasting works to Anchorage.
That's hard... {dorm3d}, do you know tomorrow's weather?
If you do... then I'll ask you!
Hehe~ Anchorage is so smart!

{dorm3d} loves Anchorage!

scripts.say: Hm...? Anchorage doesn't understand!

I'll find the seven starry balls... and make {dorm3d} a fairy tale prince!

I'm lucky! You can be lucky, too! Here, clover!

Make a four-leaf clover! We get to have... four times the happiness!

{dorm3d}, rub my back...!

{dorm3d}, come do ex-er-shun with Anchorage... to learn together!
*pant* *pant*... Tired... Oh! {dorm3d}!

options.content: Did you forget to tie them?

scripts.say: Hmm, this is hard...

But there's still... a lot of time in the day for us!
{dorm3d}, are there flower fields around here?
Anchorage wants to make a wreath! And give it... to you!
What kind of flowers would suit you? Something that smells... warm and fresh?
Or... some other smell... Anchorage doesn't know...
It's okay! There must be a special flower... perfect for {dorm3d}!
Chocolate sauce tastes good! Sweet and a little bitter... but delicious!
It gets all over me... but I wanna eat it!
Cleaning is hard... {dorm3d}, help Anchorage!
Anchorage... likes happy songs!
Singing is happy! {dorm3d}... happy, too!
When {dorm3d} is sad... Anchorage will sing for you!
{dorm3d}... What makes you happy? Or sad?
Where do you eat? How do you feel...?

Anchorage is a good girl...!

{dorm3d} is spacing out... Noted...
{dorm3d} is speaking to Anchorage... Noted...

But... what if I forget to write it down?
One {dorm3d}... One Anchorage...
Anchorage... is counting!
There's one {dorm3d}, and there's one Anchorage...
So if you put them together... The answer is...
Together forever!

{dorm3d}... Is today your day off work...? Yay!

Warm and fun... And outside, you can see the stars!
{dorm3d} taught Anchorage about the stars... The Summer... Triangle! Polaris!
All with Anchorage! Hehe!

The first pose is, umm...
Hmm... I forgot...

It's giving {dorm3d}... a big hug!
{dorm3d}, do you think Anchorage is dumb...?

But I'll do my best... for you!
As long as you're here... Anchorage can do anything...!
Paper bunny! I gave you one... as a present before!

{dorm3d}... Are you busy today?

Yay... Anchorage is so happy...!

{dorm3d}... will save Anchorage! Yay! Hehe...

More stories of Anchorage and {dorm3d}!
{dorm3d}... Let's go take a walk... on the beach!
Anchorage wants to play... in the water with you...

{dorm3d}... Camping on the beach...
Anchorage wants to try it!
Hehe~ At night... We can look at the stars...
Anchorage will protect you, too... Yeah!
