options.content: Then how about we go get tools together?

scripts.say: I'll go catch some fish... and make seafood!
Okay...! With {dorm3d}, hehe...
Anchorage is happy...!
{dorm3d}... Morning... Run together!
You wanna go for a jog with me?
Yeah...! Running together with {dorm3d}!
If you get tired... I'll carry you piggyback... and keep going!
{dorm3d}... I heard there are starfish here...! Let's look together...!
Anchorage... will try hard to find them... as a present for you!
A surprise for {dorm3d}...!
Aww... I said it... Now it's not a surprise anymore...
I heard a rainbow appeared after it rained yesterday, but I was cleaning my quarters at the time and didn't get a chance to see it...
My acquaintances have told me that if you make a wish to a rainbow, it'll probably come true. What a shame I missed it...
Maybe making a wish to a PICTURE of a rainbow works the same. Wanna try it?
Yes, please! I wish for you and I to...
Oh, wait, my wish won't come true if I say it out loud... Apologies, but I'll have to keep my wish a secret.
On the topic of photographs, I've noticed you take quite a lot of pictures of me.
If you don't mind, I'd like to take a lot of you as well.
I want to build a vast collection of pictures of you, my dear, precious {dorm3d}...
Then I will treasure them forever and ever.
While Sirius and I are chatting away, I carelessly let a yawn slip through.
Do you wish to lie down, {dorm3d}? Please don't be hesitant to inform me whenever you do.
You'll be greeted by fresh linen sheets, soft pillows... and a maid fully ready for you!
And, of course, if you need help falling asleep, I can read you a story or clean your ears. I can also...
Huh? You don't need any of that? I-I shouldn't have made such hasty assumptions...
Do you want to go outside?

options.content: No, I just want to get some fresh air with you.
I just want to spend some time outdoors with you.

scripts.say: I will gladly accompany you, my honourable {dorm3d}! You aren't, um... feeling bored, are you?
So what you're requesting then is... a date? Understood. I will do my best to give you an unforgettable experience❤
Do you have a favorite music genre?
No. In fact, I don't really get much time to sit down and listen to music.
Therefore, I don't have any particular likes or dislikes when it comes to music.
Or, rather, I should say that my favourite kind of music is the sound of your voice when you want to know more about me!

options.content: Subjects other than cooking? Like what?

scripts.say: I've been reading books on subjects other than cooking lately.
Well, almost solely romance magazines and novels.
While I am content with simply serving as your maid... I'm selfish, and I wish to read more about this subject.
I hope you will soon bear witness to my personal growth, my honourable {dorm3d}.
Hmm-hm-hmm♪
I am. My heart is racing now that we're alone with each other. In fact, I was thinking we could–
Huh? You're not in the mood for that?
If it gets any colder, it's going to be a struggle to get out of bed and get to work...
Oh. It appears that you're suffering from a kind of hypersomnia that manifests as the temperature drops, {dorm3d}.
The next time you experience the symptoms, please allow me to be by your side for the whole night!
Then, should you oversleep, I will be there to wake you up.
Do you feel like going for a hot spring bath?
Hm? Are you planning on going to a spa, my honourable {dorm3d}?
Then I'd better not waste any time!
Since you came up with this idea, I will come with you right away!

options.content: Is there anything you could use?

scripts.say: (Sirius hasn't asked for anything for a while now. I should ask about that.)
I truly, truly appreciate your consideration, my honourable {dorm3d}. However, I don't need anything at the moment.
I am content simply to live here and have the privilege of serving you.
Oh? What is that comb for, {dorm3d}? Are you going to graciously comb my hair?
Judging by your expression... was my reaction to that a bit too surprising?
Well, um... I've heard some stories about combing hair from my friends in the Dragon Empery, and...
N-never mind! Please go ahead and comb my hair, my honourable {dorm3d}!
My honourable {dorm3d}, please hold still.
You have such beautiful eyes.
And your pupils, your gaze... I find myself getting lost in them.
Please close your eyes and let me mark the start of a new day with a small gesture.
I feel the grace of a gentle kiss on my cheek.
I used to be an ordinary maid, happy with just being by your side and serving you...
Now, though, as our relationship deepens... I'm becoming increasingly selfish.
Thank you, my honourable {dorm3d} – for changing me.
Was it a good change, though?
I'm not sure, myself... However, I do know that I can no longer be without you.
{dorm3d}, you appear to be feeling hot. Shall I help you bring down your temperature?
How?

options.content: Won't I catch a cold from that?

scripts.say: First, I'll need to take off your clothes, then I will dry your body with an ice cube wrapped in a towel.
Not at all! If you're worried about a cold, don't be. If you catch one, I will keep your body warm with my own!
Liverpool asked me earlier what would happen if you couldn't find me after you tried to contact me, seeing as I don't use my cellphone much.
I thought about it for a bit, and I came to the conclusion that there will never be a time when I'm not there for you.
In fact, if you'll let me, I can be by your side around the clock! I will never let you feel lonely for even an instant!
When did I start harbouring affection toward you, you ask?
To tell the truth, it started the moment I first laid eyes on you.

options.content: It just dawned on me one day.

scripts.say: What about you, {dorm3d}? How long have you felt this way about me?
I wasn't expecting to hear an answer... I am truly overjoyed, my honourable {dorm3d}.
{dorm3d}, I've given the carpet a thorough cleaning. It should be comfortable to sit and relax on from time to time.
N-naturally, if you ever wish to do it with me on the carpet... I certainly wouldn't mind!
My honourable {dorm3d}...
What's the matter?
Oh! My apologies! My inner thoughts leaked out while I was looking at you...
I've been serving you for such a long time, and yet, I still yearn for your attention...
I don't know whether to call myself selfish, or profess how profoundly happy I am...
I found a few detective novels on the bookcase whilst I was cleaning your office the other day.

options.content: I could read one of them to you.

scripts.say: The cases sound interesting, but I'm afraid I haven't really read much from this genre.
In that case, perhaps we could make a habit out of reading a detective novel before bedtime?
Then you won't turn down my request again, will you? Heehee.
My honourable {dorm3d}, is there anywhere you'd like to go on holiday when you're done with your work one day?
I don't know what to say... I'm truly happy to hear those words from you, {dorm3d}.
Even if that day may never come, I will remain by your side forever and ever.
The Dragon Empery has a dish called "duo jiao yu tou," which is fish head with chopped peppers, and the Royal Islands are traditionally a nation that loves fish...
So what I want to try is to incorporate the flavour of chopped peppers into stargazy pie. What do you think of that idea?
That it does... However, I will still try my best!
R-really? Of course – I can always count on you to support me, {dorm3d}!
{dorm3d}, out of all the places you've been, which did you think was the most beautiful?
I will do everything I can to make this place look as close as possible to what that was. This should make it more pleasant for you every time you visit me.
Forget about me – what's the most beautiful place YOU'VE been to?
That place is a moment in time – every moment of every day spent by your side.
No matter the time, no matter the place, your light makes everything look like the most beautiful thing I've ever seen.
My honourable {dorm3d}, your face is flushed... Are you suffering from sunburn?
Please, you need to protect against the sun!
I will accompany you around holding this parasol! Also, allow me to apply suncream to you.
Let me take care of your body for you!
Would you like to go surfing with me, {dorm3d}?
It's okay if you're not the best at it. I'm not very good, myself. What matters is that we both have fun!
This way, we can be together more...
And perhaps we can even get a little physical...
{dorm3d}, would you like to have a nighttime barbeque?
I saw you were interested in the idea, so I went and got some ingredients!
Let me help you with those.
That won't be necessary. Allow me to handle it while you rest and relax.
I've worked hard to improve my cooking! I'm sure it will go fine!

options.content: Are you going to wear it?
Are you going to start a necklace collection?

scripts.say: Look, {dorm3d}. I made this necklace out of the seashells we gathered.
Oh, um... I was actually thinking about displaying it as a decoration in my quarters.
Just seeing it will remind me of the time we spent gathering all these seashells today.
{dorm3d}, it's sweltering today. Shall we have some ice cream to cool off?
I like the sound of that.
Excellent. Would you like me to feed the ice cream to you?
Or... would you rather share a single ice cream with me?
You look tired, my honourable Master.
While I am proud of you for withstanding fatigue...
I must ask that you not force yourself so.
Take a moment and come to me, if you please.
You may rest peacefully in my lap, Master.
My honourable Master, would you like coffee? I'll prepare a cup at once.
Hmm. My spare coffee beans were over here... Oh? The pantry is empty.
I'm so sorry! I must be out of coffee beans.
Master... I-if it does not offend, may I offer you canned coffee...?
I'll heat it carefully so that you don't have to suffer the cold!
Greetings, my honourable Master.
Hm? You look tired... Allow me to remedy this.
I've already brewed a pot of coffee to help refresh you. I was simply waiting for you to say the word...
Eh? You want to rest with me for a moment first?
Understood, Master. Is there anything I can do to help make it more restful for you? Anything at all...
I humbly await your orders, my honourable Master!
What music would you like to listen to, Master?
I have everything from classical to top hits. All of my records are brand-new, too.
That's odd... Why isn't it making any sound? Oh, no... Malfunctioning now, of all times?
I-if it would please you... I could sing you a song, perhaps?
Huh? You'd like to join me? I-I will do my best not to hold you back, my honourable Master!
I take it you're aware of the stereotype that everyone from the Royal Islands loves tea parties.
Do YOU like them?
If I had to say, I think I like being the security at a tea party more than the tea party itself.
I want to be the one who protects the tranquility and calm of moments such as those.
Master, I prepared... Well, truth be told, I asked the kitchen to prepare refreshments for you.
Please partake while they're hot. Cookies are best when freshly baked.
Do you want some, too?
M-may I? If only you would feed me by hand, I... Ah!
I-I must apologize! What a ridiculous thing I've said.
I'd be happy to.
...You have my heartfelt gratitude, my honourable Master.
{dorm3d}, I've taken up practicing flower arrangement. If you don't mind, could you give me some feedback on my work later?
It is a maid's duty to provide a pleasant, beautiful environment. As such, flower arrangement could certainly be argued to be a compulsory subject.
An ungainly maid though I may be, I believe I can at least arrange flowers well!
这间宿舍的感觉怎么样……？
很好哦……因为和您的见面频率和独处时间都大大增加了，所以Sirius觉得很幸福。
不过还是有一点不太方便呢。
就是……夜间想要侍奉主人的话……（小声）
……不，好像没什么不方便的，是Sirius没想明白。
……呵呵。

options.content: 你无论什么时候都很漂亮

就从……涂口红开始，可以吗？

options.content: 想更了解Sirius的喜好，比如喜欢的音乐之类的

Sirius感到很抱歉，我的主人……

options.content: 还没找到喜好也不要紧

scripts.say: 因为主人想要更了解Sirius的喜好，但Sirius完全没有这方面的认知。所以……
其实……！
Sirius最喜欢的永远是您，我骄傲的主人啊。
最近……Sirius也有在看除了食谱以外的书了。
是和恋爱话题有关的杂志和小说……
虽然作为女仆侍奉在主人身边就很幸福了，但Sirius最近变得越来越贪心了。
想要在这方面再好好钻研一下呢。
请您好好见证Sirius未来的蜕变吧，我的主人。
哼哼♪~
是的，因为主人您来和Sirius见面了。
这是Sirius最为期待，也是最为开心的时刻。
和我骄傲的主人独处一室，实在是令Sirius心潮澎湃……
接下来的时间，不如就……
欸、欸？难道您还没有这方面的想法吗？
抱歉……我的主人，是Sirius太心急了。
（虽然最近天气渐渐热起来了，但总觉得Sirius这里格外热啊……）
欸？是主人您比较怕热吗？
抱歉！是Sirius的疏忽……还请您原谅我的冒失。

洗完的瞬间就会觉得十分凉爽哦！
那么，就由Sirius来伺候主人沐浴吧。
还请您不要乱动，Sirius要来为您脱下身上的制服了哦~
说起来，入住宿舍以后……有些事情朝着更好的方向发展了呢。
感谢您让Sirius入住这里，我骄傲的主人。
比如能够像与主人像这样长时间的近距离接触……
而且无论主人要做什么，Sirius都能够在第一时间给予回应。
这些对于Sirius来说，就是朝着更好的方向发展了哦。
Sirius希望，这种幸福的时光能够长长久久的持续下去。
I've heard that people from the Eagle Union sometimes make tea using water boiled in the microwave...
Have you wanted to try that? You mustn't! Heating water in the microwave is wrong!
It will affect the tea's flavour! You may be my {dorm3d}, but even I won't tolerate you doing such a thing!
Sirius最近在尝试将皇家的传统美食与东煌的特色风味融合，做一道特殊的融合料理。
是的。Sirius听说东煌有一道叫做“剁椒鱼头”的料理，而皇家也有吃鱼的传统……

（好可怕的尝试……）
主人？您的脸色突然变得有些差劲……
我没事，只是有点好奇这道……“剁椒星空派”，目前的研发进度是？
唔，还停留在制作仰望星空派的部分。
每次烤出来的派，都不太尽如人意呢……
（呼，看来一段时间内Sirius不会做出这种料理，这下可以松一口气了……）
在想云朵的形状。
Sirius在您来之前，在走廊上看云。
因为听其他人说，在看云的时候所见到的云朵形状，就代表着人内心最期待的事物。
主人……您是在明知故问哦。
该说Sirius总是干劲满满吗……印象中从没见过你有疲惫的时候啊。
欸？

用了这样的艺术展现方式啊。

“这是一幅简笔画，内容似乎是某个建筑上的旗帜在夜幕中缓缓降下。”

同感，看到就有股无名火！

options.content: It sounds more like you were the yearner.

scripts.say: I felt your intense yearning from afar, so I called you just in time!
If I was, you'd be getting TONS of spam calls and texts from me.
Pssh, I'm kidding. But it is true that I'm yearning for you!
Anyway, the real reason I'm calling you is to remind you about our date tonight.
Do you have any plans in store? Or... should I presume that you're looking forward to my plans?
Oh, but maybe we should talk about "indulgences" in person, hmm?♡
Something that's tons of fun for both of us, of course...♡
Honey, come a little closer. Just come here... Yeah, good.

options.content: I can, but why are we whispering?

scripts.say: Can... you... hear... me?
Because it suits the vibe better, duh!
Just imagine... You and I, skin against skin...
So close that we feel each other's warmth...
Me feeding you the ice cream I made...
Watching you go wild over its sweet, refreshing flavor...

options.content: Is that fun for both of us?

scripts.say: Doesn't the thought of it fill you with bliss?
What answer are you expecting? Yes, or no?
Haha, as for me, any time spent with you is tons of fun!
Anyway, I gotta get ready for the date. I'll hang up now!
We'll meet again tonight, my beloved honey!
Mwah!
Hmm? You picked up fast, honey!
Were you waiting for me to call you?
Huh? You actually were? I'm sorry for making you wait!
But I'm so happy to hear that! My honey was lovingly awaiting my call...
Always waiting for me to make the first move...
You're too adorable!
By the way, don't you think I deserve a compliment?
Carefully planning, patiently waiting for just the right time...
And making the perfect appearance just when you miss me the most!
Hehe. Pretty awesome, huh?
I want your eyes fixed on me at all times.
Say, since we're in such perfect sync...
I have to think of how to reward you.
Hmm, what should it be... It has to be something that I do for you, right?
I could do that, or this... There are so many things I want to do with you...
I wanna wrap you up like sweet ice cream...
Heheh, and then you'll melt in my arms!
You had such a cute look on your face just now! It makes me wanna take a picture.
Hm? Did you just hit me with a counterattack?
That's my honey! You never miss an opening.
But there's an even better opportunity in front of you...
I've got a special kiss waiting in store for our date later... along with something even sweeter♡
So hurry and come over!
If you don't, I'll make the first move!
Oh, {dorm3d}, you finally picked up!
I... I had the most awful dream!
I was walking alone in the forest at night...
Wind would blow through the trees, making scary noises and making their shadows sway...
That was already creepy enough, but then, red eyes started staring at me from all over!
I was too scared to look, and I wouldn't dare turn around... I just knew they were right behind me!
Just before the dark could swallow me up, though, {dorm3d} appeared before my eyes!
You drove off those red-eyed beasts and saved my life!
I knew you'd never abandon me, my love... No matter what, you're always there.

options.content: Is that when you woke up?

scripts.say: Even in my dreams, you're so wonderful that it sends my heart aflutter♡
Absolutely not! After that, I expressed my endless gratitude while you continued to protect me.
While we dashed through the forest, a single bead of sweat dropped from your brow and onto my lips...
Unable to bear waiting any longer, I tried to confess my love – but then came a gust of wind!

options.content: Was your window open when the rain started?

scripts.say: How awful! That was what woke me up...
I left my window open and waited patiently for you, {dorm3d}, but you never came...
I waited for so, so, so very long...

options.content: I'm on my way. Don't catch a cold, okay?

scripts.say: {dorm3d}... You must come right away...
You always indulge me, my love, even in my most needy moments.
At this rate, you're going to make me into a selfish person.
You'll have to take responsibility... for letting this happen to me.
I just cleaned up the rain that got inside. When you get here, I'll make sure to lock the windows and the door alike.
After that... I expect you to take good care of me, {dorm3d}♡
{dorm3d}, you've finally returned to me!
Every minute and every second of your absence is just unbearable.
Especially when it's time to go to bed... No matter how greedily I inhale your lingering scent...

options.content: I missed you, too, so I left early.

scripts.say: The thought of a night alone is just too dreadful to bear!
Ah, my dear {dorm3d}'s love... I want more and more of it♡
Until your heart is occupied by nothing but me...
I'll have to endeavor more than ever for your sake.
Incidentally... I'm hoping those pests didn't bother you on your way back to me?
I trust you, {dorm3d}... Heehee, because I know every little thing you do♡
Those damn pests always take advantage of your sweet nature and cling to you every opportunity they get...
Heehee. I'd better find an opportunity to deal with them.
Now, idle talk of chores aside...
My longing for you won't be sated through a screen.
I so desperately need to have alone time with you, {dorm3d}...
You know that I'm always open and honest with you.
And, being honest, the thought of your arrival... already has me heating up.
Come to my side, dear, and let me soothe your fatigue. Or... release it all over me♡
There's no need to force yourself when you're with me...
So please, {dorm3d}...
Come to me as soon as possible♡
And I will fulfill every last one of your needs.
Oh, you finally picked up.
You took so long that I had the time to count every last star in the sky.
I even took a moment to consider if I should just come over and apprehend you in person...
But I suppose I'll relent. For now.
It isn't every day that I trouble myself to call you. Don't you have anything to say?
Or are you just going to stare at me the whole time?
*sigh*... I'm starting to lose my patience.
Stay still. Yes, good, just like that.
I can't just let you be the only one staring.
So if I have to suffer it, then I'll just stare straight back at you.
...Argh! Why... Why don't you so much as flinch?!
Hmph... If you want to look so badly, then go on. You may behold.
Hey... Isn't there something you should be saying right now?
Why am I so nervous when I'm the person who suggested this?
Kh... And I can't shake this feeling of defeat.
Let's start this over. I'm going to stare at you, so stay still.
Phew... I think I'm getting used to it now.

options.content: Work has been a lot lately.

scripts.say: Speaking of which, I can't help but notice that you look a little tired.
Lately? It's always like that for you. I pity you.
If that's the case... then maybe I ought to help soothe your fatigue.
Quit your laughing! I just thought that nervousness from before... was a little pleasant...
Still... I can hardly soothe you just through conversation.
Do you understand what I mean?
I'll be right here waiting for you♪
Wow, you answered fast this time.
Were you waiting all day with your finger hovering over the "Answer" button?
Just admit it. You were practically begging for me to call you.
...Y-you admitted it that easily?!
So much for all that teasing I wanted to do.
Now all the jokes I prepared have gone to waste... What a shame.
Oh, why did I call you? Hmm...
I wanted to hear your voice. A little more than usual, maybe. That's all.
What have you been doing?
Taking a moment away from work to look at all of our photos together?
Heehee... Good. You have my permission.
But don't you think the real deal is a lot more enticing than any picture?
I feel the same way about you, after all.
We must meet. Right now.
Either you can come over, or I'll come to you. The choice is yours.
You'd better think carefully about it, though.
One of them comes with a reward, and one comes with punishment...
Surely you understand?
Heehee... You're confident in your decision.
In that case, I'll tell you which you'll receive when you arrive.
Being made to wait... that's just where the thrill is, isn't it?
Well, you'd better hurry over.
I can't wait to see how you react when you hear the answer...
Heehee, just imagining it makes me tingle.
The indomitable Black Dragon, New Jersey, has captured your signal!
First, my beloved honey needs a welcoming kiss. Mwah! Thanks for all you do.
You sound like you're in a good mood! Got any fun stories?
Oooh! That sounds so interesting!
Isn't it great that we can chat about whatever any time we want?
Hm? What have I been up to?
Do you mean work, or just everyday stuff?
Either way, my answer's the same – I do it all for you, honey! Because you occupy all of my heart and soul.
Speaking of, I cleaned my room from top to bottom!
I swapped in my comfiest sheets and covers, too!
Now all I have to do is get comfy and snuggle in bed with my honey.
Relaxed, warm cuddles are just the best, aren't they?
It's just so hard to get motivated to do stuff when you're not around.
I'm doing my work perfectly fine of course, but...
I just can't get SERIOUS unless you're watching over me!
After all, I can't take my eyes off you, either!

options.content: I want to feel it more directly.

scripts.say: Do you feel my burning love, honey?
Oh? Okay, then I'll have to prove it to you with action!
Come closer, honey! Yeah, just like that...
Did you hear that? My heart is pounding...
This is how it gets every time I'm with you.
Now that you've put me in this mood... are you ready, too?
Yeah, I wanna see your love and resolve for myself!
I'm on my way to your place right now. Get ready to feel my love up close and personal, honey!
I have good news, nya!
Thanks to the hard work of everyone from the Research Department, we've managed to make two new breakthroughs, nya!
First, you can now acquire a new set of Priority ship comrades through the Tech Academy, nya!
And second, you can now preview a Priority ship's barrage and skills even if you haven't finished developing them yet, nya!
However, their stats will differ from their fully developed equivalents, nya... Think of it as the Research Department adjusting things a little, nya!
Also, the unlock requirements for these new Priority ships will be a little different from the previous ones, nya! If you don't meet the requirements, go take a look at your Fleet Technology, nya!
For the sake of safety and speed, Marco Polo's group did not choose to return directly by train.
Instead, they chose Carducci's proposal – crossing a few rivers to make straight for Rome.
As a result, the section of the Arno River flowing through the Republic of Florence would become the most dangerous part of the return route.
They rushed along the water's surface, heading for the Sardegna Ecclesia's territory at full speed.
The riverside sent a message saying everything looks normal. We might be able to go back safely.
I doubt it. There is no way Andrea would foolishly not anticipate that someone might take this route.
She wants to capture the Apostle – me! If she didn't, she wouldn't have made Bartolomeo go through the effort of erecting an illusion to delay us!
All of you, keep your eyes and ears open!
KABOOOM!
Here they come... That bunch is nothing if not bold.
What did you expect? They appeared before us to formally declare war, for goodness' sake!
Ahem... If it's the Apostle you seek, then I am right here! Show yourselves and state your names!
From within the dark mist, two shadowy figures slowly came into view.
You anticipated an ambush here, I see. Perhaps you're not as incompetent as the rumors say.
I am Bolzano, a knight of the Sardegnia League. It's a shame we must meet under these conditions, Your Grace.
(METAs? Again? If we assume that Andrea Doria is META as well, then...)
(Perhaps their kind are commonplace in this world?)
(Even Trento has turned... How strange.)
Trento, if a fight is inevitable, can't we at least have some pleasantries first? Why won't you say anything?
...You are Marco Polo, the Apostle, yes?
What is it, Trento? Is something wrong with her?
For some reason, this scenario is giving me an intense sense of deja vu. It's like I've experienced it in a dream...
Is that so? Perhaps in that dream, you and I accomplished something incredible together – is that correct?
...I can't remember.
That's it, then. We've spoken long enough.
Now that we've introduced ourselves, it's time you said your prayers. We won't go easy on you.
Took the words right out of my mouth!
No sooner than I gained the position I desired was I forced into days of exhausting work, then when I finally got to go outside for a breather, I was attacked...
My anger has reached critical mass, and you will suffer all of it!
Come, girls! After me!
As soon as she said those words, Marco Polo commenced the attack, to the surprise of everyone around her.
You're making the first move? How bold of you!
Intercept them!
KABOOOM!
Marco Polo's position after several clashes was far from disadvantageous. If anything, her momentum was growing and growing, and the advantage was hers.
Is that all you have?
You're weaker than I anticipated, and your aim is sloppy.
You're clearly lacking in combat experience as well. Ohohohoho!
I'm impressed, Apostle. Frankly, I underestimated you.
It's time to get serious.
As Trento said that, she took out an intricate, black cube.
(It's black... An Origin Cube?! They have access to THOSE things?!)
All of a sudden, a red and black fog spread out and blanketed the whole river.
Our power grows while inside the Eternal Night's fog.
You, on the other hand, will suffer and languish due to its corrosion.
Your fates have been sealed. There is nowhere to run or hide.
Dammit... She's right. This fog is corroding our equipment and bodies!
Your Grace, we have to get out of the fog immediately!
Don't be hasty! All that's happening is the power generated by the Origin Cube is spreading out.
It's but a cheap trick. Do they think they can do as they please when I have God on my side?
We're near a district that has a Source of God's Light. There should be power stored there. Let us find out what it can do!
O God, I give my faith to you! Lend me your strength!
An indescribable power surged forth, and the dark fog instantly turned ashen in color before dissipating.
Wh-what? How is this possible?!
Hahah! It is possible to use the power of the Lattice of God's Light without even activating it!
(For being a Siren creation, that machine sure is straightforward in use...)
Did you think that was the end? It's only the beginning!
Marco Polo recited another prayer of sorts. The entire area was illuminated with golden light, the bodies of her and her aides glowing especially brightly.
This must be this world's image of Paradise... Magnificent! This will be good to reference!
Whoa... What is this? Is this brain power, too?!
I never imagined you would call upon the Lattice's power like this, Your Grace!
Ohohohoho! Save the praise for later! This is no time to talk!
Stronger have we grown! Now show them your might!
KABOOOM!
Hahaha! Feel the power of art!
Focus fire on one of them!
KABOOOM!
They're actually pushing us back...
It's hard to fully carry out an ambush decided on the spur of the moment.
Victory is out of our grasp... We should retreat, Trento.
You're right... I thought this was our chance to take her out, but alas...
Next time we meet, Marco Polo, we will attack you head-on.
Not so fast! I have a message for your boss!
Tsk... They sure ran away quickly!
Let's chase after them! They'll get away if we don't go now!
Your Grace, please be calm.
I AM calm. Why pursue them in the first place and risk walking into another trap of theirs?
Those parting words – "we will attack you head on"... They just did that!
No matter. The imperative now is to return to Rome and get a full grasp on the situation. Regroup and head out at full speed!
A while later, Marco Polo and Raffaello returned after their secret talk at the ritual grounds and reorganized their forces.
They were going to withdraw their troops and allow Andrea's faction to capture every node of the Lattice of God's Light.
At the same time, their whole army would converge upon Rome and make it appear as though they were conducting a massive ritual to buy themselves time out of desperation.
Sure enough, Andrea Doria took notice and launched a naval attack with the brunt of her force, just as Marco Polo predicted.
We meet again, Raffaello. I'm quite surprised to see that you're leading the Ecclesia's navy.
Where is your leader – Marco Polo?
Her Grace is, well, busy, so she kinda just threw her arms up and told me to take care of the trouble here.
"Threw her arms up," you say? She must have put a lot of faith into this ritual of hers. No pun intended.
And yet, she has surrendered so many nodes to buy herself some time.
It frankly doesn't seem like the smartest idea, does it?
Maybe, maybe not. I'll let you enjoy the suspense.
Andrea, I'm starting to think Raffaello is also stalling for time.
Yes, and I've said my piece. All there is to do now is attack head-on.
Fine by me. I'll be coming at you as straight as spaghetti!
Da Vinci, Alfredo, remember the plan!
Do everything you can to hold the others back while I go and persuade Andrea!
KABOOOM!
Using the power granted by the Lattice of God's Light, Raffaello cut the distance to Andrea in the blink of an eye.
Andrea, meanwhile, began to brandish the power of the Domain of Eternal Night. Instantly, the world was split between light and dark.
Raffaello, you have walked into a trap.
Stall for time if you so wish, but have you thought about why I'm not doing the same?
Do you think Rome is untouchable as long as you have the Lattice of God's Light?
Nah. The thing is, Marco Polo knows you want to take us down with you, which'll result in the Lattice's destruction.
"Take you down with me"... An interesting way to phrase it. If you've seen through my plan, why deploy your forces like this, then?
Is that ritual of hers really worth staking everything on?
I wouldn't say the ritual is that important – it's you who's the most important.
The reason I'm here is to talk to you, plain and simple.
What is there to talk about after we've come this far? You're not thinking about switching sides, are you?
Uh, no. Speaking in terms of composition, we're the champions of light and you're the warriors of darkness.
...But out of curiosity, if you wanted me to join the dark side, what kind of deal would you offer me?
How about double whatever the Ecclesia is paying you?
Ooh, an enticing offer! But I'll have to say no thanks. Tell me the truth about the world, will you?
Everything I've said is the truth.
The "God" the Holy See has worshipped for all this time is a bunch of ancient machines. Robots, in essence.
They made up a religion and used the Holy See to manipulate the world based on that false belief. All as the pretense – the story – for their experiments.
Their relics, not least of all the Lattice that you're using right now, pose a disastrous threat to the world.
The relics exist for one purpose – to turn us all into puppets who dance at their command in the name of faith.
Do you even know what the ending is to this story that they've come up with?
Even if you beat us into submission and do exactly what they want you to, all that awaits you in the end is death and devastation.
It's called a "reset," and it wipes out both their most loyal followers and their most staunch opponents.
I mean, I think I've basically conformed to the status quo, but that doesn't mean I really believed in God.
That's why I approve of the revolution you've been working toward.
I just didn't expect that you'd do it by dragging your allies into an all-out war.
I'm trying to keep casualties on both sides to a minimum. You already know that, don't you?
"Minimum" doesn't mean "none."
Besides, think about it. You didn't go to war because of the threat of the Rite of the Final Judgment – you did it because the Lattice was going to be activated.
Sure, it'll lead to the world's downfall one day if left unchecked, but you don't know whether that one day will be tomorrow or a thousand years from now.
Don't get me wrong, I'm not saying that what you're doing here is wrong.
But, if you know the Sirens are manipulating us all, have you not considered that this war may be just another part of their story?
You jumped the gun a little bit, and, well... here we are.
I was out of time. A shipgirl Apostle had been born, and the Holy See had the key to activate those divine weapons.
I know what's resting inside of the 9th Armory of God. Other places like it exist across the Ecclesia, and only – and I mean ONLY – the Apostle can control the divine army once awakened.
With that kind of power, nobody would be able to challenge the Holy See, and as the executioners of "God's" experiments, they would put unbreakable shackles on all of us.
But that hasn't happened yet. The cage hasn't been locked shut just yet. That was why I had to act.
This was my one and only hope.
Okay, so you're mostly on the right track, but you're forgetting about one crucial thing.
One crucial thing?
Yeah. What if – seriously, what if – Marco Polo already knew all of this?
And what if she not only knew more than you, but she was trying to do the same thing as you – to destroy the cage around us?
It's like I said earlier. I just came here to talk to you.
I'll be real with you – Marco Polo has come up with an unbelievable plan to fix everything.
We'll both get what we want if you help her with it.
Interested? Then hear me out for a bit.
Sometime earlier, at the Rite of the Final Judgment's ritual grounds...
Marco Polo gathered her aides under the pretense of a problem with the Rite, then proceeded to tell them the same thing as she told Raffaello just earlier.
As Raffaello anticipated, they readily offered to cooperate with her.
It was then that Marco Polo began to detail her plan.
Let me make this clear: I know what I'm doing, and you are all to follow my instructions!
Our forces have already been concentrated in Rome. Andrea is similarly amassing her own forces.
What God expects to happen next is an all-out war between the two of us.
However, I will not be playing into His hand!
We are going to broach discussions with Andrea in secret. We give the impression that we're fighting while actually working together.
Then, under God's watch, we will focus our forces in one place in a way He will never see coming.
Then the plan begins in earnest. We will activate the divine army and use our might to destroy each and every one of God's weapons.
Both sides will join forces, and after our armies have arrived, we will modify the Rite and make it so God's weapons can no longer be strengthened by the power of faith.
And not just that – we'll issue self-destruct orders, switch off defense systems, and give contradicting orders. Anything we can to put them in utter disarray.
When the divine army is at its weakest, we will all march on Rome and wipe it out!
Once that cursed army is completely annihilated, the world will be free from its cage.
I will remain as the Apostle and the Ecclesia's army will follow the Holy See's commands. My commands, in other words.
And we'll all live happily ever after. The end!
Oh, and don't worry, the army won't question my orders. They'll believe me if I say they came to me in a revelation in this place.
Wow... They'll buy it, just like that?
This is certainly an... unexpected plan.
Sounds risky. Just the way I like it!
Right? Now, for the concrete details of this plan...
Raffaello explained Marco Polo's plan from start to finish, and Andrea was dumbfounded from sheer surprise.
So yeah, that's more or less the idea.
Marco Polo sure is a woman of... unconventional brilliance.
I hate to admit it, but it's a very appealing plan.
I still cannot trust her, though. You must understand – at the end of the day, she serves "God." She is the chosen one who was born in the Shipyard of God.
So you want proof of her rebellion, huh? Don't worry, as we speak, she is taking faith in God and turning it into faith in her.
Once that's done, you'll know exactly where she stands!
Faith in... her? How in the world will she do that?
The power to come up with things is in the heart of each and every one of us.
Anyway, let's separate a bit and keep up the appearance that we're in a standoff! Then just sit back and watch as her masterful plan unfolds!
Alright. From there, I will determine her true worth.
Once the plan was set in stone, the shipgirls all sprung into action.
In the truest sense, the Sardegnia League had united as one for the first time ever. They had become something worthy of the title of "league."
HQ issued orders one after the next while the shipgirls intercepted the three separate fleets of Sirens.
What's more, the core node hosting the Domain of Eternal Night on the island was very clearly signaling an intention to destroy Rome.
This borderline provocation naturally drew the attention and fire of the Sirens' defense system.

The three Siren fleets were dead in their tracks, but then, a fourth one suddenly emerged right in the middle of the sea. A figure matching the description of the MECHArbiter was clearly visible in their midst.
According to Her Grace, several fleets of so-called "mass-produced" ships and "Enforcers" have appeared.
The Genoan Republic's and the Dukedom of Milan's fleets are keeping the first Siren fleet in check, while the Republic of Venice's and the Sardegnia Ecclesia's fleets are tackling the second one.
As for the third fleet, the Kingdom of Sicily's fleet is implementing its plan to grind them to a halt.
Each of our fleets is doing its utmost to stop the enemy's advance and isolate the fourth fleet of Sirens.
While they do that, our forces will be the key to destroying the MECHArbiter's fleet.
The enemy in question is on a straight course toward Sardegnia Island. We will be within its range in approximately 30 minutes.
The Republic of Florence will take care of its mass-produced ships. The Enforcers will be dealt with by our mixed fleet that hasn't yet participated in battle.
As part of our "quenching" tactic, we cannot expect assistance in the form of the Mechanicus Harbingers or the strength amplifier in the Lattice of God's Light.
The only assistance we can expect is aerial support from da Vinci's and Alfredo's fleet of airships.
Finally, Her Grace is performing the ritual and setting up the bait and extermination parts of our plan...
...Which means that you are the only ones who can handle the MECHArbiter.
I am a knight of the Sardegnia League and I will perform my duty no matter what.
It's us against God's most powerful weapon...
I pictured countless ways that this war could end. I would not in a thousand years have guessed this is how it would end.
Every state in the League coming together in unity in pursuit of victory... It's a wonderful thing to see.
Agreed. It's the best thing I could've ever hoped for.
Only if we win will it be so, Andrea.
Yes, that is true...
Our final opponent stands before us. So does the hope we've fostered for so long.
We will break free of our cage, whatever the cost may be!
KABOOOM!
Andrea, I am presently engaging the Enforcers.
Their strength is so far beyond expectations that a quick fight is out of the question. I'll do all I can to hold them back.
Understood.
Things are going super well for our airship fleet, luckily!
Doesn't look like the enemy's equipped to deal with aerial attacks, so we've already reduced their mass-produced fleet to scraps!
Heck, we kinda have forces to spare, so how about we send some your way?
No, let's stick to the plan.
You're the boss.
KABOOOM!
Andrea! Our attacks aren't getting through! In fact, the Domain of Eternal Night isn't having any observable effect on them!
Then we don't have enough output. Carducci, we have to capture every node as soon as possible!
We're engaged on all fronts, but I'll try to hurry things along.
Is it time to employ our backup plan?
Not yet. Launch one more offensive.
KABOOOM!
As Trento said, our attacks really are ineffective.
If nothing changes soon, they'll be threatening the core node within an hour.
Andrea, Her Grace just informed me that the ritual has been set up!
The enemy is already within strike range, so the Kingdom of God can be deployed at any time.
It's too soon. Too many nodes aren't connected yet. The Domain hasn't even reached half of its predicted output.
We need more to put sufficient pressure on the enemy.
Keep capturing nodes and raising the Banner of Eternal Night.
Meanwhile, I suppose... it's time to carry out the backup plan.
Overclock the laboratory's system and push the META corrosion up to a new threshold!
Are you sure that's a good idea?
I'm sure. We've always been ready for this if it's what it takes to break free of our cage.
It's nothing too serious. It will just give us more strength at the cost of our health.
That's definitely not all it does, based on Her Grace's reaction to your plan...
Hmph. I always have wanted to break past that meaningless safety protocol.
I'm on it.
Carducci, don't flip the extermination switch just yet. Stick to the plan and focus on expanding the Domain.
We only have one shot at this, so remember...
No matter how hard the fighting gets, don't relent until you're given the signal.
KABOOOM!
ROOOAAAR!
Shrouded in thick fog, the huge machine was firing in all directions, not a single blind spot out of range of its cannons.
Andrea, 90% of all the nodes have been captured now.
Then we should be good. Overclock the system and encase the enemy completely in the Domain of Eternal Night!
The fog thickened, and streaks of blood-red light rushed through it.
It was like the Domain of Eternal Night had converged into a single entity – like a giant had risen from its slumber.
Andrea's group coordinated so closely that it was almost like they were an extension of this giant.
KABOOOM!
ROOOOAAAAAR!
Cannons covered in fog struck the MECHArbiter's sturdy barrier as blinding beams of light burst forth.
Andrea, the enemy's attacks are getting duller and its barrier is growing darker!
Looks like it worked.
The moment has finally come... Marco Polo!
I know! Commencing the final step of the plan now!
O God, I call for you! Manifest your heavenly kingdom upon this earth!
...What?!
It doesn't seem like anything happened... Did the ritual work?
...God just told me to "hang on a minute"!
Did I hear that right? God wants you to wait?
Seems we have no other choice... I'll use the final card in our hand.
What are you talking about?! The cursed thing's barrier is completely attuned to your attacks!
I'll destroy all our equipment. The core node, the laboratory, and everything else on Sardegnia Island.
They contain a tremendous source of energy. Destroying them all at the same time will generate a massive shock wave.
What consequences will that have?
It won't be possible to rebuild the laboratory. No new METAs will come to be if we destroy all that machinery.
No more METAs? An acceptable price to pay. We don't NEED them.
Can you ensure the safety of your comrades, though?
No need to worry about that.
Magnificent! Do it, then!
In the endless white expanse, I witnessed all of the shipgirls' conversations and the changes in the battle through the eyes of the statue.
An energy source that creates METAs... Is she talking about a special Wisdom Cube? Origin Cubes, to be specific?
They're not seriously considering detonating them, are they?!
The image of a black tornado destroying everything in its path flashes in my mind.
Hierophant, you have to stop them! Nobody will be able to withstand the damage if those Cubes go off!
In response to my plea, another door appears not far from me.
...What does that mean? That the plan will work out just fine?
What are you trying to tell me?
I reach out to touch it, and everything changes abruptly.
Well, Dr. Aoste, my experiment was a success.
You discovered a way to blow up Energy Cubes, you mean?
I see Dr. Aoste and Colette conversing inside a strangely familiar laboratory.
Hey, it's a serious research project. Don't paint me like some kid experimenting with firecrackers.
My peers can be as biased against it as they want, but I still believe the explosive-propulsion engine is a promising subject.
It was widely believed that it was impossible for E-Cubes to release an explosion of energy in a short time, despite the enormous amount of energy they contain.
And yet, Wisdom Cubes – particularly ones that have undergone METAmorphosis – are reliably able to cause a destructive shock wave in response to stimulus.
And what's true for Wisdom Cubes is true for Energy Cubes as well.
If a Wisdom Cube can undergo METAmorphosis, there's no reason why E-Cubes shouldn't be able to in theory.
Isn't it natural, then, to change our way of thinking and try to work out how METAmorphosis works for Energy Cubes?
"In theory" is not the same as "in practice." Energy Cubes are far more stable than Wisdom Cubes. How on earth did you make it turn META?
Sorry, OXS trade secret. If you want to use our technique, we can discuss a business contract later.
No, see, what I'm concerned about is the safety.
Talk about being a worrywart. Do you remember that Wisdom Cube power output monitor and limiter you showed me before?
My team used that as a template for our own version made for META Energy Cubes. I've named it the M-type limiter – subject to change.
A META Energy Cube with the limiter installed exhibits completely different behaviors based on whether the desired output exceeds the value needed for an explosion or not.
If it's below the value, the limiter ensures not a single iota of energy will be released, preventing the expression of its META characteristics. Basically, it's just a brick then.
But, if the value exceeds the detonation threshold... Kaboom.
The limiter is immediately disabled, and the violent energy surge is then released as a shock wave.
Since this simultaneously destroys the Cube's casing, there's also zero risk of a secondary hazard.
Come to think of it, I haven't come up with a name for these unique E-Cubes yet.
META Energy Cube... MEC for short. Actually, how about M-Type Energy Cube? M-TEC.
The statue's eyes stare back at me inside the endless white space.
An Energy Cube with META properties...
Not just that – a Cube that can be detonated...
...That's what they are?!
Amidst ceaseless explosions, the great beast of condensed red and black fog launched a relentless attack on the prey trapped within it.
ROOOAAAR!
Marco Polo!
Once again! Commencing the final quenching stage of the plan!
Carducci, send out the following commands to every node: Immediately remove the Banner of the Eternal Night and restart the Lattice of God's Light!
As you command!
Raffaello, send the Mechanicus Harbingers to the front!
Oh yeah! Let's wreck some stuff! Go and give them hell, my masterworks!
And Baracca – lead the Holy See Guard Fleet into battle!
I've been waiting for this. We're ready to go!
Magnificent! And finally...
O God! Give me your strength and bring to us your kingdom!
Thus, the red and black fog that embodied the Eternal Night vanished in an instant.
The world lit up with the light of faith, and a sacred silence filled the air from horizon to horizon.
In the midst of the pure white, the chorus resounded.
"I am Marco Polo, the Apostle."
P HT THYJV WVSV, AOL HWVZASL
"O Army of God, heed my command."
P HT THYJV WVSV, AOL HWVZASL, V HYTF VM NVK, OLLK TF JVTTHUK
"Smite this evil with your blade."
P HT THYJV WVSV, AOL HWVZASL, V HYTF VM NVK, OLLK TF JVTTHUK, ZTPAL AOPZ LCPS DPAO FVBY ISHKL
KABOOOM!
Marco Polo! I'm in position!
Holy moly! The fighting here is so intense!
This is the Kingdom of God... And that's the Army of God...
This is such good inspo! I've gotta draw this right now!
Ahem. Mechanicus Harbingers, go forth!
Save your drawing for AFTER we've won!
KABOOOM!
The Holy See Guard Fleet has arrived!
Reinforcements, Your Grace.
Excellent timing! Are the nodes done being changed?
About half of all nodes suffered damage that cannot be repaired. Besides those, all others have been converted and connected to the Lattice of God's Light.
Magnificent! I'll give you a small boost before you go in.
There! Now go! Crush them until there's nothing left!
KABOOM!
With Marco Polo commanding from atop her throne, the offense struck like an unstoppable tsunami.
The MECHArbiter's barrier was completely destroyed after a coordinated volley, so the shipgirls mercilessly bombarded its exposed armor with their cannons.
ROOOOAAAAR!
Phew... We've finally broken through that stupidly thick barrier!
Now to pierce the armor. Continue the attack! Strip away everything it has!
In the endless expanse of white, I watch as the barrier disintegrates through the statue's eyes.
A strange light flashes in the statue's eyes.
Then, the next moment, it and I are both sucked into a vortex that appeared out of nowhere.
Have a safe trip home, everyone~!
So, the STAR assessment is zero? Pleasantly calm, for a change.
I must express my gratitude to you for setting up this joint exercise area for us. The girls all wanted a little practice.
Of course, that includes me as well. I have heard many a tale about your heroic deeds, Enterprise, and I was hoping to test your skill for myself.
You don't need to be so flattering, Wales. The Eagle Union stands with its allies, and we're happy to have the opportunity to practice with you.
To tell the truth, I've been waiting for a chance to polish up my skills, too.
Very well, then let's tone down the formalities from here on. The Royal Navy will fight with all it's got, and we hope you will, too.
Let's find out if the Eagle Union's carrier fleet is as amazing as they say!
That's more like it. Eagle Union fleet, let's get ready! Hooyah!
Now THAT was a battle! We admit defeat.
It definitely was. You predicted our attacking fleet's position and countered like it was nothing. Now I can see why you've earned the nickname "Big E."
I'm honored, but I alone don't deserve all the credit. I couldn't have done it without the rest of the fleet.
... By the way, we've been saying goodbye for quite some time now. You should probably get going soon. Hopefully, we'll get another chance to fight like this in the future.
I'm sure it won't be long until it comes, at least if this war with the Sirens continues.
Funny you mention that. I was just gonna offer you an escort through the higher-risk waters. Lots of Sirens in some places.
Thanks, but we'll be fine. If any show up, they'll serve as morale-boosting victories after our defeat against you.
Moreover, ensuring the safety of NY City should be your highest priority. You don't need to worry about us.
It is my honour and duty to clean up any pests that impede our travels. Please, allow me to take care of it.
All right, if you say so. Good luck, everyone!
Likewise. May Lady Luck smile upon the Eagle Union.
... I know this ill-boding feeling all too well...
Attention, everyone! We must head home and report to Her Majesty immediately!

sequence: 距离“第一次接触”、“大冲突”之后已经过去了20年。 南极的冰山融化，人类失去了30%的陆地。 并且，这个过程还在不断恶化…
为了适应这样的一个世界环境，同时也为了应对“它们”的再次行动。 世界各大阵营组成了秘密联合组织—“碧蓝航线”
“碧蓝航线”的任务是： 对“第一次接触”时“它们”留下的科技进行研究并自我利用。 从而组建起新生的水面力量，为人类的未来寻找道路。
然而…殊不知，人类曾经犯下的种种错误，却悄悄开始重新上演…

scripts.say: 啊，新上任的第一天就迷路了，这么主角光环的出场模式真是尴尬…
不过，按照这种套路来看，接下来难道我就是要遇到命运中的女主角的节奏了吗嘿嘿嘿...
啊啦~你就是新来的指挥官吗，居然让淑女等待那么久的时间，可真不是个合格的绅士呢哼哼！
嗯？哪里突然跑出来的小孩子，还穿着这样奇怪的军服？
什…什么，人家才不是哪里跑出来的小孩子呢！别看我个头小，在我手下教导出来的优秀学生可是数不胜数呢！
诶！你居然能听到我脑子里在想的东西！？
哼哼，我们可是搭载了最新型的战术指挥系统的“兵器”哟，只要通过指挥官的脑电波就可以进行远程沟通，这点小事情根本不算什么~
当然，指挥官脑子里要是在想一些很奇怪的东西的话，我们也是能知道的哦哼哼哼~
啊啦，忘了自我介绍一下，我可是来自皇家舰队的高级教官女将号哦，负责对新人（你）进行基础教导~从今天开始就轮到我来好好调教你一番啦！加加会配合你做实战
啊…感觉似乎有一种不祥的预感-A-
指挥官一定还记得在学校学习过的战斗方法吧？只要在对方的船只和飞机越过警戒线对旗舰造成伤害前击破他们就可以了！
因为是演习，所以这次装备的都是空包弹，请放心战斗吧~
哼，看来能通过碧蓝航线考核的家伙还是有2把刷子的嘛，之前还有点小瞧你了
别误会了，这可不是在夸奖你哦，这种程度的小型对手，根本没什么好骄傲的哼！
看到了吗，敌方的舰队被击破后有时会掉落物资哦，点击把它们打捞上来看看是什么吧
Compiler's transport plan proved a lot simpler than I anticipated.
That being – after two hours of prepping as best as she could, she'd take the shortest route to the port of LD, charging through enemies on the way.
As expected, or perhaps as not expected, our fleet has ended up in a stalemate with an army of extraterrestrials in the Bristol Channel.
Hey, albino fabricator! Why have we not moved an inch after all that fighting?!
Do something about this!
The enemy has grouped up, making them stronger than the sum of their parts.
Calculating the relation between size of force and combat capabilities now.
Enemy is more numerous than predicted. We must slow down for safety's sake and wait for more production lines to come online.
Then why are you building a fort here?!
It is necessary to preserve our momentum.
Urgh... Too slow! TOO SLOW!
Who knows when we're gonna get there at THIS speed?!
Arrival within the next 72 hours is guaranteed.
That's just as long as you said before!
Negative. The previous 72-hour plan did not account for travel time. The current plan assures arrival within the next 72 hours.
UUURRRGGGHHH!
(Her going with a tactic like this is pretty consistent with her modus operandi.)
(We can't afford to take our sweet time, though.)
(Need to come up with a plan... Hmm. I really should contact the survivors in the area.)
(They may not be able to send support, but even intel on their waterways would be a godsend.)
KABOOOM!
Commander, status update. A third force is approaching from the northeast.
The northeast? Must be the local resistance force.
From what I read in your files, the Sirens that stayed here had an alliance with the previous local powers. Is that correct?
Yes. Without a doubt.
Then it's possible they think we're their former allies who've come back to life, so they sent reinforcements our way.
I was unsure whether to reach out to them. Guess they're making the first move now.
Whoa! Look, assistant! There are golden lions flying in the air!
What? Golden lions?

options.content: Did the whale tell you that?

scripts.say: I turn my gaze upward and see no lions of any kind, only flying units engaged in combat.
I dunno... I just know I saw them!
It's fine if you can't see them! I'll go and call the lions over!
Whale, take off!
Liooon!
Hey! Big, glowing lion with wings!
Eh? Trinidad, is it just me, or is that whale down there charging at us?
Looks like it. I think there's someone riding it, too!
The whale doesn't seem to have any weapons. She'll hurt herself if she collides with us!
Quick, we have to save her!
Heeere I cooome!
Careful!
Hey, it's fine! I caught her!
Woohoo! I flew like a bird!
Whoa! There's a whistle-blower and a scorpion lady on this lion! Hello!
...A what?
What scorpion lady?
That's you!
Come on! You need to go see the assistant!
The who?
What are you talking about?
After Miss D boarded a lion like she'd wanted, I managed to get in touch with Elizabeth aboard the Mesektet.
We had a brief information exchange and I learned the gist of this world. As one might expect, though, I initially wasn't sure how to react.
First, there's Lion and her team coming from a world where Elizabeth is no more...
Then there's the miracle of me ending up in the same place as the Elizabeths did...
And how all three groups mistook each other for the fighting force native to this world.
Naturally, Elizabeth was quite shocked to learn about the whale having shrunk and Compiler accompanying me.
At any rate, Compiler rebuilt a defense line and bolstered her aerial forces, after which I boarded the Mesektet with the rest and headed for the Rose Tower in the port of LD.
As for Miss D, she apparently chose to ride the "flying lion."
I have to ask – what ARE those flying lions?
Heh. Well, {playername}, they are the Mesektet's secret weapon. I cannot share more than that as it is confidential.
They're just mass-produced Siren ships that you put solid hologram overs!
Ahem...
Cleopatra, start the ship!
But Miss Governor, Trafalgar has yet to come on board.
Just send one of the Luxwing Lions out to her.
She didn't seem very keen on flying, but I'd hate for her to pass on such an unforgettable experience. Now start the engine!
As you say.
KABOOOM!
The battle continues from dawn through dusk, late into the night, and to the following dawn.
Our allies take every measure to whittle away at the extradimensional forces, but we lose breathing room by the hour.
After a night of combat, almost all of our enemies have changed their priority to attacking the Rose Tower. Corpses have stopped piling up around the Buds of the Full Moon.
But they ARE starting to pile up in the sectors neighboring the Rose Tower, to the extent that mimic entities could start appearing at any time.
Sunrise is coming. Lion's and Elizabeth META's teams have retreated to the first sector to build a new defensive line, and Compiler has diverted resources there.
Miss D and I plan to retreat alongside her, as planned. However...
GAAAAH! Assistant, assistant!
This is bad! Really, really BAD!
Class II mimic entities just popped in! It's so over! We're DEEEAD!
...Class II?
Through the command center monitor, I witness the birth of mimic entities from extradimensional corpses.
White biomass and black metal melt together into a soupy mixture that melds with the earth to create a chaotic ocean.
Within, countless individuals made of the reconstituted corpses begin to wriggle and writhe.
Even more unformed creatures clamor above, below, and between them amidst the chaos.
They aren't like the mimic entities I've seen before, but what makes them categorically different?
Does that mean there are Class I, III, and IV mimics as well?
What are the criteria for these classifications?
Shush, you! You won't get anything out of me if you keep peppering me with questions!
Listen up, Assistant! All that matters is that we run! We're dead meat if those things touch us!
Unfortunately, the horde of mimic entities spawned close to the command center.
(That's what we get for trying to use geography to our advantage.)
We're likely to be surrounded if we stay here. Let's hurry back to the Rose Tower.
Renown, Repulse. Do you know why she called those Class II mimic entities?
You're really fixated on that, aren't you? But I don't know, either!
Neither do I. We distinguish between mimic entity and mimic beast by size, and we give them levels according to their combat capabilities.
However, I've never heard of this sort of categorisation.
This might be related to Miss D's amnesia...
Assistant! Hurry! Up! Get! Outta! Here!
Okay, okay. Compiler, execute evac plan.
Orders received. There is no vector zone in the sky as of yet, so we may avail ourselves of aerial support.
Setting base self-destruct countdown. Now departing.
KABOOOOM!
Mimic entities haven't appeared on our escape route, so there's no need to leave the river and detour.
The Type II mass-produced fleet protecting our rear is no match for the mimic entities, but they're effective enough as obstacles.
Renown and Repulse quickly dispatch the extradimensionals ahead of us, as well, making our retreat a smooth one.
(Like the X mimic entities from the Martyrium, they become vector zones when destroyed, allowing them to spawn anew.)
(But this time, extradimensionals are mixed among the things spewing out of the vector zones. Why?)
(Extradimensionals are much weaker than mimic entities, and their corpses don't fully convert to mimics...)
(Doesn't that just make the vector zones less effective?)
(...Commander... hear me...)
(Helena? Have you found our coordinates?)
(...Magician... a trap...)
(Our communications are being sabotaged. I can't hear her well!)
(...Listen...)
(...can't save you this time...)
(...watching you...)
(...Follow your heart...)
(...If you want to, save them... can't, then run...)
(...No matter what... I'm by your...)
(Helena? Helena!)
(Damn. We've been totally cut off!)
KABOOOOM!
Good work, Commander! Leave this sector to us now!
I've opened a path through the barrier. Please proceed into the Rose Tower.
As soon as we approach the Rose Tower defensive line at the first combat sector, I spot the Queen's Light soaring through the sky.
Our strategic retreat has gone well so far. From here on out, this operation isn't a bid for time – it's a life-or-death siege.
(There's still room for retreat behind the defensive line. It can be brought all the way to the tower, if need be.)
(But after that, we're cornered.)
(Chariot, you have to get here soon!)
KABOOOM!
The crew safely returned to the Mesektet thanks to Lion's quick thinking. The ship took to the air, and everything seemed to have gone well.
The giant, white creatures, however, were not going to let their prey flee just like that.
Swarms of flying creatures rose into the air and encircled the Mesektet like a swarm of locusts, chipping away at the shield.
This forced them to reroute energy to the shield generator just to keep it up, which reduced their already low speed even further.
KABOOOM!
Miss Governor, we need to land in the water!
We're sitting ducks in the air. At least in the water, we can fight back.
Stay calm. Have faith in the Realm's technology.
The Mesektet has an emergency evacuation system. If worse comes to worst, we can still go home.
Should it come to that, though... the new world expedition I've yearned for will meet an anticlimactic end.
I would hate for that to happen.
That's all the more reason for us to land. Then we can fight, and if we start losing, we can just retreat again.
No. It's far too risky.
Urgh... No, you're sadly right. I can come back for another expedition, but I cannot come back from death.
Cleopatra, calibrate the Lighthouse. Prepare a homeward beacon as well, and then we'll–
With a dazzling light, an opulent train manifested in mid-air.
It flew toward the Mesektet at breakneck speed and used its tremendous firepower to rip apart all the enemies in its path.
A train?! In the air?!
Hahaha! Reinforcements from the world's inhabitants! The darkest hour is just before the dawn!
That's quite the stunning train.
Miss Governor, if that train ends up in deep water, I don't think we'll be able to help.
Whatever happens, happens! Right now, assist them in taking out these enemies!
So we're going to land, I presume?
Like hell we will! They're airborne and still fighting valiantly! Stay in the air and pound the enemy to dust!
KABOOOM!
The Mesektet's and the train's combined efforts managed to bring down a significant number of airborne enemies.
When Lion determined they'd gained enough breathing room, she contacted the train, and they immediately answered.
BEEP BEEP!
Good evening.
I am Queen Elizabeth, one of the original proponents of the Eternal Sun Project.
This train is called the Queen's Light. We heard your distress signal and were obliged by oath to come and assist.
I'm glad there is still an active resistance here. What's your status?
Psst! Miss Governor! She said she's Elizabeth and claims she came because of an oath...
She seems to have mistaken us for the natives of this world.
I wonder if this "Eternal Sun Project" has anything to do with the distress signal – "in the name of the Eternal Sun."
I think they're the real allies of whoever sent that signal, they got here before us, and their technology is much more advanced than ours.
Miss Governor, what should we do?
Hello? Do you copy? How strange – it does say we're on the line...
Miss Governor, please say something.
Ahem. We hear you.
Lady Elizabeth, is it? I am Lion, and I serve the Realm of the Neversetting Sun. I am the governor of the Nile in my home world.
Good to meet you, Lion. We only just arrived here, so we know nothing about your situation.
I want all the information you have about this world, its Royal Navy's remaining forces, and the enemy.
Hrmh...
Did you just grunt? Is something the matter?
Well, you see, we also came here after receiving a distress signal.
We know almost nothing about this world, just like you. In fact, we've been looking for someone from here who could explain things to us.
The other end of the line fell silent for a while before speaking up again.
...This is NOT what I was expecting. What a confusing mess this is.
There's more. You said your name was Queen Elizabeth, did you not?
This is my first time meeting you. Alive, I mean.
Again, the other side fell silent.
What an honour. Your world must have quite a complicated history.
We'll have to discuss it another time, though. Since we're both here for the same reason, shall we team up?
First, let's deal with what remains of these things, then find a safe place and exchange information. Sound good?
That it does. Let us work together.
Hm? Hang on...
So you noticed. Yes, a mass-produced fleet is approaching us from the northwest.
What are those things in the air? Royal Navy aircraft?
Could they be another force that received the distress signal?
No. This time, it's actual survivors from this world.
Come on, then. Let's deal with these foes, then go and meet up with them!
KABOOOM!
With their overpowering advantage, they encircled and annihilated the enemy. Silence returned to the chaotic sea.
Well, that was a gripping and grand victory.
You, the beautiful lady – it was you who called for help, was it not?
Using the Mesektet's equipment, Lion projected a hologram of herself into the air. She stood tall like a divine, golden giant.
Seeing this, the girl leading a fleet of mass-produced ships responded with a gracious bow.
I am Glorious, the flagship of the Realm of the Neversetting Sun. I welcome you, our allies.
I have no doubt that, after coming from such distant worlds, you must have many questions for me.
However, I think you'll agree that this place is not suited for a reception.
Let us first move to a safe location, and then we may speak.
Lion and Elizabeth acknowledged. They took their airship and flying train and followed the lead of the aircraft to the port of LD.
The storm is too strong! We'll be annihilated if we try to ride it out!
We're committed now, we can't just give up! Trust me, we will break through this storm soon enough!
Unknown enemy detected, bearing 150 degrees! Initiate evasive maneuvers...
An unknown enemy, in a storm like this? Tell me its coordinates!
Answer me, Shoukaku! What are its coordinates?!
... Get... out of… here…
Crap, we're losing radio contact... This isn't looking good...
Damn it... I still haven't had the chance to fight the Grey Ghost...
... Wait, what's...? What's that light...?
Oh god!
... Where... am I?
Hey... I'm still in one piece! I made it!
Ow! My head hurts, though... And I don't remember what happened...
Damn... I can't radio Shoukaku... Now things really aren't looking good...
No, get it together! I finally made it, after all...
I made it here! To the Sanctuary!

options.content: "I didn't think we’d run into the enemy so soon."

scripts.say: Woah! Commander, hold it right there!
Hehe, long time no see, Commander~
After all, we were warned that Siren Pawns were on the move, and an exercise was staged as a countermeasure.
Ahahaha! So you've seen through me! ...Wait, hold on, that was a bad joke! I'm the real Hornet!
...Anyway, here’s the deal. There’s been a lot of weird weather conditions around these parts, most likely due to Siren activity in these waters.
I don't need to be lecturing you about how the Pawns created by the Mirror Seas sometimes fight just like us, so the point of the exercise is to get us familiar with that...
And I, Hornet, will be your opponent. How about it, Commander? Ready for some action?
Orders received. Simply approach Hornet’s fleet to begin the exercise.
Woah~ You sure don't beat around the bush, Commander! But now, it’s my turn!
Objective identified: repel Hornet in this exercise.
I've confirmed that you've scored a direct hit on Hornet with a dummy round.
You really came prepared, Commander! Good on ya!
You should've already been briefed on this, but there’s been a new Siren spotted during pre-operation scouting.
If you encounter a particularly tough battle, don't be afraid to withdraw.
For example, if you encounter something... like this~!

options.content: ....“All right, let’s stick to that plan and withdraw!”

scripts.say: Warning: Based on an analysis of the incoming practice rounds, we are at a disadvantage. I would recommend withdrawing.
Orders received. Currently reassembling the fleet.
Good job out there, Commander. And you too, Cutie-B.
...All right. Now that we're done with the exercise, it’s time to get the A-team together!
And if I'm not mistaken, the Royal Navy is ready as well... Let’s hurry to NY City Port and join up with them!~
Naval exercise complete.
Course has been plotted to NY City. Please enter the port there and assemble your fleet.
Orders received. We are now entering NY City’s waters.
The port is located that way. Please move the fleet towards the destination.
Tutorial commencing. Transferring data...
Data transfer complete. I will now explain my tactical assistance features.
First, we have the fundamental navigation system. This will display a basic visual overview of a chosen sector or zone on your screen.
"Does it also show me where enemies and resource nodes are?" – That is correct. Said features are all accessible through this menu.
Special orders to the fleet can also be issued using my intermediary relay module. This will invariably ensure the message reaches its addressee.
...Orders received. Commencing test of order function.
Scan complete. Now displaying results of zone reconnaissance on screen.
Orders received. Commencing test of Scanning Mode.
Scattered Siren hostiles have been detected.
Scanning Mode has been calibrated. Scanning Mode can now be used on hostile fleets and points of interest such as item nodes.
Transferring data... Scanning the yellow tile host to an item node is recommended.
Scanning Mode can provide you with both detailed and general information on enemies, resource nodes, item caches, and more. Making frequent use of it is recommended.
Orders received. Select a target to scan.
Should you need assistance with navigation, it can be found here on your screen at any time.
Plot a course to NY City to inspect its logistics facilities.
You can manage your Operation Siren fleet from the NY City port.
This, of course, includes changing your fleet composition.
While docked in port, you are also able to buy items in the store, or repair any damaged ships in your fleet.
Here you may also view and undertake any special missions issued by naval headquarters.
Next, let us go over the item retrieval tutorial.
An item container has been located. To commence recovery of it, simply move your fleet onto it.
Commencing inventory tutorial.
Here you can view all the various items you have gathered throughout Operation Siren, such as repair items, exchange shop currencies, and the like.
Materials used in the Gear Lab and R&D are stored on the Materials tab.
It is believed that we will procure additional resources and design blueprints throughout the course of Operation Siren.
Filters can be used to only display things such as designs that may be developed.
After collecting the required materials, you can also commence gear research and development directly via this interface.
Transferring zone data... Complete. The Operation Siren map is divided into dozens of zones, based on naval command’s evaluation of the local climate and intensity of hostile presence.
Exploring and conquering zones will further expand your list of accessible zones.
G.The navigation system is equipped with a regional movement mode, which can help you quickly plot a fleet’s course.
This concludes the tutorial. You may now commence Operation Siren, Commander.
META coordinate tracking system initiated. Commencing tutorial.
It is hypothesized that META riggings are encased in a special material that renders them completely undetectable using conventional radars.
Fortunately, the R&D department has managed to engineer a device that is capable of detecting the faint tracks left by META members.
Locking on to these tracks and following them allows us to pinpoint the location of any META members active in the region.
Unlike Sirens, it is believed that META members can be reasoned with and that they are not inherently hostile. In certain cases, cooperation between us may even be feasible.
However, naval command has concluded that they will invariably interfere with Operation Siren in one way or another.
Bear in mind that fighting META members comes with extreme danger. Proceed with caution.
Extreme danger... I don't doubt it. Looking over the mission documents again, they say we only have to “deal with” the META, not “eliminate” them.
Why, what a keen eye you have. Allow me to elaborate on what means.
It is true that the META may pose a threat to the integrity of Operation Siren, but depending on who you ask, some members of the fleet view them as one of us.
If we gather more information about their goals and who they are, we may be able to get them on our side one day. Wouldn't that be something?~
Memphis has a point. We still don't know what the META are after. Moreover, they might be willing to at least hear what their fellow shipgirl has to say.
Who knows. One day, we might even fight side-by-side with them...
You have now received authorisation to sortie up to four fleets in Operation Siren.
Please, make full use of them to bring us victory.
Orders received. You are now able to deploy submarine fleets.
Submarines can be called in using the corresponding button on the interface.
Your submarine fleet can be repositioned much like normal. Use this to your advantage.
Your fleet is not prepared for Operation Siren.
Please level up your fleet more, enchance equipments and use Meowfficer to preapre for Operation Siren.
You've lifted all movement restrictions between normal zones on the Operation Siren map and earned the corresponding zone securing rewards. All normal zones will remain scouted until the next reset.
Operation Siren has been reset! Rewards other than Exploration rewards can now be obtained again. Let's sortie forth!
You used the Hidden Zone Data Logger. All Hidden Zones have been scouted, and Hidden Zone Strategic Search has been unlocked.
Entering allied port.
The Sirens in this zone look very powerful. They will be tougher than anything we’ve faced before.
The damage they take seems to persist. We might have a chance if we attack with several fleets.
We figured out these Sirens’ weak point. Make frequent use of scanning mode, update our fleet composition, and exploit their weak point.
Now entering a zone housing a Siren stronghold.
The Sirens responded to our offensive and constructed a stronghold in an area under their control. We have to destroy it if we hope to secure this zone.
Use the Fleet Deployment command to set up a sub fleet that you will be able to call in later.
You can now order the deployment of submarines to support your fleet.
With these jointly-developed damage control units, our ships can keep fighting with a sliver of durability even if they sustain critical damage during battle.
However, the damage control cannot perform miracles. Our ships’ performance will still worsen as they suffer more and more damage.
The only way to restore their performance to normal is to return to port for repairs, or order them to regroup and rest.
Losing a battle will result in your ships losing both HP and Resolve. If you lose several battles, they’ll be too fatigued and won’t be able to win against the boss.
You can order your ships to regroup and rest. This will repair the damage they’ve sustained, and restore their Resolve.
You can restore your ships’ HP by docking them at a port, changing your fleet composition, using certain items, or issuing a regroup and rest order.
Operation Siren has reset, and a special item shop has opened.

If you use the "Operation Siren Data Logger" from your Storage, you will be able to lift all movement restrictions between zones and immediately collect all the zone securing rewards. Additionally, all normal zones will remain scouted until the next reset.
It's not been that long, yet the beach is again buried under garbage brought in by the tide.
This pile of waste is an eyesore getting between the natural beauty of the sky and the sea.
Garbage has washed up again, Commander...
We've got to clean the beach again...
Come on... For the turtles...
It seldom rains on the deserted island, yet it is pouring down. Your clothes will get soaked at this rate.
You decide to look for shelter.
A while later, you notice that a lone, rain-drenched baby fox has sought shelter in the same place as you.
Its ears are drooping, and it seems to be either hungry or sad.
You take out an apple you picked in the forest and give it to the little fox.
It promptly wolves down on it, and when it's finished, the fox looks up at you with eyes that seem to yearn for more.
The rain shortly stops, and the weather clears up again. You go on your way, leaving the shelter behind.
You feel nothing special. It was just an insignificant encounter in the rain.
Feeling bad for the little animal, you offer it another apple.
It's even bigger than the last one. Its stomach must be full after this one.
Once again, it promptly wolves down on it, and when it's finished, the fox looks up at you with eyes that seem to yearn for more.
This is a greedy little creature. You don't want to indulge it any more.
You pay no attention to the fox, which looks at you with a lovable expression.
The rain stops. You leave the shelter behind, and the insignificant encounter recedes into the back of your mind.
You offer it a triply extra-large apple and swear to yourself not to give it any more after this.
The rain keeps falling. The fox happily eats the apple while you sit there, bored.
After it finishes eating, the fox wags its tail at you, seemingly very pleased, before disappearing amidst the rainfall.
The rain stops, and the skies over the island turn clear once more.
Out of nowhere, a little red critter appears before you. It's the fox you fed the apples to, and it is holding a gift in its mouth..
This is its way of repaying the kindness you showed it during this off encounter in the rain.
As you're exploring the island, you stumble across a manjuu that appears to be drowning in a small river in the forest.
Plrblrblrbhh! Help! Help me, peep! Blrlbrph...
Just as you get ready to jump in the river, a manjuu seemingly with the aura of a god emerges from it.
O, wise and kind warrior, I commend thy willingness to put thyself in harm's way to save a manjuu.
So, tell me, which manjuu fell in the river? This one of gold, or this one of silver?
