You gave the godlike manjuu your answer.
Is that so? Was it really the golden one?
...Actually, to be frank with thee, I forgot which one it was.
No matter. In light of thy sincerity, I shall give thee the golden manjuu. Treat the little peep well!
You gave the godlike manjuu your answer.
Is that so? Was it really the silver one?
...Actually, to be frank with thee, I forgot which one it was.
No matter. In light of thy sincerity, I shall give thee the silver manjuu. Treat the little peep well!
In the spirit of the fairy tale this is seemingly inspired by, the right thing to do is say neither; it was a normal manjuu.
However, you are so taken aback by what you're seeing that you cannot answer properly.
Doth thou mean to say it was neither of them, hmm?~
Indeed, thou art an honest one. Worry not about the little peep, for I already saved him before posing my question.
In light of thy outstanding honesty, I shall give thee both the golden and silver manjuus. Treat the little peeps well!
The god-manjuu hands you both the precious manjuus, then disappears beneath the surface.
Look, Otto, I'm as eager to find the hidden treasure on this island as you are...
But you need to watch your step. Remember what I told you about the vines?
What vines?
Ahem... "The creep vine lurks in the forest's dark corners. It ensnares reckless travelers who pass by it."
Creep vine? Yeah, right. That's just a story meant to scare kids who–
Before she could finish speaking, Otto felt something squirm under her feet.
Aaaaahhhh!
In the blink of an eye, the vine has suspended her in the air.
Well, well... A predatory vine. Just like the reports said.
Its morphology is also quite unique. I should bring a sample back for study.
Seriously?! You knew this vine hangs around these parts?!
Well, yes.
Then you could've warned me about it!
I literally did not even a minute ago. You chose to ignore my warning.
Urgh... It's tightening its grip... Don't just stand there! Get me down!
As you're passing through a clearing, you come across some unusual creatures.
You there, traveler! Come over here and play a game with us peeps!
One of us peeps is hiding a rare and shiny gem.
If you guess the correct peep, the gem is yours!
In truth, we don't really have a gem! Us peeps just want to play.
Zzz... Peep...
"A guessing game, eh. Let's see if I can pick the right one."
Formidable and you are walking along the cliffs of the mountain while a white mist ripples beneath your feet. The view from here is astonishing.
That's when all of a sudden, you catch sight of an orange rectangle.
It's in the distance, but if you had to guess, it's a warning sign that was put up recently.
Hmm... I can't make out what it says on account of this mist.
I'll get a bit closer and try to read it, Commander.
I will. Now let's see here...
"Unstable foundation. Beware of rockslides"...
There is an ominous cracking sound, and suddenly, the ground beneath Formidable's feet collapses.
Aaaahhhh!
Oh! *pant*... *pant*... Thank goodness there's a vine here, or else I'd been done for...
That sign is worthless where it's placed now! ...C-Commander, come and help me up!
*burp*... I'm hungry. Do you have any food, Comrade Commander?
Grozny and you are surveying the expansive forest. It's been quite the trek, and she looks exhausted.
I could eat anything. Heck, I might just take a bite out of you.
"Please don't. I don't taste good."
Take it easy. I'm just kidding with you.
"If memory serves me right, there should be a camp stocked with rations just a stone's throw away from here."
"I'm fairly sure the exploration team left behind some meat."
Ooh, meat! That's perfect for a barbecue!
Her eyes glimmer with eagerness.
While we don't have any vodka or borscht, the thought of juicy barbecue alone is enough to make my mouth water...
You can rest and I'll man the grill, Comrade Commander.
You're going to fall in love with the taste of Northern Parliament-style barbecue!
As you're exploring the island, you come across an eerie cave.
Something inside it is radiating a curious light.
Looks creepy... Do you think a ferocious animal might live in there?
There might be an unexpected find in there... Like a fluffy pillow...
You won't find a pillow out in the mountains... But, there's often lootables inside caves in video games. Like treasure chests.
I don't see any signs that it's inhabited. It's probably stood empty for a long time. What do you think we should do, Commander?
Nothing ventured, nothing gained. You decide to...
After a long walk through the snaking cave, you eventually find wooden boards and stones with clear signs of handicraft.
It seems this cave was once used for storage.
And there's no fluffy pillows to be found. Sad...
What were you expecting? Please use your common sense, Laffey.
A surprising find – you obtained a small quantity of crafting materials!
Continuing deeper through the dark, dank cave, you come across another surprise.
Halt, everyone! I just heard something!
The deafening roar of an animal echoes from further in.
I-I think we've angered the cave's resident! Let's get out of here!
This does look like an animal's den, even if it's too dark to see inside.
It could be dangerous for all you know. Best to play it safe and turn back.
An uneventful step on your journey – nothing happened, but that's fine. Every adventure needs a little downtime.
You are walking along the river when, out of the blue, you hear repeated splashing.
You turn your head to the source of the sound and spot a small animal, trying its hardest to stay afloat. It seems it fell into the river.
The river is so deep you can't see the bottom. The animal flails about, desperately crying for help.
You steel yourself and decide to...
You jump into the river to rescue the helpless critter.
The water is cold, but this only fills you with determination. In the end, you manage to rescue the animal, but you pass out on the riverbank afterwards...
When you wake up, you find a token of gratitude left beside you.
It must be from the animal you rescued. You've been rewarded for your heroic act.
As much as you want to save the animal, you don't want to put yourself in harm's way. What if you need rescuing next, after all?
It's wiser to call for someone nearby to help.
With your friends' help, you manage to rescue the little critter.
It runs off, leaving behind a token of gratitude. You've been rewarded for your level-headed response.
An enormous bird's nest, almost as big as a cloud, catches your attention.
You approach it, and suddenly hear a strange voice inside your head.
"Cock-a-doodle-doo... I shall trade with you..."
"Leave an offering... buk-buk-buk... and be rewarded..."
The unprocessed wood you offered gives off a brilliant light, and then...
You found a treasure in the bird's nest!
Do you want to try again?
The unprocessed ores you offered give off a brilliant light, and then...
Nothing. Your materials disappeared without a trace...
For want of more treasure, you put in additional materials.
However, nothing happened. Your materials remain in place, as you'd expect them to.
The strange voice has vanished, and it seems you can't get any more treasure this way.
The unprocessed wood you offered gives off a brilliant light, and then...
Nothing. Your materials disappeared without a trace...
Do you want to try again?
The unprocessed ores you offered give off a brilliant light, and then...
You found a treasure in the bird's nest!
Do you want to try again?
The unprocessed ores you offered give off a brilliant light, and then...
Nothing. Your materials disappeared without a trace...
Do you want to try again?
This voice is obviously untrustworthy and should not be listened to.
You turned back the way you came, leaving the dubious bird's nest behind.
Do you want to try again?
The unprocessed wood you offered gives off a brilliant light, and then...
You found a treasure in the bird's nest!
For want of more treasure, you put in additional materials.
However, nothing happened. Your materials remain in place, as you'd expect them to.
The strange voice has vanished, and it seems you can't get any more treasure this way.
The unprocessed wood you offered gives off a brilliant light, and then...
Nothing. Your materials disappeared without a trace...
For want of more treasure, you put in additional materials.
However, nothing happened. Your materials remain in place, as you'd expect them to.
The strange voice has vanished, and it seems you can't get any more treasure this way.
The unprocessed ores you offered give off a brilliant light, and then...
You found a treasure in the bird's nest!
For want of more treasure, you put in additional materials.
However, nothing happened. Your materials remain in place, as you'd expect them to.
The strange voice has vanished, and it seems you can't get any more treasure this way.
You got lost during your adventure and wound up deep inside an unmapped forest.
All around you are giant, unusually-colored mushrooms that give off a faint light. You decide to...
These mushrooms look as poisonous as it gets, but they should be safe to lie down on.
You sit down on the cap of a mushroom and rest. Its surface is velvety soft, and gently beckons you to dreamland.
When you open your eyes again, you find yourself inside a cave packed with treasures.

options.content: This is a dream. Snap out of it.

scripts.say: Among them, an old-fashioned but ornate treasure chest atop a tall pedestal in the cave's center catches your eye.
These mushrooms look as poisonous as it gets.
You give them a wide berth for the sake of your well-being.
Who's dumb enough to pass up free treasure? Not you.
You open the treasure chest and find that it's filled to the brim with priceless gold and jewels.
You wake up. The cave, the treasure chest, and the precious booty are all nowhere to be seen.
It seems what you saw was merely a dream induced by that weird mushroom you slept on.
Who's dumb enough to pass up free treasure? Not you.
You open the treasure chest and find that it's filled to the brim with priceless gold and jewels.
You wake up. To your surprise, you are cradling the treasure chest you found in your dream.
Filled with joy over this miracle, you open the treasure chest...
Strangely, it's filled not with gold and jewels, but rather a few handy items.
While there's no denying you got nice stuff, you still feel a bit disappointed.
You shake your head and manage to wake up.
The cave, treasure chest, and of course the valuable booty are all gone, and you find yourself back atop the giant mushroom.
With it in hand, you walk off, leaving the strange place behind.
You shake your head and manage to wake up.
But, strangely, you feel a weight between your arms. Unbelievably, it's the treasure chest from the dream.
With it in hand, you walk off, leaving the strange place behind.
呀 好像被困住了 用另一个舰队尝试找找能破解障碍的机关吧
这里是假入口
这里是机关，会破坏掉障碍
这是宝箱
被你发现了
Yo~ Looks like you're doing fine, Commander... Well then, rest up a bit and come have some tea~
And one and two and spin! Whew... I'm working hard today~ I'm dripping sweat all over~ Hey, welcome back, Commander, did you wanna train with me?
We sure did our bestest today, huh~? You did well, who's a good Commander? You are~.
Amiozing work there, Commander! You must be tired. Let me pat you on the head and tell you what a good job you did. And then we'll play a game~♪
Welcome back, Commander! Even if I'm wearing white, I'm still the same genius magician! Want to see my magic? Well then, prepare yourself!
Nakirificent work, Commander! Ay have prepared us a light meal. Heheh, aren't Ay attentive? You may partake with me in the eating of it. Mmh, delicious!
"Welcome back, Master!" or something. Wasn't that super maid-like?! Well then, I'll leave the cleaning of the office and preparation of dinner to you~
We're almost within firing range of the core tower, but these Compiler vessels won't let us get a clear shot...
There's just no end to them! I've BEEN sick and tired of this!
To make things worse, their combat specs keep going up the closer we get to the tower!
The Sirens are getting desperate. But we've defeated plenty of these vessels before, and so we shall do to the rest.
As I mentioned before, the "consciousness" of high-ranking Sirens can be transferred between any number of bodies, so they don't have a true body per se.
What we face now are scarcely different from Pawns, albeit stronger.
Oh my... I seem to have struck a nerve with someone.
...That you've come this far has already exceeded my calculations.
"Exceeded your calculations, huh? Has anything ever fallen within your calculations?"
Further calibrations will be conducted. The outcome shall be self-evident. Nothing will change.
We keep exceeding your calculations because you constantly look down on us.
You were the one who attacked us as Scapa Flow, weren't you? How the tides have turned.
Your bravado is foolish and meaningless.
Without the Sirens' intervention, the Iron Blood fleet would've been scuttled at Scapa Flow.
"...What?"
Compiler did not respond, instead using the vessel to spread a thick sea fog around the Iron Blood ships.
A number of shipgirls began to appear in the fog, like ghosts returning from the grave with untold stories.
They ordered us to take our Iron Blood flag down ten days ago and haven't given us permission to fly it again ever since.
And now, they've even unbolted our cannons. We don't have the ability to fight anymore.
Are we supposed to just sit here until the talks reach a conclusion?
That person is... me? But I don't remember ever saying anything like that...
The sea fog grew thicker, and a new scene began to play out.
We've been stuck here for months, and the peace talks still haven't panned out yet...
I can't just sit by and watch any longer! The Royal Navy fleet sailed out of Scapa Flow this morning for training, so this is our chance.
We move out today. We will honor our vows to the Iron Blood!
It's a message from Emden... "Carry out Paragraph 11."
.........Understood.
I have no desire to become a hero. Our duty is but to do and die.
Goodbye, my comrades. For the Iron Blood.
One after another, the shades of the shipgirls sank into the sea quietly and disappeared.
We fought against the Royal Navy. We were defeated, and then scuttled...
Is this the truth... or a vicious illusion to poison our minds?
I have no recollection of doing or saying any of those things.
There's no way that happened, but...
Emden is still trembling... What is the meaning of what you've shown us?
It is your truth.
I see now... Quite a convincing ruse you put on just now, Compiler.
But your "records" are neither our past nor our future.
Your cognitive jamming has no effect on Emden! Heheh... Hahaha~♥
While the Eagle Union, Northern Parliament, and Iron Blood fleets advanced, the Sakura Empire's fleet remained motionless.
(Akagi told us to stay here and wait... But how can we just watch from the sidelines while everyone else fights?!)
...That's just not my style!
Zuikaku suddenly swerved to the side, just as several Siren shells barely missed her original position.
Woah, that was a close one! Looks like the Sirens brought the fight right to us, Akagi.
That gives us the green light to counterattack, right?
*sigh*...
Hey, those were the orders you gave! Now that we're under attack, we've got no choice but to fight back, yeah?
Alright. Knock yourself out then.
Thanks, Akagi! Zuikaku of the 5th CarDiv, sortieing!
We've got planes coming in from behind us! It must be the Sakura fleet's air support!
"Did Akagi finally make up her mind? Great news - that's going to increase our odds of winning."
Fools. I will show you your truths as well.
Once again, Compiler's vessel blanketed the area with a dense sea fog.
Ugh...!
Zuikaku, you're badly injured!
Don't worry about me... Get out of here as quickly as you can!
The operation has failed, and we are the decoys. Where are we supposed to run...?
Beats me. Just, anywhere but here...
Haha... I was so gung-ho about making a heroic last stand... But I couldn't do anything at all...
There are more enemy planes coming at us! Chitose, Zuikaku, do you have any planes left?
Of course not. We never had a chance to begin with... We all knew that, didn't we?
I'm scared, Chitose... I can't feel my body anymore...
It's okay, Chiyoda. I'll... always be with you...
Shoukaku... I'll be able to see you again, soon...
The shadows of the Sakura Empire's carriers rumbled and burst into flames before vanishing beneath the waves.
Keep your wits about you, Zuikaku. She's trying to get into your head.
...I know. I've heard about a similar thing happening to the Eagle Union fleet inside the Bermuda Triangle.
I'll be alright, Jintsuu. I know those illusions aren't really us.
Right now, we're all allies... And we're even stronger when we fight together!
So something like this will never happen – and I'll fight to make sure of it!
Don't be deceived by her illusions, everyone!
What I have shown you is the truth. What you have experienced is false. History does not lie.
You know this to be true, Akagi.
After all, your reality is different from Zuikaku's.
Hahaha... Ahahahaha!
How disappointing, Siren. Our relationship goes no deeper than mutually exploiting one another.
You're mistaken if you think you can freely manipulate me to your convenience.
You have my permission to go all out. Let's show these Sirens the pride of the Sakura Empire!
Heh. Well said.
That's the Akagi I know!
Ooh, there goes the pesky barrier generator! Focus your fire on her armor, and we'll be able to smash through her in no time!
Sea fog calculated to be ineffective.
The Eagle Union is powerful and ideological.
Their military strength far surpasses the other factions.
But to what ends?
Playing simulation results––
The Eagle Union's fleet was soon also engulfed by dense sea fog.
Whew, the scenery here is pretty sweet. A nice place to carry out our last mission, huh?
Still cheery as always, huh? I guess I can't fault you for trying to find the silver lining.
Hahaha! Everyone's gotta go eventually. Might as well go with a smile on your face!
I know, but... But...
C'mon, why does everyone look so depressed?
This is a super-important mission, so someone has to do it!
It just happened to be us this time.
Besides, the whole world is going to remember us for this!
That's why... Sister Sara doesn't have any regrets!
Though, I can't help thinking about all the other things I haven't gotten a chance to do yet...
Enterprise, we'll make the Eagle Union proud, right?
A radiant pillar of light engulfed the illusions.
And though there were no explosions, the silence was deafening.

options.content: "I'm not sure what you tried to show us..."
"...But whatever it is, it won't let it happen!"

scripts.say: I... I'm alright, Commander!
It's just an illusion cooked up by the Sirens... That means nothing to me!
I'm not even sure what she's trying to show us, but...
The Commander would never betray us, in any future. None of us have ever doubted that for a second.
Indeed. My child will defy you at every turn, Siren.
What can the presence of a single human do? What I have shown you is history. And history does not lie.
Therefore, our experiments are necessary. And you have no choice but to be experimented on.
I won't deny it. That is why even Bismarck chose to work with you and accepted that Black Cube.
That has been the case - until now. You are simply creating the future you desire.
When you failed to consider our free will, the deal was no longer on the table.
Meaningless. The future is already determined. All you can do is "repeat" it.
That is for us to decide, Siren. You cannot dictate our future.
The fact that you've been unable to predict my actions, or my child's actions... means your future has already ceased to be.
Or are you going to tell me that your failure to predict the future is also a part of your plans?
The results are the same in the end. If you are unable to predict our actions...
Then isn't it best to just take your hands off and let things unfold?
If anything, you should be thanking us for making your job easier. Hehe.
A meaningless discussion.
Natural deviations occur during the experimentation process. It is within Compiler's jurisdiction to reset these deviations.
Requesting local cleanup authorization...
<Current situation: High possibility of damage to the Core Data Tower. Threat assessment: Significant.>
<Activating protocol: Allocating resources for low-level terminal experimental site reset.>
<Pruning authorized. Request complete.>
<Initiating cleanup protocol. Resetting subjects in the experimental site.>
Responding to Compiler's inorganic voice, the tower in the middle of the Mirror Sea began to flash.
The frequency of the blinking gradually increased along with the intensity of the light, and soon the entire Mirror Sea began to tremble and quake.
However, the impending disaster did nothing to halt the mass-produced Sirens' advance.
So this is the superweapon that completely destroyed Scapa Flow and the Iron Blood fleet.
Do you see it now? This is Compiler's trump card.
By tapping into the Siren networks that have fundamentally worked their way into our world, she will be able to eradicate everything inside the Mirror Sea.
My child, all my fleets are yours to command. Guide us forward, and defeat Compiler.
Now...
Show me your true potential.

options.content: "All right everyone, we've been waiting for this moment our whole lives!"
"From now on, our destiny belongs only to us!"

scripts.say: "You don't even have to ask me once."
Forward, everyone! Together with the Iron Blood and the Sakura Empire, we will put an end to the Sirens!
Excellent, my child. Conduct the end to this symphony with your own two hands!
<Warning: Loss of mass-produced ships exceeds expected outcome by 26.78%.>
<Warning: Combat simulation module deviation forecast in excess of -30%.>
<Warning: Critical pressure, tower anti-projectile barriers expected to fail in 10 seconds.>
...I have never seen such anomalous deviation values across the board.
Delay in adapting to the Iron Blood ships' attack patterns.
Holographic cognitive jamming ineffective.
Unpredictable behavior from test subjects due to the actions of the "Commander."
I can confirm that the barrier is starting to go down! For a moment there, I was worried that my planes wouldn't do anything against the Siren facilities...
We've been bombing the same place over and over again, so it's gonna overheat sooner or later!
*yaaawn*... I'm gonna start attacking now, alright? Starting to get a bit bored over here...
Woah, my shots are inflicting some serious damage to the tower's armor! Should've put me in sooner~!
<Unable to regenerate barrier. Combat simulation module deviation forecast in excess of -40%.>
<Possibility of damage to the Core Data Tower processor––>
Zero. You've run out of time.
<Core Data Tower charging complete. Weapons launching in T-30.>
<Warning: This decision will cause irreversible damage to the experimental site.>
Continue. Eliminate the sources of instability.
<Ready to launch. Experimental site reset commencing.>
Upon hearing those ominous words, time seemed to slow to a crawl. Each pulse of the tower's light seemed to line up with my own heartbeat.
My whole body started to feel numb and weak. My breathing became labored, and it became harder and harder to think straight.
As my consciousness flickered, I managed to squeeze out another order. There was still a portion of our forces using their firepower to hold back the Sirens. With their help, maybe––
("Come to me, my darling human.")
...How unfortunate. We weren't able to make the final push.
Even with the combined strength of all our fleets, we were unable to break through the tower.
And now that you're down, the chain of command has fallen apart.
I suppose this is our limit, as shipgirls.
I hate to admit it, but this is your win, Compiler.
("Follow my voice, my darling human. The Siren's song has no effect on us.")
...A message? Is that you, my child?
Haha... Hahahaha!
Who would've expected... The moment that you learned the truth behind the Wisdom Cube, this operation was already out of my hands.
Well done, my child. Nobody can anticipate the things you'll do. Not I, not the Sirens.
This is Friedrich der Große. Are you still with us, my child?

options.content: "Everyone, one last time! Focus everything you have at the tower!"
"Ignore the Sirens! Destroying the tower is the only thing that matters!"

scripts.say: "Somehow. I'm hanging in there."
I'm glad you're safe. Let us make one final push––
Well said. Allow me to lend you my assistance––
Except this time...
You heard the orders! The Arbiters won't be able to find you here!
Show us the might of the Ashes! Iron Blood battleship, Scharnhorst!
Hmph. I know what to do without needing to take orders from anyone.
I am finally starting to understand... how inspiring the "potential" you mentioned to me truly is.
Allow me, Scharnhorst, to offer you my aid.
Behold the might of the Ashes, Siren!!
KABOOOM!
The concerto of barrages from the Iron Blood, Eagle Union, and Sakura Empire ships was bolstered by the Ashes' sheer firepower.
A stubborn one, aren't we? Wait... We broke through!
Everyone, brace for impact!!
The lights from the tower converged into a single point, becoming a circular aura that convulsed several times.
In an instant, an invisible shockwave rippled out from the tower, followed by a massive explosion that shook the sky and the sea around Scapa Flow.
When the smoke cleared, only a pile of rubble remained at the original site of the tower.
Compiler's tower has been leveled.
(That person is... a META battleship? But why would she be taking orders from the Iron Blood?!)
Watch out, everyone! All the Siren aircraft are going out of control and crashing! Find someplace safe to retreat to!
They're gonna be a thorn in our side even after we win, huh? We've already made it this far, so don't get yourselves hurt now!
Eldridge... will keep zapping things...
Great job keeping the Commander safe, Eldridge. The flagship is a big target compared to us.
Mm... Eldridge... will protect Commander...
You led an excellent battle, Commander.
I-I can't believe I didn't get blown to bits by the Sirens... It must be some kind of fluke...
It's all thanks to you, Emden, for waking the Commander up...
Hmm? I didn't do anything in particular. My darling human is quite resilient, after all.
Ugh, I'm totally wiped... Hey, Seydlitz, mind giving me a piggyback ride?
I suppose it wouldn't kill me.
"Keep what just happened between the three of us, human~"
(What happened right before I was about to collapse when the superweapon was going to launch...?)
We've won, my child.
For the first time ever, we've scored a real victory against the Sirens.
We've never been able to do more than push them back in the past. But now, we've eliminated one of their program terminals.
Say, won't you accompany me back home and assist the Iron Blood as we walk this new path?

options.content: "Let me sleep on the idea first."

scripts.say: I'm well aware. As the Commander, you are not bound by faction loyalty.
Entertain the idea, though. Let's suppose you were to formally ally with the Iron Blood...
Well, I suppose first of all there'd be a massive outcry from girls of all factions. It'd be even worse than the time you stayed in the Northern Parliament.
Of course. I need some time to prepare for a potential "yes," myself.
Though I certainly wouldn't mind accomodating you at my own place until I can arrange something proper, my child.
"Now that Bismarck is back in power, what direction do you expect the Iron Blood to go in?"
Our course for the future? Excellent question. You'll see for yourself, sooner or later.
Or you could ask Bismarck. She may just spill the beans to you, my child.
"Are you hinting at some kind of departure from the Iron Blood on your part?"
Don't be silly. I just want to resume working behind the scenes, where I do best. I don't belong in front of a podium.
Before I go, let me leave you with a gift. You'll want to pay a visit to Samos Island.
All I can say is that you'll find something of intrigue there.
"Something of intrigue, huh. That's so vague I'm not sure what to think of it."
If I knew what it is, I would tell you a little more. Sadly, I don't.
Now, shouldn't you be returning to the Azur Lane? Your girls are waiting for you.
Be proud of yourself, my child. Don't forget you are directly responsible for the elimination of a key Siren.
The Iron Blood's declaration of war on the Sirens came as a surprise to everyone, most likely even Naval HQ.
What might they be saying right now behind closed conference room doors? That was a question for future me to answer.
Later that day, the Azur Lane and the Crimson Axis, both ostensibly still at war with one another, met in Scapa Flow harbor.
Before both sides sailed home, they exchanged brief pleasantries – and a promise. A promise to never forget this day that they fought side by side.

scripts.say: 我、我什么时候说过要问罗德尼的事情了！…这样…是本身就有兴趣吗…（ 小声）

scripts.actorName: Houshou [The Dream of the Autumn Pillow]

scripts.say: 说说看，要是心情好的话我也不是不能帮你……

scripts.actorName: Houshou [The Dream of the Autumn Pillow]

scripts.say: 你不会自己去吗？我可不想跟那些眼高于顶的家伙说话……算了，只有这一次
那就麻烦你了~
scripts.actorName: Houshou [The Dream of the Autumn Pillow]

Houshou～

Iris Orthodoxy - Mont-Saint-Michel
Peace Interlude Exercise Area
July 25th

scripts.say: Clear skies, calm waters. The faction flags of Europa flutter in the wind above Mont-Saint-Michel.
Shipgirls and mass-produced ships have both gotten into position and await orders. The Peace Interlude is about to begin.
Ugh... It took some ruthless all-nighters, but we got done in the nick of time...
At least we didn't run into any real trouble along the way.
You deserve a medal, Dupleix.
We can't celebrate yet, though. This is where things really kick off.
I know, I know. I just needed a little break before continuing.
Whew... Now it's time to focus on the exercise itself.
It seems this will be a round-robin competition with each of the factions taking turns between attacking and defending. Interestingly, there is no ranking system in place.
Though, I suppose there's no reason to have one. This is, after all, just an exhibition tournament meant to deepen bonds.
You'd think shooting at each other rather than a designated target would have the opposite effect, though...
You're looking at it the wrong way.
Fighting fellow shipgirls lets you figure out your own strengths and weaknesses, no?
You have a point. Anyway, we should start setting off.
Our fleet is up first, AND Cardinal Richelieu is watching. We must give it our all.
What's the matter?
Oh, nothing. I was just lost in thought.
L'Audacieux's right. Psych yourselves up and let's show them the Orthodoxy's glory.
Good day to you, ladies.
Good day to you as well. Welcome to Mont-Saint-Michel.
I've heard so much about this grand Basilica. Seeing it with my own two eyes now, I can say it's every bit as splendid as they say!
It is quite the sight. I'm glad to hear you're so fond of it.
Ahem. Hermione, that's enough small talk.
Oh, right! Do forgive me.
Then without further ado, let's begin, ladies.
Of course. Good luck.
Congratulations. We admit defeat.
You fought admirably. It's no wonder they speak so highly of you Royal Maids.
We've gained a better understanding of our strengths and weaknesses thanks to you. I look forward to fighting you again with our roles reversed.
Likewise. It will be an honour to face you again.
The Royal Navy fleet regrouped, then withdrew from the exercise area.
Whew... Great work, girls.
Catch your breaths, then we'll go and meet Iron Blood.
I'm afraid this is as far as you'll get.
That's a lot of retrofits you've got. I didn't see any of that on the invitee list.
Perhaps not the retrofit part, but we are on the list. It's not like it's against the rules.
I've heard the Royal Navy is deploying retrofitted girls in batches. It seems you had the same idea.
Yes, though we've never fought together as a fleet before, so this will be a first for us.
Still, we won't hold anything back, and I hope you won't either!
Well said! Let's go!
All our forces have either been neutralized or suffered heavy damage... That was a very close match.
What's more... it looks like they earned slightly more points than us.
It really is remarkable what a force multiplier a retrofit is. Especially when you concentrate them into a single team.
I-I mean, you were all really strong, too...
Now we should all catch our breaths for a bit. It'll be exciting to see how you fare in the rematch.
Same. We'll get you next time for sure.
The Iron Blood fleet regrouped, then pulled out of the exercise area.
Up next – Sardegna. They'll be our last opponent on the defensive.
I know there's nothing on the line, but I would like at least two victories today.
Remember that this is an exhibition tournament. Winning or losing isn't what matters.
You don't want to shoot your bolt too soon, or the next three battles as the defenders will be a struggle.
She's right. Recharge your batteries, then we'll face off against Sardegna.
*snap*!
A picture's worth a thousand words! I call this, "The Orthodoxy's Fleet Sails Against the Wind."
Whoa! Look how cool they look! You might win a Pulitzer for this one!
I reckon so, too!
You're... a journalist?
Not JUST a journalist – I'm also one of your opponents! Name's Alfredo Oriani. This is Captain Pompey, and that's Giuseppe Garibaldi.
Greetings.
Prepare yourself, challengers! The great Captain Pompey shall take you on!
Draw your swords and show me your shimmering blades!
Excuse me?
Come on, surely you know what I mean? Don't your Cardinal and Fighting Angels make their weapons glow when they attack?
You mean... like this?
Yes, just like that!
*snap*!
Beautiful. "The Templar Knight Unveils Her Radiant Sword." Another one for the collection!
Could you take this at least a LITTLE seriously?
Also, aren't YOU the challengers here? You're in Orthodoxy waters, so...
Well said! But enough words! It's time to do battle!
Were you even trying?
I've been vanquished! How could this be?!
Man, that was a really close one! Talk about unstoppable force meeting immovable object!
I mean, the scoreboard says we beat you by a landslide.
Hey, it's not about winning or losing! It's about the friends we made along the way!
Alright, Alfredo. You lost your first battle, so it's back to school with you.
No, wait! I lost on purpose, okay? I'll get serious in the next battle, promise!
I've even got a foolproof secret plan!
Secret plan? You've piqued my curiosity.
Oh, you're gonna love it! Just be patient and you'll see!
Uh-huh. I'm looking forward to it.
As you should. See you later!
The Sardegnian fleet regrouped, then left the exercise area behind.
And so, the Iris Orthodoxy's turn as the attacking side concluded. Now it was time to play defense.
KABOOOM!
Whew. A walk in the park.
This place being the source of the corruption, I expected more resistance.
Is this the power of METAmorphosis? Or has my mindset simply changed?
What is it that makes me feel so safe and dependable, yet light-headed?
KABOOOM!
Then, she heard the rumbling of machine engines not far from her.
Aircraft? Out here?
There must be others who are trapped in here.
I must help them at once!
Hiei cut through the black mist and her surroundings changed completely, as though she'd been thrust into a new place.
Dark clouds, thunder, a burning sea... This might not be real, but it certainly feels real.
I suppose an illusion has gripped this place, too.
She looked at the sky and saw the clear silhouettes of a squadron of aircraft.
The unidentified aircraft were attacking a massive phoenix manifested by the corrosion.
KABOOOM!
In but the blink of an eye, the phoenix attacked back, knocking them all out of the air.
A shame about the planes... That phoenix fights unlike anything I've seen before.
Where did that beast come from?
The sounds of fighting stopped.
The aerial attack had been meaningless, and the remains of the aircraft lay scattered in the sea.
KABOOOM!
It's not over... Not yet!
I've figured out the source of your strength!
Even if this world is beyond salvation, I can still send you to the deepest depths of hell!
Hatakaze?
She's gravely wounded... She'll sink at this rate!
Although Hiei was hardly in a favorable position herself, her body acted before her brain did.
KABOOOM!
Cannons boomed, and she dodged the incoming shells. She had no choice but to help Hatakaze against the beast.
Disappear like a cloud in the sky!
KABOOOM!
Hiei's attack struck the phoenix of black mist hiding amongst the clouds, dispersing it into nothingness.
Hang in there, Hatakaze!
Hiei? I thought we'd lost you... Am I dreaming?
Well, you could call this a dream of sorts, I suppose.
Dream or not, though, I will not turn my back on a comrade.
Our enemies will be on to us soon, so we should leave. Come with me.
Whatever comes next, we'll just have to deal with it!

Engagement Zone

scripts.say: I arrive at the rendezvous point with the Sakurans in tow. We cross paths with Sendai's unit, who just shook off their attackers.
Sorry, Amagi. I underestimated their firepower and couldn't do anything to 'em...
What matters is that you're all alright. They caught you by surprise – there shouldn't be any enemies here.
Thanks for the kind words. So, who are these people?
Our guests and our reliable reinforcements.
You've got carrier gear like what Houshou's got... Are you...?
Yes. I'm a carrier, much like Zuikaku and Ryuuhou.
I'm shocked that the corrosion has even made it into Amagi's world...
Zuikaku, Ryuuhou, show them what our carrier fleet is capable of!
Roger!
Sendai, take the severely injured and bring them to the rear. They're not fit for this battle.
Jintsuu, you'll lead the escort fleet. Don't stray too far and be aware of threats both above and below the water.
Kaga, you're coming with me. I'm not letting any of those things near you.
Finally, have the girls of the other factions link up with the escort fleet. Does that sound good, Commander?
She's completely back to her old self.
Should she really be issuing orders, though? This is YOUR fleet, Commander.
It's fine. Real or not, these are Sakuran waters, and Akagi is more familiar with them than I am.
She can be in charge of this battle.
Oh, Commander!
She's leading us? That needy woman?
Crap... Sorry, Amagi. Body moved faster than my brain.
Ugh...
Forgive me, sister... I'm no good at this...
No, you're doing great. This is a spectacular formation.
Really?
Remember the Commander's words. You're in charge of this battle.
It's your time to shine now. Show us how the carriers of the future fight.
Okay! I will!
Get ready, everyone! The fight starts now!
KABOOM!
Hah! Be reduced to ashes!
All that's left is the southern group. These shapeless heaps of corruption are pathetic.
Wooow... You're incredible, Akagi!
Yes, it's like she's a changed person all of a sudden.
The might of a carrier is awe-inspiring.
It's not long before all the invading spawns of corruption have been mopped up.
Akagi's mood has done a complete U-turn – she smiles as she turns to me and Amagi for approval.
But then, tragedy strikes...
Ambush! Look out!
Where'd they come from?!
From the distance, a crimson shimmer comes flying straight toward my command vessel.
Commander!
The girls promptly jump in the way, blocking the path of the object.
This aura... Is it...?
KABOOM!
Coward! Resorted to dirty tricks, huh?!
Kaga aims her cannons and fires a volley, but the crimson light changes course and dodges.
It locks on to a new target – Amagi – and speeds up.
I knew it was you! I'm not letting you hurt them!
Akagi rushes to her sister's side and gets between her and the crimson light, using her own body as a shield.
Before she can get a word out, the world segment is instantly shrouded in darkness.
Even so, a faint voice reaches my ears.
Commander... I'm sorry...
At least this is a fitting end for someone who committed such grave sins in the name of obsession.
Thank you... Thank you for being kind to me to the very end...
Protect... them...
Kaga, Amagi, and all the rest... Protect them...
When the light comes back, Akagi is nowhere to be seen.
The shipgirls sailed on through Naraka, with Nagato leading the way.
Nagato's powers easily dealt with what enemies attacked them along the way. There was no need for her META allies to even step in.
The enemies were of little concern to her – what really bothered her was the sense of obsession she felt coming out of Naraka from time to time.
Amagi must be brought back to life.
Why? Because she's better suited to lead our country than anyone else.
Nobody can stop me. Not even you, not even Amagi herself.
I knew it... You get your identity from Akagi.
Where there is cause, there is effect, and vice versa.
The falsehood is the effect, the original is the cause. It's only logical.
Be that as it may, a fake can never become the original.
All that you've created are empty husks, prisoners to a concept.
I am. I have her likeness, memories, personality, way of thinking, even her mannerisms.
Amagi is the only thing I am.
I WOULD never do such a thing in the past. However, you're speaking to my future self.
Yes... I am Amagi.
I am Akagi's sister and the one most fit to lead the Sakura Empire.
You only delude yourself, heighten your obsession, and walk the path to madness.
Our country needs a true leader. Reviving Amagi shall be the first step to achieving that.
Naraka, heed my call and devour all!
KABOOOM!
Enough already. Your attempts to deceive me are for naught.
(Akagi did not create Naraka by her own will. She was simply manipulated by the false amalgamations.)
(Akagi schemed for so long, only to be manipulated and exploited by the monster spawned by her own obsession.)
(Then, the monster took advantage of our very minds...)
(What a terrible turn.)
KABOOOM!
A group of enemies is approaching. It seems they've detected us.
It appears the amalgamations have the ability to connect to the Watatsumi. That must be how they can freely manipulate Naraka's environment.
They know there is no running away, so they come right to us instead.
Soon, the mastermind will appear...
Well, well. Here you are, like a moth to the flames.
I know what you are. Your bluffs work no longer.
Oh?
You are a being born of obsession. You carry that obsession with you.
You denied Amagi's existence and went so far as to try to replace her concept by "reviving her."
You will reappropriate Amagi's concept no longer, vile monster!
It seems you heard that from Naraka.
Then you must already know that I can't be stopped.
I WILL become Amagi. In fact, I am already acknowledged as Amagi.
Those who don't acknowledge me, like you, need only be erased.
Then, none will doubt my identity as Amagi.
You're hopeless.
I regret ever speaking to you.
You are a manifestation of obsession and should disappear like one!
Go on! Make me disappear then, you little runt!
Ahahahahaha!
O thundering fox, prance betwixt the spirit-realms!
KABOOOM!
Gah! How?! How does a mere temporary META possess such power?!
The loser deserves not the knowledge of the winner.
All I will tell you is this – Amagi will be revived. Not by you, but by {playername}.
You taking her concept and pretending to be her has only delayed her revival!
What nonsense...
I know better than anyone else that it's not as simple as you make it sound!
You're wide open!
KABOOOM!
Hiei?! Is that really you?
What happened to you?
I'm fine, Milady! Let us concentrate on defeating her first!
Aye. This next blow shall end this!
Wait, Lady Nagato! Something isn't right with her!
Her concept... it's changing. She has ceased to be Amagi.
So why... is she still here?
Hehehe... Hahahahaha!
You want to face the root of this obsession, do you?
Fine! Let me grant your wish, then!
How's this? Are you happy now?
Did... Did she use the Watatsumi to manifest her own concept?
I've never seen such a sight before...
Those phantoms beside you...
No... You have both what remains of Amagi's soul AND Kaga's soul!
Heehee. What are you on about now?
Amagi is gone. My sister is gone.
She is never coming back, so why are you still alive?
Huh? What kind of leap of logic is that?
Waste no time trying to understand an embodiment of obsession, Hiei.
Heehee... Amagi is no longer in this world, so I'll graciously send all of you to the next!
Once that is done... I'll join you.
Then everything will be as it should.
Hahahaha! AHAHAHAHAHA!
KRAAAAAAR! KRAAAAAAAR!
KRAAAAAAR! KRAAAAAAAR!
More enemies!
They just keep coming... We don't have time for this!
(Looks like she has already figured out how to use her powers. Then again, my ex-collaborator is smart.)
(She clearly based those shikigami spirits off of soul data she has access to as well.)
(The red one is obviously Akagi's, but the blue one? Did she use Kaga's soul?)
(Look at the brains on you. Yes, that's right.)
These shikigami were made based on the souls of Akagi and Kaga...
Is that... made from the carrier version of myself?
(Perhaps this gives us the opportunity to revive the specific Kaga who sacrificed herself...)
Commander, I've learned the ropes of carrier combat. May I lead the attack?
Also, you look like you've been wanting to tell me something...
Alright – you take the lead.
KRAAAAAAR! KRAAAAAAAR!
Very well. I shall ask again after I dispatch these foes.
KABOOOM!
You've destroyed my shikigami... That's no way to greet someone.
You're awfully rude guests, do you know that?
Tell us where Akagi is, you monster! Now!
Akagi? Ah, yes, I did see a self-absorbed little fox girl.
Let her go now, or else!
Or else what? She has already gone. By her own volition.
She said she wanted to disappear, so I granted her wish!
You did WHAT?!
You need details, don't you?
Akagi is dead. Is that clear enough?
You rotten fiend... You will pay for this!
I will avenge you, Akagi!
It's awful, I know, but don't blow your top. You can't take revenge if you lose your cool.
I get it now – why you made me her sister. If I'd known how dangerous that woman was, I'd have given up my life to protect Akagi.
I'm alright, Kaga.
It's just...
I can't believe Akagi really turned META...
Commander, what should we do about her?
(That's really her. She turned META...)
(Yes, that's exactly what I said earlier.)
(Well, I appreciate the honesty for once.)
(I deliver bad news to you, and you're grateful for it?)
(I'm grateful for you giving me the confidence that I can save her.)
(Oh? And how do you plan to do that?)
(You'll see.)
It's okay. There's still a way to save her.
Do you know what I mean, Amagi?
Yes. There is certainly a way.
But first, we need to pacify her.
That is true. I know what needs to be done.
To do it, I believe I should take the vanguard position.
Absolutely.
Ryuuho, Zuikaku, are you ready?
Just don't do anything wild, okay? I know how you must be feeling.
Let's take her down.
Take me down? Do you really think you can?
I think I'll burn you to ashes instead!
KABOOOM!
Akagi continues to call forth her immense powers, unhindered by her injuries.
However, Amagi and her fleet gradually gain a larger and larger advantage.
And as the battle draws on, Akagi's strength eventually runs dry.
*cough*... Heh... So, this must be the power... granted to you by the Commander...
These flames that purify all sin... are a fitting end for me.
The dark aura surrounding Akagi suddenly flares up, but Amagi's flames are one step faster.
The sinister mist is swallowed up, disappearing without a trace. And Akagi, so prideful and imposing just moments earlier, collapses to the ground.
Everyone, please stay back. Allow me... to be with my sister until the very end.
With a solemn nod, Amagi slowly makes her way over to the fallen Akagi.
Wait, Amagi!
Let her handle it. If anyone has the right to deal with that person, it'd be her.
Flames that purify all sin? Is that... Amagi's true power?
(No, that should have just been the META disguise dispersing on its own. It had nothing to do with the flames.)
(Interesting. You even managed to catch on to that?)
(That's right. Akagi purposefully camouflaged herself with a temporary META state.)
(A handy trick she picked up from Helena.)
(Observer?)
(Apologies. I needed her powers to help secure an escape route, so I had to cut the comms first.)
(That's fine by me. I trust you more anyway.)
(So, how's Akagi doing now?)
(Well, that depends on you. She'll become whatever you want her to be.)
(And what about Amagi?)
(Getting a little greedy here, aren't we?)
(Ahem... I meant, the condition of her hull.)
(Still running my analyses, but everything looks pretty good so far. Your plan seems to have worked even better than expected.)
(I still have to secure the escape route. Talk to you later.)
With that, Helena abruptly cuts off the call.
(There she goes again... Though, she was more curt toward the end than usual.)
Commander... Are you sure you don't want to head over as well?
It'll be fine. If anyone can make a difference right now, it's Amagi.

scripts.say: Despite a jarringly long wait, the elevator finally stopped.
The light enveloping the elevator faded, and the group stepped out onto a new floor.
Please be careful. The area ahead is unexplored ground.
Proceed with caution, and map the area as you go.
Understood. We'll be careful.
KABOOOOM!
Hmm? That was an explosion, wasn't it?!
...There's a battle up ahead.
Could it be... DEAD MASTER? Did she get here before us somehow?!
Let's go support her.

The wall on the other end of the passage collapsed from artillery fire. As twisted monsters poured through the breach, one figure stood out among them: a distorted humanoid, controlling some kind of massive equipment.
Strange patterns spread across its body, seemingly corrupted by something alien just like the rest of the tower.
Purifier? Or Purity...?
Analysis: This may be the elite Siren, Purifier.
Hypothesis: The tower's abnormal data may have contaminated her.
...Could it be that Purity herself got contaminated?
It cannot be ruled out. More performance data is required for more precise speculation.
The girls' hesitation gave the twisted Purifier time to draw closer, slow but sure.
...Here it comes!
Can't be helped. Fight first, figure out the rest later!
KABOOOOM!
Stronger than expected... That patterned shell makes it incredibly tough to crack.
I can't find an opening at all. Guess I'll just have to ratchet up the firepower!
Stand back, everyone.
Warning: extremely high energy levels detected.
The instant BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER and TB shouted their warnings, space itself seemed to rupture, and a searing flash of steel streaked past.
The lightning-fast strike cleaved the twisted Purifier in two. Its mangled body collapsed to the ground.
Next to the wreckage was the other girl in black, DEAD MASTER.
DEAD MASTER? Thank goodness you're safe...
You're fast. Thanks for the backup.
...Wait.
BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER's voice interrupted the shipgirls' approach.
Look closer. DEAD MASTER and her rigging...
Huh?! She has that same messed-up pattern as that Purifier... and her rigging is all weird, too!
Could it be...?
Without a word, BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER silently raised her sword once more.
As if triggered by this move, DEAD MASTER turned to her, lifting her massive scythe and assuming a battle-ready stance.
Her eyes were lifeless, the hollow sockets holding nothing but void.
Like a bolt of lightning, an attack struck; BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER instantly countered.
Thus, another battle to the death had begun between these two fated rivals...
...Or had it?
A dazzling exchange of strikes flew constantly between them. This time, their all-out duel was backed by fierce artillery fire.
But something was wrong.
For some reason, the shockwaves from their clashes always stopped just short of reaching the search team.
Not so much as a speck of rubble grazed them.
...Put an end to this stupid prank.
You already figured me out? Always such a buzzkill.
But I'll have you know that I'm fighting every bit as seriously as ever.
Do you know the phrase, "time and place"?
If I really wanted to put an end to our little contest here and now, I could do it~
Now is not the time.
Does this mean...
Scanning... Corrosion confirmed, but only at a surface level.
So she's wearing it like clothes?
That means... her mind is totally intact? She's just like that?
And she attacked us for the hell of it because she had an excuse?!
Maybe she's a little stressed from fighting so many enemies for so long.
That's why she wants to stretch and have "fun."
Umm...
Be patient for now.
When this problem is solved, we'll have all the time in the world to fight.
Okay, okay. I get it.
Are we done now? Can anyone explain what the deal is between you two?
Let's go, everyone! No more dilly-dallying!
Come ON!
CLUNK!
Hey, did anyone else hear that just now?
It came from that Purifier vessel's wreckage. No way... Is it coming back to life?!
From within the scattered debris, Purity's eyes opened anew.
Uuugh... I didn't think the contamination would be this bad.
I might've gotten a little carried away...
The search team watched, stunned, and quietly raised their cannons.
WHOA, WHOA, WHOA, WAIT!
DON'T SHOOT! I SURRENDEEER!
WHOA, WHOA, WHOA, WAIT!
DON'T SHOOT! I SURRENDEEER!
Everyone's attacks stopped on a dime right before the finishing blow.
...Come again?
Surrender? Wait, you really are Purity?!
That's riiight~☆ I'm basically one of you guys!
I'm only getting more confused. What's going on here?
Sooo, basicallyyy... It's complicated and simple, at the same time.
To put it briefly...
All I'm hearing is that you don't know, either!
Yep! That about sums it up!
Stupid, useless Purity.
But listen! I know other stuff. You're looking for the source of all this, right?
How convenient! For some reason, some of the map data of this tower's been shared with my vessel here!
That means I can show you straight to the core!
Then do it. Now.
Lead the way, little loser.
Okie-dokie!

Anomaly's Source

scripts.say: Scan results analyzed.
Judging from the explosion's traces and the density and distribution of pollutants, this block is the source of the anomaly.
The giant machine there, its interior exposed by the explosion, would be the core of said anomaly.
The enormous machine TB described as the "core" was originally meant to be a computing node that normally managed the internal environment of the tower.
However, some writhing creature had taken over, continuously outputting errors and alien data.
You can really tell from how strong the hostiles are...
Are all those things packed in there... contaminated Tester vessels?
Analysis: Except for the corrosive growths attached to the armor, their structures are consistent with those of the mass-produced vessels used by the Sirens.
Henceforth to be referred to as "Viral Junk Sirens."
The system was infected by a virus, and the resulting glitch is causing it to generate all these junk Sirens...
The things we saw on the lower floors must have been even shoddier junk Sirens, probably the result of data from all the different floors getting mixed in.
What I'm hearing is, we just have to destroy that core machine right there, and all our problems are solved!
...Easier said than done. How do you mean to destroy that army of Testers?
Don't we have you on our side?
I can't do it!
Like I told you on the way here, this vessel is just a hodgepodge of junk thrown together at random because of some stupid program error!
I can tank a few hits for you, maybe, but if you think I'm soloing all those things, you'll be sorely disappointed!
Tch...
I'm tired of you calling me useless! Look, I've got a plan, but I need to talk with your navigator first.
What do you think?
Proposition: Suppress computing power. By using our computing resources to return the corrupted areas to normal, we can greatly reduce both the number of enemies and their overall strength.
Exactly! This thing's just a crappy little machine, while you've got the resources of the entire port in the palm of your hand. So do something!
Please wait a moment. Issuing request to the Commander.
Request approved. Allocating resources and calculating solutions. Please buy as much time as possible.
You're saying we need to fight anyway? Then let's get started. Can you still fight?
Of course.
Everyone, focus your firepower! Begin by securing a safe zone around us!
Seemingly sensing TB's attempt to gather computing resources, the dense swarm of enemies charged frantically toward the team.
The girls' formation shattered under the onslaught, and for a moment, they were each forced to fight alone.
They're too close... My brilliant brain requires backup to function properly!
BANG!
Are you okay, Impero?
Phew... Thanks for saving me.
KABOOOOM!
This is bad... Be careful, BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER! Don't let them get a clean hit on you!
Urgh!
The moment BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER lost her balance, DEAD MASTER glided in front of her, eliminating the attacking enemy with one swift, decisive blow.
You're still too careless. Should I hold back next time we fight?
Eventually, good news came from TB.
All preparations are complete. Now implementing computing power suppression. Please stay as far from the enemy as possible.
A blue data stream appeared out of thin air. Every hostile it touched, along with the abnormal area, was quietly engulfed by it.
Perfect! We have a path to the core now. Everyone, prepare for assault!
Kearsarge summoned everyone to her side to focus their firepower, but Purity stopped them.
The suppression is working, but it's nowhere near as much as I was hoping.
At this rate, we can't destroy the contaminated core.
If you get too close now, you'll just be swallowed up by the next wave it generates.
Not that I planned to let you all do it in the first place.
Nope, lucky you, I've got more than just data in this vessel – I inherited a few permissions, too!
As long as I can get physical access to that machine, I can send a self-destruct command!
You nerds just watch me save the day!
But if the core explodes, then what happens to you?
You know. Bam! Dead as a doornail.
Aw, don't look at me like that. You know I won't ACTUALLY die, right?
My mainframe isn't here. In fact, I've already self-destructed a bunch of times today.
I just hope this time gets me out of this hellhole!
Let's gooooo!
With that, Purity charged into the interior of the machine.
There was a boom as the computing node burst into glorious flames.
TB, target destruction confirmed.
Oooh! She did it! That's another problem solved!
I'll never forget you, Purity... May you return stronger than ever before.
Am I hearing them right? Our little problem here is dealt with?
Probably.
Good. In that case, shall we?
Both girls jumped away simultaneously and readied their weapons, as if they hadn't just won a life-or-death battle by the skin of their teeth. Their blades dripped with murderous intent.
Whaaat?! I seriously don't get why you're... Do you just ALWAYS do this?!
Stay out of this if you don't want to get caught in the crossfire.
We don't need a reason. No matter what, things always come to this.
No matter what world, no matter what era. We meet, and we fight.
That's the fate placed upon us.
Even as they talked, the two carefully closed the distance between them. One more step, and they would once again straddle the bounds of life and death...
Hold on!
Impero rushed between the two and forced their confrontation to come to a grinding halt.
Things aren't completely finished yet. We haven't left the Virtual Tower.
Then why don't you all just go?
And let you two kill each other?
You should realize by now that this place is nothing like whatever world you came from.
I don't know how things worked for you before, but...
Or do you really think you know what will come of your stupid fight when you don't belong in this world in the first place?
As for me, I'M not gambling my life on unknowns, I'll tell you that much.
It seemed Impero's words had quelled their fire; both girls silently lowered their weapons.
DEAD MASTER was clearly unhappy with this, but she didn't push the matter any further.
For now, come back to port with us.
If you still want to fight, then Sardegna will gladly arrange a formal duel for you.
Sounds like a lot of unnecessary effort to me. What if I say no?
Overruled. TB, get everyone out of here – INCLUDING them.
Understood. Executing recovery program.
A curtain of blue light descended, enveloping the girls. For a moment, they were rendered immobile.
Hey, what's going on here?!
A necessary purification procedure before your evacuation. It will not harm you, so please remain calm.
What?! I didn't agree to this!
Say something, damn it!
...I don't think anything we can say would matter. We're outsiders. Let's obey for now.
The light intensified, and the tower began to blur. In its place appeared an expanse of deep-blue water and sky.
Uuugh! I can't stand this!
Meanwhile, in the port's command center...
Phew... That settles that matter.
Why do you think those two were in the Virtual Tower to begin with?
At present, there is not enough information to investigate the precise reason.
Unfortunately, I cannot answer your inquiry.
I was just asking out of curiosity, so don't worry about it. This isn't the first time something like this has happened, anyway.
We already know these people all come with their own unique, if not strange, circumstances.
Still, I can't believe they exited the tower so smoothly...
You can't go in there without being made into data in the first place, right?
I cannot answer this question either.
Hypothesis: Some particular trait of the Virtual Tower may be the cause of their appearance and smooth exit.
Either way, they're our guests now.
We should give them a warm welcome.
Let's go and greet them right away.

sequence: Illusory Drifters - END

scripts.say: Z43 becomes engrossed by her own singing. As her song comes to an end, the girls regain their senses one by one.
Hm? I could swear I heard the strangest melody just now... Well, perhaps "melody" is glorifying it somewhat.
My head feels all weird... Oh no! And my hair's such a mess, too!
I feel as though I had a nightmare...
Sounds like that weird influence is wearing off. Phew... I knew something was wrong with that melody.
Well done, Z43. Is everyone back to normal now?
*pant*... *pant*... Yeah! Man, I really sang my heart out there...
Er, I mean! Augur of Destiny, now you have witnessed my might – the might of a REBEL!
Is that the Commander's voice I hear? Where are you, Commander? Are you spying on us from your office?
Hey, back off, little lady. The only person the Commander's watching is me, anyway. Right, Commander?
U-31 flips the camera around and covers the screen with her ear-to-ear grin. Immediately, all the little shipgirls gather around and wave to me. Well, all except for one...
My hair is super messy! I'm not letting the Commander see me like this!
Hi there. I'm glad you girls are all okay.
Commander, you should probably order them to get out of there, now. The mind influence might have worn off, but the music's still playing, so...
Well, hello. I didn't know you were here, Enterprise.
Of course I am. This is a big deal. I can't just sit by and watch, can I?
U-31, could you open the door? Everyone else, cover your ears and get out of there.
Roger-roger.
U-31 walks up to the door and tries to open it, but it won't budge no matter what she tries – strange, as it opened easily on the way in.
That's... weird. I can't get the door open.
Hmm, maybe it's got something to do with that mind influence? The song's still playing, so maybe it's subconsciously preventing you from leaving.
Looks like you'll have to blow your way out after all. Take aim at the speakers and let 'er rip!
Let's not be hasty. Disrupting the melody worked once, and I think it might just work again.
See the colorful notes on the blackboard? I think they're the key.
She's right... Firing your cannons might blow up the whole classroom.
My throat is dry as a bone, so please don't make me sing again.
I've got it! Let's all team up and form a band!
A band? Sounds... fun.
Sure, but Friedrich is the only one here who knows music.
And even then, she's more about conducting it than playing it...
I could teach you basic music theory, but I don't think we have time for that.
Music is all about soul.
Friedrich... er, grown Friedrich is right. Just play with your heart and it'll be fine.
Yippee! It's time for music! I call dibs on the drums!
What kind of song should we play, though?
Simple. A song befitting a rebel such as I – a heavy metal song!
Pass. That stuff makes my ears hurt.
Heavy metal... exhausting. Pick something else.
Unable to reach any kind of consensus, the girls turned to the camera and asked us for advice.
You should play whatever kind of song you want. Metal, a nursery rhyme, folk, pop, whatever.
What matters is that you have fun. Remember: it just has to disrupt the melody!
Exactly. It doesn't have to be perfect.
BZZT... CULTIVATING INTERESTS... BZZT... HAVING FUN ABOVE ALL... BZZT...
Hey, did you hear that voice? I think someone's monitoring us!
Any guesses as to who it is?
No idea. They've applied a filter, making it impossible to infer anything.
What the...? Whuah?! Where'd all these things come from?!
Meow!
Meow-meow!
Meow meow meeeow!
They superficially resemble Meowfficers, but these bust creatures are clearly something else entirely.
Is this that cat's handiwork again? Akashi, come here!
Y-yes, nya?
Have you something to do with this?
No, nya! I swear on my shop's name I don't know anything, nya!
Meow meow meeeow!
Now they're... waving instruments around.
I think they want to challenge us to a play-off.
Oh yeah? The Twinkling Little Stars are gonna rock their world!
Together, now! Let us play!
As the music dies down, the speakers cease playing that strange melody. Stranger yet, the odd Meowfficers all stop moving at the same time as well.
Whaddya think, Commander? Am I cut out to be an idol?
Please, if anyone's cut out for that, it's me! I know the Commander agrees.
Mwahaha! With rock as the medium, my power has been unleashed!
Whew... I think we all played pretty well.
Goodness...
The fiery hot emotion packed into every beat... There was frankly too much of it for my tastes.
At any rate, you're safe now. What happened to those Meowfficer busts?
I think they... went bust. But seriously, they turned back into normal statues.
Hmm. I think that weird melody and those busts are connected, I'm just not sure how yet.
Regardless, there's no time to waste. I propose you split up – one team can investigate those Meowfficers, the other can move forward with the rescue mission.
Good idea. We've found and rescued a few people, so splitting up here would be more efficient.
Twinkling Little Stars, check the arts building for anyone else that needs rescue, then head to the main school building and continue the mission.
Everyone else, see if you can find out anything about those strange Meowfficers.
Rogery-dodgery-doo!
Worry not, my child. We shall handle it.
Hang on a sec! You girls haven't got a team name yet! You HAVE to have one!
Why? What do we need a name for?
I think it'd be nice to have. It'll make us feel more like a team.
You may decide the name. Meanwhilst, this one shall sleep... Zzz...
Ooh, I've got a good one!
What, pray tell?
"The Sparkly Kitties!"
Can we veto that?
Nuh-uh! Your name's set in stone now!
Okay, let's move, girls! Last team to finish their mission is a bunch of rotten eggs!
Also, the Commander's probably gonna shower the winning team with rewards!
R-rewards? Okay! The Sparkly Kitties WILL win!
(Why is this a competition now? And why am I obliged to reward the winner?)
(Well, if it motivates them...)
After reminding them numerous times to be careful, I order both teams to set upon their respective tasks.
The Twinkling Little Stars went straight for the school building and started looking around. In the end, they only found anomalous activity in one classroom.
Now they stand at the firmly shut door. Something on the other side is making an eerie scratching noise.
Those damned Dark Requiem conspirators are employing the Abyssal Noise! However, they are sorely mistaken if they think that will scare me again!
Heh. "Again"? So it has scared you before.
H-hey! "Scared" is a strong word! I was only mildly perturbed! Come on, let us head in!
Settle down, Z43. Stay in formation and move in carefully.
U-31 cautiously opens the door. Inside the classroom, there is a massive stack of wooden blocks, so tall it even towers above the girls.
At the top stands a lone Meowfficer bust, writing something on the blackboard. This is the source of that eerie scratching sound.
Meow! Mreow!
As soon as the Meowfficer becomes aware of the girls, it jumps inside the heap of wooden blocks and hides.
Commander! Found another one of those Meowfficer busts!
Go after it!
Try as you might, evil spirit! My demon eye has already seen where you went in this blazing sea of endless nothingness!
Yeah, we all know where it is – in the block pile. Can we start looking now?
Oh. Right...
The team climbs onto the pile and starts looking for the sneaky Meowfficer.
Dowsing rod... No response.
I've got something! Feels soft to the touch... It's gotta be the Meowfficer's hat!
Li'l Sandy pulled out the thing under the blocks with such force that she lost her balance and fell flat on her butt.
Please don't pull on my apron! I don't want it to tear!
Oh, it's Little Bel! Not the catch I was expecting, but I'll take it.
Long... Silky... Tail?
Eldridge, meanwhile, uproots something else as well.
My word! Don't pull on a lady's hair – it's so uncouth!
I feel something firm! Those Meowfficer busts look pretty hard, so this has GOT to be the one!
U-31 pulls out the object from among the wooden blocks.
Sorry. That's just my iron claw.
While they failed to find the Meowfficer, they did manage to find Little Bel, Little Formidable, and Little Spee.
After a short break, the girls all attempt to leave the classroom. Much like last time, though, the door has fused itself shut with the walls.
Well, we're doing this again. The key to getting out should be somewhere in here.
Commander, I'll take the camera for a tour around the room. Tell me if you see anything interesting.
(Hmm... As far as clues go, all we really have are the wooden blocks and the writing the Meowfficer left on the blackboard.)
The blackboard says, "Building with blocks," and there's a drawing of them stacked atop each other.
Supposing that you must satisfy a condition before you may leave, perhaps we should start by arranging the blocks as shown in the drawing.
(They didn't need to follow a template in the music room, they just played whatever they wanted.)
(If this follows the same rule, shouldn't they just stack the blocks however they want?)
First, I want to try something. All of you, go ahead and arrange the blocks however you like.
However we like, huh?
Blocks... Like... Commander...
We like the Commander more than anyone else, so...
Let's build a wooden block Commander!
I must admit, I do like the Commander more than my wings of dark...
Wooow. You hear that, my Commander? You're adored by all!
I'm behind this idea. I will make a great wooden block statue to demonstrate my love!
(Ruh-roh. Sounds like I'll need to "keep a close eye" on the Commander for the near future...)
(But right now, it's building time. Gotta be quick so I can be where I'm needed – by the Commander's side!)
The little shipgirls quickly got to work. It quickly dawned on them how fun the act of stacking blocks actually was.
Now to put a heart in the Commander's hands...
I say, this pose is somewhat lacking in grace. The hands should be more like... this! Even a statue should be well-mannered.
I've found you, long-lost wing! I shall now return you to where you belong – on the Commander's back!
Wait, the hair's going the wrong way! This bit should go left, and this part goes right.
With much merry collaboration, the girls finish their blocky statue of me.
Aaand done! Look and be amazed, Commander! We made a mega version of you!
Whoa! That Mega-Mander is peak art!
I never knew you put any points into art appreciation.
I mean, just look at that warped orb in the Commander's hands! It's a metaphor for the forbidden knowledge endowed to our supremely wise leader!
Uhh... that's a heart.
Wh-what? A... heart?
Then explain those peculiar ornaments on the statue's back! What arcane unknowns do they represent?
Those are angel wings...
A-angel wings... Ahaha...
Is THIS really how you all view me?
More or less! Looks pretty cute, doesn't it?
There's still one block left... What should we do with it?
It LOOKS Like a Meowfficer, so we could put it on the shoulder like a pet.
Little Spee puts down the final "block" – which then comes to life.
Hey! That's no block, that's the Meowfficer bust!
BZZT... PLAY LIKE INNOCENT CHILDREN... BZZT... FIND YOUR OWN HOBBY...
Meow! Mreow!
Let's fight it using blocks!
*rumble*...
Mega Commander shatters the Meowfficer busts' Mega-Meowfficer stack with a powerful tackle.
With that, the classroom door opens, and the Meowfficer busts turn back into lifeless stone.
Heheh! The Twinkling Little Stars can't be beaten!
The school building rescue mission is a success! Next up...
*rumble*...
A-an earthquake?
Oh, no... What's happening? I can't maintain... proper Royal Lady... posture?!
There's a loud rumble as the video feed shakes violently, as if an earthquake is really occurring.
Nothing is happening in the makeshift command center outside the academy.
(Could it be... something's happening inside the school building?)
Everyone, get out of that classroom and take shelter in an open space!
The rumbling and shaking in the camera feed still hasn't stopped.
It's even worse on the athletic field! Commander, what do we do?
Above all else, stay calm. Once you've secured your own safety, confirm that there's nothing around you that could trigger anything worse–
AAAAH! HELP MEEE!
Is that... Z47?
Renown, Zeppelin, and Cleveland, too...?
U-31, spin the camera toward them for me.
Roger-dodger!
On the other end of the field, Z47 is running desperately on a moving track reminiscent of a treadmill.
On the inside of the track are Little Renown, Zeppy, and Clevelad. They're surprised and relieved to see the Twinkling Little Stars.
(The track on the field is moving... This must be what caused the earthquake.)
(Based on how we've solved the other problems so far, there must be some condition we need to meet in order to stop it.)
A rebel would never abandon her imprisoned comrades! I'm on my way!
Hey, wait!
U-31's cries fall on deaf ears. Z43 runs onto the track thoughtlessly... and gets stuck running on it just like Z47.
Aaaagh! Heeelp!
*sigh*... Things are just getting worse...
But one destined to be a Solomon Knight mustn't be afraid of a moving track! Allow me to–
Clevelad tries to run in, too, but Zeppy and Little Renown manage to stop her after seeing the horrors that Z43 fell into.
Idiot! If you go, you'll just be the third one stuck on it!
Th-that doesn't mean I can stand idly by and let it happen...
We have no other choice. Let's blow this field to smithereens with our cannons!
Our friends are stuck on that track! Ever heard the words "friendly fire"?
Just use small-caliber cannons!
Ooh. Now we're cooking with gas!
No, you are NOT!
...I have an idea!
What is it?
Zeppy grabs Clevelad by the waist and lifts her up high above.
Eep! Wh-what are you doing?
Now...
Then, she starts spinning Clevelad around at incredible speed!
Huh? W-wait...
Take thiiis!
KABOOOOM!
After being fired like a missile, Clevelad strikes Z47 and Z43. The momentum throws all three of them off the track.
Phew... That's another one solved!
Hmm... Creative, to be sure.
At least tell me first... Ouchies.
So, did you all come here to check out the situation at the academy? While relaying everything to the outside with that camera?
Commandeeer! Can you hear meee?
Yeah, I can hear you. What in the world happened before the investigation team came in?
Well... We don't really know, either!
The classroom door suddenly wouldn't open, and weird Meowfficers started running through the halls...
When we finally got the door open and came to check out the field, the track started moving out of nowhere...
And you saw how that turned out.
If we don't do something about this track, the whole campus could get destroyed by the earthquakes...
Agreed. We have to stop that track ASAP.
Commander, there's nobody left on it. Let's fire–
FU SHUN!
Okay, sorry... Ow, I said I'm sorry! Ow, ouch! H-have mercy on my ear!
BZZT... HAPPY AND ENERGETIC... BZZT... TREASURE YOUR YOUTH...
Meow! Mreow!
Hahah! I get it. It's a track-and-field competition they want!
Let's show them just how athletic we can be!
After 105 games, the Meowfficer busts have suffered a total defeat.
The failed Meowfficers returned to stone busts, and the track finally stopped moving.
*pant*... *pant*... Now do you see the power of a future Solomon Knight?
I would never lose a fair contest!
Woohoo! We are number one!
So next would be...
You all must be tired after all that running. Take a break before you continue your investigation.
Ahaha♡ You're too sweet, Commander! I thought you might say that~
The shipgirls enjoy a moment's respite on the field.
Though, of course, not all of them are happy to just relax. The little shipgirls quickly tire of sitting around and resort to playing together.
(Things haven't been resolved yet, but... there's nothing wrong with taking a nice break.)
I change my communication line from the public channel to a private channel, so as not to disturb their rest.
While her friends all enjoy the many play facilities near the track, Z47 sits on the seesaw alone and plays with her phone.
Z47? You don't want to play with them?
If you want me to, Mandy... I'll put my phone away...
But I don't know what to talk about with them... You're not here, either.
I may not be there, but thanks to our communication lines, it's like I am.
Your calls for help also helped resolve the situation before it could take a turn for the worse.
Do you mean that? I thought you left me on read, even if it was just because of the stuff going on...
But my message really helped...
Can I have a reward?
Sure. Want me to play some phone games with you? Or I could join you on the seesaw when this is all over.
Alone with you here, when it's all over...
Sure. It's a promise.
Okay. When the time comes, you better not act like you forgot.
I switch back to the public channel and reevaluate the situation.
(The academy gate, classrooms, and field tracks are all basic infrastructure that any school should have.)
(All of the occurrences so far have been related to innocence and fun. Save for the gate, every area where they happened have had Meowfficer busts present.)
As I unravel things, I recall a request I'd approved several days ago.
(The Academy Companion System development plan... Who requested that? It was Yuubari.)
(Yuubari was also on the missing persons list.)
(Did that companion system cause everything that's happening right now?)
While the girls play, almost every Meowfficer in the staff room turns back into busts.
But a few of them continue to hold their signs up.
(The Twinkling Little Stars have played plenty by now, but there are still Meowfficers. Have we overlooked something?)
Meow... Meow!
Ugh, these things are so annoying. Are they mad, or what?
Huh? They STILL want us to answer questions?
All work makes one a dull shipgirl, yes, but that doesn't mean we can be all play either.
But if we keep answering questions, the Meowfficers will multiply again. That'll put all of our work playing to waste.
How about a more simple method? Every problem until now, the Meowfficers hid or kept you away from them.
