But all of the Meowfficers causing the problem in the staff room are IN the staff room. Blow them up, and you might have your way out.
Melee combat with special gear oughta keep the damages to the facility to a minimum.
Enty, are you serious about this? Those Meowfficers are kinda cute, so...
They're ripe for research, too, nya!
We need to prioritize rescuing the girls who are still trapped. Commander, it's time for swift decision-making.

options.content: No other choice. Let's try to solve this with violence.
Wait. Just let me think for a minute.

scripts.say: Hmm...
Woohoo! Violence! Twinkling Little Stars, kick some ass!
Alvitr, Duke of York. Are there any clues relating to innocence and fun in the admin building?
There are, actually. Just a second.
Alvitr takes out a school newspaper and shows two headlines to the camera.
"The Meowfficer who went missing at night"?
"Cherish your innocence! Give everyone a mischievous and fun little paradise!"
Huh? I thought it was a cryptid that went missing during the night, because it couldn't fit in its cage?
That isn't a missing fallen angel of fate who fell into the endless abyss – the late night – to defend the light, either!
Both of you are obviously wrong!
(Cherish your innocence, and give everyone a mischievous and fun little paradise... Hmm. Everyone?)
I know what we have to do. The Twinkling Little Stars can't have all the fun. The teachers have to have fun, too.
Us, too?
Of course. This is a world for EVERYONE to have fun in, so everyone has to join in.
Alvitr and Duke of York agree and join in with everyone's games.
BZZT... WORK AND PLAY... EVERYONE FIND THE PERFECT BALANCE... BZZT...
MEOW! MREEEOW!
Eventually, the team managed to solve the problem in the admin building.
Commander, we've finished investigating all of the main facilities in the academy now. Next–
Sorry to interrupt. Commander, I have an urgent report.
The Academy Companion System terminal has been found inside the campus control room.
Yuubari should be there, too.
(The control room... It seems likely that's where this all began.)
Contact the two investigation teams and have them meet up there.
Roger~
Little Academy - Control Room
In the control room, there's a giant screen flickering with colorful static while it displays the same slogan as the banner at the gate.
"A little paradise for the pure, innocent, and mischievous."
In front of the control panel, a giant Meowfficer bust stands with an intimidating blue gleam in its eyes.
And the one facing that Meowfficer...
It's Yuubari! Commander, we found her!
Thank goodness... You're all here!
Yuubari. How's the situation in there?
It's still a stalemate... But with your help, we can get through this danger, no problem.
Wary of the giant Meowfficer bust, she briefly explains the situation.
Today is routine maintenance of the Academy Companion System. When she shut it down to perform said maintenance, everything went haywire.
When it should've shut down, the system began an abnormal startup and started producing endless Meowfficer busts.
When Yuubari was forced to focus on the production issue, something took advantage of the opening to steal her toolbox.
Then, the anomaly appeared and covered the entire academy. That was when we at the port learned about it.
It's evident that the Meowfficer right there is the one that stole your toolbox and made a mess of everything.
Yeah. By the time I realized it, it was too late...
But the Companion System has one final safety feature.
She gestures at the lever she's holding tightly in one hand.
When I pull this lever, unless the correct sequence of buttons is pressed in five seconds, the Companion System's power source will be forcibly cut off.
Alternatively, if it tries to overload the Companion System to expand this special space, I'll need to pull this lever in order to nullify the overload.
So... As you can see, whoever acts first loses in this state.
MREEEEOW!
Heheh, I see~
So basically, it's up to our interference to break the stalemate!
Mission objective: defeat the crazy Meowfficer bust.
If we take that thing down, we can all go home!
At home... Soft, comfy bed, and the Commander...
Let's go for it, everyone!
One ordinary day, I rack my brain over a certain report.
Akashi hasn't come back to the port in over a week.
But despite that, her business data keeps on flowing in.
Are the profits from her island development project enough for her to just abandon us?
TB, get me in contact with her. I need to ask her directly.
Orders received. Contacting now.
Abnormal warning: Communications with the island development area are being jammed. The call could not be completed.
Jammed? Connect to nearby monitoring stations and give me a sitrep.
Orders received. Directing monitoring stations to begin a scan of the island development area and nearby regions.
This is odd.
Commander, multiple monitoring stations have reported contradictory scan results from the same area.
Hypothesis: A space-time anomaly is taking place above the island.
A localized space-time anomaly, huh... It's not a Singularity, is it?
Oh, no... Of all the places for a Singularity to appear!
And we can't get in contact with Akashi or anyone from her team?!
Affirmative. This is the most reasonable assumption with the data we have.
And yet, her business data keeps on increasing despite all this?
Affirmative. According to my calculations, her business activity has risen by 170% over this period.
Don't tell me... Her whole business is in the Singularity, isn't it?
I cannot say for sure due to a lack of information, but your hypothesis is logical.
Something stinks here. I'm going there to investigate it myself.
TB, secure a safe and reliable aircraft for me.
Affirmative. Searching for a safe and reliable aircraft...
Twenty results found. All of them were designed by Leonardo da Vinci.
One of da Vinci's flying machines, huh? That should be safe... surely...
Pick one of them for me and get it ready for takeoff.
Let's go see what this island's Singularity really is.
(Is this the inside of the Singularity? The environment seems stable, and I don't sense any danger.)
(Mishaps aside, I made it here in one piece. Time to go ask Akashi's team what's going on.)
I see a few buildings up ahead. Let's go.
(Hmm? That girl over there... Isn't that O'Brien from Akashi's team!)
O'Brien! Hey there.
Ah... C-Commander? That is you, isn't it?
The one and only.
Thank goodness! Long time no see. We all missed you so much! God, we were starting to worry that you'd forgotten about us.
Over these six months, we've been hard at work developing the island.
Did you just say six months?
Yeah... It might not look very different, but we built an entire harbor on the shore. You should totally check it out when you get the chance!
(Outside, it's just been a week... The flow of time must be different here. No wonder the aircraft malfunctioned.)
I'll do that. By the way, you've been here for a long time. Have you noticed anything strange?
Strange? I can't think of anything in particular during these six months.
Except for the huge explosion that happened just before you got here, that is.

options.content: Oh, really? I didn't know that.

scripts.say: I'm told that an aircraft crashed nearby?
I was on that aircraft. Things went a little awry, as you can tell.
Oh, my. That was your ride? Well, unfortunately, shrapnel from the explosion destroyed the bus stop leading to the harbor...
Really! Shrapnel from the explosion destroyed the bus stop leading to the harbor!
Worse, today is the deadline for Akashi's request. This is definitely going to delay our materials shipment...
Akashi's request? Speaking of her, do you know where she is?

options.content: The bus stop, huh? I'll go check it out.

scripts.say: She's usually around the harbor, but with the bus stop as wrecked as it is, you'll have to wait for the time being.
O-okay... You might wanna talk to John over in Rockheap Mine. She's the one in charge of repairing the stop.
Aw, shoot! It's nowhere near enough! What do I do?!
Oh, it's you! Perfect!
So, the deal is, the bus stop got utterly smashed, and I need a whole heap of coal to fix it, but I can't mine nearly enough of it all on my own, no matter how I try!
You can't get enough, even in a mine? Don't you have a storage or something?
Yeah, but it's all gone! My whole stockpile was just enough to cover a request for it. And then something crashed into the delivery before it could make it to the harbor...
*sigh*... I'm not gonna be done in time for this request.
Huh? You mean it? Heck yeah!
Of course I do. It's partly my fault that the transport network's down to begin with.
Well, I appreciate the help! You showed up at just the right time to save my bacon!
Okay, let's get to work!
John, reckon this is enough?
Whoa! I knew you wouldn't let me down! You're so efficient!

options.content: So we can repair the station now?

scripts.say: Combining what I've got with what you mined, we've finally got all the coal to do the repairs! There's hope!
Almost. To fully repair it, we'll also need wood to reinforce the roof with.
W-wood, you say? I'm afraid we don't have that ready to go.
John, will we make it in time if we start now?
Yeah! Easily!
You two go off and fix the wood, and I'll use the coal to repair the road surface!
We'll get it done in time if we split up! O'Brien, could you bring the Commander to the woods?
Um, sure!
Let's go and quickly gather some wood, Commander.
How's this, O'Brien? Think this is enough wood?
Yes! Thank you for helping, Commander. This will be more than enough.
Alright, then let's hurry on back to John.
Of course. She should be waiting by the bus stop toward the harbor.
Let's bring this wood over to her.
John, we're back.
And we have the wood.
Bravo! Nice work, you two. That's all the materials we need.
Now we can start repairing the bus stop!
Let us help you with that.
Yeah. We'll get it done faster if we work together.
Done!
Reckon this will do?
Yep! It's finally done!
Man, it took a lot of work to fully repair the station, huh?
Will we be able to deliver our packages before nightfall now?
Yeah, no problem! And we couldn't have achieved this without the Commander.
You deserve a reward. Let's see... Here it is!

options.content: Sure does. That's some beautiful ore.

scripts.say: I found this while mining. Pretty, isn't it?
Right? It glitters, and looks so beautiful!
Y-you can also have this...
It's... some wood I processed in a special way. Doesn't the texture remind you of a star?
You're right, it does. Thanks.
The bus is he– Oh, it looks like it's already full of cargo.
Yup. Urgent packages really piled up 'cause of the bus stop being destroyed.
Commander, if you're not in a rush, do you mind waiting for the next one?
No worries. I'll just carry the cargo to the harbor myself.
Besides, I'm curious to see how this place operates.
Alright, thanks! Here's the cargo list. Give it to Patrick when you get to the harbor!
You're bound to find her standing guard there.
Best of luck to you, Commander.
See you, Commander! Stop by and ride a minecart sometime!
(O'Brien wasn't exaggerating... In just half a year, the girls have turned this barren island into an honest-to-god place to anchor.)
(These freighters are even stranger. How in the world did Akashi get this much transport capacity? There's not even any mention of it in the port's reports.)
At any rate, I can't stand here all day. Need to deliver these goods to Patrick.
Patrick, you look awfully busy. You don't handle every single request that comes through the harbor, do you?
Commander?! Well, I do. I oversee the harbor's requests.
What brings you here, anyway? We could've all welcomed you if you'd given us a heads-up.
I think you all have your hands full as it is. You don't have the time to welcome one person.
There's no denying that, I suppose. Our incoming request amount has skyrocketed to triple the usual.
(And yet, the port hasn't received a single request from Akashi for the past week.)
(So where does all this cargo end up?)
Um, what are you staring at? Did you come all this way to check my ledger?
Oh, nah, I'm just here to deliver these goods from the islanders. O'Brien and John prepared all of these.
And they're all urgent goods, too! Thanks, Commander!
Although, I'll still need to check each and every one, even though you personally brought them in.
Could you submit them in order for me?
Patrick, this should be everything, right? Is everything in order?
Yep. They're the right quantity and quality. Well done.
Good to hear. While I'm here, do you happen to know where Akashi is?
Akashi? Ah, well, see Café Manjuu over there? She often hangs out around there, so that's where I'd check first.
Near Café Manjuu, huh? I'll go have a look!
Heheh, you do that. See you, Commander!
There she is. The green cat!
What's she doing, sneaking into the café like that? That's suspicious.
Bet she's up to no good. I'm gonna tail her!
(Café Manjuu must be hiding some enormous secret for it to have such a powerful security system.)
(Can't let my guard down. Knowing Akashi, there must be some loopholes that she set up.)
(Need to search carefully and move slowly. I WILL catch her red-handed this time!)
I've got you now, Aka– Huh?
Wait, I could've sworn I saw her go in here... Where is she?
(Unless what I saw was a ghost... No, come on, that can't be.)
(Cats vanishing without a trace isn't unusual. There must be a secret passage somewhere – but where?)
(Hmm. This should be it. Camouflaging an elevator as a display case – now that's clever.)
(Let's see... Are these the controls?)
(There's an entire research lab hidden under Café Manjuu... So this is what Akashi's secret is.)
(It's anyone's guess as to what she's researching, but it's safe to assume it's something devious if she keeps it secret even from me.)
I'm gonna get her to spill the beans!
I've got you now, Akashi. Gonna try to run away again?
Nyaaa?! It's you, nya... What a rude way to greet someone, nya.
I'm glad you came to have a look around the island, nya!
Enough playing dumb. What the hell is up with this Singularity?
I'll level with you – we happened to be caught in it while doing a mine blasting operation when we first got here, nya.
The environment here is stable, and the terrain isn't much different from the outside, so everyone still thinks we're on an uninhabited island, nya.
All I'm hearing is, "I developed this area for half a year behind your backs."
It's not that I did it behind your backs, nya. It's just that nobody asked, nya.
Besides, since this is a Singularity, not only can we send requests directly to the port, but also directly to far-flung places, nya!
And I wanted to put that unique quirk to use to make some money, nya.
I'm surprised you found out about it so quickly, nya.
(Should've known. Akashi only gets this invested when money is involved.)
Okay, and you're sure there aren't any safety problems with this Singularity?
Not a single one, nya. All the exits are controlled, and nobody gets in or out without my permission, nya!
Come again? Then explain how I made it here.
Um... Well... Because my authority can't stop you from doing anything, nya.
I see, I see.
As you know, I've always been fair. You're the one who developed this... Singularity island, so you should get to be in control.
Having said that, this IS a Singularity we're dealing with. No matter how stable it may look, it's still an unpredictable force at the end of the day.

options.content: You know what? I should manage this place.
With great danger comes great responsibility. Too much for you alone.

scripts.say: Go on, nya.
Huh? But that's not fair to you, nya.
Don't sweat it. I mean, I made it in despite what you just said, didn't I? Mistakes like this will keep happening if we don't tighten up the management.
That's true, nya. Okay, I'll entrust you with everything, nya!
(What? She accepted it just like that? That was too easy.)
Here's the machine to transfer management rights, nya. All you have to do is confirm, nya.
(She's unusually eager for some reason. Whatever. I'll accept now and think about her motivations later.)
How's that?
Nyahaha! Perfect, nya! Now you hold the reins over this island, nya.
All assets, facilities, and operational rights have been transferred to you, nya!
Alright. Thank you, Akashi.
Oh, but wait, nya! That also means... there are a few problems YOU have to deal with now, nya.
What problems?
Well... I needed some, uh... startup capital to kick off the development efforts, nya.
Basically, this place is in debt... Phew! That's a weight off my shoulders, nya!
Tell me how much we're in the hole, and I'll cover it.
But why would you, of all people, need to go into debt to develop this island in the first place?
Umm, basically... Developing inside the Singularity requires a special currency, and you can only get that currency from productive and business activities on the island, nya...
To get this snowball rolling, I needed to take a loan, nya!
I've never heard of a rule as asinine as that.
We're building an island in a Singularity here, nya! EVERYTHING is asinine, nya!
Okay, so who did you get this loan from?
Nya... Nyahaha! That would be... a trade secret, nya!
Don't worry about the details, nya!
I do have a friendly tip for you, though: You can check out the details of the loan in the debt mission!
Expanding the harbor... Farm development, animal ranch, commercial area, and plantations? A beach development, too?
No wonder Patrick said the harbor's gotten so much busier. Why did you take on all of these projects?
I... wanted to make money faster, nya.
Greedy as always. Do you even have the personnel to staff all of these developments when they're finished?
Hahaha... That's why I'm so glad you came when you did, nya!
If we just bring more people in, take on more commissions, get the factories moving, raise some crops, and breed some livestock...
We'll recoup that investment in no time, nya!
Okay. And how do you plan to bring people in?
Heheheh. That's what the Island Authorization Permit is for, nya!
Come with me, nya!
What does this machine do?
This is the island's central control system, nya. All of our island tech research and developments depend on this bad boy, nya.
And island tech entails...?
This Singularity might be stable, Commander, but it comes with a whole lot of rules, nya.
Like the entry and exit rules, nya. Goods aren't affected, but personnel need permits to come in, nya.
So everyone here has gotten a permit from this machine?
Nope, nya. Everyone in the development area got locked in here from the start, so we got permits automatically, nya.
What about me?
Uh... I guess you got authorized automatically because you counted as coming in by accident, nya...
Ahem! So anyway, we developed this Island Authorization Device to help everyone come here normally, nya!
Get authorized with a valid permit, and you'll be able to come and go as you please, nya. There aren't any real limitations either, nya.
Okay, and where are these permits? I'll take ten for now.
Heheh, I don't have any, nya. You'll have to research them yourself if you wanna get your hands on 'em, nya.
You can arrange any and all research plans through the control system here, nya.
Go ahead, nya. Try it out and develop your first Island Authorization Permit now, nya!
Akashi... Is this the permit we need?
Yeah, that's the one, nya!
With this bad boy, we can have everyone back at the port join in the island's fun and profits, nya!
Come over here, nya. Put that permit in the authorization device, and the job is done, nya.
Hmm? The machine stopped working. I wanted to call more people in.
Too bad, nya... The rules of the Singularity don't allow it. You have to wait between each permit you issue, nya.
But don't worry! You'll have plenty of people helping out around the island before you know it, nya!
For now, let's go back to the harbor to meet our new development partner, nya!
Tadah! Sara has arrived!
Did you miss me that bad, Commander?
Saratoga! Welcome to the Singularity's island development area.
Welcome, nya!
I've been briefed on everything.
We all would've thought this whole Singularity business was a silly prank if you weren't the one telling us about it.
I'm just as surprised as you are, but now that I'm in charge, I plan to see it through.
Hehehe. Don't worry – I'm here to help.
Same here, nya! If you need any help during construction, come to me, nya. You'll get a special discount, nya!
You're already trying to squeeze me for money right after foisting this whole thing onto me?
Pssh, NO, nya... I just wanna see this place thriving already, nya! Money is no object, of course, nya.
I'm excited for this island's future, too!
Great. Let's all do our best to make this island thrive!
I can't wait, Commander!
So, where do we begin? I'm dying to get started!
Hmm... Good question.
If you don't have any ideas, I've got just the proposal for you, nya!
Let's hear it.
Start out with your Daily Plans, nya.
Everyone on the island is gonna have different missions and needs every day, and helping them out will be a major part of the project, nya.
Assisting with other people's work sounds perfect for me! I'm always helping people around the port.
Not a bad proposal, surprisingly.
I take it you're familiar with everyone's daily life here, right?
Of course, nya! Go ahead and try doing one of today's plans, nya.
I'll go look for a nice reward for you while you do, nya!
I'm scared. What is this reward?
It's an Island EXP Textbook, nya! Just the thing for newcomers, nya!
Akashi, did you find that Island EXP Textbook, or whatever?
Nya~ I just did, in fact, nya!
I packed all my knowledge from the past six months into this thing, nya. It's got everything from survival skills to construction tips, nya!
It's your own secret manual, nya! And I'm giving it to you for FREE, nya!
Free, eh? What's got you in such a generous mood?
Well, you are my most important development partner, nya.
Besides, you're not gonna sell that for a good price with all the debt you've got on your shoulders, nya.
Sorry, whose fault is this debt, again?
Don't worry, nya. Once we solve our little manpower problem, that debt will be gone just like that, nya!
But you and I gotta focus on the long term, nya! About how to make money, you'd better ask Patrick at the Greatship Pier later, nya!
(Patrick looks awfully busy.)
I guess being busy is a good thing, given how much work there is to be done.
Commander? What's the matter? Are you still worrying yourself over everyone's duties?
Not just that. I've inherited all of the debt taken on by this island and its development project.
And it's astronomical, I'll have you know.
Hahaha... Akashi was so busy building farms, expanding the harbor, and establishing a commercial area that she never stopped to question if she should.
I just assumed you were funding her efforts.
Funding her? Well, you're not wrong now, I guess... Either way, we're in debt.
I need to do something, or else this place is going bankrupt the instant the repayment deadline comes.
Oh, my. I'm sorry to say, but I can't really solve that problem.
Ahem... I'm not trying to make the loan everyone's problem, or anything.
But since you're in charge of managing requests, I thought maybe you'd know a way or two to get rich quick.
The simplest and most reliable way would probably be completing transport jobs.
Transporting the island's assets to where they're needed most is a good way to earn money. Unfortunately, the development area isn't exactly overstocked.
Whether we can make money quickly depends on your actions.
Okay, moving on... Any more efficient methods that would involve more complexity or risk?
Heheh, someone's getting greedy...
Since you asked, though, there have been some rumors circulating about...
Have you heard of the legend of Treasure Island?
Treasure Island?
It's just a rumor, but apparently, there's this island that sometimes appears like a mirage in the seas near the development.
They say there's tons of treasure there, from precious metals and jewels to even lost technology.

options.content: You know, I think I'd prefer transport jobs.
This calls to my treasure hunter nature...

scripts.say: Interested yet?
Hah! I knew you wouldn't be impressed by hearsay.
But Stephen, the person in charge of transport jobs, says she's seen it with her own two eyes.
It sounds a little fake, though.
Don't take my word for it. Go ask Stephen for yourself.
She's in charge of transport jobs, so I think she'll know a lot more about it.
You might just win big!
Hmm... There's nobody at Greatship Pier, huh?
There's a whole pile of freight, though.
Stephen isn't slacking off, is she?
Well, maybe she has urgent business to attend to. I'll look around for her.
I've hit the end of her tracks...
Stephen must be nearby!
Whoa?! C-Commander, why are you here?
I came to see how your "work" was going.
Hahaha... I-I'm working hard, I promise!
I just got a little, uh, tired... so I'm on break!
Hmm... To be fair, it's important to separate work and rest.
Long break you're on, though. The cargo holds are plumb empty.
EMPTY?! No way...
Have I not been working at all? Was I just... dreaming of work?
Dreaming?
Wait a minute. Are you telling me that the lumber and ore piled up at the pier are the same materials I brought over just yesterday?
M-maybe... Possibly... Yeah.
Ugh. You're not on a long break – you're just not working entirely.
Aww... You don't have to say anymore, Commander. I feel really bad...
I'll get to work right now! Right this second!
We need that cargo loaded NOW! I'll help you do it.
R-really?! You're too kind, Commander!
I-I'll get it done right this time! Just you watch!
Not so fast, Stephen. Remember: Safety first.
Stephen, you good?
Whew... I'm finally done stacking everything.
And it's all thanks to you, Commander! If you weren't here, I'd be working well into the night!
Just don't take a day-long nap next time.
I won't! Oh, right, that reminds me...
Did you hear the rumor about Treasure Island?
Yep. Patrick told me. You interested in treasure-hunting?
Sure am! You won't believe what I saw while I was sailing.
Off to the southeast, there was an island shrouded in mist that glittered like gold! Like, actually glittering!
But, when I tried to get closer, the mist suddenly got thicker, and the currents started pushing against me! I couldn't get there no matter how I tried!
So everyone started saying that's gotta be the legendary Treasure Island.
Interesting... I'd love to go and investigate it once our finances are more stable.
Hrmh... You're only looking at the short term.
I'll pass out from exhaustion before our finances stabilize if all we do is move wood and ore around!
Hmm... You have a point. The island's production is pretty limited, and we're still reliant on the port to provide us with many daily necessities.
Raw resources alone don't bring in much profit, either.
Wait, are we THAT strapped for cash?
To be frank, we're not just strapped, we're basically penniless.
Have you thought about shipping agricultural products, then?
Fresh fruit and vegetables, especially!
You can fetch twice or more their regular price, depending on the location! They're way more profitable than wood and ore!
Shipping produce is a race against the clock. The small freighters we have now won't–
No, wait, we might just be able to pull it off if we go through the Singularity.
(There's some risk, but it's got a better return.)
Exactly! Follow me and I'll show you to the farm! While we're at it, let's stop and rest for– Err, never mind.
No, let's take a break. Just don't forget about the pine wood being delivered later.
Got it. Then I'll take my break while waiting. *yawn*...
(Agricultural products... That might just be the breakthrough we need, and it's more realistic than looking for Treasure Island.)
Homeric?
You sure look concentrated. Did you find treasure or something?
Hm? Oh, Commander. I was just observing the wheat that's growing.
Is there something unusual about it?
Yes. It's the number of tillers. There are 50% more on average than wheat grown off the island.
It grows fast, the stems are thick and robust, and it's remarkably resilient.
Are any other farm plants like this?
Well, as far as I can tell at the moment...
All plants grown on the island are clearly superior to those grown elsewhere.
I want to find out why that is. Could it be the sunlight? Or is it the soil?
Whatever the case, you've got a keen eye.
Pl-please, you flatter me... These features are simply so evident that anyone who's grown them before will notice.
I have an idea – why don't you buy some seeds and try growing them?
Then we can thoroughly observe their growth process, from planting to harvest!
Good idea. I'll give it a shot.
That's everything!
Well, Commander? Did you notice anything different about those seeds?
Compared to regular wheat, they were shaped and sized completely differently. Weird stuff.
Come to think of it, yeah, they were different. Like, they were... Um...
*stares patiently*...
They were bigger!
That's right. I knew you'd notice it.
The island has a blessed environment, and all the crops grown here are of exceptional quality.
Many of the crops have undergone changes visible even at a glance if you compare them to ones in an encyclopedia.
From what I've heard, there's still untapped potential lying in this field.
There is. Given a small time investment, this field on its own will be able to feed the entire development area.
Sure, but what if we scale up a bit?
How about feeding the island AND increasing our exports at the same time?
If we were to scale up, our high yields and quick growth cycles would indeed be nice advantages...
However, it will also rapidly deplete the nutrients in the soil.
It won't be possible to outpace the nutrient depletion with our current crop rotation and basic compost.
Look at this. While the field may seem fine on the surface, the organic matter content deep in the soil has already begun to decline.
If we don't replenish it, the harvest will drop in both quality and quantity next season. It isn't a sustainable process.
Soil fertility's the problem, huh? In that case...
Whenever we take from the field, we must also give something back.
Ah, yes, that's a great idea!
We could try natural fertilizer, for instance. There's a ranch right next to us, after all.
Of course. It's a safe and efficient option.
Depending on how the field's doing, we can also use it in tandem with chemical fertilizer when appropriate.
Yes, then we should be able to keep the soil fertile and grow lots of quality crops at the same time!
Great! Then the key to solving this problem lies in the ranch.
Well, it may solve the soil issue, but there's another...
The scale you're envisioning is too much for me to handle all by myself.
So you need manpower? Not a problem. I'm not a tyrant – I'll get you some helpers.
Now, let's head to the ranch and look for some brown gold.
Amerigo?
Oh! Commander! Welcome to Laidback Ranch!
Don't mind me, just setting up some bedding for the little ones on the way!
The plans said something about a perfect ranch built with cutting-edge tech to provide the animals with the best possible living environment.
That's right! This place's about to get real heckin' comfortable. The animals are gonna love it!
That's what I like to hear. Although, where are said animals? They're the most crucial thing, and I don't see a single one.
That's 'cause plans are just that – plans! All the ranch has got right now is a single free-range clucky clucky bird!
It's free-range, yet I don't see it anywhere. How come?
Sounds like SOMEONE doesn't get the appeal of a ranch!
See, free-range means it's free to roam about the ranch however it wants.
Watch this, though. If you just take a little feed and spread it around...
Clucky! Dinnertime! I've got food for you! Come here!
Doesn't look like it's coming.
Just give me a second! I'll try again!
Cluckyyy! We're having sweet, sweet corn today! Better come quick or the birds'll eat it all first!
Huh, that's weird... She usually comes running as soon as I call for her.
Oh no... What if she's left the ranch?!
Seems like your one and only resident has gone off in search of freedom.
Do you think you could go and bring her back, Commander? Please!
Without her, my dream of running this ranch will end before it's even begun!
Alright, alright, calm down. She can't have gone far, so I'll bring her back in no time.
Heck yes! You're the best, Commander!
Got you!
Made it all this way, huh? You're a quick runner.
(I've caught the clucky clucky bird. Better take her back to Amerigo.)
Amerigo! Guess who I brought along.
Wow! Commander! You actually caught her! You're amazing!
I was SO freaked out, thinking the ranch was done for when it just got off the ground!
You should know she's a skilled hider. She was hiding in the shade over there this whole time.
Man, I can't thank you enough for finding her!
Please, it's nothing to write home about. Still, you need to keep an eye on her from now on.
Of course! I'm never letting her go far away again.
Cluck-cluck-cluck!
Alright, you must be pretty hungry, huh? Let's get you some–
Wait, what the heck?!
What's up?
The feed... It's run out! It's empty! Not a single grain left!
It's one thing after another on this ranch...
Where do you usually top up your feed?
Uhh... Homeric usually just drops by and gives me some.
Ah, right! She said she takes some wheat to the mill to get it ground up!
Grinds the wheat? So she makes flour. Alright. Wait right here.
She just finished growing some new wheat at the farm, so I'll head over to the mill.
Thank gosh you're so reliable, Commander!
Me and little clucky here will be waiting for you.
Olympic?
Zzzz……
Olympic. Wake up.
Mmh... Commander... Do you need something?
Amerigo's run out of feed for her chicken, so I'm here to check on her behalf.
She said you make feed from grinding wheat here. Do you know how to do it and how long it takes?
Feed for her chicken...
*yawn*... I already have some ready.
I ground a ton of wheat earlier, and it's all lying over there...
You can leave the wheat you brought over there... and wait for me to finish...
Alright. Thanks, Olympic.
Mgh... So sleepy... If that's all, then I'll get back to recharging my batteries...
Zzzzz……
Wow, she fell asleep in an instant. Well, seeing as she's finished her work, I might as well let her rest.
Amerigo, I brought some feed! Think this will do?
Holy cow, Commander! Yeah, this will more than do!
Don't forget to let Homeric know before you run out of feed next time.
I will, I will! Hey, wanna get a feel for feeding clucky?
I've been told she'll lay some eggs once her stomach's full.
Eggs, you say? I'll give it a try.
Hey, Amerigo, are these eggs?
They sure are! Eggs laid on this very ranch!
Your hard work's paid off. They're only the beginning, but they're also proof that the ranch is in business.
Yep. It wasn't easy, but looking at 'em makes me feel like it was all worth it!
Here, Commander! They're all yours!
Wait, you're giving them to me? But it's the ranch's first yield. Shouldn't you keep them?
I said they're yours! You can't keep food as a trophy, and even eggs go bad if you leave them lying around.
And I don't want no rotten eggs on my ranch.
Alright, I'll take it, then. Thanks.
I'm just glad you're happy!
Anyway, we should go and tell Homeric the good news.
Okey-dokey! Three, two, one...
Yes?
Last one there's a rotten–
Hey! Look before you run off!
*pant*... You run way too fast, Amerigo.
Oh, Commander! Come here! Homeric's been rambling about some stuff I don't understand!
Stuff you don't understand?
C-Commander, Amerigo told me about the situation on the ranch, so we chatted, and...
Well, it's about your ecological cycle idea. About using natural fertilizer from the ranch to replenish the farm's nutrients.
Ah, that. Did you reach a conclusion?
Yes. Considering the ranch's and the farm's current states and needs, it's necessary to expand them both.
As you might expect, it's completely impossible for a single chicken to sustain a large farm.
So basically, the ranch needs more animals? Sounds perfect!
We don't need them right this moment, though, right?
Not yet, no. The farm's soil is still nice and fertile, so Amerigo doesn't need to rush to get more animals.
Great! If we do it slow and steady, we can not only pay back our debts, but also greatly increase the island's output.
Granted, Amerigo will have to put in some work for it.
Then work I will! I'll raise all the animals by myself, just you wait and see!
That's the spirit. Oh, geesh, look how late it is, and I've barely had a bite to eat the whole day. Is there any good food on the island?
Ah! You hungry? Then you'll definitely wanna check out Café Manjuu by the harbor!
You're saying I should have coffee for dinner? I'm not sure I need something to put my brain into work mode this late.
Hey, I'm not telling you to drink coffee! Remember the eggs you just got?
You can give those to the staff at the café, and they'll whip up a heavenly omelette for you!
Ah, an omelette. That sounds lovely.
Okay, I'll go do that. I deserve a little treat after today.
You two should head to bed soon. The future of the farm and the ranch depends on you.
Yeah, we know! Come on, off you go! Go have yourself an omelette made with fresh eggs!
See you later, Commander.
Hey there, Bremen.
Oh, welcome, Commander.
You here to inspect the shop? Then I'll calculate our earnings for today right away.
Then I'll give you a weekly and monthly report, followed by a business overview.
Uh, what are you talking about?
Huh? You don't know? Akashi made you the store's new owner yesterday.
So I rushed to put together a business report.
(She really gave me everything alongside the development area...)
I do appreciate the report, but before you give me that...
Could you give me one of your signature omelettes first?
An omelette? Well, sorry to say, but we sold out on those today.
You... sold out? Are you only serving a limited quantity or something?
Funny you ask that, 'cause Stephen just said the same thing.
It's not how I'd describe it, but I guess it fits. Why? Because we have a limited amount of ingredients.
See, most of our ingredients are brought in from the port, and there's not much to go around.
I see, so it's a supply issue. Then I've got just the thing for you.
Oh? These eggs are excellent. Nice color and gloss, with smooth shells.
Did you bring these in from the port?
No, they're from Amerigo's ranch. Collected just today.
I see. No wonder they look so fresh.
I'd love to make some food for you out of these. I'll use them responsibly.
Smells wonderful, Bremen. Is my omelette ready?
Whew... Yep, here. One omelette just for you. Warm and straight out of the pan.
Think of it as your first repayment for all your hard work.
Man, it looks so appetizing. The aroma alone was worth coming here for.
Heheh. I made one for Stephen as well, although she left just a while ago.
Would you mind delivering it to her?
To Stephen? Sure. I was gonna check on her anyway to see if she's having another "long break."
Thanks. I've already boxed it up so you can take it with you.
But right now, just take your time savoring your omelette.
Hey, Stephen. I've got a fancy omelette made by Bremen for you.
How about you take a break and eat something?
Whoa! C-Commander! Is this for me?
Perfect, because I was just getting really hungry. Staring at this load of cargo has given me a headache...
Sounds like you are doing your job after all. You've earned a bite.
Nom!
Whooaa! This omelette is ten– No, a HUNDRED times better than any I've had before!
Right? They're made with fresh eggs collected from Amerigo's ranch.
Take your time. Nobody's gonna steal it from you.
Mmh, this is divine... I wish I could eat this every day.
I mean, you can if you go to Café Manjuu. Just get there early.
No, no! The ones I've had before were good, too, but this is on a whole new level!
If the last one was a 10/10, this one's a 100/10!
This is a taste that transcends being just delicious!
Come on, you're exaggerating.
Heehee... Hey, you need money, don't you? Have you thought about selling food like this at the café?
I think I speak for all of us when I say we want food made using ingredients from the island. It'll sell like hotcakes, trust me!
Selling food through Café Manjuu? Yeah, it might not be a bad idea.
It'd bring in some money and cater to the islanders' needs.
That's what I'm saying. You should talk to Bremen about it and start making it happen!
I will. I'll hit her up right now.
Bremen, I gave your omelette to Stephen, and she proposed an idea. Wanna hear it?
An idea? Tell me.
She said we should make more food made with ingredients from the island, like the omelette was, and serve it here.
Sounds good. Only problem is, the island's ingredient supply still isn't all that stable.
True. That is a bottleneck. I'll see if I can't do something about the ingredients.
Although we can only serve a limited number of dishes right now, the variety and quantity should steadily increase as we develop this place.
Alright, then how about first I sell what dishes I can make using the ingredients available, then you come have a look?
Let's do that. I'll add all the omelettes you just made to the shop lineup.
There. I'm done placing all the omelettes on the shelf.
It smells incredible in here. Wonder who our first customer is gonna be.
Yeah, I'm curious as well.

sequence: Some time later...

scripts.say: Nya! I recognize that smell, nya! It's the smell of fresh, world-class omelettes, nya!
(Where have I heard that voice before...)
It's you! Akashi!
Nya?! You, nya?!
It really is you, nya! I see that omelette in your hands... That smooth surface that glitters like gold, with a fluffy inside – that's Bremen's pièce de résistance omelette, nya!
You can't eat an omelette that big all by yourself, nya... How about...
It's for sale. For money. Or what, are you saying you don't have any money?
Of course I do, nya! I just thought the omelette was just for you, nya.
Bremen, get me one– No, two of your omelettes, nya!
Akashi, here are the omelettes you ordered.
Nya?! Has your huge debt made you so desperate you've even resorted to doing catering, nya?
Very funny. It'd be even funnier if you gave me a tip if you're happy with my service.
Hm? Tip? Sorry, I didn't catch what you just said, nya!
Alright, then just for you, this order is now self-serve.
Nya! Don't leave WITH my omelettes, nya! Look, is a tip really gonna satisfy you, nya?
Keep talking, then you'll get your omelettes.
Ahem... I'm genuinely impressed with what you've done with the development area in such a short amount of time, nya.
But even so, don't you agree the variety of supplies on the island is pretty limited, nya?
What are you trying to sell me this time?
Nya! I'm hurt that your opinion of me is so low, nya!
I'm sincerely delighted by and proud of you and the island's growth, nya!
Also, after seeing your decisiveness and how limitless this place's potential is...
I've decided to present my very best assets and support your enterprise to the full extent of my abilities, nya!
Your "very best assets"?
You heard me, nya! Have a look at the special goods shop I've prepared just for you to see the island's development through, nya!
It's packed to the brim with items that'll be of use to you from all over the place, carefully chosen by yours truly, nya!
These deals are worth so much more than their retail value, nya! Check it out now or kick yourself later, nya!
Should've known... It's always a sales pitch with you.
Okay, so can I have my omelettes now, nya?
Hahah. Yeah, they're all yours. Enjoy.
Akashi, what do you want?
Get over here, nya! I found a way to fix the aircraft, nya!
The aircraft? You mean the one that crash-landed here?
That's the one, nya!
But I'm gonna need your help picking up all the debris scattered around the island, nya.
Why are you suddenly trying to repair it?
Heheh... You've heard the rumors about Treasure Island, haven't you, nya?
Treasure Island? Patrick and Stephen told me about it. What does that have to do with the debris, though?
You're not after that treasure now, are you?
Mwahaha... Of course I am, nya!
But you've been so supportive of my business lately that I couldn't bear to keep all the spoils for myself, nya!
So I'm giving this opportunity to YOU, nya!
What opportunity?
Heheh! Treasure Island is surrounded by dense fog and turbulent waters, nya. Any ship that goes near it gets too lost to ever find it, nya!
BUT! I have a plan, nya!
I'm guessing the plan involves travel by air.
You've got a good head on your shoulders, nya! That's right – we fly, nya!
You want to fly there. In an aircraft that crash-landed once already. And is currently destroyed as a result of said crash.
Of course, nya. Find all the parts scattered around the island, and I'll get it working lickety-split, nya!
Are you sure this is safe?
Nya! Why do you doubt my skills, nya?! The only way to get through fog and turbulent waters is by air, nya!
But things are starting to operate smoothly here, so I'm ready to take a risk if it means finding a path to greater growth.
The island is developing already, but if we had extra start-up capital...
(That debt is still a huge weight on my shoulders, but the way forward is clear. Everything is going well so far.)
Alright.
Heheheh, I thought you might say that, nya! So I already took the liberty of getting things ready, nya!
There are still lots of important parts left, nya. They're probably around the Windswept Plains, Morningdew Farm, and the harbor, nya.
When you find out where the parts are, just call me, nya! I'll take care of the rest, nya!
(That should be all of the parts here at the harbor. Next...)
(The Windswept Plains, huh? I think that's where the bus stop was destroyed, wasn't it?)
(I've got all of the debris from the plains. All that's left is Morningdew Farm...)
(I just hope we didn't hurt the crops or livestock.)
(And that's everything.)
(It's about time I paid Akashi a visit.)
Akashi, I sent you the locations of all the parts. Did you get them?
Commander! Perfect timing, nya!
I just brought them all back, and I'm about to start repairing it, nya.
As long as I've got parts, this is easy work, nya!
Is it really that easy to fix it? It looked pretty wrecked to me.
That means nothing in the face of my unparalleled repair skills, nya! It'll be done in one, two, three, nya!
Okay... How long is that, exactly?
Give me as long as it takes to eat a meal... no, as long as it takes to drink a cup of coffee, nya! Anyway, I'll be done soon, nya!
Are you kidding me?
Of course not, nya! Come find me at the pier when I'm done, nya!
Is this... the same aircraft?
Nya? Commander, right on time as usual, nya!
The aircraft's all ready for ya, nya. You can go to Treasure Island any time, nya!
Did you really fix it? It hasn't been that long since you got all the parts.
I'm the most efficient worker at the port, nya! Piece of cake, nya!
It looks as good as new. I'd believe you if you said you built a new one entirely.
...I don't remember you ever mentioning you could do this before. Someone helped you, didn't they?
Pssh, nooo! I'm just that smart, nya!
Looking as good as new ain't what matters, nya! What matters in an aircraft isn't the appearance, but what's inside... The soul, nya!
(I'm not convinced yet.)
Like I keep telling you: Details, shmetails, nya!
Time is money, and a whole island of treasure awaits you, nya! Get going already, nya!
(Hmm? Is this Treasure Island?)
Something about this place feels off.
I guess I'll just take a look around first.
Mary? Why are you here?
Welcome!
You've just set foot on Get-Together Island, dear Commander! I'm your personal guide, Mary!

options.content: An island with a beach and a pier...
Where's the glittery Treasure Island full of riches?

scripts.say: ...Huh? Come again?
This can't possibly be Treasure Island.
If anything, this place looks more like a tropical resort...
Treasure Island? Oh, that's the name we all came up with when we first came to the development area.
It's just part of the development now, and it's called Get-Together Island.
It was supposed to be an awesome resort where everyone could have fun together.
But development was halted due to funding issues, right?
Yep! See those big vacant lots over there?
We're supposed to have a castle, an amusement park, beachfront villas... There are all kinds of plans for this place, but they won't be complete any time soon.
It's still a nice place to relax, though.
I see what's going on. No wonder Akashi was so excited about this place.
That's why she went through all the trouble of repairing the aircraft, too. She's always got an angle.
Okay, personal guide Mary. If Treasure Island isn't real, then this treasure must be one of Akashi's lies to sell me building materials, right?
Nope! Get-Together Island really is a place where you can get all sorts of goodies every day.
Goodies...?
Yep. With this device Akashi left behind, you can pinpoint the island's coordinates.
And that's your treasure?
You'll get it when you see for yourself. Come with me!
...Okay. Guide the way, I guess.
Is this the device you were telling me about?
Yep. Try using it like I told you.
Press the button, and all sorts of stuff will come out. It's the best!
Hmm... Sounds fun.
I'll give it a try.
Well? Pretty cool, isn't it?
Sure is. It's all very practical stuff.
Alright, now head over to the Free Build Area.
The Free Build Area?
Remember all those vacant lots we saw along the way?
Those are all free-use facilities left just for you!
Once you know what you wanna build, go tell Elizabeth outside the Free Build Area. She'll build whatever you need.
I can really build anything I want?
Yeah! For instance, you could make the Beary Nice Bus Stop I designed.
Sorry, a bus stop? You're gonna run a bus from the ocean?
It's just decorative. You see it all over the development area, so I felt Get-Together Island should have one, too!
Go on, see what it's like!
Hi there, Elizabeth.
Commander! Welcome to the Free Build Area.
Would you like a drink?
I'd love to serve you black tea. You must be tired from your travels.
Thank you, but I'm fine.
I just got this bus stop blueprint, and I'd like to put it here.
Let's see... Did Mary give you this? She's been badgering me about how much she wants one on this island.
No wonder she was so insistent on it. Can I help with it?
Once you've chosen a location, just let me know where, and I'll do the rest.
Now that's adorable. It might not be a real bus stop, but I can't complain about how good it looks.
It sounds like you like it. Wasn't this a good experience?
Yeah. It's a joy seeing the building I envisioned take shape right before my eyes.
It'd be nice to make this place into a figurative "Treasure" Island for us all.
You always have others' best interests in mind. That's so sweet.
Having said that, you mustn't neglect yourself. You must be tired, no?
Tired? I guess, but I'm long since used to it from working at the port.
This is not the port, however. You shouldn't need to be dragged down by work everywhere you go in the development area.
You've repaired the bus stop, carried materials, managed requests and commissions...
I know it's for the sake of the island's future, but still, you must stop and take care of yourself once in a while.
So, at the very least, when you come to Get-Together Island...
We all want you to forget your troubles and create a place where you can relax.
So... relaxation is the reason I was brought here?
Yes. You should take a load off, relax by the beachside, listen to the waves, and release the stress in your heart.
By the way, please take this camera. Use it to snap pictures and record tranquil moments and sights that bring you joy.
You want me to photograph stuff?
Indeed. Since we're right next to this newly finished building, I suggest you use it to get a feel for the camera.
If you have any questions, don't hesitate to come to me. It's simple, so don't be worried.
Elizabeth, I took a picture!
Lovely. The composition and lighting are both wonderful. You're good at this.
Would you care to try your hand at a moving subject this time?
Like what?
The critters that live around the island.
Or, should I say, your neighbors now. Let's get a lasting picture of them.
Alright, I'll have a look around.
Let's see if I can't find any seagulls or sea turtles.
Elizabeth! I snapped a photo of an actual animal! An up-close shot, at that.
Impressive!
Heheh. You have a smile on your face now.
You're right. I feel alive again after doing this.
Yes, because your photograph captured not just the scenery, but also the emotions you felt in that moment.
Doing photography is a lovely way to relax and discover beautiful things with your eyes.
The next time you feel tired, you can look at your photo – at the beach and the animals there – and remember our gratitude.
It'll also remind you that you don't have to do everything all by yourself.
Yeah... I'll take that to heart.
Well, now that you're in good spirits again, I have some news for you.
What is it?
The aircraft you arrived on the island with can be upgraded.
Akashi has found a professional for the job. She believes she can give the aircraft a complete overhaul if she gets the materials.
What's the need for an upgrade in the first place?
She said that it would allow you to fly with greater comfort and safety.
Moreover, it would also be able to bring you to a wonderful place.
A wonderful place, eh? Then I'll need to have a look at that.
Elizabeth, I'm back.
Outstanding work, Commander. Did you find all the materials?
Yep. Everything on your list is right here.
Let's see... You're right. All is in order.
Then all we need to do is let the expert do her work.
Well? Where is she?
Um, well... She's waiting for you at Get-Together Island's harbor. Please go and see her.
Ugh. Is the angle on this coupler off? No, wait... The problem's with this thing.
Wrench! Where's my hex wrench? I JUST left it here!
Miss... Russell?
Hm? Who is it?
Oh! Commander! The materials! Did you bring 'em?
I've got 'em. It's everything on Elizabeth's list.
Awesome! Good quality on 'em, too. Nothing like the garbage Akashi made me use last time.
Speaking of Akashi, I heard from her that you yourself volunteered to do the upgrade on the aircraft. That true?
Volunteered? Well, I guess you could say that. It's 'cause I heard it's your personal aircraft.
I sensed there was still untapped potential inside 'er last time I fixed 'er up.
Wait, "fixed her up"? You were also the one who repaired it in the first place?
That's me. One of the hardest jobs I've ever done.
Improved its safety features by a whole lot while I was at it, too. If it ever has the same issue again, you'll at least be able to land it.
That damn cat... She tricked me again...
What's that?
Nothing. Never mind. Anyway, shall we get to work?
Yep! I'm almost done here, so just hang on a minute!

sequence: A few hours later...

scripts.say: Phew... Not bad, efficiency-wise. Well, Commander, say hello to your new buddy!
You're already done?
Of course I am! The upgrade was a huge success!
Wanna take 'er for a test ride? She's as safe and stable as can be now!
Thanks, Russell. Since they've been calling it an "upgrade," did you add any new features?
Heehee. This bad girl's for more than just flying around Get-Together Island – she can take you to a more incredible place, too.
Incredible, eh. Maybe this one time, Akashi isn't just blowing smoke.
Well, what're you waiting for? Get on!
You've got it! Let's take her for a spin!
How'd you like it, Commander? My skill didn't leave you disappointed, did it?
You blew my expectations out of the water. Bravo, Russell.
Heehee. I knew this is how this baby should've looked from the very start!
If you ever get trouble with machinery again, just gimme a call.
Because I promise 100% customer satisfaction!
Got it. When I need you, I'll be sure to let you know.
Our request processing volume has gone up by 30%, and our backlog of ore and wood at Greatship Pier has been cleared. We're starting to make good money.
I'm sure the Commander will be delighted to see this progress.
Of course we're making money! Even I haven't been slacking off for a good while.
Out of the norm, but welcome.
Oh, Commander. You're back from Get-Together Island. How was it?
You knew it wasn't an island full of treasure all along, huh? I should've figured.
Heehee. What can I say? People were getting worried you'd keel over from exhaustion.
Well... I did get something good out of it, so I should be thanking you all.
Hooray! You're the best there ever was, Commander!
Please, I'm not. You ran the harbor perfectly fine without me around.
That's all because of you two. I'm glad to have you.
Heehee – I'm just glad everything went smoothly! The farm and the ranch are stable, and business is booming at Café Manjuu!
Patrick's been saying we'll be able to pay off the development area's debt in no time at this rate!
Yep. We're still a ways off from fully clearing our debt, but your arrival here has breathed new life into the place. Everything is working well, simply put.
It's not solely because of me. The reason this previously barren island is as prosperous as it is now is that everyone here has been putting in work and brainpower.
At its core, it's because of our shared desire to protect and live on this land and support one another.
Our debt will be gone one day or another, new projects will be undertaken, and the island will grow ever more beautiful and prosperous.
Because the most important treasure there is already in our hands.
Patrick, you called?
Have you heard about the new commercial area nearing completion near the harbor?
A commercial area, huh? I think I saw that on Akashi's blueprint.
Halted due to funding issues, I assume?
That's right. But it's almost done, so it would be a real shame to leave it so close to completion.
Hmm... Am-Mer-Mar was in charge of it, right?
Yep! She's been organizing materials in the plaza lately. You should go check on her.
I'll do just that. I don't like the thought of leaving our investment untouched, either.
Am-Mer-Mar... I hear that construction here has halted. Is that true?
Commander! Thank you for coming to inspect!
Umm... As you can see, the harbor commercial district project is on hold.
I'm in the process of tallying up our leftover materials to see if they can be moved to more urgent projects.
That won't be necessary. I want this project back on track.
Back on track? As the person in charge, I appreciate the thought...
Knowing our financial situation, though, I think you should consider using the materials for your main priorities.
You misunderstand. This IS a main priority.
What kind of resort is all work and no play? People can't have fun here.
Besides, all that's left is to set up the actual storefronts, right? That can't cost that much. It should be profitable in the long term, too.
But compared to other projects, and with the personnel shortage bad enough already, it'll take too long...
When this place is complete, everyone will have a place to relax and have some fun.
Let's make a warm and lively restaurant district for everyone, Am-Mer-Mar!
...Okay! I'll start drawing up new plans right away.
I'll build the first restaurant myself, but I'll need your help deciding what food to sell. That isn't really my strong suit.
Of course, I'd be happy to figure out the menu. Let's make this a success.
Yeah! I'll do my very best!
Look, Commander! The storefront is already done! Now we just need the most important part...
The food that will bring everyone here in droves!
You've got that right. Can't fill your stomach if the restaurant doesn't serve food.
On that note, I brought plenty of food to satisfy everyone's tastes.
Impressive! Once we put them on store shelves, our work is done!
Fantastic. Shall we?
Am-Mer-Mar, I got all the food ready.
Thank you, Commander. Just place it on the table here for me.
Now that I'm seeing it all lined up, the selection might be a little too limited.
It might be fine for one restaurant, but it's far from enough for the whole district...
If variety is your concern, I did hear that the farms and ranches of the development have been ramping up production.
You could try going to the Prosperous Plantation.
Tell me more.
It was built a long time ago, but there hasn't been any proper activity there.
Maybe they've hit a wall.
In that case, I'd better go check it out. We can't let anyone get left behind.
Thank you. I can handle things here for the time being.
Good luck, Am-Mer-Mar.
Thank you! I promise, I'll make this commercial district the tastiest-smelling place in the whole development!
Lusitania and Laconia? Hey. How are you two doing?
Oh, Commander! Heehee – welcome to Prosperous Plantation!
Commander... Hello.
Why the long faces? Something the matter?
Umm... It's the apple trees. The orchard was completed quite some time ago, but most of the trees haven't even blossomed, let alone produced fruit.
Yeah... Even the ones that have bloomed haven't produced fruit.
I see. I was hoping you'd have new ingredients ready to deliver to the stores in the harbor.
Sounds like the orchard's not doing too well, though.
Sadly not. We HAVE been doing our best, so it's not that!
We've been watering on time, and making sure they get plenty of sunlight, but while the leaves are lush and green, there just aren't any flowers growing, much less fruit!
Little blooming, and no fruit... Lusitania, have you been pollinating them?
Sorry? Polli-what?
Then there's your problem. See all the bees flying around outside?
They fly from flower to flower, carrying pollen from one to the other. That's what pollination is.
Fruit trees – especially apple and mandarin trees – don't grow fruit unless they're pollinated. Just giving them water and sunlight won't cut it.
That's why?! Gosh, what a fool I was for going out of my way to chase them away...
What's done is done. What matters is that the solution's easy now that we know the cause.
Bees? Wait, are we going to start raising bees?
Uhh... Yeah, basically. You'll need some nests and their inhabitants.
I'll go look for some in the wild, and bring them back to the orchard once I find some. I'll leave them somewhere around...
Ah, I'm getting carried away. You'll need some beehives, too.
Right, beehives! Can't raise bees without a place for them to live.
I'll get some set up right away!
You sound... really hyped about it. Are you a bee enthusiast?
Yeah, she is. She gets really excited whenever the subject of bees comes up!
That's reassuring. Anyway, I'll go look for those nests. Laconia, I trust you to make some big and sturdy boxes.
Hmm... That should be all.
The bees look healthy, time to head back to the orchard.
Laconia? Are these the beehives you made?
Whoa! You really did bring back the hives! And yes, these are the beehives she made. Let those bees come into their new homes!
Hm? You've got nests from the wild!
Aww, they look so healthy. Nice work, Commander.
Got lucky and found them in a forest nearby. They were very friendly, thankfully.
They'll make the perfect residents for your beehives.
These new friends of ours deserve the best home.
Be careful when you put them in, Commander.

sequence: Working together, we carefully transfer the bees from their nests into the large beehives.
Although a small handful of cautious bees fly off, they don't attack us.
Still, they're clearly flapping their wings much louder than before as they adapt to their new environment.

scripts.say: Something wrong?
Shh. They're afraid.
It's a scary, new environment for them. I think giving them a sweet treat would help calm them down.
A sweet treat? Like what?
Like honey. Just a little bit.
Alright, I'll head off and look for some. Hope they settle down before then.
Let's hope so. Take care, Commander.
Laconia, I got some honey for you.
Golden and glittery... So pretty.
It's sweet, and it smells wonderful. Thank you. The bees will love it.
Wow! So now apples will start growing, right?
Yeah. In theory, at least.
Awesome! Here, have these as thanks, Commander!
What are they?
Why, apple tree seeds!
I picked them out from our finest apples. Why don't you plant them and see what happens?
You mean try to grow trees? Not my area of expertise, so...
It's fiiine! I managed it, and I didn't even know what pollination was!
Bees love apple flowers, so it'd be nice if you could...
Alright, I'll try. Guess I'm an orchardist now!
Wow, look at the soil! It's loose and fertile now, very suitable for the growth of tree roots!
You're WAY better at this than I was my first time around, Commander!
Really? Here I was, worrying I wasn't watering them right.
No, you nailed it. The soil's moisture is perfect, and they're getting the ideal amount of sunlight.
I'll look after them from here. Although, it's mostly up to the sun, the rain, and the bees.
Give it some time, and these trees will yield big apples before long!
Yeah. The next step is to watch them grow, bloom, and bear fruit.
Heehee – remember, they're your trees, Commander. Be sure to look after them.
Of course I will.
Whoooaaa! This is a big– No, supergiant harvest!
Amazing, Commander! You're the god of gardening!
How's it taste? Have a bite!
Sure! I'll have a taste of your very first apple!
Nom, nom... Mmm! It's like a gentle explosion of sour and sweet!
It's crunchy, sugary, and tastes like the sun! It's incredible how the first apples you've grown are this tasty!
It wasn't all my work. You looked after them, and Laconia's bees helped, too.
All of us put in work at the orchard, so it's the fruit of all our labors.
Heehee, that's true!
Oh, right, Laconia should have some!
Let's pick some apples and give them to her! I want to share this sunny flavor with her!
You're right. She's earned a sweet treat.
Watch the orchard while I'm gone.
Will do! Have a nice walk!
Laconia.
Commander?
I brought the first bounty from the orchard... and those bees of yours, of course.
Lusitania said you should have some. Give it a try.
Apples? Did the bees make them grow...?
It smells like sunlight, soil, and... like apple blossoms...
Thank you... Lusitania, Commander, and bees... You're all wonderful.
Don't sell yourself short. You took care of the bees, remember?
Commander, I...
Yes?
The apple tasted so good. I want to grow something for myself now...
Like you and Lusitania... I want to help everyone, too.
You wanna grow something, eh?
Aha. You just reminded me of something, actually.
This land has ample sunlight and soft soil. You can grow more than just fruit trees here. For example...
Plants that are soft and fluffy like clouds.
Like cotton?
Exactly – cotton. Lavender might be nice, too.
These crops are delicate, though, so they're going to need tender care. I don't think Lusitania is the right fit for them.
Delicate... and tender?
Yeah. Like how you care for those bees.
The development area doesn't have seeds, though, and we don't have a plan for cultivating them yet.
I'll go look into this. You just wait, okay?
Yeah... I'll be waiting.
Laconia, my research has yielded fruit... so to speak.
Okay?
Here's a preliminary cultivation guide.
It includes the correct temperature and humidity for seedlings, proper sowing depth, and how to identify and deal with the most common pests.
Wow... I'll read every bit of it.
Good. The future of this plant nursery is in your hands.
Yeah... I promise I'll care for every last seed as if they were my babies.
Ahem... Akashi? What have you been up to lately?
Nya?! C-Commander?!
What's going on with you? I haven't even seen you at Café Manjuu.
Nya... Well...
I've been cooking up a grand plan, nya! It's gonna revolutionize the workflow of the entire development area, nya!
Skip the advertising pitch, please.
Basically... It's an assembly line, nya!
You want to build an assembly line on this island? With... those parts?
That's the plan, nya!
But even with the perfect plan... you can't do much without materials, nya...
I figured this would happen. What do you want this time? Nothing crazy or expensive, please.
Heheh, don't worry about that, nya! It's all stuff you can grab on this island, nya!
Glad to hear that. Give me a list, and I'll go searching.
Already got one, nya! Good luck out there, nya~
Akashi, here's the stuff you asked for.
Nya? Back so soon, nya?
You... got everything on the list, nya?
Yep. This should be everything.
Incredible, nya! Now Russell's assembly line can finally get to work, nya!
Russell? She's here, too?
Of course, nya! I'd never be able to get a huge project like this on its feet without a subject matter expert like her, nya!
She's been hard at work for days already, nya! Now Commander, let's go witness that miraculous moment, nya!
Akashi... You seriously turned this into a factory?
Heheh, isn't it awesome, nya?
And this is just phase one, nya! Before long, it'll be full of assembly lines that operate all day and all night, nya!
Commander! Perfect timing!
Did you bring all the materials? Great! With these, I can complete the core driving mechanism!
Did you design all of this?
Of course! Akashi just provided the location, and I built the rest up with my own two hands.
What can it do?
Lots of stuff!
Like this! Once the automated grinder is online, we can just deliver wheat and corn from the farms to make standardized flour and feed pellets!
Olympic can sleep her whole life away, and it won't affect productivity at all.
Oh, and this! Toss in ore and wood, and it can generate anything from specified building materials to even tools!
If we can secure more equipment, we'll even be able to manufacture metal alloys and simple machine parts!
Nya-nya! Standardizing all these products will make the development area's trade volume boom, too, nya!
Our excess flour, feed, and alloys can be sold off for pure profit, nya!
Well, you two are the professionals. I can definitely see the potential of this factory.
Darn right, nya! Once these hunks of metal get to work, your debt...
Ahem! The island's balance sheet, I mean, will be greener than ever, nya!
Endless money... no, PROSPERITY, is almost in our paws, nya!
Wow... Yeah. We've gone from vacant lots to farms, pastures, and a booming factory.
Our development area has finally gone from blueprint to reality.
Mmm... I can't wait to see the breath of industry fill this land. To see the lights on at all hours!
That's going to be more beautiful than any blueprint could ever hope to be.
Nyahaha! By then, we won't be worrying about going hungry anymore, nya!
That's true. Before that, though, we need to screw these screws in tightly.
You'll continue supporting us, won't you, Commander?
That goes without saying. There are no plans we can't realize as long as we have you.
It's a promise then, nya! We'll all keep working hard at it, nya!
Yeah. Let's make this an even better place than it already is!
欢迎指挥官来到农场
明石，你怎么在这里
因为我是指挥官的向导
就由我来为你介绍一下农场吧
那就交给你了
Watching the windmill go round and round... makes me sleepier.
The smell of wheat... makes me want to take a nap.
All the flour's in the bag... probably. I hope nothing's missing...
Ships are coming and going, and cargo is piling up!
This harbor really is full of life!
Heheh – today's another new record in number of requests made.
Whew... The requests have piled up again!
I sure hope the next transport ship returns on schedule.
Checking the quantity, verifying the quality – Stephen's a prodigy♪
The plants are growing so well, filled with the sun's warm grace.
Drink up, little seedlings! We want you growing fast!
I'm so sweaty because I've been working in this field.
Ah, I love the breeze that blows through the ranch.
Alrighty, here's some fresh grass!
Nice. Pretty good yield for today!
Nice! This is pretty good ore! Few impurities, too.
Last minecart! C'mon, you can do it! You're almost there!
Alright, leave it here. I'll check the purity.
Yep, this is top-rate lumber. It's solid and well-balanced.
Did the bushes just move? Um... must've just imagined it.
Whew... I'm done processing this lumber. Time for a quick break.
The restocking order needs to be processed urgently.
I still have a few stores' daily reports to read.
Our patronage has grown over yesterday again.
Hmm, the problem doesn't seem to be over here.
Wrench! Where's my wrench?
Our patronage shows an increase over yesterday again.
Greetings. I'm Elizabeth, and I will be your get-together guide.
Please mind your step near the water. Safety comes first, always.
The guide, first-aid kit, spare communicator... Okay, I'm all set.
Grow, little saplings, and become big♪
Mmm! Sweet, sour, and so juicy!
Smell that sunshine! We'll be able to harvest soon.
Perfect caramel color. Love that sweet apple smell.
A steady water flow ensures a uniform extraction.
Mmm. That citrus aroma is so refreshing.
Tick, tock, tick, tock♪ I wonder what new things will happen today!
Whew. I'm tired, but my friends' smiles make it all worth it!
Welcome! I'm Mary, your fun get-together guide!
Grow, little saplings, and become big♪
Mmm! Sweet, sour, and so juicy!
Smell that sunshine! We'll be able to harvest soon.
I've gotta sell off these goods quickly.
It's not easy getting in here.
Hello? A customer? A real customer?
These resources will be of great use in the island's development.
Hmm... It will be impossible to deal with all these requests.
This is very high-quality lumber.
Meow... It seems nothing's biting. Today is a day ill-suited for fishing!
A catch! Keeping it steady is key!
Whoa! What a splash! That must be a big one!
Thank you so much, Commander.
I will manage the logging site carefully from this point on!
Now nobody has to worry about lacking wood anymore.
As always, you work fast, Commander.
This is precisely what the commercial area was lacking, and in the perfect amount, too.
You've really helped us out. We owe our prosperity entirely to you.
Zzz... Hm? Commander... You got the things needed for the water mill...
Okay, just... Leave them over there. Thanks...
Now I can sleep a little longer...
Zzzzz...
Bless your heart, Commander!
You needn't worry about the orchard now!
I'll take good care of it!
Thanks, Commander. This will make the bees happy, I'm sure.
And, moreover...
It makes me happy.
Is all of it done already?
Yep, looks like there weren't any issues with the manufacturing equipment.
That's good. Let me know whenever you want to make something.
Oh, Commander, you're here!
That over there is cargo for the islanders. I should be the one to deliver it, but...
But you have your hands full, I'm guessing.
Yeah. The cargo just arrived, and I'm checking all the quantities right now.
If I wait to deliver them only after I'm done here, the packages will be late, so...
I've got you covered. I'll deliver them.
I had a feeling you'd help! There's a package in there for you, too.
Open it once you've delivered the rest!
Apologies, Commander, but I'm a bit overwhelmed by the flood of orders today...
You've got it rough. Want me to help with some deliveries?
Yes, please. The destination of each order is written on its label.
I've got you. I'll get these deliveries done before the food goes cold.
Amerigo, I got them to calm down.
Really? You did?
You just need to find their cozy place and comfort them patiently.
But that's exactly what I tried...
Was I just not patient enough? That can't be it, right?
Take it easy. Try doing it nice and slow from now on.
You're here, Commander... Sorry I made you do all that work.
It's fine. What is this? Food for those little cats?
Yep. Dried fish made just for them and divided into equal portions.
I see them around often, so I want you to feed them.
Got it. Anything particular I should know?
Well, you might need to go looking for 'em. I'm not sure where they went, either.
Alright. I'll head out now.
Appreciate the help, Commander.
Oh! Commander! You got here at just the right time!
What's up? Did an animal escape again?
No, no, not this time!
The animals have been on super good behavior lately, so I wanna let 'em play out in the meadows next to the farm!
You're bringing them all there? Will you be able to keep watch on them?
Not a snowball's chance in heck! That's why I want you to give me a hand with that! I'll handle the rest!
Alright. Just don't go overboard.
Swell! Much appreciated, Commander!
Now, don't worry, these little guys know how to behave! Just give 'em a pat and they'll follow you anywhere!
Oh, Commander! Perfect timing!
Let's see... Yep, that'll do! Appreciate it!
This'll let us take on mine-related commissions!
Whew – you're finally here! Thanks a bunch!
Oh boy, it's about to get busy for me again... but I don't mind as long as I can be of service to you.
Heehee. Don't worry! I may get a little lazy sometimes, but I'll do my job!
Thank you kindly for this, Commander. I'll do my best to manage the farm well.
I'll strive to quickly provide a wide array of fresh vegetables for all the islanders to eat.
It's the one thing I can do to help you.
Whoa! It's you! Here to feed the animals?
If not, that's fine, too! I love everything you give to me!
Same goes for the animals! The ranch gets more lively whenever you're around!
Oh, you brought the ingredients I need.
Yup, they look really good.
Now I can provide tastier food to our customers. Thanks a bunch.
I'll be sure to pour extra love into the dishes.
Hm? You've already gotten everything I requested?
Let's have a look-see... Yep, it's all here! You work fast!
Thank gosh you're here. I would've never gotten this done on my own.
Great work! Keep it up!
Ah! Commander! You actually found the stuff I wanted!
Let me see what you got!
Wow! It looks so tasty! Thanks!
Heehee – batteries back at full charge! Now I can get back to excitedly showing people around the island!
Ah, Commander. Were you able to find what I requested?
Excellent. All the items on the list are here.
Delivered at just the right time as well. Now maintenance work may begin on the island's buildings.
I shall use these to make our activity area an even more pleasant place.
O'Brien, what are you doing?
Whoa! C-Commander... You gave me a scare. How do you walk so silently?
Something the matter? You look on edge.
Well, do you know what's been going on?
Lately, just before it starts raining, something in the distance starts howling all strangely!
Howling? You mean like an animal's cry?
Oh, I'm used to animal cries! These howls are something completely different. They're hollow, and long... Sometimes it sounds like it's crying, other times it's so sharp it makes my ears hurt.
It might not be raining right now, but just thinking about that howl sends chills up my spine... I think there's something dangerous creeping around in the woods.
Where does it come from, specifically?
Umm... Right by the forest. Yeah, that's where they come from.
I've been too scared to go there to chop wood, despite all the work I need to do...
Alright. I'll go check it out.
You will? Okay, just please be careful. I'm telling you, that sound is terrifying!
Don't worry. I'm just gonna observe from a distance.
There's a large amount of wood scattered around outside the logging site. It's piled up, but with a few irregular gaps.
Hm? Wait, I hear something...
Just as I come closer, a soft breeze blows through the narrow, crooked gaps.
Woooo... Aaahh....
Suddenly, there's a sharp, long, and drawn-out howl.
I see... So the howling came from the wood.
I should tell O'Brien.
O'Brien...
Ah, Commander. Was everything fine?
Well... I found the source of those strange howls.
Oh! What was it?
It was the piles of wood.
It... came from the wood?
Yep. There were gaps in just the right shapes and places.
When the wind blows through them, it creates a noise. Kind of like playing a flute.
What?! The sound... came from some gaps?
