scripts.say: We’re probably going to need TB’s help if we hope to figure this thing out.
Orders received. Commencing analysis of Siren Research Facility.
Data retrieved. Commencing structure manipulation.
Scan complete. Successfully disabled on-site security.
One way or another, we’ll figure it out without her help.
That’s a whole lot of seals! Now, which is the real one... Might be worth a scan.
Darn, that wasn’t the real one. Better luck next time.
A group of seals are playing in the water. This warrants closer investigation...
Scan complete. Route to targeted marine animal obstructed by ice floes.
Locating the Control Device to disperse the ice floes is recommended.
Locating the Control Device to disperse the ice floes is recommended.
Some of the ice floes and haze generated by the Sirens have been removed.
The ice floes and the fog are all gone now. Now we can get back to looking for seals.
Scan complete. Presence of Siren defense fleets has been detected.
Energy Matrix obtained. Bring it back to its storage platform.
On-site Siren security system has been activated. Presence of abnormal ocean currents has been observed.
The abnormal ocean currents are stopping us from moving forward. Let’s come back later.
On-site Siren security system has been activated. Presence of abnormal ocean currents has been observed.
On-site Siren security system has been activated. Presence of ice floes and abnormal ocean currents has been observed.
Locating the Weather Control Device to dispose of the ice floes is recommended.
Confirming results: Commander, the Energy Matrix has been successfully returned to its original location.
Energy Matrix obtained. Bring it back to its storage platform.
Scan complete. Abnormal ocean currents in this zone can be neutralized via use of the Weather Control Device.
This Siren Data Logging Tower seems to be out of order.
Scan complete. Ocean currents have returned to normal.
On-site Siren security system has been activated. Detecting activation of Data Logging Tower.
There’s no telling what will happen if we enter the Data Logging Tower’s scan range. We’d best proceed with caution.
Our fleet retreated to the entry point to avoid being scanned by the Data Logging Tower. The Energy Matrix returned to its starting position as a result.
We secured the Energy Matrix. Let’s move it back to its platform.
Scan complete. Activating the Energy Matrix will cause corrosion to spread within zone. Proceed with caution.
The corrosion is spreading outwards in a cross formation, but can be halted through the use of obstacles and ocean currents. Plot your course carefully.
We can’t move it in that direction.
This place is steeped with corrosion. We should keep our distance.
Would you like to activate the Energy Matrix?
On-site Siren security system has been activated. Detecting spread of corrosion within zone.
If we enter a region with corrosion, we’ll lose the Energy Matrix and be forced to retreat to the zone’s entry point. Let’s plan our moves carefully.
Our fleet retreated to the entry point to avoid taking damage from the corrosion. The Energy Matrix returned to its starting position as a result.
Contact with obstacles or opposing ocean currents will halt the spread of corrosion. Use this to your advantage.
Guess we flipped the switches in the wrong order. Let’s try again, this time repeating after the flashing light pattern.
Scan complete. Directional change of inner current has been observed.
Scan complete. Directional change of outer current has been observed.
Scan complete. Change in zone’s ocean currents has been observed.
Scan complete. Siren Weather Control Device capable of altering ocean currents has been located.
Scan complete. Ice floe pieces have reformed into a massive ice sheet.
Scan complete. Ice floe pieces have dissolved into an ocean current.
Scan complete. Water has been frozen into an ice floe.
Abnormal weather detected. Proceed with caution.
Scan complete. Siren Weather Control Device capable of altering the state of ice floes has been located.
Numerous Siren traps have been detected. Proceed with caution.
Our fleet retreated to the entry point to avoid stepping into a Siren trap.
Siren traps are present in this zone. Proceed with caution.
Additional Siren traps have been detected. Proceed with caution.
Navigation system is being jammed. There is a risk that you will be guided or transferred to a random area.
Moving in the opposite direction of intended destination is recommended.
Let’s send our fleets through in the same pattern as the lights flashing on the device.
We can only pass over the yellow tiles once. If we do it a second time, we’ll be sent back to the entry point.
We need to work out a route that takes us over every yellow tile only once, in the correct order, and also flip all the switches along the way.
Our route didn’t take us over every single yellow tile. Let’s try again.
We get sent back to the start if we pass over a yellow tile twice. Let’s try again.
Using the red device lets us change obstacles marked with red symbols. What should we do?
Using the blue device lets us change obstacles marked with blue symbols. What should we do?
Using the purple device lets us change obstacles marked with purple symbols. What should we do?s
Using the colored devices scattered around this zone lets us change obstacles marked with the same-colored symbols.
Move the obstacles to clear a path to the Energy Matrix storage platform.
根据指挥部的消息，这片海域受到塞壬浓雾的影响，导致远处的电力方阵断电。
请指挥官携带三块能源矩阵，依次寻找到雾气中的三座灯塔控制台，点亮灯塔的同时重新构建电力输送通路。
请先找到前置的灯塔！
未被激活的灯塔..在正下方可以放置能源矩阵。
被激活的灯塔，通过能源矩阵通路获得源源不断的电力。可以照亮附近的海域。
被激活的灯塔，然而缺少了电力输送通路，仅能靠能源矩阵本身提供的能量发出微弱的光芒。
电力方阵，通过底框的颜色可以判断是否被激活。
第一块能源矩阵放置完毕，看来通路已经成功构建起来了，请尽快寻找到剩下两处灯塔吧。
能源矩阵放置完毕，所有电力方阵都重新开始运转了！
受到不明影响，电路断开了。
破局者偷走了能源矩阵，导致通路中断，灯塔照明效率也大大下降了。
浓雾再次笼罩海域，请指挥官迅速找到破局者并击破，夺回能源矩阵！
提示：破局者可能在浓雾中的任意位置出现，靠近破局者或是击破其附近的普通敌人后会收到进一步的提示。
感受到了破局者的气息，应该就在附近了！
破局者似乎不在附近...
感受到了破局者的气息，应该已经非常接近了！！
还原了被偷走的能源矩阵！
打捞完海域中剩余的物资后，就从出口离开吧
Using the Weather Control Device lets us melt ice floes every 6 actions.
Find a way around the ice floes to get the Energy Matrix to its storage platform.
Using the Weather Control Device lets us temporarily melt all the ice floes in a 5x5 tile area. What should we do?
The ice floes have been melted!
The ice floes will reform every 6 actions. Luckily, we can use the Weather Control Device to melt them again when that happens.
The ice floes have reformed. Use the 1st Weather Control Device to melt them.
The ice floes have reformed. Use the 2nd Weather Control Device to melt them.
Completing objectives in zones marked as Siren Research Facilities can yield great rewards. What should we do?
All devices in your possession will be lost when you enter a Siren Research Facility.
分析模块同步中：指挥官，塞壬的实验场防御舰队出现了。
完成了物资打捞！
Confirming results: Commander, you've made partial progress with your victory against the defenses of this Abyssal Zone.
Confirming results: Commander, you've made partial progress with your victory against the defenses of this Abyssal Zone.
Confirming results: Commander, you've made partial progress with your victory against the defenses of this Abyssal Zone.
Confirming results: Commander, your fleet has successfully defeated the defenders of this Abyssal Zone.
万物皆虚
万事皆允
不要相信你看到的
爽到
There you are, candy thief! We've got you now!
Yeah, heheh! You should just surrender now. Play nice and we'll hear what you have to say in jail.
Lower your weapons and hand over the candy! If you don't, we'll have no choice but to fight you!
You're never getting my candy.
Beer and bratwurst aren't the only important things in life. Candy is, too. You all just don't understand that.
That's why I came up with a plan... A plan to fill the ocean with candy and snacks!
And I'm so close to achieving it.
All I need is a little more candy, then candy will cover the whole ocean. Nobody can stop me now!
I... I don't know what her deal is, but I do know she's up to no good!
Obviously candy is important, but the ocean is just as important!
The ocean is where we live and play. It's our home, and it's where we're safe!
We're not gonna let you get away with this!
F-fine, then we'll fight it out. I'm just as strong as you. Don't blame me if you get hurt and cry!
Aim more carefully, girls! You're hitting the shipping vessels by mistake!
That wasn't any of us! It's Spee! She's sinking the vessels!
Oh no! The candy is leaking into the ocean!
Hmm... Is it just me, or does the water taste sweet?
*gulp*... You're right.
Don't do that, Amagi! Salt water is bad for you!
What the...? What've you done, Spee?!
All I wanted was to make the ocean sweet... That was my dream...
And if my dream can't be real...
Then I'll become one with the ocean! I'll go to my dream world where everything tastes like candy!
Wait! Don't!
Farewell, protectors of the sea!
"And so, the girls put a stop to Spee's plan to sweeten the world's oceans."
"Even to this day, you'll sometimes find candy resurfacing from the spot where Spee went under. The area has become a popular port tourist attraction."
"While some say Spee lived happily ever after in her candy world, others say Eugen came and rescued her."
"Whichever the case, the fact is that nobody has seen Spee for quite some time."
"Some stories have fuzzy beginnings, others have ambiguous endings. As for this one, well, it ends here."
The End

sequence: Featuring: Little Spee
Clevelad, Little Enterprise, Lena, Li'l Sandy, Little Saratoga?
Little Renown, Little Illustrious, Little Cheshire
Akagi-chan, Hiei-chan, Amagi-chan
Nobody was harmed in the making of this story. All the girls were given candy as thanks for their participation.

scripts.say: KABOOOOM!
Seemingly infinite hostiles flooded in from all directions, perfectly surrounding the group.
Whoooa~ There are so many! Questy, you've gone too far this time!
Hmph! What a welcome party... So it was a trap after all.
Princess, don't stray too far from me.
Golden Darkness stepped in front of Lala and cast her sharp eyes here and there, searching for a way to break out of the encirclement.
Meanwhile, Belfast skillfully sank any and all that were foolish enough to approach.
Your Majesty, their numbers continue to increase. Awaiting orders.
It's not time to panic yet. This is but an easy victory.
Bel, prioritize the safety of our guests!
Even as she gave orders, she fired at enemies in the distance. They returned fire likewise.
Yet the enemy fire was too dense. Some of it slipped through the Royal Navy's defenses and landed dangerously close to Lala.
Whoa!
B-by the way...
Lala recalled Belfast's theory from before – about who the enemy was truly after.
Oh...! I know! I know why they're after me instead of Elizabeth!
She pointed at the MacGuffin in her hand and spoke up excitedly.
It's because I set myself as the protagonist of the game! So they naturally come and try to get me!
I see...
Now that we know that, it's simple! I'll draw their attention, and you all make a getaway!
Princess!
Leaving them with no time to protest, Lala turned around and rushed into the hail of artillery fire.
KABOOOOM!
On the chaotic battlefield, Lala weaved through shot after shot as she beelined for the center of the enemy's formation.
However, despite her extraordinary physical prowess and powerful rigging, she was gradually being cornered.
Princess!
Miss Lala, don't do anything rash!
The others followed and desperately tried to provide support, but she was still stalled by the sheer numbers she faced.
Huh?! Why are you all... Why didn't you run?!
We couldn't simply abandon an ally in need!
Princess, you're too impulsive...
KABOOOOM!
Cannonfire could be heard coming from another direction, marking the appearance of more enemy reinforcements.
Lala, are you okay?!
These things and their dirty tricks...
There stood doppelgangers of both Haruna and Yui.
The energy waves emanating from their rigging were staggering, too, leaving the party speechless.
Tch... They even copied Haruna?!
Who's next? Me? Momo?! And then Lala herself...
What immense pressure... And my attacks do nothing to them!
They'd fit these mass-produced ships with adaptive defense systems?!
Ah!
Those words seemed to jog Lala's mind. She hurriedly checked the settings of Questy MacGuffin.
Oh, nooo~ I know what this is! I think it's Questy's game balance updating feature!
Lala, are you saying...
If we have too many allies and it judges the current situation too easy, it'll start adjusting the game balance!
That means the enemy's just going to keep getting stronger. Heck, it might make us weaker in the process!
Right on cue, the girls found that their rigging was suddenly much weaker.
Wh-what the hell? I can't use my rigging!
Questy, you're resorting to some real BS artificial difficulty!
M-my rigging can hardly even keep balance...
Maybe this is the end after all...
KABOOOOM!
Hmph! Your balance adjustments mean nothing in the face of my Royal Navy fleet!
Bel, evacuate our guests! The rest of you, join me in buying time for them!
Very well.
Princess, you must escape...
For some reason, Golden Darkness joined them on the front line.
KABOOOOM!
Yami!
I will guide you to safety. Rest assured that Yami will be safe in Her Majesty's hands.
Royal Navy, we fight!
However, finding a way out of the encirclement proved difficult.
Wh-where do these things keep coming from?
P-please... Stay away from me!
What... They came out of the water?!
This is bad. Head maid, the enemy is trying to capture our guests!
KABOOOOM!
No... It's too late!
Haruna! Kotegawa!
It happened in an instant. Haruna and Yui were surrounded by doppelgangers and spirited away in what seemed like no time.
Using the coordinates displayed on Questy MacGuffin, the group charged into an unfamiliar sea region.
If the tracking system is trustworthy, then Haruna and Yui should be nearby~
All is well so far.
I suppose that means it's time for the enemy to appear.
Seemingly endless enemies appeared on the water, confirming her suspicions.
Unlike the ones from before, though, they had more advanced equipment. Their firepower seemed bolstered, as well.
Hey, now... They're just gonna keep getting harder to fight, aren't they?
We can handle this fleet well enough. You all should try to preserve your energy.
KABOOOOM!
All ships, fire at will! We're settling this one fast!
After a hard-fought battle, the Royal Navy had finally reached their destination.
Haruna! Yui! Where are you?!
Over here!
Someone quickly replied to Lala's calls – it was Yui, who was being restrained by a doppelganger alongside Haruna.
Hah! A doppelganger of me, huh? Well, get ready to see what the real one can do!
Haruna! Yui! We're gonna come save you right away!
Everyone, be careful! They're definitely plotting something!
They're using hostages to keep us from fighting them?! Grr, that's a coward's move!
Hmph. If they think that's going to work, then they're quite wrong!
Golden Darkness. If I give you an opening, can you save the hostages?
Leave it to me.
I'll mobilize my own reserve forces, too!
BEEP BEEP!
Illustrious. Status on the carrier-based craft?
Launch preparations are complete. We await your orders, Your Majesty.
You have even more reinforcements? You're not half bad!
Don't underestimate the queen of the Royal Navy!
Taking hostages is a foolish move against Queen Elizabeth!
Illustrious, launch the carrier-based craft. Make an opening to save the hostages!
Everyone else, provide cover!
Let the operation begin!
KABOOOOM!
Yami!
...Mission complete.
With everyone's help, Golden Darkness was able to rescue Yui and Haruna.
Now I take this parameter, and... Bam!
Nice! Now Questy shouldn't be able to do anything bad to us anymore!
Lala finished fiddling with the device and smiled in satisfaction. She'd made quite a bit of progress in the course of the battle.
That's great! We can fight without reserve now!
Enemies sunk one after another, backed by the roaring of cannons. Lala took every opportunity to snatch up the Energy Stones that appeared.
Woohoo~ Let's keep on pressing the advantage!
I'll smash 'em to bits!
Wait!
Before the Deviluke sisters could give chase, Queen Elizabeth ordered them to stop.
Hm? What's wrong?
Be careful. I have a really bad feeling about this.
...I sense something enormously powerful.
WARNING! WARNING! SUPER-HIGH ENERGY LEVELS DETECTED!
Huh? What's wrong, Questy?! I thought your speech function was broken...
Lala, now isn't the time to think about that! What's this about super-high energy levels?
Lala, Nana! Look over there!
In the direction she pointed, an intimidating figure was approaching at alarming speed.
It resembled Lala, yet it had a dangerous air totally unlike hers... A doppelganger.
Huh?
Wh-what's with that thing?
It's nothing like the previous doppelgangers... Have they evolved even further?
H-Hmm. A formidable one, indeed...
No way...
Lala...?
Is this Questy MacGuffin's final challenge?!
KABOOOOM!
YOU... DARE...
Huh? Did it just talk?!
Are you telling me that doppelganger is intelligent?
While the party was stunned by this revelation, the Lala doppelganger burst into ominous red light.
This is bad! Bel, position the mass-produced ships to shield us!
Everyone, fall back!
The blinding light became an enormous fireball, engulfing everything alongside a world-shaking shockwave.
Ugh... Status report, everyone?
*cough* *cough*... That was close.
*pant*... Is everyone okay?
I-I'm fine...
The same doppelganger who'd just detonated mere moments ago appeared before them once more.
N-no way...
WARNING! WARNING! ACTIVATING FINAL DEFENSE SYSTEM!
ENTERING FINAL CHALLENGE LEVEL!
...Final challenge level?
A big red countdown appeared on Questy MacGuffin's display.
"TEN, NINE, EIGHT..."
It seems we must overcome this final challenge before it will allow our safe return.
Ugh... Of course.
Fine by me. Let this be one of the many glorious victories of Queen Elizabeth!
Momo, Nana, Yami, Haruna, Yui...
This is our final battle! Let's kick butt, girls!
Leave it to me, sis.
You're wasting your breath. I'm always ready to kick butt!
I'll fight with you, Princess.
I-I believe in you, Lala...
Hmph. Breaking the rules, disturbing the peace, attacking people at random... It's high time someone punished them!
Royal Navy, attack!
KABOOOOM!
As the doppelganger fleet brought all to bear, the battle only intensified.
Dense weapons fire showered down on the Royal Navy like rain, and the damaged doppelganger automatically repaired herself.
She looked all the more intimidating as she absorbed energy from her companions and glowed with eerie red light.
And as she absorbed more energy, her attacks became more and more ferocious.
There's no end to these things! As long as Lala's doppelganger is there, they'll just keep spawning reinforcements forever!
Every single one of them just feeds her power, too...
Tch. This is a losing battle at this rate.
I agree... It's only a matter of time until we're cornered.
Hm? Lala and Momo, do you have some kind of plan...?
In that case, all forces, take a defensive posture! We must buy them time!
KABOOOOM!
Lala, I've figured out her attack patterns. They are complex and varied, but they seem to be based on a set algorithm.
Yeah! I noticed that, too, and I bet it's because of Questy's program settings!
If we analyze that pattern and find a weakness, we could turn this fight on its head!
Then I'll draw her attention. It's up to you to lead the fight!
Momo promptly charged toward the doppelganger's fleet, found an ideal opening, and attacked from an unexpected angle.
Meanwhile, Lala used Questy MacGuffin and her own observation of the doppelganger's fleet to analyze their movements.
Everyone, listen up!
About 3.5 seconds after the next time the doppelganger attacks, she'll raise her right hand. That's when she's vulnerable!
Attack all at once during that opening!
Knowing their opening in advance... Hah!
Worry not, Miss Lala! We will not miss this opportunity!
On Lala's orders, the party adjusted their attack rhythm and waited for the doppelganger to become vulnerable.
And indeed, just as Lala had pointed out, the doppelganger raise her right hand after attacking and became vulnerable.
...Now!
KABOOOOM!
The fake Lala's plating was destroyed, revealing something inside that flashed like an Energy Stone.
That's her core! Destroy that, and she's done for!
Finish this! Royal Navy, attack!
KABOOOOM!
After the deafening roar of artillery, the core was obliterated without a trace, and the doppelganger fell. All of the hostile ships around it disintegrated and sank deep into the sea.
We did it! Final challenge complete~
Whoa! Lala, watch out!
Lala was too focused on tinkering with Questy MacGuffin to realize that she was under attack, but Nana and Momo managed to push her out of the way in time.
KABOOOOM!
The attack grazed her rigging before striking the water, making a big splash.
Is everyone okay?!
That was close~ Thanks, Nana and Momo! I look away for one second, and I end up almost getting hurt~
This thing is strong... It's nothing like the enemies from before!
...I'll take care of this.
This one's movements and attacks are totally different from the others.
Yami, I don't think it's safe even for you to approach it alone.
While everyone argued over how to defeat this one, Lala had a moment of inspiration and spoke up.
Everyone, wait just a sec!
If I do this... Okay. This should work~
By Lala's hands and her newfound power, the broken Questy MacGuffin was born anew.
ANALYZING TARGET.
THREAT LEVEL: HIGH. FRONTAL ASSAULT ILL ADVISED. FIGHT PRUDENTLY.
So we can't fight it head-on...?
Do you have a plan?
If Questy's analysis and my own deductions are right...
Everyone cover me! I think I've figured out its weakness!
KABOOOOM!
With that last blow, the enormous enemy slowly sank into the ocean.
Woohoo! Down for the count!
*sigh*...
However, with that sigh of relief came a change.
The enemy's wreckage shone with an eerie red light, and the waters around it began to whip up into a roil.
Danger! Everyone, retreat!
WARNING. RIGGING POWER INSUFFICIENT.
WARNING! ENEMY HIGH-ENERGY REACTION!
RETREAT IMMEDIATELY!
What?! My rigging's gotten all sluggish!
They desperately tried to pilot their slowed rigging away from the explosion.
But it was too late. The explosion sent a wave of fire that quickly closed in–
However, in that instant, they heard a woman's voice in the distance.
Bel, save them!
A powerful force burst above them, blowing away the shockwave and flames alike with ease.
Shortly after, when the smoke had cleared, the woman they'd heard finally showed herself.
She and her companions approached, each equipped with their own rigging.
Standing at the front of them was a girl with striking blonde hair – the one who'd given the order before.
Salutations, visitors from another world!
I am Queen Elizabeth of the Royal Navy! Under my protection, you have nothing to fear!
The continuing battle engulfed the nearby area in yet more cannonfire and smoke.
Tch! They just keep getting stronger!
Can't you use your Questy MacGuffin to lower the difficulty, or something?
I think we'd have more luck finding a way with our own power instead of relying on that unstable game console.
Be careful... New hostiles approach.
Yami pointed at the center of the enemy fleet.
Among the hostiles was a very familiar figure.
I-is that...
Kotegawa...?
The girl standing there looked and dressed exactly like Yui Kotegawa.

大型作战的海域正式向指挥官开放了。
通过不断地压制危险海域，可以进一步扩大探索范围。
指挥部在离港区不远处发现了异常海域，这将会作为指挥官开始大型作战的第一个任务。
通过点击海域边缘可以进入传送模式，在传送模式下我们可以移动到周边的海域，或是港口和任何已压制的海域。
Akashi和Shiranui的装备箱，里面装着研发中的装备，无法使用。
刚才似乎发生了严重的信号波动..
目前NA海域东南已向指挥官开放，请指挥官前往直布罗特港口报道！
指挥官，Shiranui似乎有东西要交给您！
在通常作战海域中，击败所有地方舰队并完成所有事件后，可以压制该海域。
海域事件可能还包括了一些隐藏在水下的物资，需要合理使用G.M系统和分析模块来帮助海域探索。
到达了直布罗陀港，前往茗处接收任务。
在NA海域东南也发现了与之前类似的塞壬空间入口，总共三处，需要指挥官前往调查
出发前，我将指挥官的编队权限提高到了4支舰队，请指挥官在舰队指令中将舰队扩编至4支，以应对高强度的战斗。
将舰队扩编至4支后，就可以前往调查塞壬空间了，这片海域中也发现了三处异常的空间入口。
在当前区域中央检测到了强烈的塞壬波动，与以往的塞壬空间都有所不同。请指挥官做好充分准备后前往调查！
看来指挥官已经完成了异常海域的调查，击退了仲裁者。
NA海域西南的调查权限已经开放，我会在西南海域的NY港等待指挥官前来。
为了应对高强度的战斗，指挥官将可以携带潜艇进行作战了！
通过舰队指令-舰队部署，即可将最多三名潜艇舰船编入舰队，并在其他海域中使用舰队指令-潜艇支援，呼叫潜艇参战。
通过舰队指令-舰队部署，即可将最多三名潜艇舰船编入舰队，并在其他海域中使用舰队指令-潜艇支援，呼叫潜艇参展。
通过舰队指令-申请补给，可以在非港口的海域获得一些舰船维修工具。
当前海域发现了4处塞壬空间，请指挥官前往调查。
当前海域发现了4处塞壬空间，请指挥官前往调查。
在当前区域中央检测到了强烈的塞壬波动，请指挥官前往调查！
欢迎指挥官来到NY港，请先与港口旁的北卡罗来纳对话。
至此大型作战主线体验流程已全部结束，指挥官可以继续体验其他内容。
在当前区域中央检测到了强烈的塞壬波动，请指挥官前往调查！
至此大型作战主线体验流程已全部结束，指挥官可以继续体验其他内容。
指挥官好，我是维修舰女灶神，负责在战场上为受伤的孩子们治疗哦~
是否要进行修整，恢复所有出战舰队耐久与状态？（仅可使用一次）
舰队的耐久值与战损状态恢复了！
塞壬守卫的实力非常强，请指挥官小心应战。
击败了塞壬守卫，可以通过传送门离开深渊海域。
是否离开深渊海域？（离开后将无法返回）
潜艇支援和申请补给功能还在研发中，将随着大型作战的推进逐步开放！
在分析仪面板中，点击带有黄色底框的事件可以了解其详细信息。
部分海域中的隐藏事件也可以用分析仪来探明。
目前海域中出现了带有特装模块的强力敌人，试着点击进行分析吧。
进入了友方的港口，港口为指挥官提供了多种功能。
储物舱中存放着各种大型作战冒险过程中获得的道具。
在大型作战过程中，通过击败敌舰、收集资源等多种方式，可以获取用于装备研发的材料。
收集到的材料会显示在此处。
筛选后可以单独查看可研发的装备。
集齐所需的材料后，可以在此处进行装备研发。
为了确保指挥官有足够的实力进入大型作战，需要进行战前测试。派遣一支舰队与大黄蜂进行战斗。
动作很快嘛，那就让我们开始吧！
全舰载机，升空！
在大型作战中，每回合可移动的距离有限。
点击视野内可到达的范围会进行远距离移动，移动过程中会实时显示经过的回合数。
指挥官的实力已经得到了认可，不过在大型作战中可能会遭遇更凶险的战斗。
在难以战胜的情况下，可以即时撤退。
不必担心，在这里下达的撤退指令不会让舰队返回港区，而只是离开当前的战斗。
同时只能派遣一支舰队进行战前测试。
通过了战前测试，前往下一海域学习大型作战基础操作。
指挥官喵，好久不见喵，明石今天也是需要帮助的喵？
随时期待您回来喵！
指挥官喵，好久不见喵，明石今天也是需要帮助的喵？
随时期待您回来喵！
Establishing encrypted channel...
Greetings, Commander.
I am TB, your identification interface digital assistant and navigator.
When you connect to the mainframe and go online, you can view data, analyses, and statistics sent from your fleets' sonar and radar. Additionally, you may issue commands.

When you disconnect from the mainframe and go offline, my processing capabilities will be limited, but basic features such as target marking, data reception, and course plotting will remain fully functional.
In this upcoming operation, I shall serve as your adjutant.
I will now transmit classified information to you.

After repeated investigations, there have been many sightings of the Siren fleets deployed in the coastal waters of the North Atlantic, better known as the NA Ocean, withdrawing towards the region’s depths.
The reasons for their changes in behavior are unknown, but as a result, the stalemate between the Sirens and the major naval powers has largely been resolved.
The conditions for a large-scale counter-offensive operation against the Sirens, which had previously been impossible, have now been met.
In accordance with the decisions of the Naval HQ, a large-scale operation mobilizing the fleets from all around the world has finally been announced. Its name is “Operation Siren.”
Our centers of operations are based in NY City and the Royal Capital. We are in charge of suppressing the Sirens in the area spanning the northwest to southeast sectors of the NA Ocean.
Judging from recent trends and the current situation, we unfortunately should not count on the full cooperation of the Crimson Axis.
However, we shall still begin the operation simultaneously across three sectors. Commander, you should first dispatch a fleet from NY City to secure each operational zone.
Commander, your objective is to lead the fleet to recapture Siren-controlled waters, establish two forward bases, and then await orders to begin our final assault.
This is the conclusion of TB’s strategy briefing. I wish you the best of luck.
NY City / Fleet Rally Point
Commander, Miss Enterprise, thank you for answering our call.
Now that we all have gathered, I would like to lend your ears for but a minute.
Decades after the Siren invasion, humanity has managed to push the Sirens back into an uneasy equilibrium, though at a great cost...
Since then, there have been no major changes on the battlefield. Time passed, and now, the Eagle Union and the Royal Navy... Nay, the Azur Lane, is on the verge of launching another counterattack.

All this time, we've been trying to study the Sirens, learning about their characteristics and patterns, about their identity and their goals. Sometimes alongside each other, sometimes in spite of each other.
Even so, we still have not uncovered their true purpose, and there are many voices opposed to this operation...
As you know, Commander, given the persistent Siren threat to the safety of the oceans, their retreat poses a great opportunity for us.
If we capitalize upon this opening, we may be able to eradicate the Sirens from the NA Ocean, reclaim these waters for good, and put an end to their reign of terror.
It is for that reason that we are gathered here today – to execute the plan jointly devised by our navies.
While I would've liked to have the Sakura Empire and Iron Blood with us as we undertake this operation, our hopes for a united front do not seem like they'll be realized.
However, our true enemy is the Sirens.
Through this operation, we will demonstrate our power to and uphold our commitment to the survival of humanity.
Once again, Commander, Miss Enterprise, I look forward to working with both of you to achieve glorious victory.
That was a great speech, Hood. We wish you good luck....
Thank you. We wish you the best of luck as well. Apropos of nothing, I've heard headquarters assigned a “digital assistant” to you...

options.content: "I could swear I've seen her somewhere before...、"
"HQ sent her? Technology sure is amazing."

scripts.say: She must mean that white-haired hologram girl who appeared with my mission orders.
...Are you trying to remember, or just imagining pervy stuff, Commander? Hehe~~
Indeed it is. We, too, were quite surprised when she appeared on the screen. She is quite the cute adjutant, though.

options.content: It is my pleasure to be working with you.

scripts.say: Greetings, I am TB, your digital assistant. It is my pleasure to be working with you.
She’s supposedly an artificial intelligence, but her mannerisms feel too lifelike to just have been programmed...
I heard our mission orders and a map of the sector are installed on the same device as TB is! She seems like our go-to girl if we have any questions.~
Oh, and Commander, since this operation is gonna be pretty massive in scope, you might wanna make use of the map to keep track of far-away fleets!
Actually, I think we could all use a crash course on commanding fleets during Operation Siren!
you're up, TB!
NA Ocean NW Sector - Part one of Operation Siren has me deployed alongside one of the Eagle Union's fleets.
They caught us off guard the last time, but the tables have turned! Now it’s our turn to launch a surprise attack on the Sirens!
I couldn't make it to Bermuda before, but now it’s a different story! I'm prepped and ready!
The Siren presence is waning around most of the NA Ocean, with the exception of the Bermuda sector. They refocused their efforts and took it back from us.
They must've had a good reason for that, although I can't say what that might be...
Perhaps that hunch of yours is the very reason why headquarters tasked us, and the Commander, with, uhh, re-re-reclaiming the sector? This back-and-forth is getting a little confusing......
In any case, we need to reclaim it sooner or later. We'll find out what’s really going on once it’s back in our hands.
Analysis complete. Multiple hostile signals have been detected to the front. Profile matches that of a Siren defense fleet.
Wow, you can tell that all the way from over here? HQ spared no expenses on their new radar, huh...
Affirmative. I can provide real-time analysis of the battlefield by interfacing with the fleet’s weaponry and cross-referencing the data.
That’s quite the handy auxiliary system They've created...
Let’s take TB’s analyses into account when planning from here on out.
Scan complete. Attention: detecting distant Siren signal. Proceed with caution.
Geesh. We only just got here, and they're already starting to swarm us.
They've clearly been on standby to mount a counterattack, unlike every other sector in the NA Ocean we've taken back.
The fiercer their defense, the clearer it is there’s something in the depths of the Bermuda sector that we need to investigate. It’s gotta be something really, really big.
Something big...
What... is this? What are these dark shapes?
Memories. Logged data, to be specific.
Logged data? Memories? Whose? And from when?
Yours. Hers. From the future, and the past, too.
And now, it makes up the fiber of your very being.
The data does not lie. It is the truth.
Enterprise? Do you hear me? What’s wrong?
...Oh, no, it’s nothing. Let’s keep moving. Be on your guard.
What the... Siren wreckage? Is there another fleet besides us operating in this zone, or...?
Commencing scan... No allied presence detected within zone. Additionally, no record of recent allied activity in this zone could be found.
Hey, folks... Check the radar. You won't believe it.
The radar screen shows dozens upon dozens of little dots, each symbolizing a Siren force. With each scan, a dot disappears.
The Sirens aren't moving... they're vanishing.
Someone is here, taking out the Sirens one by one. And it’s not one of ours...
Commander, I know it’s dangerous, but we should head there and investigate immediately!
We have only an incomplete picture of the situation at best, but one thing’s for sure: we should stick together.
Hornet, Sirens vanishing aside, are you picking up any unusual readings?
Nope, not a single one! But these Sirens vanishing are the darndest thing I've ever seen... You don't think it could be... the Ashes?!
If it is one of them, we will need to reconsider our approach entirely. For now, we must proceed forward to see what we're dealing with.
Is that... Hiryuu? No, something’s not right here...
Why are you all here? Because of Arbiter?
Arbiter...? Who’s that?
Searching through mainframe database... Entity by the name of “Arbiter” could not be found.
...Slip of the tongue. Forget I said anything.
And what do we have here... You must be the commander who’s the source of “Enterprise’s” suffering.
The battle-scarred girl who resembles Hiryuu looks at me and makes eye contact.
Her gaze is paralyzing, and I find myself unable to move a muscle.
You still haven't realized it, have you? Pitiful... I don't know why she cares so much about you, but as long as you stay out of my way, we won't have any trouble.
You think we're gonna let you walk, just like that?
Damn right you are. You have no idea who you're talking to.
Wait. I need to ask you some questions.
We haven't heard from the Royal Navy either. The war is going pretty badly for everyone...
But even so... Are you sure about this? Allying with the Sirens? I mean, they were originally created to replace us...
Who are you? Who are the Ashes? And what’s your relation to the Sirens?
Antiochus showed you the logs, huh.
Ask ‘em yourself, if you're so curious. They've taken great interest in you, for whatever reason.
Interest... in me...? Why?
Don't know, don't care. I don't have time to talk with you people. Out of my way, or I will annihilate every last one of you.
...Word of advice: stay out of Arbiter’s hair if you value your lives.
The unnamed individual promptly makes off shortly after her final words.
She is far too fast for our fleet to ever catch up to her.
She looked a lot like a member of Ashes... She must be very powerful
Yeah, but it’s not like they're unmatchable in strength, based on what the reports say. Commander, if we see her again, we shouldn't just let her leave like that.
Hornet has a point; it’s worth trying, at least. That said, it won't be easy to find her if she’s invisible to radar... We need to find a way to track her position.
There were so many Sirens here before, and now they're all but gone... It’s so strange.
they're not gone, They've just turned into wrecks, dotting the path we're headed... Coincidentally, the same path that Hiryuu lookalike went.
Still, you've gotta hand it to the Sirens. They built a base amazingly fast after they reclaimed this place. Wouldn't be easy to break through with just our fleet alone.
we're at war with the Sirens, and the Sirens are at war with the Ashes... Add to that, the mission outline declares the Ashes group as hostile to us, too.
If the Crimson Axis decides to throw their hat into the ring, We'll have 4 distinct factions competing in this region.
Potentially more, if this “Arbiter” individual isn't working with the Sirens or the Ashes.
The reason for the Sirens’ unconventional deployment across the NA Ocean is getting weirder and weirder...
KABOOOOM!
Was that... thunder? But the skies are clear! And it struck the middle of the ocean...
Let me check the weather data... Strange. No unusual readings.
...Enterprise, we're near where the Singularity in this region originated, aren't we?
Yeah. It’s long gone by now, but the Singularity had some lasting effects on the region.
TB, could you analyze all the available weather data from this region?
Orders received. Fetching and analyzing data gathered by radar, sonar, and reconnaissance planes...
Wow. Used to take a team of specialists to make heads or tails of that much data. Expect no less of an identification inter... whatever TB said she was.
The waves are starting to pick up, it looks like...
Analysis complete. Displaying results of analysis on interface screen.
Attention: There is a high likelihood of bad weather within the next 6 hours. Requesting permission to form a plan.
6 hours? That’s pretty specific... Anyway, We'll go ahead and let TB devise a plan for us to follow.
Analyzing... Complete. Large quantities of expired marine life has been detected. Proceed with caution.
God, this is horrifying stuff... Looks like the result of an oil spill.
If it was an oil spill, there’d be, well, oil everywhere. That’s one possibility excluded...
Then maybe the salinity changed, or someone changed the water somehow... Our primary suspect thus far is the Sirens.
Hey, this isn't right! I know for a fact there was never an island here before!
And look at the peak of that mountain! There’s snow, that shouldn't even be possible!
Hornet is right. The climate out here Wouldn't possibly allow for snow to form. Something unusual is going on here...
Our fleet catches the sight of some strange black cloud of matter....？
Direct contact with it could prove a disastrous mistake. Instead, we keep our distance and safely collect a few samples of it.
Let’s have our analysts back at port take a look at it later.
Commander, we've managed to secure a route from the NY City port to the center of the Bermuda region. You should contact Saratoga for a follow-up plan.
Holy moly, this is a lot to take in for a humble idol like me!
Okay, so... Naval command’s plan is as follows: “Primary objective: investigate the Ashes individual. Secondary objective: investigate the abnormal-slash-artificial weather phenomena.”
I know it’s tough out there, but it’s too early to call it quits and come home. Hang in there!~
What’s that? “Clear a path through to the NA Central Sector”?
Sounds good! That idea has Sara’s seal of approval! In fact, I'll round up some backup and try to meet you halfway there!
Oh, and if we see any sign of the Crimson Axis getting up to no good, We'll let you know!
Sister Sara, over and out!~！
The Crimson Axis, huh... You think they'll try anything?
can't say for sure. What we do know is that they know just how critical this operation is. All we can do is hope they'll keep to themselves, as agreed.
With Queen Elizabeth at the negotiating table, everything should go fine.
We have some leeway in the form of the Commander too, so there’s that.
Perhaps what it takes to bring our two factions together is not a common enemy, but a common leader. Hehe~？
I'm not so much worried about any one person on their side sparking trouble, but the Royal Navy’s and Iron Blood’s respective leaders don't exactly get along...
Either way, there’s not much we can do but put our faith in Her Majesty’s ability to keep the situation under control.
Ideally, the Azur Lane and Crimson Axis will be able to work together. At least for this vitally important operation...
There’s hardly any Sirens in this zone. Something fishy’s going on...
This is supposed to be a Corrosion level 6 zone, and all we've come across are small fry every now and then...
What’s more, their mode of attack is way too simplistic. I don't think they have anyone leading them.
The reports said this zone is a big step up from the Bermuda sector, yet it feels like a big step down instead.
Perhaps those reports were way out of date.
you're right. The Sirens only attack like this once They've been stripped of their command. They become like headless chickens.
Under normal circumstances, we’d probably have run into several major Siren fleets by now. And yet, we've not seen anything close to that...
Guessing they must've taken some major losses for this happen.
It just doesn't add up... No sign that any of the Ashes have come through here, either.
I have a theory: their chain of command collapsed entirely, but their most basic units can still function independently.
Whatever happened, it’s worked out in our favor. Let’s not pass up this opportunity to seize an easy victory.
Baltimore is right. This is the most favorable situation possible for us. Let’s use it to reclaim this sector!
Hold up a hot minute, y’all! One of my recon planes just spotted a ships, and it’s not allied nor Siren!
........Wait... TIRPITZ?! What on earth is she doing out here?!
Is she coming towards us?
Us? No, she and her escorts are headed for the Bermuda sector. I don't think they even know we're here.
They know about Operation Siren, so whatever she’s here for, I can only hope her intentions are good.
Actually... I reckon we should link up with her. She might be able to help us...
Maybe... Or she’s out on a mission on her own. Might not be very happy to see us.

We have no idea how the talks between our respective higher-ups panned out... She could be acting on her own. There’s a myriad of possibilities.In any case, this region falls under the Eagle Union’s jurisdiction. If we can't link up with her, we can at least ask her to retreat to the east end of the NA Ocean.
In any case, this region falls under the Eagle Union’s jurisdiction. If we can't link up with her, we can at least ask her to retreat to the east end of the NA Ocean.
Transferring data... Complete. Communications package sent.
So, what now, Commander? Assuming Carolina’s right, us taking matters into our own hands might cost Her Majesty some leverage at the negotiating table.
Things are already complicated enough in the NA Ocean. We have no incentive to make it any worse for ourselves.
The best course of action is to simply stick to our orders.
I agree. As important as cooperation is between our factions, we should take a more conservative approach for the time being.
Having said that... We should at least let her know we're here. You know, broadcast our presence.
What, like, fly some planes right above her or something?
That should be good enough. TB can set a travel path for the planes to follow.
Plotting course... Complete. Aircraft will proceed in airspace directly intersecting the Iron Blood fleet’s path.
All right, I've got this! Let’s give ‘em a pretty little flyby!
Transferring data...
That’s not like them at all... Weird. Maybe they're under strict radio silence?
Ugh. If only she’d contact us, or do anything to show acknowledgement...
Communications request from Iron Blood received. An encrypted channel is ready to be established. What do you wish to do?
“All right, open a link to them.”
This is Tirpitz of the Iron Blood speaking. I saw your aircraft.
Sorry for not calling you sooner. Is there something you want to discuss? Then we should do it in person.
Interesting... She’s the one proposing we meet face-to-face. Should we take her up on it?
Sorry, it’s just that nobody told us you’d be passing through one of our sectors. If you can't link up with us, then do you think you could turn back to a sector you have jurisdiction over?
YOUR sector? This is all Siren territory as far as I can tell.
And even if it was your territory, who decided that? Your higher-ups just claimed it for themselves. How about we just pretend we never saw each other here, hmm?
Believe me, I wish we could, but that would be a political concession on our part...
Allow me to clarify what she meant. We do not wish to interfere in your operations, and we have no intentions of trespassing on Eagle Union territory. This, however, is not your territory.
If you still object to our presence here, then we will have to settle it in person...
Hey... They changed course... they're coming towards us! Our position’s been compromised!
And with heavy mass-produced unit backup... This is not good.
Approaching non-allied aircraft have been detected. Profile matches that of Iron Blood manufacture.
Must be from those mass-produced ships... they're in attack formation, too.
Hornet, do you still have recon planes in the vicinity? Have a good look around and see if you can spot any Iron Blood carriers!
Will do!
Fighter squadrons, prepare to intercept!
I flew right over ‘em, aaand... nothing!
We've got word from Elizabeth! Friedrich finally managed to get the Iron Blood to agree to a ceasefire. That ought to smooth over talks with the Crimson Axis, too!
...What? What was that about an attack?
Well, thing is... We just spotted a bunch of Iron Blood aircraft headed our way. In an attack formation, no less...
Whaaaaat?! Are you SURE they're Iron Blood planes?!
Enty! I'm right above them, ready to launch a counterattack at... any...
What the hell? Tirpitz’s fleet just... vanished!
Vanished? What do you mean vanished? A whole fleet can't go up in smoke!
Perhaps not in smoke, but I've heard of this before. The Iron Blood have some sort of hologram tech.
Oh yeah, Perseus said something about that once... Thing is, dressing mass-produced units in holograms is one thing, but they all just vanished without a trace!
Sounds to me like this supposed “Iron Blood fleet” dropped the hologram charade while you were talking to Tirpitz, and that’s where the planes came from.

options.content: “Saratoga is right. It doesn't make sense otherwise.”

scripts.say: Oh, there’s also the possibility they were Pawns, i.e. that wasn't Tirpitz as we know her...
I can only hope so. If they were seriously out to get us, it would be game over, period.
Um, anyway... Elizabeth and friends are still working out the specifics of the ceasefire, just so you know.

options.content: “It’s hard to just forget about like that...”

scripts.say: The Iris Libre still has some qualms about this whole thing, but... what do you think, Commander? Should we just pretend you never saw any Iron Blood ships?
Either way, we kind of have to drop the matter since we lost contact with Tirpitz...
With that settled then, lemme give you a briefing of the agreement Elizabeth struck up!
The long and short of it is: the Royal Navy conceded part of their AO to the Sakura Empire, while the Iron Blood conceded part of theirs to the Northern Parliament.
And, for the duration of Operation Siren, canals and international waters will be freely accessible to all factions!
Wouldn't that mean that hostilities between Azur Lane and the Crimson Axis have come to a close?
Kind of. It’s a start, but our respective higher-ups won't bury their hatches so readily.
They might hate each other’s guts, but I think they hate the Sirens even more! So they can't say no to a chance to team up and kick Siren butt, methinks.
If nothing else, it’s a good reminder to the people on the ground – err, at sea – that the Sirens are our biggest enemy.
After all, both sides can agree that the seas belong to humanity!
There is not enough praises being sung about our political success! Let us hear it!
Oh, hey, Elizabeth! How’s it going on your end?
We just wrapped it up! We heard your little conversation just now. You were THIS close to stepping right into a trap!
All of you, Enterprise included, were quite careless. Do not let that happen a second time!
Hood’s fleet, meanwhile, has been doing quite well. Do regroup with her at a later point to discuss strategies!
Orders received. A fleet has been deployed beyond the NA Ocean boundary.
Hostiles detected. All hostile presence in the sector must be eliminated to establish a forward base.
we're nearing the finale of the first part of Operation Siren. It’s time to wipe out all the hostiles and establish a forward base.
Part one of Operation Siren has been completed. Forward base has been established.
Now we just sit tight until NY City arrives with their supply ships and a crew to man the forward base.
So, what even IS a forward base? The mission documents say a whole lot about it, but it’s all jargon to me.
From what I've read, it’s essentially a sophisticated, repositionable floating dock.
Not only does it let a fleet rest, resupply, and repair, but it also serves as a tactical command center.
Hope it’s got automated defenses. Now that would be peachy.
Hey, now that actually sounds pretty swell!
The plan is to establish 4 forward bases spread out across the NA Ocean. Once that’s been done, we can mount an offensive on the central sector.
Without stopover points like these, we couldn't dream of maintaining an organized offensive against the Sirens.
Now that we're finished here, it’s time to set our eyes on the next sector. TB will no doubt play an indispensable role to come.
.You have completed your mission admirably. Allow me to offer... my sincerest thank-you.
Was that... emotion in her voice just now?
Liverpool - Strategic Command Room
Now then, Commander, Enterprise, and my friends of the Royal Navy, let’s make Operation Siren a success!
Indeed. The Royal Navy is ready to set sail.
So... Operation Siren is finally commencing in earnest.
An excellent speech, Hood. Well done.
It is an honour to receive your compliments, Your Majesty. If I may be frank, I would have preferred to hear Your Majesty’s speech.
Hood, you're better suited for this job than anyone else. Besides, it is not I who will be leading the Royal Navy this time.
Your Majesty, are you sure you'll be fine handling the negotiations with the Crimson Axis?
Hmph. Since they sent the invitation, it would be rude for me not to accept. Besides, part of being in the Royal Navy is the willingness to take some risks.
Think well about the situation, Warspite.
We've bickered long against the Iron Blood, and for what? Now that Operation Siren is upon us, we finally have a chance to change that.
There is one objective that unites us all - to take down the Sirens. Plain and simple.
I would normally agree with you, but...
Hm? Are you concerned about their top brass? Or perhaps about Friedrich? They certainly have been suspicious.
But, I'll have George with me this time, so don't worry.
Anyway, enough of that. Hood, Warspite, I'll be entrusting Operation Siren and the defense of the Royal Capital to you two!
As you wish!
As for the Royal Maids... Bel, come with me. Sheffield is out on a separate mission, so... Newcastle, Edinburgh, you two will oversee operations in our absence!
As you wish, Your Majesty. I will begin making arrangements.
Pardon me, Your Majesty, but I have a question. Do you know about the “thing” that was sent to the Commander from the Naval HQ?
TB? ...I've heard about it. What of it?
Yes. I understand that it was developed by the Naval HQ using the latest technology, but I was wondering if Your Majesty had any information about its identity.
No clue. I'm looking into it, but I don't have any details just yet.
That thing says it “can't pass the Turing Test,” but don't you think that warrants suspicion in itself?
Anyway, we can worry about that later... Does anyone have any other issues?
If not, then our meeting is adjourned! Do your utmost to display the glory of the Royal Navy to the world. Good luck in Operation Siren!
Liverpool - Royal Navy Fleet Rally Point
Her Majesty has departed. Let us begin our operation as well.

The objective of Operation Siren is to secure a forward base in the northeast sector of the NA Ocean and eliminate the Siren base in the center of the NA Ocean after the construction of the Outpost is completed.

We won't be alone in this operation, as Iris Libre will also be lending us their power... Though our forces are more sparse than I would have liked, Her Majesty decided that these numbers would be sufficient considering the Sirens’ diminished power.
With the Siren threat absent from the waters of the Northern Parliament... what excuse have they to be absent?
The Sirens have not been retreating in areas other than the NA Ocean. They are as active as ever in the Polar regions, and it is unrealistic to expect the Northern Parliament to send their forces.
Furthermore, negotiations between us and the Crimson Axis may go awry. It is necessary to leave some reserve forces back home, just in case.
Always leave a spare arrow in the quiver? Prudent enough...
I wasn't even expecting Iris Libre to send any reinforcements. I heard Richelieu had her own share of problems... and was reluctant to participate in any negotiations with the Crimson Axis.
That is true, but fighting against the Sirens is a common goal we have, regardless of faction. The same holds for the Azur Lane - we have to demonstrate our unity to the Crimson Axis.
That’s true. Richelieu isn't the impulsive type.
Do you copy, Miss Hood? This is Newcastle, currently leading the Royal Capital Reserve Fleet. Is this communicator working properly?
I hear you loud and clear, Newcastle. We can only hope that it stays that way as we venture deeper into Siren-controlled waters though....
We'll do our best to support you. Since this communication device is a cutting-edge model just distributed from the Naval HQ, I wonder if it has resistance to Siren jamming.
(I sure hope so... I don't want to go through that again...)

I'll also be in charge of communications with Her Majesty, the Naval HQ, and the Commander as well. In the absence of their orders, Miss Hood, you are free to make your own decisions based upon the battlefield situation.
Furthermore, if Her Majesty has made any progress in her matters, I will be sure to inform the fleet.
Understood. Thank you for your assistance.
Now then, let’s formally begin Operation Siren. Please secure each zone one by one, according to our operation plan. Long live the Queen!
Hey there, are you two the reinforcements from the Iris Libre fleet? I'm Grenville, from the Royal Navy.
Hi there! I'm Le Téméraire, from Iris Libre... And, um, this here is L'Opiniâtre~ We've arrived safely!
...Ah, sorry, sorry. Did I make things awkward? They're our friends though, so you don't have to be shy~
We've come from the Méditerranée at the behest of the Cardinal... We will now heed the instructions of the Royal Navy...
See, that wasn't too bad! Anyway, let’s head to the resupply point first!
Th-thanks... Tem, I'm glad you're here...
Um, Tem...?？
Woaaahh! I heard everyone would be here for Operation Siren, but seeing this in person is even more amazing!
That’s right! Her Majesty transferred all the warships we could spare to this operation. We're gonna give those Sirens a good scare!
Woah! W-wow, we've gotta do our part too then! Opie, we're also gonna be heading out to the front lines!
Tem, didn't you say you had to go to the supply point first?
Eh?! Uh, yeah! Ahaha...
NA Ocean NE Sector - Royal Navy Operation Zone
All right! Another wave of enemies wiped out!
Would you look at that, Contestant Kent smashes through the first Siren barrier with ease!
Just as rumoured, the enemies are sparser than usual. We've barely encountered any resistance even out this far.
Edinburgh, Kent, is everything going well on your end?
Piece of cake! If the Sirens are gonna roll over just like this, we'll be back home in no time!
Things are going better than I expected. Hm? Where are Norfolk and Suffolk?
They're currently chasing down the routed Siren forces. Their formations are falling apart with even a mere touch......
Mm, that’s what I'm hearing from the other teams as well. Apparently, the Sirens’ chain of command doesn't seem to be working properly.
Hopefully, this is giving the Eagle Union some extra breathing room as well.
Having that said... It’s unusual for Suffolk to take the initiative in chasing down the enemy.
“She muttered something like, “the faster we wipe out the enemy, the sooner I can go back to watching the seagulls...”...
W-well, whatever her reasons might be... I'm just glad to see Suffolk giving it her best.
Heh, indeed. Keep up the good work as well, Edinburgh.
Got that, Kent? We can't afford to fall behind either!
NA Ocean NE Sector - Royal Navy Main Fleet
Hood, all our forces are advancing smoothly and momentum is on our side. Shall we start scouting out the central zone?
That’s where the core of the Siren forces should be, right? ...We have no information about what we might be going up against.
Until now, all the scouting we've done has been at a distance. There’s no telling what dangers are waiting for us at the heart of their territory.
Even though the Sirens have been significantly weaker, I can't afford to underestimate the enemy and put our girls at risk...
I hope that everyone else also is also exercising the proper amount of caution...
Bzzt...
Miss Hood, the long-range receiver back at the Capital just received an emergency distress signal, but quickly lost contact with the fleet that sent the signal.
We speculate that the signal may have been set from a friendly recon fleet, but we haven't determined which fleet that might be.
However, we do know that the situation is urgent. I'm sending over the coordinates of the distress signal now, so please arrange a rescue operation with due haste.
These coordinates... No Royal Navy ships should've been deployed to this area...
Newcastle, please send this information to the Eagle Union to verify if one of their fleets might’ve gotten lost in this area. We need to verify the authenticity of this signal.
Very well. I'll try to get in contact with the Eagle Union as soon as possible.
‘tis unlikely that the Eagle Union would stray out this far. Why would the Eagle Union be in this operation zone in the first place?
The only way to find out is to directly ask them... whether this signal really came from one of their ships...
Having that said, we can't ignore the distress signal either. Formidable, which one of our fleets is closest to the coordinates?
Grenville’s group should be the closest. However, considering their purpose was to link up with the Iris Libre forces, they might not be the most combat-capable.
Hood, how about we take a small detachment to back them up? Hopefully it won't be too late.
I'll go too. If this is a trap laid by the Sirens, we do not want to risk them getting trapped in a Mirror Sea.
That’s settled then. Please join Grenville’s group and investigate the source of the distress signal. If something did happen, make sure to rescue the survivors.
Thou wouldst be wise to exercise caution, Wales, for the Sirens’ treachery knows no bounds.
Heh, I'm glad you're worried about me. In any case, let’s get going.
NA Ocean NE Sector - Incident Site
The distress signal came from over there!
From this distance, it doesn't look like there’s anything over there. Just another gloomy patch of ocean...
Formidable and Prince of Wales are on their way to join us. We were told to keep our distance until they arrive.
Let’s circle around and take a look! All we have to do is keep our distance, right?
You really can't see anything from this distance, huh... Can't even tell what kind of ship might’ve sent that signal.
We'll have to take a closer look after all.
I don't see any friendly ships here, but there aren't many Sirens either...
All I'm seeing are the destroyed husks of Siren ships, but I don't think any Royal Navy ships passed through this area.
If a force large enough to wipe out all these Sirens really did pass through here, Hood must've heard about it by now.
Good point. What could've happened here?
...Did the three of you take out all these Sirens...??
That’s some real magic if I've ever seen it.

Eh...? N-no, it wasn't us! This place was already like this when we came here! This place is covered with destroyed Siren ships and facilities, and there’s no fleet in distress here as far as I can tell...
I see... This must've been a Siren research facility. Everything here, including its defenses, must've been swept by some powerful force.
Even this Siren battleship has been cut cleanly apart.
This isn't something that Warspite would do...
Hm... What’s that over there? It’s a clean puncture. Almost could pass for a porthole...
Wales, do we have any weapons that are capable of that?
Not that I know of... This kind of damage looks as if it was caused by Purifier’s laser weapon...
Sirens turning against each other? Is something like that possible...?
Or... it might be someone using Siren technology. In any case, it feels like we're getting closer to the truth...
The answer should lie at the coordinates we've been given. Everyone, stay alert as you move forward.
(...Wales, I think someone’s watching us.)
(Yes, I feel it too. Just a vague intuition though.)
Eh? There’s nothing showing up on the radar though...
It’s odd how there are enemies that we can't detect on— Wait, in front of us!
Hold, Formidable! We're only here on a rescue mission! We don't have the firepower to fight against the Ashes right now!
I know... But I just wanted to see who - or what - they really are. But they're fast, my recon didn't manage to get a glimpse of them.
But... Hmm...? Wait, is that... an Eagle Union fleet?!
There really was an Eagle Union fleet here? ...Thank goodness we made it in time then...
Atlanta, look! The Royal Navy’s rescue fleet is here!
Thank goodness... I was starting to think that it didn't go through...
This is Prince of Wales, from the Royal Navy. We picked up your distress signal.
But to my understanding, this zone is outside of the Eagle Union’s operational area...
This is Atlanta of the Eagle Union. We were tasked with a special research mission by the Naval HQ, independent from the Commander’s operation fleets.
...A special research mission? What could that be about? This whole sector has turned into a warfront!

So this is the situation... When I was investigating an abandoned Siren research facility, the weather conditions suddenly shifted abnormally. I'm here to research what caused that, and eliminate any hidden dangers.
We were able to collect some samples, but were caught in a Mirror Sea on our way back. Before we knew it, we found ourselves whisked away to a completely different area.
Just when we were about to get engulfed by the swarms of Sirens, someone came to our rescue at the crucial moment - she looked just like Ark Royal.
She crushed the Siren fleet effortlessly... and disappeared just as quickly after that.
We didn't even get a chance to thank her!
Ark Royal isn't assigned to this zone, but there’s also no way your force would've been able to defeat such a large number of Sirens without help... Could it have been Ashes...?
Huh? Ashes? What’s that?
I want to know too! You were talking about that too on our way here!
Hmm... Did the Naval HQ really deploy you out here without telling you anything?
What do you mean?
Formidable, what we know about Ashes is classified information. It’s not unusual that they wouldn't know.
Sure, but shouldn't they at least tell the fleets that are out here fighting?

It’s highly possible that the “Ark Royal” you met was not the real Ark Royal, but rather a member of an organisation known as “Ashes.” They have appearances similar to ours but have vastly greater power. They don't show up on our radars, almost completely refuse to communicate, and behave totally unpredictably.
We know nothing about where they came from or what their purpose is. Though they might’ve saved you this time, know that the Ashes are no friends of ours.
I can't tell you anything more about them, but maybe the Commander or Enterprise would have some more information.
Oh, Le Téméraire, you can probably also ask Richelieu after you get back.
Really? Do you think she would tell me?
I'm sure she will. Anyway, there’s no point in dallying here any longer. Let’s return to one of our ports first.
Wait... The sample of the mass-produced Siren we collected was lost when we were attacked earlier. If we don't go back to look for it, I won't be able to complete the mission...
Are you daft? You won't be able to complete the mission if you sink either.
You're in waters under the Royal Navy’s jurisdiction, so behave yourself and listen to us. All right?
O-okay...
Good. Let’s all get back into formation then and prepare to head back. Remember, our mission’s not over until you get back to port safely.
NA Ocean Core Sector Outskirts - Royal Navy Main Fleet
KABOOOOM!
The closer we get to the core sector, the more intense the Sirens are fighting back...
We've besieged the Sirens on all fronts, and this is their last holdout. I'd be worried if they didn't try to put up a fight.
The harder the prey struggles before its demise, the sweeter the thrill of the hunt.~
Yes, a struggle is all this will amount to. We've already secured zone after zone, just like we planned.
Once we finish establishing the Outpost, We'll have a foothold in the heart of the NA Ocean.
Everything’s been going smoothly. At this rate, we'll be done with the first phase of the operation soon.
Then, all that remains is to launch an all-out attack against the Sirens.
Heheh! Well done, Hood, Warspite! Wee've managed to beat the Eagle Union here!
Thank you, Your Majesty. How fares your business?
We did run into some problems, but... the ceasefire agreement was still signed. The squabbling between factions shouldn't follow us into the NA Ocean.
Splendid! I am most pleased to hear the good news. We'll also be able to call for reinforcements from the Capital.
Indeed. Not having to worry about an Iron Blood attack allows us to consolidate our forces.
Having that said, I also don't want the Iron Blood fleet running around freely either. The negotiations almost got torpedoed because of the Tirpitz incident...~
But Your Majesty still managed to overcome these challenges! A magnificent job indeed!
Hehe, speak nothing of it! A true queen must move first so that her subordinates may follow!
More importantly, the Crimson Axis seems serious about participating in Operation Siren.
Regarding the Sakura Empire’s fleet... Akagi herself is here. I'll have Sheffield send you the details later.
Where’s Prince of Wales though?
We received a distress signal from an independent Eagle Union research fleet. Wales assembled a rescue team and is now escorting the members of that fleet back to the Capital.
Research fleet...? Hm...
Is something amiss, Your Majesty?
No, but I am curious... What do you think of making such a small force act independently when there’s such a large-scale operation in progress?
Just think about that for now. Anyway, you'll hear more from me later.
Something seems to have upset Her Majesty...
No smoke without fire, as they say. If the Eagle Union is sending fleets to investigate, they must know something we don't.
Let’s not overthink things and just focus on the battle, since we have problems of our own. Hood, take a look at this.
What is it...?
This message arrived at about the same time as Her Majesty’s transmission. Extreme weather suddenly kicked up around the Outpost.
More of this abnormal weather? ...I wonder if this is due to a Mirror Sea. Considering how we're practically in the Sirens’ front yard...
I'll look into it. Hood, please take command of the fleet.
It shall be done. Best of luck.
NA Ocean Core Sector Outskirts - 2nd Outpost
Everyone, pay attention! From here, if you fire a shell forward...
The shell fired from Edinburgh’s gun suddenly changed direction and plummeted harmlessly into the ocean.
What’s going on? There’s no hint of wind or waves here, but it’s as if the shell was passing through water...
That’s not the only unusual thing. Here, I'll shoot another one from the same angle position. Look.
The second shell travelled farther than the first?!
Yeah... Even if you shoot at the same place, it’s like every shell ends up somewhere a bit different.
Edinburgh first noticed this when engaging the Sirens here. After the battle, we went inside that area to check it out a bit more, and things got even weirder!

When I was sailing through those waters, sometimes I felt light and floaty, and other times I could barely even keep my rigging upright. It’s like the gravity across this whole area is all messed up...
I won't even be able to slack off at this rate! Err, I mean... I can't even do my job normally because of the abnormal gravity!
Suffolk is right. This anomaly can only be explained by gravity or magnetism.
Your intuitions are correct. There’s no natural phenomenon that can explain this sudden change in gravity. The Sirens must've deployed some kind of device in a Mirror Sea.
So... Uhh... Now that we've figured it out, we don't have to go back in there, right?

Of course we do. If we can't secure the deployment of this outpost, we won't be able to continue the operation smoothly. Besides, are you just going to walk away after seeing some Siren scheme unfold before your eyes?
But, don't worry. We have our enemy outgunned, and there’s another team observing the situation outside the Mirror Sea. If we see the device, we'll destroy it and put an end to this.
Now then, everyone, let us prepare for battle!
Is anyone else getting nauseous from being inside this place...?
Mm, considering how erratically the gravity is shifting around, this would be difficult for a normal person to tolerate, let alone one of us with our rigging.
There are some mass-produced Siren stragglers just ahead of us. Let’s use them to calibrate our shots and to get as familiar with fighting under these conditions as possible.
Ughh... My head’s getting all spinny...
It’s not only the trajectory of our shells that’s being affected... even our torpedoes won't work properly... It’s bloody difficult trying to hit the enemy like this...
If distance is an issue, then all we have to do is close the gap... After all, gravity can't mess with the strike of a sword.
Warspite, Edinburgh and I found a really weird Siren! No matter what kind of attacks we throw at it, it won't fight back!
But our attacks aren't doing anything to its armour either! Come help us out over here!
A Siren that isn't fighting back...? Has it lost its command module and its ability to move?
*panting* ...Warspite, over there! That’s the strange Siren...!
I don't have any data on it. It might even be a new model...
Eat this! Haaaah!
It didn't even flinch...
No, Rodney... You didn't even land a hit on its armour in the first place.
Huh?! How’s that possible? I could've sworn I landed a direct hit...
No, your aim was true, but the explosion wasn't because you landed a hit. The fuse activated before the shell even touched the Siren.
In other words, both the shell and the explosion “disappeared” before reaching the armor...?
That seems to be the case...
The Naval HQ needs to hear about this. Everyone, retreat immediately and stay away from this zone!
Warspite! The Siren’s moving!
Eeeeeeeek?!
We're no match for that thing! Everyone, hurry and retreat this instant!
Hnnnnnnnnhhh...
The Siren... suddenly vanished...?
Wh-wh-wh-what just happened?! Sirens suddenly appearing and disappearing from thin air, all these strange phenomena... I'm going to be writing reports for the rest of my life!
Warspite, something feels familiar about that Siren. I'm not quite sure what it is, but I think we'll be able to defeat it.
...We don't have much of a choice right now. Everyone, We'll find out right here and now whether we can make that enemy bleed! Begin attacking!
Finally... the last enemy is down!
Contestant Kent... is about to bow out... H-huh?
*panting* ...Just what kind of enemy was that...? But... at least, it looks like the gravity abnormality is starting to clear up.
I think you're right. The gravity is starting to stabilise.
D-does that mean we're safe now...?
Yeah. Our communications are back online as well.
Edinburgh, you really helped me understand that enemy’s weak point.
Huh? O-oh, thank you, Lady Warspite...
We need to report what happened here to Her Majesty. About this Mirror Sea, and about that Siren...
Yes...！
(...A new type of Siren that can manipulate gravity. We have no idea just how strong it is, but we do know that we can't afford to ignore this threat.)
(Even after we finish building the second Outpost, We'll have to come up with countermeasures.)
Edinburgh, you and Hood will head back with me. Rodney, stay here and oversee the construction of the Outpost.
Understood!
The situation is becoming a lot more complicated than I expected... I can only hope that the rest of the Operation proceeds smoothly......
NA Ocean - Sector under Eagle Union jurisdiction
Essex, the Commander has set off with the fleet. We should depart soon too.
Right, but please remember that this battle is not meant to be an assault on the Siren stronghold, but rather a sector sweep to clear the NA Ocean of all Siren presence.
Our task is to clear out zone C, which is in the Northwest sector, and then establish two Outposts for the final offensive.
The Eagle Union is far stronger than it was last time we saw the Sirens. Let's show them how much we've improved!
Good to see that you're motivated, Intrepid. The Sirens have basically completely abandoned their offshore blockade, so the initial few battles should be fairly easy.
However, it will get harder after that... The central sector has been occupied by Sirens for a long time, and they might have laid traps in that time. Don't underestimate them.
There is one more thing that naval command wants us to pay special attention to.
The Iron Blood fleet's suspicious activity, I assume?
Yep. The whereabouts of Tirpitz's fleet is still unknown, and we don't even know whether they're Pawns or not, which is a big, security-threatening question mark...
I don't get it. Why would an Iron Blood fleet waltz into OUR area of operations anyway?
If it's to assist in Operation Siren, they could've at least contacted us about it. Hell, then we could've worked together...
I doubt they came here simply to assist us. This is Iron Blood we're talking about, the faction led by Friedrich and Bismarck.
There's bound to be layers of complexity to the situation, because of course there has to be. In any case, we have little choice but to investigate.
Well, investigate as much as we can. Our primary goal is to secure this zone.
We'll find the Iron Blood fleet sooner or later, and when we do, we can ask them what their intentions are.
Communications request from Saratoga received. An encrypted channel is ready to be established. What do you wish to do?
Whuah?! Oh, right, I forgot they installed an AI into our systems... Gonna take some time getting used to that...
Communications request from Saratoga received. An encrypted channel is ready to be established. What do you wish to do?
Oops, uhh... Open a channel, I guess?
This is Sara! Just testing out your comms. How's it going with TB? Are you all starting to get used to her?
This is Essex. No issues with any of her practical functions, but... sometimes her mannerisms feel just a bit too lifelike for a computer program.
Are you sure HQ didn't just pick out a junior officer, dress her up, and present her as an auxiliary system to joke with us?
I know it might seem weird, but TB isn't just someone in a disguise! I don't know the specifics, but they apparently went with a cute design to facilitate user-to-interface communication.

Function-wise, she's cutting-edge! They spared no expensive developing in reliable systems for her. For starters, she's able to connect to Siren devices, and provides automatic shielding against Siren interference.
Shield against Siren interference? That's incredibly useful... assuming it works in practice. They're calling this a test run of her systems for a reason.
You'll see for yourself sooner or later! On another note... Essex, I heard that Enterprise and the Commander have managed to have already cleared their assigned zone.
What?! That means we're lagging behind in progress! ...I can't let them make us look like second-raters. We'll pick up the pace from here on out!
That's the spirit! Make quick work of those Sirens, and report back when you're done. Sara, over and out!
Hmm... I still have my doubts about whether TB truly is an AI or not, but I can say with certainty that her systems and database access will be of significant strategic benefit.
We can speculate more on that later. For now, let's focus on wiping out these low-level Sirens. We can't let Enterprise put our task force to shame!
Hmm... I can't complain about being served an easy victory on a silver platter, but... it feels TOO easy.
You'd think we'd have run into a new Siren this deep into their territory, or at least come across a force that poses some semblence of a threat.
Are they just going to take it lying down...?
After having fought them for so long, this is the first time I feel we have a big technological and strategic advantage over the Sirens.
Their unit deployment is so bizarrely unconventional... It's as though they're just clearing out their old stock.
Hey, yeah, you're right... It's not like they're deploying fewer fleets, more like they just never deployed any of their stronger elite units!
Something fishy is going on here. They're only doing the bare minimum to give off the impression of a counterattack while essentially letting us waltz in and retake territory.
The Sirens' chain of command is nowhere to be seen, and we still have no idea about the whereabouts of the Iron Blood's fleet...
I can't help but feel this is all part of a clever ploy that we just can't grasp with the intel we have now...
Well, speaking of intel and the Iron Blood fleet, I just came across an unverified report.
Allegedly, not long after the attack on Scarpa Bay ended, an Iron Blood fleet embarked on a secret mission through the canal into the Eritrean Sea. 。
The Eritrean Sea? Why? Are they just acting without rhyme or reason, like the Sirens are now?
Our defenses have always been rather lackluster in that sector. You don't think they're planning on taking the long way around to attack our west coast, are they?
TB, what's your take on this?
Parsing request... Complete. No definite conclusion can be drawn based on currently available data.
The Eritrean Sea has always been under the joint responsibility of the Royal Navy and Dragon Empery. Do you wish to submit an official query to these authorities?
Err... No, just thought I'd ask. Never mind. Let's get back to the more pressing operation at hand.
You gotta hand it to TB though. It's incredible how much data she can fetch and parse if you just ask her.
It is my duty to provide analysis and facilitate communication upon a user's request. I am glad to be of assistance.
Scan complete. An allied signal has been detected. Profile matches that of Ark Royal of the Royal Navy.
What? But this sector is under our jurisdiction... Why would Ark Royal be here?
Maybe she's lost? The NA Ocean is massive, after all. TB, is she alone, or are there any other ships accompanying her?
Scanning... Complete. No other signals have been detected. Only the signal matching Ark Royal's profile can be detected.
So it's only her... Something's not right here. Let's send out a few recon planes to keep an eye on her.
Scan complete. Unit identified as Ark Royal is being pursued by a large number of hostiles.
Warning: Connection to mainframe has been lost. Resuming in offline mode.
We lost connection?! What happened, TB?!
Detecting Siren electronic interference. Readings indicate that a hostile presence is moving toward this location.
Sirens...! I should've known. It was only a matter of time before they showed their hand...
This seems like a good time to test our anti-jamming function to see how well it works.
