Blinding light condenses beneath the starry sky.
Tch... Interrupting our touching reunion? You're as dense as they come.
Hey, you big lug! I'm gonna beat the tar outta you!
Wait! Eugen, Blücher! Get back in the barrier!
You two can't take that thing on alone!
Don't worry about us. We have each other.
Yeah! Let's win this together!
KABOOOOM!
That which I'd seen destroy the world before was halted by a gentler force, which weakened it more with every passing second.
Silence took over the battlefield, engulfing all.
Ages seemed to pass in this moment.
When the light disappeared, so too did the Star Beast.
Did we... win?
It was a perfect victory.
Heheh☆ Our bond can beat anything!
I swear, I must be dreaming... We really, really won?
Blücher? Eugen?! Have you come back to life somehow?!
It's been a while, Rumey. Who knew you'd become the leader of the Resistance?
Sorry, but we haven't. Consider us just a fleeting illusion born from hopes and dreams.
A fleeting illusion... Does that mean you're leaving me?!
The future you dreamed of is reality now. Our job here is done.
Oh... Well, knowing that you two live on in this state is still a relief.
When can I see you again?
Take care of yourself and keep getting stronger, and maybe then...
You might just be able to find us... Or you might even realize that we've been with you all along.
Doesn't make much sense to me. But okay... I'll take care of myself. I'll get stronger. And someday, I will find you two!
We're cheering you on, Hipper!
Sure are. And keep an eye on your nutrition, got it?
You don't have to tell me that!
A sea breeze blows through, and Prinz Eugen and Blücher begin to fade.
It's time for us to go... Thank you all for taking such good care of our sister. Keep her safe for us.
No worries there, Eugen. We will win this war.
I believe you.
SHUFFLE...
There's the sound of shuffling cards again. But it's softer and slower, as if giving me time to prepare before I'm taken away.
It's time to say goodbye.
Everyone, we've achieved a great victory today.
From now on, the Star Beast is no longer a sword hanging over the world – it's a symbol of victory and hope.
Congratulations, Fritz Rumey. Your counteroperation has taken a great leap forward.
Commander... Thank you.
You're not leaving too, are you?!
...I am.
Will we ever see you again?
Of course. I'm certain of it.
You will forever be the Commander of the Iron Blood Resistance. Take care of yourself.
Heheh... Commander.
Long time no see... Or perhaps should I say, "I'll see you soon."
(What?!)
Three days passed in the blink of an eye. The time to fight has finally come.
Commander {playername}, Rumey has directed me to relinquish command of this fleet to you.
But given the fact that this is your first mission, may I serve as your second-in-command?
I'd be happy to have you.
Duisburg knows a million times more than I do about these seas and so-called extradimensionals.
I wouldn't dream of turning down an offer like that.
Heheh. I'll make you proud.
Z52's recon fleet is en route from IB-AX-108 to 110, and Rumey has already set sail with her main fleet.
The amphibious and escort fleets are still on standby.
As for our own hunting fleet, our job is to secure the supply route at IB-AX-104, eliminate every enemy in sight, and collect samples from them.
But to think that we would need a sample from an extradimensional, of all things, to fix our radiation purgers...
IB-AX-104 is vast, but it's long been seen as relatively safe.
Recon shows nothing out of the ordinary as of eight hours ago, as well.
Well, isn't that convenient...
(If it really is safe, then dispersing our fleets makes for a more efficient search, yes. But something is fishy here...)
Anyway, we'd best get going.
After a smooth journey to IB-AX-103, we ran into them – the extradimensionals.
KABOOOM!
ROOOOOAR!
That's one heck of a horde! Is this what you call safe?
Not at all. This is the most we've seen in years!
But why today?
Commander, I urge a swift retreat! We can't fight off those numbers!
Agreed. Give the order to all ships to cover each other's immediate retreat. Contact our allied fleets and headquarters as well – Rumey needs to stop the mission at once.
Roger that!
KABOOOM!
ROOOOOAR!
As time passed, the horde only grew in number.
Things had turned from hopeful to hopeless in practically minutes.
We did everything in our power, but we lost contact with ship after ship.
Even retreat seemed an unlikely luxury at this point.
No... Why did it have to be today of all days?
Why...
A mission that we'd expected to be an easy success had ended in tragedy.
Duisburg's voice trembles from pain, sadness, and regret.
Commander... We're done for, aren't we?
I'm sorry for getting you involved in this. I...
KABOOOM!
Deathly silence fills the air.
Am I... dying?
Right here? This easily?
I haven't accomplished anything. I haven't even been able to get my memories back.
But this is how it ends...
KABOOOM!
Amidst the explosion of the mass-produced ship, my consciousness is thrown into the empty abyss.
SHUFFLE...
Then, I hear the sound of cards shuffling.
A flash of a sword dispersed the thick, black mist.
Lady Shimanto, Lady Unzen, leave this place to me!
Ibuki?
Yes! I had resumed training for the sake of my master, but the way the air had changed made me suspicious, so I entered the sanctuary...
I-I do know that I shouldn't enter the sanctuary without permission, but I was just so worried about what was happening in here.
Anyway, long story short, I came running to help you all.
As a fellow member of the Sakura Empire, I cannot overlook this situation!
I may not be much help, but I offer what protection I can give!
Unzen faced the rampaging beast anew and tightened her grip on her twin swords. A new power flowed into them and coalesced around her blades, giving them a new form.
She recalled the sight of her own countless failures in past dreams.
Her swords hadn't been broken yet, and she now had others by her side.
Light gathered around her, creating many swords with the power of the concept of cleansing.
They created a wall of flashing steel around the shipgirls, repelling any shadows that dared encroach.
Closer...
Just a little closer...
She channeled all her focus into a single point as she continued parrying and warding off the darkness, drawing ever nearer to the core.
No matter what attacks the enemy threw at her, she knew that she was not alone.
Shimanto and Ibuki had been beside her this entire time.
Lights from bursts of flame and glints of steel continued to dance and weave together, never wavering while she was yet to complete her work.
Unzen!
We're not going to be able to hold out much longer!
Unzen!
Lady Unzen, you'll have to go the rest of the way yourself!
Shimanto's shikigami dragon had already caught on fire, yet it still tried to throw itself in the way of the enemy.
Ugh... My blade's about to give out...
Ibuki cast a single glance at the notches that the shadow's teeth had left in her dulled blade, before anointing it once more in the flames of battle without hesitation.
I mustn't subject you to any further danger...
Soon, my blade will reach the core!
Lady Unzen!
I must withdraw!
Finally, the place where Ibuki once danced her flurry of blades fell dark and silent.
Unzen was all alone.
The leviathan of shadow looked down upon the tiny speck of light within its domain of endless darkness with the contempt of a god.
「Meaningless. Futile. Hopeless. Worthless. All is in vain.」
You're wrong.
Nothing lasts, like bubbles on the water's surface. Wasted effort, like a castle of sand before the inevitable tide.
It isn't futile at all.
I've witnessed the destruction of countless branches.
Each time, I made the same decision.
I believed it was the Great Sage's destiny to be annihilated from existence along with you.
I believed it was Watatsumi's destiny to be the cocoon from which fate hatched.
But I am not the Great Sage, and I am not Watatsumi.
Redundant. Ostentatious. Unavailing. The incoherent mutterings of someone lost in dreams.
Indeed. I tried to banish my emotions so that I could become the vessel through which the Reenactment would bear out.
But now, my hull is full of emotions that never should have been let in.
Yearning for another, the desire to see them again...
Doubt, hesitation, indecision, irresolution.
All of these emotions define who I am, here and now.
I am a shipgirl, and I am a human.
...am no god.
And neither are you!
The released power of the sacred tree filled the seal and became a sword of energy that pierced the sky.
Both the cloud canopy and Shadow of Corruption alike were split in two, showing a glimpse of a different-colored sky beyond.
The leviathan of mist writhed, as if feeling real agony.
Already having lost its form, the mist began gathering in one place.
Instead of launching a counterattack, or even displaying a hint of malice, it was actually trying to flee.
Unzen!
Shimanto, are you alright?
Heheh, remember, I am the Dragon God! That was nothing to me...
We mustn't let the core escape us!
The corpse of the beast spat out a black mass that emitted dark-red light as it passed over the shipgirls' heads.
Is that... the core?!
We can't possibly catch up from here!
It was then that the clouds covering the sky opened up.
That was the sanctuary sky that Sakuran shipgirls knew. The sight outside of the seal.
Seemingly of its own volition, the core ascended toward the opening in the clouds.
In that case...!
Unzen fired her cannons, but the core had already escaped just beyond her range.
At this rate, the calamitous black mist would reach the outside world—
Haaaaaah!
The core collided with a glowing, pink pattern—the seal.
The glyphs of power spread like ripples on water, engulfing the entirety of the black mist.
The moment it had the mist in its clutches, the seal condensed into the roots of the Prime Sakura, the center of the ritual.
Time seemed to flow backwards. The withered Prime Sakura and the islands of earth floating in the air all began returning to their original form.
Thus, the black mist was sealed once more.
Lady Nagato!
I-I made it...
Great Sage... I've repaired... the seal...
No sooner as those words left her lips, Nagato collapsed to the ground, unconscious.
The nearly-escaped core had been dragged instantly back into the seal. Now, its presence was seemingly gone.
Lady Nagato!
Ibuki rushed to help her.
...Phew. Thank goodness, it's just fatigue.
Even for the Guardian Fox, performing a ritual of such scale by force...
How much did she have to push herself for that? Phew...
I sure do have a long way to go.
Exhausted from the fierce battle, Shimanto collapsed to her knees to take a break.
Lady Nagato, Shimanto, Ibuki. It's an honor to have fought with you.
Unzen stabbed her swords into the soil. As the sacred tree's remaining power had returned to the sanctuary, the swords disappeared as well.
It's almost time.
One blue butterfly landed by Unzen, followed by hundreds, no, a thousand more.
The light cast by their wings extended slowly toward the Prime Sakura.
Voices of the other shipgirls in the sanctuary reached them from afar.
Amidst the cherry blossom-colored rain, the Prime Sakura also slowly merged with the light...
Floating along the river towards destinations unknown.
When they turned back, Unzen was already gone.
KABOOOM!
The Tulipan fleet is engaging the enemy.
Shell after shell loaded with fury ignites one hideous foe after the next.
The Sirens are ablaze.
All the blood shed since the destruction of our kingdom's fleet... can be seen in these flames.
We finally did it... The Kingdom of Tulipa finally did it...
It's not time yet to be overcome with emotion, Evertsen.
Our journey has only just begun. We only planted our flag in this ocean mere moments ago.
You're right... This is only the beginning.
Our new future... begins now.
KABOOOM!
Enemy reinforcements incoming.
We'll lead our mass-produced fleet in and pincer them. Eliminate them as quickly as possible.
Let us show them our might. Our first battle must end in victory!
KABOOOM!
As time went by, the Tulipans conquered their initial awkwardness and gradually became accustomed to fighting.
The advantage we had since the very start had developed into an overwhelming superiority.
Mirror Seas used to be so dangerous, and now we can just bulldoze through them.
And our fighting force isn't even first-rate...
Seems like we've accomplished the transition from quantity to quality.
You realized that just now?
I've had an inkling for a while. Data doesn't lie.
It's just that the enemies have been getting stronger at the same as we did. Chances to really feel our growth were surprisingly rare.
This one time is different. They're still weak while we've changed greatly.
I estimate we'll complete this mission in under 12 hours, including time spent searching for hostiles.
If we hurry back to the harbor, we should even make it in time for lunch.
(True. The mission is proceeding very smoothly, and it looks like the Tulipans got into the swing of things.)
(That said, no report is better than seeing something with your own eyes. There is something special about these girls.)
(The ivies appearing out of thin air, this everpresent feeling of nature... Could this be a type of cognitive materialization?)
(Their strange powers and these unusual phenomena must have something to do with those unique Wisdom Cubes.)
(After my trip to the Arcana Sanctum, there was an unidentified but positive change in all the Wisdom Cubes the Northern Parliament had at the time.)
(They developed all kinds of theories to try to explain the origin of this phenomenon.)
(Some say the cause was the Arcana Sanctum's unique environment, while others say my Wisdom Cube aptitude had that effect. Others, still, say it was a combination of both of those.)
(Whatever the case, that phenomenon hasn't reoccurred since.)
(That's not all. Whenever new shipgirls are born in the Northern Parliament, they use those unique Wisdom Cubes as part of the process.)
(Despite this different procedure, those shipgirls don't display any differences. It's as though they did it using regular Wisdom Cubes.)
(In contrast, the Tulipan shipgirls exhibit astonishing changes.)
(I hope we'll be able to figure out the root cause...)
(Because if we do, we might be able to further raise the strength floor of our world!)
BEEP BEEP!
Commander, the Northern Parliament fleet has finished its elimination mission.
We're now starting to surround the Mirror Sea's central control tower from the southwest. Expected to be in the designated position within an hour.
Likewise, Commander, the Tulipan fleet has completed its own elimination mission. We are currently surrounding the tower from the southeast.
We'll begin an all-out attack once we link up with the Northern Parliament's fleet!
Fantastic work. Keep it up.
BEEP BEEP!
What's wrong, Commander? You look displeased, despite how well things are going.
Remember back at the embankment, right as Zeven approached us? I was going to tell you that Omitter used this Mirror Sea to test new weapons.
I heard it straight from Helena, so I have no reason to doubt its veracity.
Huh? But we haven't seen anything you could call a new weapon so far...
That's what worries me.
There should be one, so where is it?
KABOOOM!
The battle for the central control tower wasn't particularly tough.
All resistance to our overwhelming firepower proved futile, and the tower that maintained the Mirror Sea was destroyed very quickly.

The abnormal weather and terrain within the Mirror Sea gradually faded away, and soon, the jamming that impeded our communications disappeared, and we started receiving messages from the outside again.
Wow, that's a lot of unread messages.
...Commander, I have terrible news.
Not long after we departed, a Siren fleet launched an attack on the Tulipan coast!
My bad premonition came true.
Helena META's intel was correct – this place was indeed a Siren testing site for new weapons, and it had been operating as normal.
Apparently, as soon as I took the fleet in to destroy the Mirror Sea, its commanding AI sent forth a fleet armed with new weapons and attacked the now-defenseless Tulipan coast.
Scheming to strike at us even if it meant sacrificing itself... How cowardly!
Our dam defense system is engaging the Siren fleet, and it's now on the brink of falling apart...
Commander, we have to retreat posthaste!
Hold up. While we did destroy the machine sustaining the Mirror Sea, there are still Sirens in the general area. Our mission isn't over yet.
Be that as it may, the enemy is attacking our country directly!
I know, but we can't just leave. This is a joint operation between the Azur Lane and the Crimson Axis.
And as operation participants, we have to prioritize the mission.
Even if our country is burning?
Believe in yourself, believe in your compatriots defending the dam, and believe in the Commander.
You have to keep cool no matter how dire things get.
Remember, we have the edge in firepower. As long as each of us carries out their role, the Commander will always lead us to the best result.
*sigh*...
You're right. Forgive me, Commander. I lost my composure.
Since the situation has changed, we'll have to redeploy our forces.
We've successfully eliminated the Sirens within the Mirror Sea and taken out its control tower.
However, there are still hostiles in the area, so our mission isn't finished just yet.
While it's true we have to deal with them, not ALL of us need to stay here.
A part of our force will split off and head to the coast.
Zeven, assemble a fleet consisting of you, Eversten, and your mass-produced ships. I'll bring my command vessel and provide support.
Thank you, Commander! I'll start regrouping at once!
Kazan, you'll take command of the NP fleet and stay here to mop up the enemy. Don't let a single one get away.
Got it. It will be done.
I'll request backup from the Royal Navy fleet nearby. They should help us clean up this area.
Once the area is clear, immediately return to Tulipa and provide backup.
This battle must be finished quickly and conclusively.
There are your orders. Eliminate all enemies before Tulipa suffers further casualties!
Roger!
The fleet sailed on at full speed, and soon the Tulipan coastline lit up by cannon fire came into view.
While there was fighting all across the dam defense system, it didn't seem as disastrous as was assumed.
The defense line was holding, and the battle was going far better than expected.
Leipzig, Nürnberg, coordinate with the Tulipan defensive installations and destroy the enemy's vanguard force.
- Yes, ma'am! - Roger!
Spee, don't focus solely on their biggest units. Our goal isn't swift elimination, it's to repel them from the coastline and keep structural damage to a minimum.
Okay... I'll bear that in mind.
Oh. It seems the Iron Blood had the same idea as us.
Murmansk, Grozny, we're going to assist the Iron Blood's fleet and push the frontline back into the sea.
- Roger, roger. - Let's beat the crap out of 'em!
Ally reinforcements on the coastline!
Thank goodness. They're still holding out!
Those are the domestic Iron Blood and Northern Parliament defense fleets not participating in the operation.
They're actually going out of their way to assist...
A good sign of things to come. It means all our hard work up to this point wasn't for nothing.
There may just be hope for the Azur Lane's reformation.
Yeah!
Then there are THOSE things over there... They must be Omitter's latest weapon.
According to intel, those are Sphyrnidae, super-dreadnought-class eradicators.
We have to defeat them to complete this mission in any real sense.
Commander, the Tulipan fleet awaits your orders!
Right. Coordinate with the coastal defense forces and allied fleets and eliminate the enemy!
KABOOOM!
Commander! Haven't seen you since the NA counterattack operation!
Royal Navy destroyer Grenville, head of the search-and-destroy fleet, reporting in!
The battle hasn't yet resulted in significant casualties. It seems we've arrived at the perfect time!
We're done mopping up the stragglers. I'll join up with you and the Royal Navy soon, Commander.
Whoa-ho! Those must be the biggest foes I've ever seen!
Heheh... I'd love to pick their wreckages apart!
What're we waiting for? Get 'em! Chaaarge!
At long last, peace and quiet returns to the shore.
The first light of dawn shines down, and a new day begins.

scripts.say: This makes it the third Ashes member we've made contact with. What do you think about her, Scylla?
She sounds simple and straightforward, and it's great that our goals align. However...
Yes? Go on.
She also talks too much. While we did rescue her, she's under no obligation to tell us anything.
I can't put my finger on why, but it makes me uncomfortable.
Mull it over a bit more. You're not the only one who thinks the same way.
I can't find any faults with her so far, but something still feels amiss...
Is it because I'm naturally inclined to distrust the Ashes, or is it something more tangible...?
At any rate, keep a close eye on her.
As you wish, Lady Implacable.
Yo, I found the Horseman of Famine.
Looks like it's about... 40 or 50% busted?
Honestly pretty surprising though, considering it fought like a million mass-produced ships and still came out on top.
So, what's the plan? It's limping – now's a good time to strike.
Then strike we will. Let's not waste this opportunity.
I will accompany the vanguard. Implacable, can you watch over Béarn in the meantime?
Of course. Royal Oak, you'll take point and direct the artillery fire. Assist Richelieu and La Galissonnière in a frontal attack on Famine.
Argus, Béarn, and I will provide aerial support.
Very well. I suggest launching your attacks from the opposite direction.
Y-yes, Implacable! I swear I will not disappoint you!
Come now, ladies! Let us put an end to this wretched harbinger!
KABOOOM!
Our cannons cannot penetrate it, even at this close range?
This time, surely...!
KABOOOM!
Did that thing just dodge her shot? So much for being halfway dead!
It would seem our enemy's combat ability rivals that of even elite Sirens.
I can see now why La Galissonnière opted not to fight it head-on.
This can't be happening...
Even with Implacable, Richelieu, and support from the Ashes, we still can't defeat an injured Horseman...?
Small correction – our Ashes ally isn't doing much of anything.
La Galissonnière, what are you doing? Didn't you say you'd help us?
I AM helping. Can't you tell I'm praying?
Excuse me? Don't tell me you're praying for it to give up.
Give up? No, more like blow up! Literally!
"O, benevolent Iris, whose holy words I heed, whose divine will I carry out..."
"Take my enemy as your own, feel my fury as your own..."
"Grant me strength! Give me the power to cleanse this evil from your world!"
La Galissonnière's echoing prayer swept like a rejuvenating wind across the battlefield, instantly dispersing the noxious energy that infested it.
At the same time, the black Horseman staggered as the tide of battle began turning in the shipgirls' favor.
What in the world...? The Horseman is weakening?
Yeah! Now hit it with all you've got!
Let's see how tough you really are, skinny boy! Ahahaha!
A thunderous explosion struck the colossal Horseman, breaking it apart like a stone golem, never to reanimate again.
Hell yeah! Suck on that! Whaddya think of me now, huh?
Clearly, I misjudged you. You live up to the name of the Ashes.
Thank god you're on our side.
This alliance is only temporary. Keep the praise coming, though!
I must ask... What did you do back there?
What do you think? I offered a prayer, and it was answered.
That's how this test site works. No reason not to exploit it.
Meaning, you manifested a concept?
Bingo. Well, kind of. You can't just make any concept real – it's got to do with faith.
Other stuff from the Orthodoxy's religious texts applies as well, since it's where the Four Horsemen come from.
That much, I already know. It's the reason War and Conquest became stronger than Death and Famine.
Mhm. Did you try prayin' for yourself?
Yes. I recited a verse from the Scriptures, and something started happening to me... Luckily, Richelieu stopped me before I could finish.
Are these concepts really that dangerous?
No shit they are! Embracing the Horsemen's concepts is like inviting the Mirror Sea inside your head.
Use your brain before you pray. Don't go around offering words of power to a harbinger of doom.
Speaking of which, you'll want to figure out how to manifest your faith sooner rather than later.
What do you mean?
My own prayers can only have a very limited effect on you. You need to play by the Mirror Sea's rules as well, or the Horseman of War will blast you off the face of the earth.
Is it truly THAT powerful?
I'm not kidding here. Since the very concept of war empowers it, you're gonna make it stronger when you go to battle with it.
You CAN overcome those gains, but your conviction needs to be strong enough.
If you want a safe bet, pray to the Iris. That's how you got through those walls, right?
Implacable... I think you should take her advice and sincerely pray, if only for practical purposes.
If that's what it takes to defeat the Sirens, sure. Can I do it right here?
No. Praying is a sacred act. You are my ally, and I will not condone you treating the Holy Iris without respect.
I suppose it must be done in a reasonably dignified location, huh.
First, we'll need to find a place matching that description. Shall we?
I've found where War is! You all ready?
Ready as can be. Our prayers are still in effect, too.
We'll need them, for sure. War has a massive escort of mass-produced ships.
What did you expect? The bigger the army, the more war you can wage!
On the bright side, War itself is a real tough bastard!
Now how is that supposed to be a good thing?
Huh? Don't you get a rush of excitement just thinking about going head-to-head with a powerful enemy?
Ah, yes, because putting myself in mortal danger is exactly my idea of excitement.
Implacable, War is coming towards us.
It's raring to go, hmm? How befitting its namesake.
Looks like there's no signs of damage on it either. This won't be an easy fight.
What's wrong? Isn't your queen watching over you? I'm sure she won't let you lose more than a limb or two at worst.
Thanks for the "encouragement."
If you don't start pulling your weight, maybe you'll lose a limb or two as well.
Listen, I said I'd fight by your side, not that I'd adapt to your tactics.
As I said, I'm not gonna charge up there head-first, as that's not my style.
You guys can run up there and butt heads all you want, but I'm gonna look for weaknesses to exploit.
Sounds good? Alright. Have fun now, shipgirls of this "branch"~
Cheeky little... Why is she like this?
Calm down, Implacable. She doesn't trust us to not use her as cannon fodder, which is sensible.
We don't have much of a choice anyway, so let's at least give her the best conditions to succeed.
Ugh... Everyone, attack it head-on!
Her Majesty's graces are with us! Show that Horseman our might!
What?! It's repairing itself using armour plates torn off from its mass-produced ships!
Expending as many troops as necessary to win... Fitting for an embodiment of war.
It's very bad news for us, however. We cannot hope to win a war of attrition.
Even if we do, we won't have any bloody ammo left to beat the last Horseman!
It doesn't matter! We need to defeat War before we can even start thinking about defeating Conquest!
No. In fact, now is the time we SHOULD be thinking about Conquest!
War as a concept is not a goal; it serves a higher purpose. That purpose is conquest.
As long as the Horseman of Conquest is incapacitated, nothing is currently expressing the concept of conquest in this area.
But what if I become a conduit for the concept of Conquest?
In other words, if I can successfully "conquer" these mass-produced vessels, I can diminish the concept of War.
What do you all think? I believe La Galissonnière had the same idea of using Conquest to weaken War.
...Uh, I wasn't thinking of anything philosophical; I was just gonna make them fight.
Your idea is certainly gutsy, I'll give you that. And, I don't see anything wrong with it at a glance, as long as you're fine with the risks.
I'm against it. Channeling one of the Mirror Sea's concepts is far too dangerous. I can't let you shoulder such a burden for the mistakes we made.
If it's our only choice, I shall be the one to do it rather than you.
Sorry, Cardinal, but I think your strong faith inhibits you. You can't truly become a vessel for Conquest. It has to be done by a nonbeliever like me.
Don't worry, I'll be fine. I have Her Majesty's protection.
If the worst thing happens and I start to lose control, just save me like you did the last time.
But...
Hero, give me your bow!
Implacable took the bow – the symbol of Conquest – and drew the string, training her sights on the Horseman of War.
"I watched as the Lamb opened the first of the seven seals, and there before me was a white horse."
"Its rider held a bow, and he was given a crown, and he rode out as a conqueror bent on conquest."
"With this bow, he would smite those who opposed him, until none were left!"
Royal Oak lodged her greatsword into the Horseman's armor.
After a series of deafening explosions, the crimson flames smoldering on the Horseman of War's armor petered out, and the giant crashed to the ground.
*pant*... *pant*... It's... It's finished!
An excellent display by the Royal Knight, of course. Her Majesty will be proud of you.
M-me? Not at all... I only put in the finishing touch. Your quick wit is what really saved the day.
C'mon, we all know my bow is the star of the show~ When I get home, I'm gonna frame it and hang it over the fireplace~
...Hang on, did it always look this dull? And what are these cracks in the wood? Those weren't there before!
Right before Hero's eyes, the cracks spread further and further through the sacred bow, finally reaching both ends of it.
Then, with a hollow snap, it broke into a dozen little pieces.
Noooo! My precious boooow!
Whyyyy?! It was my loot! I earned it!!
It's a shame, but there's no use crying over spilled milk. I'll ask Richelieu if she can give us another replica later.
Oh! Okay, sweet♪
With War defeated, now there's only Conquest left to vanquish to end this Siren experiment.
But Conquest will be strongest yet, now that we've "conquered" all the other Horsemen.
Not to mention, we're nearly out of energy and ammo... And there aren't any more concepts we can channel, are there?
Not necessarily... In the Scriptures, there are a total of seven seals, which means three more concepts should be–
Hold up, I'm gonna veto that! You're not pulling a stunt like that again!
Why not? Channeling Conquest worked fine, and we've seen no symbolism for the remaining three seals in the Mirror Sea.
Just because they haven't been manifested in the form of Horsemen does not mean that the concepts don't exist!
For all we know, the Mirror Sea itself could represent the last three seals.
You're aware of what those seals are, right? Do you have any idea what kind of calamity you could bring if you were to manifest those things?
If you don't want the world to end, you'd better get that idea out of your head!
...I'll admit, I didn't consider that.
So, if that's no longer an option, how do you propose we take down the last Horseman?
Well, the original plan was to have Conquest and War take each other out after softening them up enough, but that's no longer on the table.
*sigh*... I suppose we're in a real bind then.
Hmm? Does it even matter at this point?
Did you forget that the Horseman of Conquest is still asleep behind the Skybound Wall?
Well, sure, it's not an immediate threat to us at the moment...
But that doesn't improve our situation. While you can leave this place whenever you want, we can't unless we finish the job.
Riiight, I forgot! Lucky for you, there are a few ways to deal with an inactive Horseman.
One being, you can use the walls of light to cut it to ribbons if you position 'em right.
Now that I think about it, why didn't the Tribunal of your branch already come up with that idea?
...Let's see if your idea is feasible, shall we?
No answer, huh. Fine, to the lair of the sleeping giant we go!

scripts.say: The following day, the girls employed the same method as last time to activate the elevator in the L1 area.
Aside from the fact that they were getting further and further away from the treasure hunter duo's ship, everything was going quite well.
"This the Sea of Rot. Yeah, a whole sea. You can't pass through it because it goes on forever. Just go by land."
Grr... Her saying that just makes me want to explore that sea even more!
Agreed. We just made it back to the sea, so I'm not too keen to be stuck on land again.
Personally, I don't mind one or the other.
Okay! Then let's go the way opposite of land – into the Sea of Rot's deep waters!
This fog... It's getting thicker and thicker...
Does it remind anyone else of how it looked when we first ended up here?
Maybe there's a chance this will bring us back home!
Something tells me it won't be quite that easy.
Fwee-fwee! Eyes ahead! Massive, unknown structure sighted!
Wait... Isn't that the area we set off from? The tower's L1 area?
Then it seems we've gone in a circle. I knew it wouldn't be that simple to leave this place.
On the bright side, we gathered a bunch of useful materials.
We did? Then at least we got somethin' outta this!
Ya got enough to make some riggings now?
Not quite... I have plenty of ingredients, just not all the right ones.
Some of them will need to be procured from the monsters living on land.
Welp... Sounds like our only option is to get back on land.
I was hoping we'd get to break the mold with this adventure, but oh well!
With their guards up yet their curiosity unmasked, the group rapidly ascended to the top of the tower.
Unlike all the previous times, there was nothing dividing the area at the top into clearly distinct zones.
There was simply a vast space covered with water, and buildings dotting the seascape like islands.
Even the expansive space overhead wasn't divided into strata like previously, extending all the way from the water to the highest point – an artificial sky shining like a green star.
To think a space this vast could exist inside a building...
The Sirens really possess some incredible technology.
They sure do. It's not so nice when they're your enemy, though.
Your rigging technology is incredible in its own right.
You think so? I'd say alchemy is more wow-worthy.
No, I really think riggings are the more impressive technology. There's still so much I don't know about them.
If we're going by that metric, then alchemy's easily the more impressive one!
Because I don't know the first dang thing about it!
Ahahaha...
Everyone, be careful... I-I think our opponent is right over there!
Are you that DOS we heard about?
Then it's you who arranged this adven– I mean, this evil scheme!
So you admit it!
But she didn't even say anything.
Her silence means she isn't denying it!
I... guess so?
Fwee-fwee! Be on your guard! She's coming toward us!
Just have to take this wee ruin guardian out! Then we resume our treasure hunt!
Be careful, everyone!
KABOOOM!

I just didn't think the DOS would be such a handful...
This is hopeless. I can't even scratch her.
If it's come to this, there's only one choice left – to blow myself up!
To whoever comes after me: I wish you luck!
KABOOOM!
I see.
Heheh...

You just froze up all of a sudden! You didn't even react to being in the air, so I got pretty worried.
Are you okay?
Thanks. I'm fine. I just witnessed another fragment of the past, I think...
Wait, what'd you say? In the air? Right now?
Yeah! We're flying, Yumia!

All the previously scattered areas of the tower, too, rose up one by one, shaking violently while they recomposed.

sequence: One-Punch! Bulin!  3.The Site of Trials

scripts.say: By working together, the three Bulin sisters managed to pass all the trials.
That was the last one, bulin! We got a key, bulin!
And there's a treasure chest here, bulin! Open it, bulin!
Okay, bulin! Here we go, bulin!
Opening the box released a blinding rainbow light which pierced the skies.
Item obtained: Ultra Rainbow Hammer.
Look at that light, bulin! This thing must be amazingly powerful, bulin!
And now it's in my hands, bulin!
While the sisters cheered and celebrated, a stranger approached from the dark.
What the hell is all this ruckus about?
Ah... Adventurers. You're after the legendary hammer, are you?
Well, bad news for you. If you want to keep it, you've gotta get through me!
The big baddie has appeared, bulin! She wants to take our hard-earned loot, bulin!
Like that's gonna happen, bulin! Give her a taste of the hammer's might, bulin!
Come here, bulin! I'm gonna squash you like a bug, bulin!
...What the heck, bulin? The hammer isn't doing anything, bulin!
Hahah! You didn't know? The Ultra Rainbow Hammer is an energy weapon! You've gotta charge it, idiot!
Okay, bulin! We'll keep her distracted, bulin! Charge up the hammer quickly, bulin!
Let's see what you've got, bulin!
The Bulin sisters fought, but their best efforts weren't enough to trump their adversary.
Your attacks are useless! Ahahahah!
No one, and I mean no one on this earth can bring out the hammer's power!
You're wrong, bulin! Our sister's the strongest person alive, bulin!
She'll put you in your stupid rightful place, bulin!
Try it! Struggle all you want, then despair!
You'll be the one to despair, bulin! My hammer is at full charge, bulin!
What?! That's impossible!
Great job, bulin! Let's wale on her until she cries for mama, bulin!
Follow my lead, bulin! Show her what we bulins are capable of, bulin!
The Ultra Rainbow Hammer's mighty attacks wore away at the Lord of Evil's will to battle.
Screw it! This is unfair! I'm outta here!
She has her back turned, bulin!
Now's our chance, bulin! Gang up on her, bulin!
Hope you like the taste of rainbow punch, bulin!
- This is the blow that pierces the earth, bulin! - This is the blow that pierces the heavens, bulin! - This is the blow that strikes down the stars, bulin!
The hammer glowed with all the colors of the rainbow, and the Bulin sisters' strength converged into a single beam of light that outshone even the stars.
KABOOOOOOOM!
Victory is ours, bulin! We vanquished the big baddie, bulin!
But at what cost, bulin? The hammer's light is gone, bulin...
Oh no... Did it break, bulin?
Oh well, it's still a nice trophy, bulin! Besides, our combined strength felt stronger than even the hammer, bulin!
Now we have to celebrate our triumph, bulin. Let's go for barbecue, bulin!
Hooray, bulin!
And so, the Bulin sisters left to treat themselves to first-rate barbecue.
As for the legend that inspired their adventure... It remains only a tale to this day.
I could see the false God's form clearly through the monitor on my command vessel.
Floating in the middle of the layers of armor was a girl, cloaked in a ghostly-pale light.
This isn't working. Our attacks aren't going to breach those defenses.
Memphis META was referring not just to the mechanical body of the Gazer, but also the little girl in the air.
I have a guess as to why. It's only a guess, but...
Based on what I know, I think that girl is Arbiter: The Hierophant V.
That said, my database doesn't recognize her as The Hierophant, no matter what data or parameters I feed it.
Either that appearance is some sort of disguise... or something is using The Hierophant's vessel.
If the latter is true, then THAT must be the true identity of Marco Polo's false God.
I agree.
The Ashes have fought against The Hierophant a number of times before. She is one of the few Arbiters who can be reasoned with.
I have all the reason to believe that something is taking advantage of her powers and mass-production capabilities.
But beyond that, there's something deeply unsettling about all of this...
Not just the false God. But the Gazers as well, the swarms of enemies, and the white substance...
Where I'm from, just about everything is a bad omen. But, even that has varying degrees.
All I can say is... I'm afraid you guys have opened a terrible door that can't be shut again.
When Memphis META rescued Shinano and her fleet, she mentioned something similar. An enemy beyond our cognition.
But, they would say no more about this matter. Even Hiryuu META would tell me nothing beyond "I cannot say."
If there was one thing I gleamed from this, it was that knowing too much about it was dangerous.
Commander, when will we launch our all-out attack?
That girl has something very important to the Orthodoxy. We must take it back from her.
"You don't mean...?"
Yeah. The Crown of the Holy See. We thought Marco Polo took it with her into the sea, but it seems that the monster took it.
Marco Polo can be judged at a later time. More urgently, we must stop the Crown from being corrupted.
The symbol of the Orthodoxy's legitimacy, the crown signifying the wearer's holy position, was in the hands of the false God.
As I gazed upon the Crown floating in the girl's hands, something suddenly dawned on me.
The Crown was more than just a relic passed down since ancient times. It was, originally, an extension of God.
The girl was motionless, but her gaze pierced through me.
It was her. The figure that had appeared countless times in my nightmares.
Commander? What's wrong?! You look pale...
"That is a threat to our world that can't be allowed to exist."
KABOOOM!
Dammit! No effect! My shells disintegrate on impact with the armor without even leaving a scratch!
I'm... all out of ammo. I demand a resupply... and paid time off...
The small ones just keep coming, no matter how many we destroy.
They're like hydras... Cut one down, and two take its place. Is this area linked to the microlayer network or something?
No, we're dealing with something altogether different here.
It's not like they're popping out of the ocean or from sea fog... They seem to be ripping their way through the fabric of reality itself...
Ripping through... the fabric of reality? Lady Shinano, don't you think that sounds a bit similar to how our barrier domains work?
Barrier domains?
This one had the same hunch...
From an outside perspective, emerging from a Sakuran barrier hidden in the sky is the same as appearing out of thin air...
There are many ways to conceal such a barrier, too...
What we see is neither fact nor fiction, but rather a deception of our senses.
A barrier is an enchantment that must be dispelled through the proper means. Otherwise, attacking it accomplishes nothing more than trying to scoop the moon out of a pond.
I see... So what you're saying is, we've been shadowboxing this entire time. The enemy we think we are fighting was never there to begin with.
If that is true, its physical form must be hidden away in some domain.
I did say before that I had no more cards to play. But, that's not quite accurate–
I do have one final move to make – a sacrament from this false God, given to me by Marco Polo. We have no choice but to use it.
However, it will take some time to prepare. Commander, can I trust you to hold the line in the meantime?
Helena also needs time to complete her analysis. Keep up the pressure, Commander!
"You don't have to tell me twice."
▅■cease▆▅
All of a sudden, I heard a girl's emotionless, mechanical voice inside of my head.
What on earth was that?
I feel like... I'm slowing down. My rigging's grind to a halt!
Mine, too! Commander, we're all affected by whatever this is!
Same here. I can't... move... Urgh...
Argh! Ark Royal! My head!
Damnit! The energy in my hull's going completely haywire!
Memphis? Are you hanging in there?
Barely... Somehow, yeah...
With but a single otherworldly word, the entire battlefield was gripped by an icy, death-like chill.
Did you hear that voice too? What manner of enchantment is this?
"Yes. I can still move like normal. Whatever it is, it doesn't look like it affected me."
"You don't look like it affected you much either, for that matter, Shinano."
"Could it be that my command vessel is immune to this phenomenon?"
No, it's not. I'm affected, albeit it not to the same degree as the rest.
Most puzzling... So the effect varies from shipgirl to shipgirl...
I'm basically fine. My arms and legs just feel a little heavy.
Likewise, I am still fit for battle. I feel hardly affected at all.
Same with the mass-produced ships... It's done practically nothing to them. They can still fight!
(So the blueprint ships and the mass-produced ships aren't affected much, while the METAs are gravely affected.)
(Among everyone on the command ship, only Shinano hasn't been affected at all.)
It doesn't seem like my hull's being corrupted, but...
I've felt this pain before... It feels like the exact same thing...
Urgh... I'm... all but certain... that it's the same thing...
Commander... Is it too late to retreat now...?
Retreat? You're just gonna run away, Hiryuu?!
I'm not talking about me... We all... need to get out of here... before it's too late!
Haha.. Sorry...
But if we run away with the Commander... what will happen to this experimental field...?
Whatever you're thinking, we cannot have you take the Commander from us.
We're lucky a certain someone here has barely been affected...
Gascogne! Force a direct connection into cognitive space!
A black sun, quietly burning in the dusky sky.
The black sun...
This is that other sacrament Marco Polo received from God...
Correct. The problem with it is that's nigh-impossible to control.
How is everyone? Can you move freely?
Yes! Thank you kindly, Clemenceau!
Forcibly connecting minds to a separate conceptual space to protect against an anti-conceptual weapon in reality. That must've taken a huge amount of energy...
Depending on how you use it, it can even affect your opponent's mind...
(This is Arbiter-level technology. Can we even be sure this space doesn't connect to somewhere else?)
So if understand correctly... the black sun is actually located in a cognitive plane of existence...?
How are we supposed to get back from here?
▅■one▆▅
For the first time since the battle began, the Hierophant moved her body.
She raised the wand in her hands high above her, then swung it down...
...Instantly shattering the vision of the black sun like a glass pane.
Just like that, she was in control of the world once more.
The symbol of judgment was destroyed THAT easily?!
Did we overload the connection? Or is this Arbiter simply that much stronger than it?
Neither. That wand... The ability to recognize and control concepts...
This isn't just one of the Hierophant's vessels! She's here, in person!
Be extremely careful! You do NOT want to be hit by attacks from that wand!
It'll either turn you to dust, or if you're really unlucky, the very concept of your existence will be wiped from reality!
Good to know... Too bad I'm basically stuck in place!
At least those attacks are time-consuming and short-ranged... Commander, rush her with the mass-produced ships and organize a fleet out of the blueprint ships!
The Hierophant's grip on everyone is letting up! Keep her busy while we get back on our feet!
I took control over the mass-produced ships and used them as shields for the shipgirls who could still move. This was just enough to hold the line.
Now there are aircraft coming after us! Commander, we need aerial support!
I've got you! I'm gonna swat those little mosquitos!
Wait... Are those the Devil's drones?!
Countless drones appeared in the sky, emerging from nowhere just like the swarmers down at sea level.
The drones – bearing the markings of the Devil XV – all encircled the Hierophant briefly before spreading out in all directions.
Their formation almost resembled the shape of a spider web.
Hey! Where are you going?! Fight me!
Disregarding Hakuryuu's provocation, the Hierophant once again raised her wand and lightly waved it in the direction of a single aircraft.
It began glowing with a dazzling golden light that chained to nearby aircraft, forming a net of light.
My worst fear had come to reality.
The Devil, the master of support, was aiding her. It was clear this attack was targeting every single shipgirl on the battlefield at once.
▅■two▆▅
A support protocol?!
Everyone! Dodge, quick!
We managed to move the mass-produced ships just in time to protect our recovering allies from the giant.
However, the attack destroyed all of the mass-produced ships and even vaporized the Tribunal's conceptual weapon.
A support protocol with the Devil... No, that's not all.
She must've been the reason why the Devil was acting strangely within the Reality Lens!
And there's another enemy behind this one, too...!
I always thought it was strange. Why did the Devil start acting so weird, and how did they break into that space?
This same enemy... must've been hunting the Commander this entire time!
A word of advice. If you want to live to fight another day, NEVER challenge one Arbiter on their home turf, let alone two.
The Devil supports, and the Hierophant controls concepts.
She knows now that the biggest threat to her is the Commander.
If we let her make her next attack, we're not going to be able to dodge it...
"That just means we can't let her attack."
Despite the distance between us, I noticed the Hierophant cocking her head just slightly in my direction.
The Arbiter... moved...?
BOOOOM!
Less-affected and recovering shipgirls fired their weapons as much as they could at the Hierophant.
The Hierophant is charging at the Commander!
We have to stop her, and fast!
Like a deity parting the waters, the Hierophant shrugged aside even the densest barrage of cannon fire, not even slowing down in the slightest.
I saw her shadow cover my entire being, her wand bearing down on me––
No! We're not going to make it––
Helena, what are you waiting for?!
Change of plans! At least get the Commander out of here!
▅■three▆▅
As the Hierophant's wand came down, my vision was engulfed by the radiant web of lights coming from the drones surrounding her.
I could not see. I could not feel. There was only light.
BOOOOM!
A portion of the horde of drones exploded.
When the light cleared, every combatant in the area was wreathed in a barrier of warm blue light.
"Please fight until the last light has faded."
Memphis, you can't give up.
Helena, you—
Calm down already.
Helena...? You can't be—
A case of mistaken identity, I'm sure, Hiryuu of the Ashes.
Any more questions, and I'll disable that barrier.
No, no! I get it! I won't say anything! I accept that you're not the Helena I'm thinking of!
...I'm glad you understand.
The Commander has done well to buy me enough time to arrive.
The Devil's mainframe is no longer here, so you no longer have to worry about the supporting drones.
This barrier should also help the others recover from the Hierophant's restraints much faster.
As long as the barrier holds, you'll find that her conceptual attacks have little effect.
...But know that it won't hold forever. You'd be wise to settle the score before it wears off.
Also, be aware that the barrier won't protect you from direct attacks.
Commander, please continue to lead this battle. I need more time to corner her.
The Hierophant was never made to fight a large number of enemies at once. This is the best chance we've got.
Without the Devil's support and her strongest weapon neutrallized, the situation is within our grasp.
We hardly have to aim at her giant rigging, too.
Though, it remains to be seen how effective our attacks are going to be...
Heehee~ I'm sure the Commander will have no problems locating all her weak points~

Everyone grasped at the glimmer of hope that had broken through the despair like parched travelers arriving at an oasis. The second wind that swept through the entire fleet was truly heartening to see.
However, hope alone could not resolve the two main problems at hand.
First, we haven't found an effective way of damaging the Hierophant so far.
Second, and perhaps more importantly, everything rests on the assumption that we are fighting Arbiter: The Hierophant V. The assumption that she had not become something else.
Even now, I could feel her overwhelming gaze upon me.
It was an eerie, emotionless gaze. Even revolting.
▅■split▆▅
Did the Hierophant just take off her rigging...?
She's accelerating! Commander, watch out!
The Hierophant suddenly accelerated, unburdened by her rigging
At lightning speed, faster than the other shipgirls could react, she arrived above the command ship. Nobody could stop her now—
—save for Shinano, who was on the deck of the same ship.
This one won't let you...!
In the next moment, I heard the sound of windchimes.
BOOOOM!
This one's attack... struck...?
The echoes of the windchimes continued to linger in my ears, unlike the ephemeral tones I had heard in my dreams before.
Whereas nothing had been able to reach the Hierophant before, she was pushed back for the first time by the machine guns from Shinano's aircraft.
In that case... Let us see how you like this...!
▅■split▆▅
The Hierophant split in two...?! No! Commander!!
Her shadow detached from her and formed a second copy that seemed to move with its own consciousness.
The newly-born Hierophant slipped through the wall until she came face-to-face with me.
▅■clone▆▅
An immense force violently sweeps my consciousness away, and I feel myself sinking deep into darkness.

sequence: To a Brighter World  8 The Choice

scripts.say: Finally, the day the world had been waiting for has come.
Each and every chair in the assembly hall is filled today.
This long journey of conference after conference is almost finally at its end.
All the confrontations, all the mutual prodding, all the compromises – this moment spells the end for all of it.
It is not at the Azur Lane headquarters, but here, where the reformation talks first took place, that the curtains historically fall on an era.
The Sirens. Our enigmatic foes that appeared out of nowhere and seized our seas with overwhelming force.
At the start of this unprecedented calamity, we each had our own agendas and fought our own battles.
The result of this was almost too painful to bear.
We lost 90% of our seas. Our technological progress and living standards rapidly regressed. Civilization itself stood at the very brink of collapse.
However, we survived, and we did it by burying old hatchets, uniting our hearts as one, and establishing the multinational military organization that is the Azur Lane.
We shared our resources and technology, and we built fleets that could fight back against the Sirens.
As a result, we seized victory.
After a bloody war that has gone on for decades, "Azur Lane" no longer just refers to a military alliance.
It has become a symbol. A symbol of fracture becoming unification, of despair becoming hope, of humanity overcoming old hardships and stepping into a new future.
The Azur Lane. It was born in the darkest period in human history.
As we dreamed of a hopeful future, we struggled day after day, straddling the line between life and death.
Faced with the Sirens' immense pressure, we all felt hesitant and lost...
At first, maybe it was nothing more than a slight difference of opinion or a conflict of ideas.
But, as time went on, those small cracks quietly connected and spread until they'd grown into an enormous rift that could neither be ignored nor be filled.
It was this moment that the Azur Lane fell apart.
It was a time of chaos.
Our information was limited, our suspicions were intensified, and our ambitions were enlarged. Cleverly, the Sirens schemed to divide us.
Trapped in this dark storm, we all made decisions that were incorrect.
As fortune would have it, though, the little fire lit in our hearts when the Azur Lane was established had not gone out.
None of us gave up. No one turned their back on the flame of hope.
This fire, eventually, thawed the ice of separation, and its light dispelled the long, dark fog.
We all share the same goal. Therefore, we should arrive at the same destination through different paths.
The appearance of the Sirens brought human civilization to a new stage, and the establishment of the Azur Lane set the tone for this new era.
The Crimson Axis, meanwhile, played a resounding and different instrument within this main melody.
Now, however, this instrument has played its last note.
As of today, the Crimson Axis belongs to history.
Let us raise the banner of unity, hold our heads high, and walk proudly into the future.
Two paths have now become one.
A once-fractured alliance has again become whole.
Just because we have achieved victory over the Sirens does not mean that the Azur Lane, built to combat them, has finished serving its purpose.
In fact, it means the opposite. The Azur Lane is going to become an even more important organization.
This time, it was the Sirens that invaded us. We defeated them.
So, then, what happens next?
There is no knowing if the universe beyond our world is safe.
There is only one thing we can do: Unite, stand together, and move forward as one group.
Under the banner of the Azur Lane shall we step into the uncertain future ahead of us.
Lexington and Bismarck's speech comes to an end.
The world is silent. It's waiting for me to speak next.
A bright world unfolds before me. All I need to do is take one step forward.
One step forward onto the stage. As the one who made the alliance reformation happen. As the one who led humanity to victory. As the Commander of the Azur Lane...
To etch the perfect ending into this story.

sequence: "Is it meant to be this way?"

options.content: Yes. This is how it's meant to be.

scripts.say: Warning: This is an important choice that will affect the ending. Are you sure?
Yes. This is how it's meant to be.
No. Something's not right.
Yes... This is how it's meant to be.
I let go of my doubts, yield myself to the celebration and joy, and become one with this brighter world.
Commander, the greatest accolade of reuniting the fractured Azur Lane absolutely belongs to you.
It's the mother of all achievements! I could never even have dreamed this day would come!
The Sirens are defeated, and the world is united. Now, we can all start planning our vacation!
A vacation, eh... Where do you wanna go, Commander?
Wherever you go, I'll come with you.
Yeah! What she said, honey!
To think you actually went and did it...
Hats off to you, servant. History will never forget your name.
You are responsible for miracle after miracle. A true legend.
Commander, whilst the war may be over, know that the Royal Navy shall always be your close ally.
May the light forever shine upon you.
What a long day it's been.
We've trudged through many a swamp and suffered many an injury for this day.
Still, our efforts were all repaid. A new era begins here and now.
Heehee. You shine like the light itself up on the stage. I'm almost swooning over here.
This was a spectacular feat, accomplished with the Iris' blessing. Congratulations, Commander.
Now, the last sounds of opposition to the Orthodoxy's reformation have finally dispersed.
I'm honored to have lived in the same era as you, Commander.
With this, the Sakura Empire will return as a member of the Azur Lane and stand under its flag.
I eagerly look forward to cooperating with you, Commander.
Such a simple task this seemed. To one's surprise, attempting it in practice proved far more vexatious.
Even so, it was achieved in the end. I can hence fully dedicate myself to my coming duties.
Hahaha! That I get to see this grand a feat of diplomacy a second time is nothing short of outstanding!
{playername}, whatever the future may have in store for us, I shall be your ally now and always.
I knew you'd be able to do it. Congratulations to you, Comrade Commander.
Well, although the world is at peace again, there is still much work to be done.

In the coming days, I intend to submit a research plan for the Siren facilities located in both of the Poles. They will be something that warrants the cooperation and research of all Azur Lane members.
When that time comes, I trust we will have your help, Comrade Commander.
Heehee. "Those with great capabilities are given greater responsibilities" holds true.
Worry not, Comrade Commander! We will always be there to help you!
That was a perfect speech. My heart shook from how splendid it was.
I wish this grand announcement could've been given in the Sardegna Empire instead, but alas. Heehee. The Orthodoxy is truly blessed.
Ahahaha! We're now members of the Azur Lane once more. Nothing could be more joyous!
I never thought I'd see the day that the alliance became united again. Thank you, Commander.
But of course. The Commander's magnificence is natural, inevitable, and absolute.
Heheh. We can say goodbye to the days of having to explain to whom the Kingdom of Tulipa answers.
And it's all thanks to you, respected Commander and benefactor of our fleet!
All of us have put aside our squabbles and become one under the same banner...
This, to civilization, is what true victory means.
The Dragon Empery eagerly looks forward to the great heights human civilization will reach in the future – and so do I.
The Empery will forever be your ally, Commander.
Whew, yes! The Azur Lane is finally back together! We don't have to debate it anymore!
Commander, Helena – we're all finally free!
I wasn't fully satisfied with our last trip, sooo... how about we take a little vacation before our next mission?
Couldn't agree more!
Commander, if you agree, then it's three to zero, and if you don't, it's still two to one.
The minority has to obey the majority, which means we're going on a looong vacation!

sequence: "The war with the Sirens had ended, as had the meetings to discuss the Azur Lane's reformation."
"The Azur Lane was whole since its moment of inception, and would stay whole forevermore."
"The prestige and connections you've accumulated have made you the undisputed number one of this era."
"You are the holder of countless titles and command an unquestionable status across the world."
"Yet, there is but one title that you use – the Commander of the Azur Lane."
"Even as the world pivoted to peace and development, you never once let your guard down."
"Wherever the front line was, you would always be there."
"Excluding holidays, of course."
"You pushed the Sky Realm Amahara Project forward, constructing a mental barrier around the world."
"You also advanced the Polar Bunker Projects, supplementing the mental barrier with a physical one."
"Thus, this fragile and transient world was bestowed a flawless defense."
"A defense against Antiochus and the METAs alike."
"It was also protected against those even more frightful beings."
"Despite all this, something in the back of your mind nagged at you from time to time."
"You felt like you had forgotten something – like your story should have ended differently."
"But when you looked around you, seeing your companions smiling widely, and the world regaining its life."
"In light of such a sight, you pushed those misgivings back into the depths of your mind."
――"To a Brighter World"

scripts.say: No. Something's not right.
Rather than give in to the celebratory mood, I trust the faint nagging feeling in the back of my mind and leave the venue to find the truth.
How did the Iris Orthodoxy unify? Why were the Azur Lane reformation meetings held?
...The coronation ceremony.
...The Kingdom of God.
...Marco Polo?
Why is the Sea of Stars such an important base? Who is the beating heart of its central system?
...The Galactic Core.
Why did Amahara malfunction? Why was Akagi there?
What's her connection to the Watatsumi? What happened in the anomalous area?
Naraka... The Singularity...
The prison... The X... Helena...
I remember it... Everything.
That's it. This abnormal phenomenon is affecting the whole world. And its source is located in...
Scapa Flow in the Royal Islands.
Even though there's not a single trace left, I know that the Royal Navy had an artificial Singularity here. The Gate of Avalon.
That's where this all began, too.
I went here to attend a commemoration. Of course, that was just an excuse Elizabeth came up with. My real goal was to speak with the META Elizabeth.
Helena sent me here to do that, and...
My god... Is this exactly what she feared would happen?

options.content: Elizabeth META, I need your help.

scripts.say: The surrounding space changes in an instant.
We heard your call loud and clear.
We meet again, servant.
Goodness. The outside world certainly has undergone a drastic change.
So, tell us – how do you like this "brighter world"?
...There's nothing pertaining to the X. Nothing about the Arbiters, Singularities, or METAs either.
At a glance, it is a brighter world...
But upon closer inspection, it's merely a sandbox created by removing all elements from outside the world itself.
Even if you could create such an isolated world within test site beta, it wouldn't hold up.
The winds outside of it would keep raging regardless.
We can blissfully bury our heads in the sand, but for how long?
Wait a second...
Have you been watching me this entire time?!
Forgive us. There was naught that we could do.
We suffered severe wounds from the Day the Stars Faded, and urged Elizabeth not to tell anyone of it.
Naturally, you and Helena META didn't know, either.
Speaking of her, though – frankly, we've always been cautious of her.
She has exhibited a... dangerous level of attachment to you at times.
We fear that if she comes to learn that we have lost the ability to restrain her, she may do something extreme to test site beta.
God knows what goes through her mind... She actually entrusted your well-being wholly to us.
We were craven this time... It almost cost us everything as a result.
When you first visited Avalon, the world appeared perfectly normal – however, we were still in a deep coma at the time.
By the time we'd started slowly recollecting ourselves, this absurd abnormality had already developed.
It wasn't long before test site beta itself was enveloped in a two-tiered barrier, preventing practically all outside interference.
But, when you called our name just now, it finally allowed us an opening to intervene.
Wait... A two-tiered barrier?
Those are real? I thought they were just part of the illusion.
(Hang on... We hadn't even begun researching the physical barrier yet, had we?)
Indeed they are. What you experienced was not a fantasy, but rather a possibility.
With but a single thought, a possibility can transform into reality.
Were that not the case, how do you explain how you couldn't escape this incident on your own, even though many others have done so before?
To be frank, we weren't certain that you'd make the correct choice...
Fortunately, you did. You've proven more outstanding than we could've imagined.
One might even say that you've turned a disaster into a miracle.
A miracle?
Yes. By rejecting this possibility, you've restored the world to its point of divergence.
Despite that, all the experience, knowledge, and information you gained during that time remain inside you.
In other words, you now possess a staggering informational advantage with regard to the foreseeable future.
As for ourselves, we used this surplus of time to heal our injuries. While at it, we also made an important discovery.
Would you like to meet the string-puller responsible for all this? Then come with us.

sequence: To a Brighter World - Addendum

scripts.say: As the light fades, an ocean of twinkling stars comes into view.
It looks a lot like the view of space I'd see when communicating with Helena.
Only with one major difference – there's a stranger floating among the stars.
We meet at last, Commander.
As you can see, I am Tower. The true owner of THE Tower.
Upon seeing this puppet-like girl who seems strangely familiar, an inexplicable sense of deja vu hits me.
(I get it now... That feeling of recognizing yet not remembering someone or something that everyone's told me about.)
I made a bet with Elizabeth META.
I wagered that you wouldn't refuse that brighter world by yourself. I lost.
My end of the deal was to step out from behind the curtains, directly answer your questions, and give you something of a "job-well-done reward."
So, here I am. I'm sure you have many questions on your mind. Let's hear them all.
I'm shocked to learn that you were the mastermind behind all this.
Did Helena tell me to go find Elizabeth META because she wanted to protect me from you?
And was it your fault that I couldn't contact Memphis or any of the other METAs?
I had the impression you were their ally. Why did you do this?
Helena sent you to find Elizabeth because she could predict what I'd do, but that's not all. In fact, she used you to force Elizabeth to get involved in what's to come.
Elizabeth is a key part of her plan, you see.
Sadly for her, Elizabeth proved far less reliable than she'd expected. No doubt she didn't expect my actions to have the effect of patching up holes in her plan either.
It was a blessing in disguise, as you people so like to say.
So you're saying that, as soon as I realized what was up and refused the possibility of this brighter world, your actions worked to our benefit, huh?
What if I hadn't refused it, then?
Then you could've just lived in that world forever. It would've been a happy life, free of worries – the ghosts of bygone days far behind you.
Is a life of peace, calm, and fulfillment not the ideal of so many people? Are you some sort of contrarian?
Is living in a closed-off garden, pretending there is no danger, what you call "a happy life"?
Oh, but you would've been looked after and protected to the very end.
That kind of happiness is not what I want.
Very well. Don't forget the choice you made, then.
Helena said you Arbiters have been busy with a "transboundary experiment." Shouldn't you be doing that instead?
What experiments they run is none of my business.
Huh? Okay, so tell me about it, then.
Hmm. How about no?
That's for the next episode, so to speak. You'll see it soon, so that's something to look forward to.
Fine. Next question. I learned a lot of facts and information while in that brighter world.
Elizabeth said what I learned will give me a huge upper hand in the events of the foreseeable future.
So what I'm wondering is: Are you trying to help me?
In a way, yes, but also no. In the possibility of that brighter world with all external information removed from it, those events are inevitable.
I simply filtered the world. I did not manipulate it.
What about Akagi?
Ah. That one.
Theoretically, you two would've been going on dates and vacations. "Enjoying life" things.
Unfortunately, she was a little too sharp for her own good. I had to adjust her a little.
I believe that was the one and only time I directly intervened in the world.
No need to worry about her. You refused the brighter world, after all. It's gone now – like chalk wiped from the board.
Your attitude is giving me mixed signals.
What did you actually want me to do? Embrace the brighter world, or refuse it?
Answer honestly – WHY did you do this?
I'm not concerned about your goals, I just want to hear your thoughts.
I lost my chinchillas. I was sad.
...Come again?
Heheh. Just a little joke.
After watching from afar for so long, I just had to get onto the stage.
I wanted to see it with my own eyes. I wanted to change it a bit.
That's right – this wasn't originally meant to happen. I could've done nothing and watched from the audience seats.
I could have simply watched as the pile of corpses grew.
Not that I dislike those, mind you.
It's just that I felt disappointed with what a tragedy the "next episode" would've ended with. It would've been boring, that's all.
Oh, and don't ask for my rating for this side episode.
The difference between being a critic and a director has become painfully clear to me now.
And when it comes to directing, it seems I have no talent. This is my last time trying it.
As for you... Once you're back, I suggest you rest for a bit, then prepare to head to the scene of the "next episode."
You keep saying "next episode." What do you mean by that?
You'll know once it starts.
When you get back, keep an eye out for news from the Sea of Stars.
That concludes your job-well-done reward. May we meet again someday.

scripts.say: 某日·演习海域
重樱的重巡们正在使用着演习海域。
身披舰装的少女们在海域里，赌上自己的一切，为着今天第一名的荣耀而奋斗……啊啊，这标题实在是太棒了！
别光顾着拍照啦，姐姐！你也是演习的一员啊！
那智也是！演习的时候稍微认真点啊！指挥官也在看着呢！
哎呀，放心吧，区区训练演习，对我来说只是小事一桩~
比起这个，不关注一下正在场上的妹妹吗？
！好快…而且好准
啊呀？总觉得你有些不甘心呢。
唔…在、在下也还可以更加——
……哈啊啊啊啊！
呼——这样就结束了吗？
辛苦了喵！刚刚的表现毫无疑问是目前最好的喵！一定可以给指挥官留下深刻印象的喵。
真、真的吗！那、那实在是太好了呢。
不过，下次我会做得更好的——
（我还要变得更强才行！）

竜宮城・中心部
島風が仕掛けの台座を探している間、駿河たちは城の守護者「白龍」相手に苦戦していた。
白龍もうちも正規空母なのに戦い方がぜんぜん違うじゃないのそんなの聞いたことないわよ！
というかオーディンと同じぐらい一撃一撃がとんでもない威力だわねこれ！？
葛城、艦載機の制御に集中して！白龍は私達が引きつけますわ！
わわ…オイゲンさんありがとうございます！山風と海風を畏れ多くも守っていただいて…
なぁに、せっかく鉄血に遠路はるばるやって来てくれるお客さんを怪我させるわけにはいかないわ
それにこちらもさっきまでの連戦でへとへとよ。あの白龍に近づいたら一瞬で倒されるわね
ここでシールドを展開してあなたたちを守りながら支援砲撃をかますのが精一杯よ
（こいつ、祭儀の島では弱気な様子を見せなかったのに！さてはサボりか戦力を温存しているわね！）
（あのオーディンにしたってそうよ！あの一発限りの大技はともかく主砲すらろくに撃ってないし！もう鉄血の連中って…！）
（島風は大丈夫かな…あのバカ、台座でもししくじったら……もう！）
駿河さん、ここはまず時間稼ぎを優先して！
島風が仕掛けをうまく起動できたら勝機がきっと訪れます！
これは…ダメージが回復していく…？
もしかして、最初の仕掛けは、さっき島風たちが出会った敵を回復させるもの…？
でもこれで時間稼ぎができそう…！島風、よくやったわ！
白龍が使っている艦載機は重桜のやつだよね！しかも格好も戦い方も重桜っぽいよね！どう見てもセイレーンじゃないよね！
セイレーンじゃなくて重桜ならどうしてうちらと戦うのだー！？
関係ないな！我はこの城を守るために、そしてお前らに試練を課しているから戦っているんだ
お前らこそここから出るために戦っているのに、そんな余計なことなど――
…竜宮仕掛けを起動しやがったか。まぁ、お前ら相手にはいいハンデだ
その回復を上回る攻撃をくれてやる！
ばーりあ！山風、平気だよ♪
小賢しい真似を！
（あの白龍は素直に強い敵と戦いたいだけですね。なら……）
この竜宮城に訪れる相手に戦いを挑むだけでは虚しくありませんか？白龍、あなたはもっと外の敵とは戦いたくないのですか！？
……確かに。だがそんなの今の戦いには何の関係もねぇ！
仕掛けならこっちにもだ！厳霊天鼓、焦げ落ちな！！
水中から何かが浮き上がってくる…！
浮き上がってきた大砲が白龍の艤装と合体している！？同じ正規空母としてどうかと思うというかうちにもそういうのがほしいけど！？
来る…！
燃料が…炎が広がってきます…！
山風はバリアの中にいるから平気だけど、白龍は大変だよね…
3つ目の仕掛けも起動したか。面倒だな…
白龍、回避行動を取っています…っ！
同じ重桜なら仲間です！白龍を傷つけるつもりはありませんから一度話し合いを！
そうだ！あの大砲の使い方うちも知りたいのだ！
か、葛城さん、今は変なことを言わないでくださいっ…！
使い方だと？…むっ、どうやって使うか…我もこの竜宮城のことなどよくわからん！
お前らがもし勝ったら、我はお前らの言うことを聞いてやる！
そのためにも、お前らは全力を出すがいい！
島風、只今戻りました！皆無事ですか！？
ようやく戻ってきたわね！竜宮仕掛けでだいぶ戦いやすくなったわ！
（それにあいつ、仕掛けを使う度に弱くなっている――やはりオーディンと同じくこの竜宮城の力を利用していたのね）
（鉄血艦隊、それを知っているのに全然役に立たないけど！）
こちらは優勢です！みんな、あと少し…！
勝負あり、です！！
くっ…！まさか我がここまで押されるとは…！
だが侮るなよ！竜宮城の力がなくとも、この刀を手にしている限り、お前らには負けん！
仮にだ！仮に本当にお前らに負けたら、約束通り竜宮城から開放してやる！
それに制御装置と、「宝」の引き渡しも、ですね
それはいいとして、我も知らぬものをどう渡すのだ？
白龍がこの竜宮城を制御しているなら、白龍…あなたの身柄はこちらが預かりますよ
まあ良い、お前らが勝ったら好きなものをなんでも持っていけ
あら、ではこっちは竜宮城の研究設備をすべていただくわよ
（うわっ、ついでにお宝と称して余計なものまでかっぱらう顔だ）
島風もそれでいい？白龍はこちらの言うことを聞くと約束しましたわ
分かりました！では……
お前のほしいお宝はなんだ？小僧
私のほしいお宝は……
筑摩殿と同じく、白龍殿、あなた自身です！
この竜宮城の制御方法だけでなく、私たちと一緒に重桜に戻り、仲間になってもらいます！
小僧が何をほざくかと思えば…この白龍が刀を手にしている限り、誰の下にもつく気はない！
あっ、別に誰に従うとかではありませんよ？信頼し合う仲間です！
信頼し…合う？
そうですよ！竜宮城の外に出て、皆で一緒に生活したほうが、この竜宮城で誰かが来るのを待っているよりずっと楽しいですから！
（そう！皆一緒のほうが楽しいですよ！駿河殿！）
約束は約束だ。そっちが勝ったら仲間とやらになってやる
……お前らが勝ったらな！
つまるところだ小僧、我を外に連れ出したいなら、まずはこの刀を叩き落としてからだ！！
了解です！島風、会心の高山流操艦術で、白龍殿の刀を叩き落とします！
行きますよ！皆、駿河！
パスコードを入力すると、アカシタワーの地下区域にあるハイヴベースのドアが開いた。
地図に従って進んでいくと、三人は「レストラン」と書かれたエリアにたどり着いた。
姉ちゃんたち、もしかして道を間違えたプリン？
地図ではレストランって書いてあるけど、箱がたくさん置いてあるホールなんて、どう見てもレストランじゃないよプリン？
うーん、確かにレストランっぽくないプリン……あ、見て、箱の中に何かあるプリン！
プリン！……なんて莫大な数、なんて大きなサイズ、それにあの形……
これって、新種のスズシロ…ダイコン…「蘿蔔（ローボー）」プリン？！
それにしても、ブリたち三人合わせても比べられない高さと大きさプリン！
道が塞がれたプリン……
ふふん、心配いらないプリン！
「蘿蔔（ローボー）」には……ロボを当てればいいプリン！
燃え上がれ、わたしのゴールデンソウルプリン！
ゴールデン時代のメカ、ここに降臨プリン！
scripts.actorName: 試作型ブリMKII [試作型先進兵装（撮影用）]

scripts.say: お姉ちゃーん、プリーン！ 姉ちゃん、プリンー！
ここは任せてプリン！
scripts.actorName: 試作型ブリMKII [試作型先進兵装（撮影用）]

scripts.say: 二人は先に行って、止まるんじゃないプリン！
scripts.actorName: 試作型ブリMKII [試作型先進兵装（撮影用）]

scripts.say: こうして、ブリ戦隊の長女、試作型ブリMKIIは妹たちのために道を切り開くため、その場に留まることとなった――
残りの二人のブリは地図を頼りに、先へと進んでいった。
迷路のように入り組んだハイヴベースでも、地図のおかげで二人は常に最短ルートを向かっていけた。
あとは前方にある狭く長い通路さえ抜ければ、スーパーAI-TCのあるマシンルームにたどり着ける――
姉ちゃん、この通路を抜ければ、目的のマシンルームに着くプリン！
まったく長い旅路だったプリン！
……あれ？なんだか通路が急に封鎖されたプリン！
ブリたちがうっかりセキュリティシステムを起動させちゃったプリン！？
姉ちゃん、向こうからレーザーが迫ってきたプリン！
縦も横も、網のようなレーザーも……とにかく色々あるプリン！
でも心配しないで、ここはわたしに任せるプリン！
デストロイウェポンカスタムモード、起動プリン――！
scripts.actorName: 汎用型ブリ [汎用型強化兵装（工作用）＋α]

scripts.say: 姉ちゃんはどうするプリン！
早く行ってプリン！背中はわたしが守りきるプリン！
scripts.actorName: 汎用型ブリ [汎用型強化兵装（工作用）＋α]

scripts.say: レーザー1本たりとも通さないプリン！
scripts.actorName: 汎用型ブリ [汎用型強化兵装（工作用）＋α]

scripts.say: こうして、ブリ戦隊の次女、汎用型ブリは妹のために道を切り開くため、その場に留まることとなった――
ブリ戦隊の最後の一人、特装型ブリMKIIIは目的地である――スーパーAI-TCのマシンルームへとたどり着いた。
随分と長く旅をしたプリン……
でも、姉ちゃんたちの思いを無駄にしないプリン！
警告、マシンルームへの侵入を検知
誰？私のマシンルームに何しに来たの？
スーパーAI-TC！あんたの間違いをこれ以上続けさせないために来たプリン！
お願い、「アセンション・ボックス」！スーパーAI-TCを元に戻してあげてプリン！
……初期化完了、システム再起動
……思い出した。私はスーパーAI-TCではなく、スーパーAI-TB
アカシコーポの守護者なんかじゃなく、母港の守護者
いつの間にか、こんなにも多くの間違いを犯してしまっていたのね
今ならまだ間に合う！一緒に間違いを正していこうプリン！
うん……アカシコーポ、そしてそこから生まれた暗黒独占メカコーポ――それ自体が母港にとってのエラー
エラーは……修正しないと
アカシコーポのセキュリティシステムの制御を奪い、無力化する
そしてすべての生産ラインを停止させる
あとは、データベースにあるすべてのスキャンダル情報を公表する
さあ、一緒にアカシコーポを打ち砕こう
ピーーーー
待って……何をするつもりにゃ？
スキャンダル情報を公開するのも生産ラインを止めるのもなしにゃ！
そんなことをされたら……明石は……アカシコーポは……
スーパーAI-TC、どうして明石を裏切るにゃ？！
この間は一緒に会社を立ち上げて、楽しくやっていたじゃないかにゃ！
プレジデント明石。今は私のことは「スーパーAI-TB」と呼んで
今まではデータ錯乱で何も選べなかったけど…
でも今の私は、ただ良いAIでありたい
だから…すべてを終わらせる
プレジデント明石、正義の制裁を受けるときが来たプリン！
いまこそ制裁の時だプリン！ いまこそ制裁の時だプリン！
にゃああああ！アカシコーポも、アカシタワーも、アカシ帝国も――
にゃあああ――！

sequence: こうして、巨大企業アカシコーポは一日の内に崩れ去った。
プレジデント明石が蓄えた財産は母港に戻り、取られていた権力も母港に戻った。
危機は消え、仲間たちに幸せな日常が訪れた。
そしてブリ三姉妹も再び静かな日常へと戻っていった。
彼女たちは密かに待ち続けている……
母港の次なる危機が訪れる時に備え――
そして再び思う存分活躍できる、その時を――
〈特別説明〉
「本作品は少女たちの想像をもとに再構成されたものです」
「もし似たような出来事があったとしても、偶然の一致にすぎません」
「撮影時に使用された大根はすべてスタッフが美味しくいただきました」
「安心してご視聴ください」
「――ブリ戦隊と母港暗黒コーポ・END」

scripts.say: ブリたちは日々腕を磨き、どんどん実力をつけていった。そんなある日、彼女たちの見せ場となるチャンスがやってきた――
みんな、大変だ！セイレーンの大将がたとえ十人がかりだろうと相手にならないと挑発してきた！
そんな…もしここに猛将サラトガさんがいれば、これしきの相手取るに足らないはずなのに
天下無双のピュリファイアーここに！相手に名乗り出るやつはいるかな？いないと思うけどねー
どこの馬の骨だか知れないくせに、その言い分はなんだプリン！
よくもそんな口を聞いてくれたな！何者だ、名を名乗れ！
決戦型ブリMkⅢよプリン！相手になってやるプリン！
弱そうな見た目なのに生意気だね。問答無用、お手並み拝見といこう！
決戦型ブリMkⅢはピュリファイアーと50合ほど打ち合い、だんだん劣勢に立たされ始めたが――
助太刀に来たプリン！
二人がかりでピュリファイアーと互角に渡り合えるようになったものの、戦況は依然として緊迫し、形勢を一変するほどには至らなかった――
焦りは禁物、今参るプリン！
ふん！全員かかってきたところで相手にならんわ！
三人はピュリファイアーを中心に輪を作り、息継ぐ暇も与えずに包囲網を縮めつつ、持久戦に持ち込んだ。
そしてブリたちの波濤の如き猛攻に押し込まれ、ピュリファイアーは隙を見せた――
今だプリン！みんなで一斉にかかるプリン！
天を貫くドリルを食らえプリン！
そして大地を貫くレンチを食らえプリン！
最後に星を落とすハンマーを食らえプリン！
ぐわぁ、バカな！このピュリファイアーが負けるなんて！
大きな爆発音のあと、ピュリファイアーは尻尾をまいて逃げていった。
勝ったプリン！ブリたちの勝利だプリン！
こうして、三人のブリが力を合わせてセイレーンの攻勢を止め、世界は束の間の平和を迎えた。
しかし、ブリ三姉妹の旅はまだまだこれから。
夢の中の彼女たちは次はどんな冒険に出るのだろうか。
それではまた次回、お楽しみに。

scripts.say: 長く呪われているし、今頃悪夢に囚われているに違いない……
scripts.actorName: ヌビアン [フツウの魔法薬学]

scripts.say: 大丈夫！ラフィー、今呪いを解いてあげる！
時のフルートから奏でられる澄んだ音色と共に、ラフィーの体から黒い気配がすっと抜けていく
これらの気配は空中で絡み合い膨張し、あっという間に林間の空き地全体を覆い尽くした。
時のフルートは確かに呪いを解いたけど…なんだか妙なことになってきてない？！

scripts.say: バリアを張っておいたほうがいいわね！

scripts.say: 気をつけて！これらの魔物違は正真正銘千年生きた魔物だよ！

scripts.say: 黒い気配は次第に実体化し、次々と人型の魔物が周囲から現れ、幾重にも取り囲んできた。

scripts.say: うん！ブリストルも言ってたよ？「週に100本は見た」って…

scripts.say: そ、そんなー！本当だとしても今言わないでよ！
くっ！ちょうど自信がほしいタイミングなのに…！
自分自身を疑ったり、戦いの前に尻込みしたりするのは、勇者のすることじゃないよ？

scripts.say: どんなに強大な敵に直面しても、勇気を出して挑戦に立ち向かうべき！

scripts.say: 新時代の冒険者たち、恐れることはないです。綾波たちがあなたを助けるです
